questions.stem: Dreamhouse Realty requires that field value changes for certain fields such as Asking_Price__c and Real_Estate_Agent__c on their House__c custom object show up prominently on Chatter. Which Chatter feature should the app builder use?
questions.explanationEs: Feed Tracking se activa por objeto en Setup y permite elegir los campos (hasta 20) cuyos cambios de valor se publican automáticamente en el feed de Chatter del registro, que es justo lo que pide Dreamhouse para Asking_Price__c y Real_Estate_Agent__c. Topics solo etiqueta y agrupa publicaciones, Publisher Actions son acciones que el usuario lanza a mano desde el publicador y Pin Field no es una función de Chatter para registrar cambios de campos.
questions.explanationEn: Feed Tracking is enabled per object in Setup and lets you choose the fields (up to 20) whose value changes are posted automatically to the record's Chatter feed, which is exactly what Dreamhouse needs for Asking_Price__c and Real_Estate_Agent__c. Topics only tag and group posts, Publisher Actions are actions a user launches manually from the publisher, and Pin Field is not a Chatter feature for recording field changes.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks has five years of sales data and would like to track when customers made their first purchase. How should an app builder use a roll-up summary to meet the requirements?

options.text: Create a new date field called First Order Date, then create roll-up summary to update the field using Type MIN.
Create a new roll-up summary field called First Order Date, Using type MIN on the Opportunity Close Date with a filter where iswon = TRUE.
Create a new date field called First Order Date, then set the date using a roll-up summary on Opportunity Close Date.
Create a new roll-up summary field called First Order Date using type SUM on Opportunity Close Date.

questions.explanationEs: Un roll-up summary es en sí mismo un tipo de campo que se crea en el objeto padre; Account admite roll-ups sobre sus Opportunities, y el tipo MIN sobre Close Date con el filtro IsWon = TRUE devuelve la fecha de la primera venta ganada. No se puede crear un campo de fecha normal y luego «rellenarlo» con un roll-up, porque un roll-up summary no actualiza otros campos. SUM solo admite campos de número, moneda o porcentaje, así que no sirve sobre una fecha.
questions.explanationEn: A roll-up summary is itself a field type created on the parent object; Account supports roll-ups over its Opportunities, and MIN on Close Date filtered by IsWon = TRUE returns the date of the first won deal. You can't create a plain date field and then have a roll-up 'fill it in', because a roll-up summary doesn't update other fields. SUM only works on number, currency and percent fields, so it can't be used on a date.

questions.stem: The CFO of Cloud Kicks needs to sign off on any major shoe retail deal that has a discount of more than 30% before the deal can be closed. Which feature should be used to handle this requirement?
questions.explanationEs: Un Approval Process (o un Flow Approval Process) envía el registro al CFO para que lo apruebe o lo rechace y puede bloquearlo mientras tanto, de modo que una operación con más de un 30 % de descuento no se cierra sin su visto bueno. Un Email Alert o un mensaje de Slack solo avisan a alguien y un Field Update solo cambia un valor; ninguno recoge una aprobación formal.
questions.explanationEn: An Approval Process (or a Flow Approval Process) routes the record to the CFO to approve or reject and can lock it in the meantime, so a deal with a discount above 30% can't close without sign-off. An Email Alert or a Slack message only notify someone and a Field Update only changes a value; none of them captures a formal approval.

questions.stem: Sales reps at Universal Containers create multiple quotes per opportunity. Which automation tool should an app builder recommend to delete rejected quotes?
questions.explanationEs: Flow es la herramienta declarativa que puede borrar registros: un record-triggered flow sobre Quote que se ejecute cuando el estado pase a Rejected (o un schedule-triggered flow) usa el elemento Delete Records. Un Approval process solo gestiona aprobaciones, una Validation rule solo impide guardar datos incorrectos y Einstein Next Best Action muestra recomendaciones al usuario; ninguno elimina registros.
questions.explanationEn: Flow is the declarative tool that can delete records: a record-triggered flow on Quote that runs when the status changes to Rejected (or a schedule-triggered flow) uses the Delete Records element. An Approval process only handles approvals, a Validation rule only blocks bad data from being saved, and Einstein Next Best Action shows recommendations to users; none of them deletes records.

questions.stem: The marketing director is concerned that too many car parts were given away for free last year. They want to track discounts, samples, and Giveaways by Sales Rep. The manager's sign-off on free parts also needs to be processed. Which functionality should an app builder use to meet these requirements?
questions.explanationEs: El requisito decisivo es que el responsable apruebe las piezas gratuitas, y eso es lo que hace un Approval process: envía el registro al aprobador, lo bloquea y deja constancia de la decisión, que luego se puede analizar por comercial en informes. Quotes sirve para presentar precios y descuentos pero no gestiona la aprobación por sí solo, un Check box solo guarda un valor sin enrutar nada y High Velocity Sales es para cadencias de ventas.
questions.explanationEn: The deciding requirement is the manager's sign-off on free parts, and that is what an Approval process does: it routes the record to the approver, locks it and records the decision, which can then be reported by sales rep. Quotes present pricing and discounts but don't handle approval on their own, a Check box only stores a value without routing anything, and High Velocity Sales is for sales cadences.

questions.stem: An app builder installs an unmanaged package in a full copy sandbox that is an exact match for production, and now they are ready to install it in production. The app builder attempts to install the package in production, and it fails. Why did the package fail to install?
questions.explanationEs: Como el full copy sandbox es idéntico a producción, un problema de licencias, de funciones no compatibles o de límites de objetos ya habría aparecido al instalar el paquete en el sandbox. La diferencia está en que, al instalar en producción un paquete que contiene Apex, se ejecutan sus pruebas unitarias y todas deben pasar; si alguna falla, la instalación se revierte.
questions.explanationEn: Because the full copy sandbox is an exact match for production, a license, feature compatibility or object limit problem would already have shown up when the package was installed in the sandbox. The difference is that installing a package that contains Apex in production runs its unit tests, and they must all pass; if any test fails, the installation is rolled back.

questions.stem: DreamHouse Realty (DR) is expanding into subsidized housing by partnering with local government entities. DR uses Sales Cloud and has Enabled field history tracking on the Opportunity object. Due to increased information requirements, the App Dev team is changing Text Area (Long) fields To Rich Text fields to allow for up to 1,000 characters and better descriptions. Which two considerations should be made by the team? Choose 2 answers

options.text: Data loss may occur when changing custom field types.
Audit Trail is available through REST API extracts.
Rich text field values of all lengths are displayed fully in reports.
Field History Tracking records value changes of 255 characters or less.

questions.explanationEs: Cambiar el tipo de un campo personalizado puede provocar pérdida de datos o de formato, así que conviene revisarlo y hacer una copia antes de convertir los Text Area (Long) en Rich Text. Además, Field History Tracking solo guarda el valor antiguo y el nuevo cuando tienen 255 caracteres o menos; en campos más largos solo registra que el campo se editó. Los informes no muestran completos los valores largos de Rich Text, y el Setup Audit Trail registra cambios de configuración, no de datos, así que no es una consideración para esta conversión.
questions.explanationEn: Changing a custom field's type can cause data or formatting loss, so it should be reviewed and backed up before converting Text Area (Long) fields to Rich Text. Also, Field History Tracking only stores the old and new values when they are 255 characters or less; for longer values it only records that the field was edited. Reports don't show long Rich Text values in full, and Setup Audit Trail records configuration changes, not data changes, so it isn't a consideration for this conversion.

questions.stem: Universal Containers wants to collaborate with its customers within Salesforce and has decided to enable the Allow Customer Invitations in the Chatter Settings. Which permission is granted to customers when invited to a Chatter group?

options.text: The ability to invite members to groups of which they are a member.
The ability to interact with members of their groups.
The ability to mention accounts of which they are a contact.
The ability to request access to public groups.

questions.explanationEs: Con Allow Customer Invitations activado, los clientes invitados a un grupo de Chatter solo ven los grupos a los que se les ha invitado y solo pueden interactuar con los miembros de esos grupos. No pueden invitar a otras personas, no ven registros de Salesforce como las cuentas para mencionarlas y tampoco pueden ver ni pedir acceso a grupos públicos.
questions.explanationEn: With Allow Customer Invitations enabled, customers invited to a Chatter group can see only the groups they were invited to and can interact only with the members of those groups. They can't invite other people, can't see Salesforce records such as accounts to mention them, and can't see or request access to public groups.

questions.stem: Universal Containers wants customers to be able to open cases from a public-facing website. What should the app builder use to enable visitors to the website?
questions.explanationEs: Web-to-Case genera un formulario HTML que se inserta en la web pública y crea un Case en Salesforce cada vez que un visitante lo envía, sin que necesite usuario ni inicio de sesión. Email-to-Case crea casos a partir de correos, no de un formulario web; un Outbound message envía datos desde Salesforce a un sistema externo; y un Screen flow exigiría montar además un sitio de Experience Cloud con usuario invitado, así que no es la solución estándar.
questions.explanationEn: Web-to-Case generates an HTML form that you embed in the public website, and it creates a Case in Salesforce every time a visitor submits it, without needing a user or login. Email-to-Case creates cases from emails, not from a web form; an Outbound message sends data from Salesforce to an external system; and a Screen flow would also require an Experience Cloud site with a guest user, so it isn't the standard solution.

questions.stem: The Universal Containers data manager has been complaining about the lack of data integrity on Contact records. Sales reps have not been filling out the Region field. The data manager wants the Region field filled out only for Contacts that are associated to Accounts that have been marked as 'High Priority' on the Customer Status field. What can the app builder do to fulfil this requirement?

options.text: Create a validation rule on Account.
Make the Customer Status field required on Account.
Create a validation rule on Contact.
Make the Region field required on Contact.

questions.explanationEs: La comprobación debe hacerse al guardar el Contact, porque el campo que falta es Region; una validation rule en Contact puede leer el Account padre y dar error cuando su Customer Status es High Priority y Region está vacío. Hacer Region obligatorio en Contact lo exigiría en todos los contactos, y una regla en Account o hacer obligatorio Customer Status no controlan lo que se guarda en los contactos.
questions.explanationEn: The check has to run when the Contact is saved, because the missing field is Region; a validation rule on Contact can read the parent Account and raise an error when its Customer Status is High Priority and Region is blank. Making Region required on Contact would enforce it for every contact, and a rule on Account or making Customer Status required doesn't control what is saved on contacts.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks wants to make sure that users without the Marketing role are unable to update the Contact Retail Opt In picklist field to Yes. Which validation rule should an app builder use to prevent other users from making this update?
questions.reviewNote: El PDF pierde los operadores y los guiones bajos de las fórmulas (en la opción C aparece «=» donde debe ir «<>»). Se mantiene la clave C de la fuente, que es la única que combina rol distinto de Marketing, ISCHANGED e ISPICKVAL, y se reconstruye el texto de las cuatro fórmulas. La explicación de la fuente habla de visibilidad de componentes y no corresponde a esta pregunta.
questions.explanationEs: Una validation rule bloquea el guardado cuando su fórmula devuelve TRUE, así que debe combinar tres condiciones: que el rol del usuario no sea Marketing, ISCHANGED sobre el campo (para que solo actúe cuando alguien modifica el valor) e ISPICKVAL para comprobar que el nuevo valor del picklist es Yes. Las fórmulas que comparan el picklist directamente con un texto no son válidas, porque un picklist solo se evalúa con ISPICKVAL. La fórmula sin ISCHANGED bloquearía cualquier edición de un registro que ya tiene Yes, aunque el usuario no toque ese campo.
questions.explanationEn: A validation rule blocks the save when its formula returns TRUE, so it must combine three conditions: the user's role is not Marketing, ISCHANGED on the field (so it only fires when someone modifies the value), and ISPICKVAL to check that the new picklist value is Yes. Formulas that compare the picklist directly with a text string are invalid, because a picklist can only be evaluated with ISPICKVAL. The formula without ISCHANGED would block any edit to a record that already has Yes, even when the user does not touch that field.

questions.stem: Universal Containers has the Account object's Organization-Wide Default set to Private. The marketing team owns Accounts; however, they also Need to be able to see the sales team's Accounts. Both the sales and marketing teams are in completely different branches of the role hierarchy. Which feature should be used to enable marketing to see sales-owned accounts?
questions.explanationEs: Con el OWD de Account en Private y los equipos de Sales y Marketing en ramas distintas de la jerarquía de roles, la jerarquía no da visibilidad entre ellos, así que hay que abrir el acceso con una sharing rule (por propietario o por criterios) que comparta las cuentas de Sales con Marketing. Un public group solo reúne usuarios y sirve como destino dentro de la regla, pero por sí solo no concede acceso. Los aliases no son un control de seguridad y las assignment rules solo asignan propietario a leads y cases, no comparten registros.
questions.explanationEn: With the Account OWD set to Private and the Sales and Marketing teams in different branches of the role hierarchy, the hierarchy gives no visibility between them, so access has to be opened with a sharing rule (owner-based or criteria-based) that shares Sales-owned accounts with Marketing. A public group only collects users and serves as a target inside the rule, but it grants no access on its own. Aliases are not a security control, and assignment rules only assign ownership of leads and cases, they do not share records.

questions.stem: When an opportunity has a closed date that is pushed more than 30 days, manager approval is required. An approval process is in place but Reps frequently forget to submit for approval to run the process. How can an app builder ensure that these opportunities are submitted into the approval process?

options.text: Change the entry criteria on the approval process to criteria are met and lock the record on initial submission.
Use a validation rule and an email alert to the manager requesting approval.
Submit the record for approval from an automated process.
Give the manager the "API Enabled" permission to permit approval responses by email.

questions.explanationEs: El fallo es que el envío depende de que los reps se acuerden, así que hay que enviar el registro desde automatización: hoy, un record-triggered flow que se dispara cuando la fecha de cierre se retrasa más de 30 días y usa la acción Submit for Approval. Cambiar los criterios de entrada del approval process solo decide qué registros pueden entrar, no los envía por sí mismo. Una validation rule con un email alert solo avisa al manager sin iniciar el proceso, y el permiso API Enabled no tiene relación con el envío automático. Process Builder está retirado para automatización nueva, por lo que no es la opción actual.
questions.explanationEn: The weakness is that submission depends on reps remembering, so the record has to be submitted from automation: today, a record-triggered flow that fires when the close date is pushed more than 30 days and uses the Submit for Approval action. Changing the entry criteria of the approval process only decides which records may enter, it does not submit them by itself. A validation rule with an email alert merely notifies the manager without starting the process, and the API Enabled permission has nothing to do with automatic submission. Process Builder is retired for new automation, so it is no longer the current choice.

questions.stem: An app builder at Universal Containers has been asked to add the Chatter feed to a custom object record page. Which approach should the app builder use?

options.text: Add a custom Chatter feed component.
Add the standard Chatter feed component.
Add the Chatter feed component from the AppExchange.
Add the standard related list component.

questions.explanationEs: Lightning App Builder incluye el componente estándar Chatter (antes llamado Feed), que coloca el publisher y el feed en una Lightning record page, así que basta con arrastrarlo a la página del objeto personalizado. No hace falta crear un componente personalizado ni buscar uno en AppExchange. El componente estándar Related List muestra registros relacionados, no el feed de Chatter.
questions.explanationEn: Lightning App Builder includes the standard Chatter component (formerly called Feed), which places the publisher and feed on a Lightning record page, so it is enough to drag it onto the custom object's page. There is no need to build a custom component or look for one on AppExchange. The standard Related List component shows related records, not the Chatter feed.

questions.stem: Universal Containers wants to improve the process to create Opportunity records related to an Account. Many fields can be populated Based on the Account record. Some fields require input from the user. What should an app builder configure to meet the requirement?

options.text: Quick Action on the Account object
Assignment rule triggered from Account update
Quick Action on the Opportunity object.
Assignment rule triggered from Opportunity update

questions.explanationEs: Una object-specific action de tipo Create a Record definida en el objeto Account, que crea la Opportunity, se ejecuta en el contexto de la cuenta: puede rellenar muchos campos con valores predefinidos o tomados de la cuenta y dejar el resto para que los introduzca el usuario. Una acción definida en el objeto Opportunity no parte del contexto de una cuenta concreta, así que no sirve para crear la oportunidad desde la cuenta. Las assignment rules solo asignan propietario a leads y cases: no crean registros ni rellenan campos.
questions.explanationEn: An object-specific Create a Record action defined on the Account object, creating the Opportunity, runs in the context of the account: it can fill many fields with predefined values or values taken from the account and leave the rest for the user to enter. An action defined on the Opportunity object does not start from a specific account, so it does not help create the opportunity from the account. Assignment rules only assign ownership of leads and cases: they neither create records nor populate fields.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks is implementing an approval process for opportunities that requires managers to approve all opportunities above $50,000 before they can be marked as Closed Won. Which two delivery methods can a manager utilize to respond to approval requests in the Salesforce Mobile app? Choose 2 answers
questions.explanationEs: En la app móvil de Salesforce, el manager recibe una notificación in-app cuando le llega una solicitud de aprobación y también la encuentra en el elemento Approval Requests del menú de navegación, desde donde puede aprobarla o rechazarla. La pantalla Home no es un canal de aprobaciones, y Record Detail muestra los datos del registro pero no entrega la solicitud al aprobador.
questions.explanationEn: In the Salesforce mobile app, the manager gets an in-app notification when an approval request arrives and also finds it under the Approval Requests item in the navigation menu, from where it can be approved or rejected. The Home screen is not an approval channel, and Record Detail shows the record's data but does not deliver the request to the approver.

questions.stem: The brokers at DreamHouse Realty (DR) are having an issue When using the Salesforce mobile app on their iPhones. There are several Key fields on the contact record they need access to at a glance. Because of the small screen, they currently have to scroll down the page to view the Information. What should the app builder at DR use to configure the Salesforce mobile app to show these key fields at the top of the screen?
questions.explanationEs: El compact layout define los campos clave que se muestran en el área de highlights en la parte superior de un registro en la app móvil de Salesforce, que es justo lo que necesitan los brokers para ver los datos sin hacer scroll. La mobile navigation solo configura los elementos del menú, el componente Record Detail muestra los campos más abajo en la página y una object-specific action ofrece una operación, pero no muestra datos.
questions.explanationEn: The compact layout defines the key fields shown in the highlights area at the top of a record in the Salesforce mobile app, which is exactly what the brokers need to see the data without scrolling. Mobile navigation only configures the menu items, the Record Detail component shows the fields further down the page, and an object-specific action offers an operation but does not display data.

questions.stem: Nickname__c is a custom text field on a contact record that is Utilized to override the contact name appearing on an email template. This Field is not required and is not always filled in. Which formula should an app builder use to select the contact's preferred Name for email communications?
questions.explanationEs: ISBLANK es la función adecuada para comprobar si un campo de texto está vacío, así que IF(NOT(ISBLANK(Nickname__c)), Nickname__c, FirstName) devuelve el apodo cuando existe y el nombre de pila en caso contrario. BLANKVALUE devuelve un valor, no un booleano, por lo que no puede ir dentro de NOT. ISNULL no se recomienda para campos de texto y, además, la versión mostrada tiene la lógica invertida; TEXT() convierte a texto en lugar de evaluar una condición.
questions.explanationEn: ISBLANK is the right function to check whether a text field is empty, so IF(NOT(ISBLANK(Nickname__c)), Nickname__c, FirstName) returns the nickname when it exists and the first name otherwise. BLANKVALUE returns a value, not a Boolean, so it cannot go inside NOT. ISNULL is not recommended for text fields and the version shown also has inverted logic; TEXT() converts to text instead of evaluating a condition.

questions.stem: A company needs to evaluate all open Cases related to an Account when that Account's status changes to "Critical". The flow must loop through the retrieved Cases, change their Priority to "High", and then update all modified records in a single database operation. Which combination of Flow elements must the company use inside the loop to store the changes before updating the database?

options.text: A Decision element and an Update Records element
An Assignment element and a Collection Filter element
An Assignment element and a collection variable
A Loop element and a Get Records element

questions.explanationEs: Dentro del Loop, un Assignment element pone Priority en High en el Case actual y lo añade a una collection variable; después del Loop, un único Update Records actualiza toda la colección con una sola operación DML. Un Update Records dentro del bucle haría una operación por registro y podría superar los governor limits, y un Get Records dentro del bucle repetiría consultas. Collection Filter solo filtra una colección existente: no sirve para acumular los cambios.
questions.explanationEn: Inside the Loop, an Assignment element sets Priority to High on the current Case and adds it to a collection variable; after the Loop, a single Update Records updates the whole collection in one DML operation. An Update Records inside the loop would perform one operation per record and could hit governor limits, and a Get Records inside the loop would repeat queries. Collection Filter only filters an existing collection: it does not accumulate the changes.

questions.stem: The marketing team at Universal Containers has a list of 400 leads it wants to upload to Salesforce. The team needs to avoid creating duplicate records. Which two actions should be taken to meet this requirement? Choose 2 answers

options.text: Use Data Loader's update function to import leads and match to existing Records based on e-mail address.
Upload the lead list using the Import Wizard and select a Matching Type to Prevent duplicate lead creation.
Enable Duplicate Matching in the Data Management section in Setup and Activate the Lead-to-Lead scenario.
Utilize a Lead Matching Rule and corresponding Duplicate Rule to block newly Created duplicate leads.

questions.explanationEs: Para no crear duplicados al cargar 400 leads se puede usar el Data Import Wizard con un matching type (por ejemplo por email), que evita insertar leads que ya existen, y completarlo con una matching rule de Lead y una duplicate rule que bloquee la creación de duplicados. La operación update de Data Loader solo modifica registros existentes (necesita el Id) y no inserta los leads nuevos, así que no resuelve la carga. Activar un escenario Lead-to-Lead en Data Management no es la forma de configurarlo: se hace con matching rules y duplicate rules.
questions.explanationEn: To avoid creating duplicates when loading 400 leads, you can use the Data Import Wizard with a matching type (for example by email), which prevents inserting leads that already exist, and complement it with a Lead matching rule and a duplicate rule that blocks the creation of duplicates. The Data Loader update operation only modifies existing records (it needs the Id) and does not insert the new leads, so it does not solve the load. Activating a Lead-to-Lead scenario in Data Management is not how this is configured: it is done with matching rules and duplicate rules.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks wants to display the number of Opportunity records associated with each Account. Which solution should be used?
questions.explanationEs: Un campo Roll-up Summary en Account de tipo COUNT sobre Opportunity muestra automáticamente cuántas oportunidades tiene cada cuenta, sin código. Un campo de fórmula solo lee campos del propio registro o de registros padre, así que no puede contar registros hijos. Un campo Lookup solo crea la relación y no calcula nada, y una solución de AppExchange sería innecesaria para algo que la plataforma ya resuelve de forma estándar.
questions.explanationEn: A Roll-up Summary field on Account with the COUNT type over Opportunity automatically shows how many opportunities each account has, with no code. A formula field only reads fields from its own record or from parent records, so it cannot count child records. A Lookup field only creates the relationship and calculates nothing, and an AppExchange offering would be unnecessary for something the platform already solves out of the box.

questions.stem: Universal Containers (UC) wants to delete data in several fields for 5,000 Lead records. UC exported the selected record Ids and fields that need to have data deleted in a CSV file. Which two steps should an app builder suggest to meet these requirements? Choose 2 answers

options.text: Use Import Wizard to update leads using the CSV file.
Use Data Loader to update leads using the CSV file.
Select Insert Null Values in Settings.

questions.explanationEs: Para vaciar campos en 5.000 Leads hay que hacer un update con Data Loader usando el CSV con los Ids y las celdas de esos campos en blanco, y activar Insert Null Values en Settings; sin ese ajuste Data Loader ignora las celdas vacías y deja los valores como estaban. Import Wizard no puede escribir valores nulos para borrar datos existentes, por lo que no sirve. Seleccionar el record type correcto no tiene relación con borrar valores de campos.
questions.explanationEn: To clear fields on 5,000 Leads you run a Data Loader update with the CSV that holds the record Ids and blank cells for those fields, and turn on Insert Null Values in Settings; without that setting Data Loader ignores empty cells and leaves the values as they were. Import Wizard cannot write null values to wipe existing data, so it does not work. Selecting the correct record type has nothing to do with deleting field values.

questions.stem: When a deal is closed-won, it has to be approved by the owner's Manager prior to being added to the leaderboard for a quarterly sales Competition. An opportunity is won on the last day of the quarter and the Manager is on vacation. What is recommended to ensure all of the appropriate deals are reviewed and the leaderboard is up to date?

options.text: Have the manager's assistant reassign the approval request.
Use a quick action to forward the approval request to the next level approver.
Set up a delegated approver for the manager.
Use an assignment rule to automatically assign a delegated approver.

questions.explanationEs: Un delegated approver configurado para el manager puede aprobar o rechazar las solicitudes en su nombre mientras está de vacaciones, así que los deals de cierre de trimestre se revisan a tiempo y el leaderboard queda al día. Que la asistente reasigne la solicitud es un paso manual y reactivo, y reenviar con una quick action no es el mecanismo previsto para una ausencia planificada. Las assignment rules asignan registros como Leads o Cases, no delegados de aprobación.
questions.explanationEn: A delegated approver set up for the manager can approve or reject requests on the manager's behalf during the vacation, so the quarter-end deals get reviewed on time and the leaderboard stays current. Having the assistant reassign the request is a manual, reactive step, and forwarding with a quick action is not the intended mechanism for a planned absence. Assignment rules assign records such as Leads or Cases, not delegated approvers.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks currently deflects its customers to a help article when they have questions about shipping, including package location, delays, and complaints. Cloud Kicks wants to automate this experience with dynamic, real-time support. What should a Platform App Builder recommend?

options.text: Create an approval flow to route customer shipping questions to a specific approver.
Use Agentforce to take actions such as looking up missing packages, verifying shipping delays, and offering discount codes.
Set up scheduled email templates to all customers with links to help articles regarding shipping and delays.
Embed a Screen Flow on Cloud Kicks ' external site for users to submit details about their problem to create a Case.

questions.explanationEs: Un agente de Agentforce puede atender al cliente en tiempo real y ejecutar acciones (basadas en Flow o Apex) como localizar un paquete perdido, comprobar retrasos de envío u ofrecer un código de descuento, que es justo la experiencia dinámica que se pide. Un approval flow solo enruta aprobaciones internas y no atiende a clientes. Los emails programados con enlaces son contenido estático, igual que el artículo actual, y un Screen Flow en el sitio externo solo recoge datos para crear un Case sin resolver nada en el momento.
questions.explanationEn: An Agentforce agent can serve the customer in real time and run actions (backed by Flow or Apex) such as locating a missing package, checking shipping delays or offering a discount code, which is exactly the dynamic experience requested. An approval flow only routes internal approvals and does not serve customers. Scheduled emails with links are static content, just like the current help article, and a Screen Flow on the external site only collects details to create a Case without resolving anything on the spot.

questions.stem: A Platform App Builder is working with a client to format shipping ZIP codes. The client has been struggling with data inconsistency among users and wants only 5-digit variations saved. How should the app builder ensure that the client's shipping ZIP code is formatted properly?

options.text: Create a screen flow to enter address information and populate the ZIP code in the desired format.
Create a validation rule to enforce proper formatting and block any ZIP codes that are not 5-digit.
Create a custom ZIP code field with help text displaying the desired data input formatting as XXXXX.
Create an approval process for manager sign-off on all shipping codes entered by users.

questions.explanationEs: Una validation rule, por ejemplo con REGEX(), comprueba el formato en cada guardado y bloquea cualquier ZIP code que no tenga exactamente 5 dígitos, sea cual sea el canal de entrada. Un Screen Flow solo controla los registros creados por esa pantalla concreta, el help text únicamente orienta al usuario sin impedir nada, y un approval process de manager es excesivo y no valida el formato al momento.
questions.explanationEn: A validation rule, for example using REGEX(), checks the format on every save and blocks any ZIP code that is not exactly 5 digits, whatever the entry channel. A Screen Flow only controls records created through that particular screen, help text merely guides users and enforces nothing, and a manager approval process is excessive and does not validate the format at entry time.

questions.stem: Universal Containers (UC) has several picklist fields on the Account object whose values are routinely modified to meet changing business requirements. Due to These revolving changes, UC has a high number of inactive picklist values that are Impacting system performance and user experience. What can the app builder do to alleviate this issue?

options.text: Establish upper bound on existing picklists in Picklist Settings.
Set up Global Values in Picklist Value Sets.
Remove upper bound on inactive picklist values in Picklist Settings.
Convert the picklist fields to a different field type that will still meet the business requirements.

questions.explanationEs: Picklist Settings incluye la opción Establish upper bound on existing picklists, que aplica un límite al número de valores inactivos de los picklists existentes para que no sigan acumulándose y degradando el rendimiento. Quitar ese límite permitiría que el problema creciera. Los Global Values sirven para reutilizar los mismos valores en varios campos, no para reducir valores inactivos, y convertir los campos a otro tipo es una medida drástica que no es la función prevista para este caso.
questions.explanationEn: Picklist Settings includes the Establish upper bound on existing picklists option, which applies a limit on the number of inactive values in existing picklists so they stop piling up and hurting performance. Removing that limit would let the problem keep growing. Global Values are for reusing the same values across several fields, not for reducing inactive values, and converting the fields to another type is a drastic step that is not the feature meant for this case.

questions.stem: Universal Containers (UC) has large data volumes and is nearing data storage limits. The planned solution is to archive historical data to reduce Data storage in Salesforce; however, UC would still like to use reports, queries, and lookups on the archived information. Which two options could meet this requirement? Choose 2 answers
questions.explanationEs: Los external objects dejan los datos fuera de Salesforce (vía Salesforce Connect) y aun así se pueden consultar, usar en reports y relacionar mediante lookups externos o indirectos. Los big objects almacenan grandes volúmenes de histórico fuera del almacenamiento de datos normal y se pueden consultar con SOQL y usar en lookups. Los custom objects siguen consumiendo data storage, por lo que no resuelven el problema, y «related objects» no es una opción que reduzca almacenamiento.
questions.explanationEn: External objects keep the data outside Salesforce (through Salesforce Connect) and can still be queried, used in reports and related through external or indirect lookups. Big objects store very large volumes of historical data outside regular data storage and can be queried with SOQL and used in lookups. Custom objects still consume data storage, so they do not solve the problem, and 'related objects' is not an option that reduces storage.

questions.stem: Universal Containers wants to implement an email alert to the Case owner after deleting a Case's related Tasks. How should Universal Containers meet this requirement?

options.text: Build a record-triggered flow to run after the Task is deleted.
Build an After Delete Apex trigger.

questions.reviewNote: La fuente V23.35 marca el record-triggered flow que se ejecuta después de borrar la Task. Un record-triggered flow disparado por un borrado solo puede ejecutarse antes de eliminar el registro (before delete), así que ese flow posterior al borrado no existe. Las tres votaciones ciegas coinciden en el Apex trigger After Delete, que sí corre después del borrado y puede enviar el email al propietario del Case. No he podido contrastarlo con documentación en línea, solo con conocimiento propio de la plataforma.
questions.explanationEs: Un record-triggered flow disparado por un borrado solo puede ejecutarse antes de que se elimine el registro, así que no existe un flow que corra después de borrar la Task. Para reaccionar tras el borrado y avisar al propietario del Case hace falta un Apex trigger After Delete, que es un caso donde lo declarativo llega a su límite. Las assignment rules y las escalation rules gestionan la asignación y el escalado de Leads o Cases, no reaccionan a eliminaciones.
questions.explanationEn: A record-triggered flow fired by a delete can only run before the record is removed, so there is no flow that runs after the Task is deleted. To react after the deletion and notify the Case owner you need an After Delete Apex trigger, which is a case where declarative tools reach their limit. Assignment rules and escalation rules handle routing and escalation of Leads or Cases and do not respond to deletions.

questions.stem: Universal Containers (UC) has a time-sensitive need for a custom Component to be built in 4 weeks. UC developers require additional Enablement to complete the work and are backlogged by several months. Which option should an app builder suggest to meet this requirement?
questions.explanationEs: Con una necesidad urgente y desarrolladores ocupados durante meses, lo más rápido es instalar un componente ya hecho desde AppExchange en lugar de construirlo. Un screen flow y una Lightning record page implican construir algo internamente, y la record page solo ensambla componentes existentes en vez de crear uno nuevo. Las Bolt solutions son plantillas prediseñadas, sobre todo para Experience Cloud, y no son un componente personalizado concreto.
questions.explanationEn: With an urgent need and developers booked for months, the fastest path is to install a ready-made component from AppExchange instead of building one. A screen flow and a Lightning record page both mean building something in-house, and a record page only assembles existing components rather than creating a new one. Bolt solutions are prebuilt templates, mostly for Experience Cloud, and are not a specific custom component.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks wants a visual representation to track delivery status. Which component should a Platform App Builder recommend?
questions.explanationEs: Path muestra de forma visual las etapas de un picklist como Status o Stage en la Lightning record page, así que sirve para seguir el estado de una entrega de un vistazo. Related List muestra registros relacionados, no el progreso de un proceso. Details enseña los campos del registro y Related Record muestra datos de otro registro relacionado, ninguno de los dos es un indicador visual de estado.
questions.explanationEn: Path visually shows the stages of a picklist such as Status or Stage on the Lightning record page, so it lets users follow a delivery's status at a glance. Related List shows related records, not the progress of a process. Details displays the record's fields and Related Record shows data from another related record; neither is a visual status indicator.

questions.stem: Dreamhouse Realty (DR) has many properties for sale and wants to Identify the highest value of all offer records on each Property__c record. Which solution should the app builder use to meet DR's needs provided that there is a Master-detail relationship between the objects?
questions.explanationEs: Un roll-up summary field con la función MAX en el objeto Property devuelve el mayor valor de Offer entre todos sus registros hijo. Es posible porque el enunciado dice que la relación es master-detail, y se calcula de forma declarativa y automática. Summary no es un tipo de campo de Salesforce, y Text Area (Long), Multi-select Picklist y Rich Text Area son campos de entrada de datos que no agregan valores de registros relacionados.
questions.explanationEn: A roll-up summary field using the MAX function on the Property object returns the highest Offer value among all its child records. It works because the stem states the relationship is master-detail, and it is calculated declaratively and automatically. Summary is not a Salesforce field type, and Text Area (Long), Multi-select Picklist and Rich Text Area are data-entry fields that cannot aggregate values from related records.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks wants to display the number of opportunities that Are Closed Won with a Close Date within the last year on the Account detail Page. What should an app builder use to implement this?
questions.reviewNote: Premisa dudosa: la fuente marca el roll-up summary field, que es la única opción que encaja con el enunciado, pero la relación Opportunity-Account es un lookup y un roll-up summary nativo no es posible en Account. En una org real se resolvería con un record-triggered Flow o con una herramienta como DLRS. Se mantiene la clave de la fuente como respuesta esperada por el examen.
questions.explanationEs: La respuesta que espera el examen es un roll-up summary field en Account de tipo COUNT con criterios de filtro (Stage = Closed Won y Close Date dentro del último año). Un formula field no puede contar registros hijo, una validation rule solo bloquea guardados y el Activity timeline muestra actividades, no oportunidades. Ojo: un roll-up summary exige master-detail y Opportunity se relaciona con Account por lookup, así que en una org real esto se haría con un record-triggered Flow o con una herramienta como DLRS.
questions.explanationEn: The answer the exam expects is a COUNT roll-up summary field on Account with filter criteria (Stage = Closed Won and Close Date within the last year). A formula field cannot count child records, a validation rule only blocks saves, and the Activity timeline shows activities, not opportunities. Be aware that a roll-up summary requires master-detail while Opportunity relates to Account through a lookup, so in a real org this would be built with a record-triggered Flow or a tool such as DLRS.

questions.stem: Universal Containers uses a custom picklist called Account_Region__c on the Account object. The vice president of sales has asked that the value of this field is visible on Opportunities. How should an app builder create this solution?
questions.explanationEs: Un cross-object formula field en Opportunity, por ejemplo TEXT(Account.Account_Region__c), muestra el valor del picklist de la cuenta padre sin duplicar datos. Field History Tracking solo registra cambios de un campo, un linking o lookup field solo enlaza registros pero no muestra valores del padre, y el field-level security controla quién ve un campo sin copiarlo a Opportunity.
questions.explanationEn: A cross-object formula field on Opportunity, for example TEXT(Account.Account_Region__c), displays the parent Account's picklist value without duplicating data. Field History Tracking only records changes to a field, a linking or lookup field only connects records without showing values from the parent, and field-level security controls who sees a field without copying it onto Opportunity.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks wants to summarize the number of open Cases related to an Account, as well as the number of closed Cases to indicate whether customer support utilization is high, medium, or Low. Two number fields have been created: NUM_open_Cases__c and NUM_Closed_Cases__c. Which two solutions meet these business requirements? Choose 2 answers
questions.explanationEs: Case se relaciona con Account por lookup, así que no hay roll-up summary nativo. Para rellenar los dos campos numéricos hay que contar los Cases con Apex (un trigger) o con una app de AppExchange que haga roll-ups sobre lookups, como DLRS. Una validation rule solo valida datos al guardar y un approval process solo enruta aprobaciones; ninguno calcula conteos. Hoy un record-triggered Flow también serviría, pero no está entre las opciones.
questions.explanationEn: Case relates to Account through a lookup, so there is no native roll-up summary. To populate the two number fields you have to count the Cases with Apex (a trigger) or with an AppExchange app that rolls up across lookups, such as DLRS. A validation rule only validates data on save and an approval process only routes approvals; neither calculates counts. A record-triggered Flow would also work today, but it is not among the options.

questions.stem: An app builder wants to create a new field using Schema Builder. Who will get access to the new field by default?
questions.reviewNote: Los tres votos ciegos dicen No profiles (un campo nuevo no tendría field-level security hasta concederla), pero la clave de V23.35 en sus dos copias es Internal profiles y no he podido comprobarlo en la documentación. Se mantiene la clave de la fuente; conviene verificar el comportamiento en una org.
questions.explanationEs: La clave del examen es Internal profiles: según esa fuente, un campo creado en Schema Builder recibe field-level security visible y editable para los perfiles internos, pero no para los externos (por ejemplo, los de comunidad). All profiles y No profiles serían los extremos, que esa clave descarta, y Standard profiles no es una categoría de acceso por defecto. Es un punto dudoso, porque otros solucionadores apuntan a que un campo nuevo no tiene acceso hasta conceder field-level security: conviene revisar siempre el field-level security de cada campo nuevo y concederlo con perfiles o permission sets.
questions.explanationEn: The exam key is Internal profiles: according to that source, a field created in Schema Builder gets visible and editable field-level security for internal profiles, but not for external ones (for example, community profiles). All profiles and No profiles would be the extremes, which that key rules out, and Standard profiles is not a default access category. This point is disputed, because other solvers believe a new field has no access until field-level security is granted: always review the field-level security of each new field and grant it through profiles or permission sets.

questions.stem: Universal Containers created a custom object called Component to capture details about products sold. Which approach should an app builder take to display Component as a related list on Product?

options.text: Create a junction object to relate Component and Product. Add the Component related list to the Product page layout.
Create a roll-up on Product. Add the Component related list to the Product page layout.
Create a lookup relationship on Component to Product. Add the Component related list to the Product page layout.
Create a master-detail relationship on Product to Component. Add the Component related list to the Product page layout.

questions.explanationEs: Para mostrar Component como related list en Product, la relación se crea en el objeto hijo: un lookup en Component que apunta a Product, y después se añade la related list al page layout de Product. Un junction object solo hace falta en relaciones many-to-many, un roll-up no crea related lists, y un master-detail definido desde Product hacia Component invierte la dirección (un objeto estándar no puede ser el detalle de un objeto personalizado).
questions.explanationEn: To show Component as a related list on Product, the relationship is created on the child object: a lookup on Component pointing to Product, and then the related list is added to the Product page layout. A junction object is only needed for many-to-many relationships, a roll-up does not create related lists, and a master-detail defined from Product to Component reverses the direction (a standard object cannot be the detail of a custom object).

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks built a process that is supposed to update record ownership based on several different criteria. Some users report that they are not getting the expected level of access to accounts and contacts. Which two considerations should an app builder be aware of that could be causing the issue? Choose 2 answers

options.text: Processes that update record owners do not transfer child records.
Processes use the first value if the Owner field is updated multiple times.
Processes will fail on records owned by inactive users.
Processes will only run if the most current version is active.

questions.reviewNote: La respuesta correcta describe limitaciones de Process Builder, que está retirado: la automatización nueva se hace con Flow. Las dos respuestas de la fuente (no transfiere registros hijos; falla con owners inactivos) se mantienen como válidas para procesos ya existentes.
questions.explanationEs: En un proceso de Process Builder, cambiar el Owner no transfiere los registros hijos (hay que actualizar cada tipo relacionado por separado) y el proceso falla en registros cuyo owner es un usuario inactivo; ambas cosas pueden dejar a usuarios sin el acceso esperado. Si el Owner se actualiza varias veces, el proceso usa el último valor, no el primero, y se ejecuta la versión activa, que no tiene por qué ser la más reciente. Process Builder está retirado: hoy esto se haría con un record-triggered Flow.
questions.explanationEn: In a Process Builder process, changing the Owner does not transfer child records (each related record type must be updated separately) and the process fails on records owned by inactive users; both can leave users without the expected access. If the Owner is updated several times, the process uses the last value, not the first, and the active version runs, which is not necessarily the most recent one. Process Builder is retired: today this would be built with a record-triggered Flow.

questions.stem: Universal Containers has several new fields they've requested for the Opportunity Product object. What should an app builder be able to configure using a formula field?

options.text: A hyperlink to the parent Account of the parent Opportunity.
A Rich Text area field that uses HTML to bold certain characters.
A combination of the Opportunity's Text and a Description fields.
A mix of functions and concatenation of 10 Account fields and 10 Opportunity fields.

questions.explanationEs: Un formula field en Opportunity Product puede recorrer relaciones hacia arriba (Opportunity Product, Opportunity, Account) y usar HYPERLINK() para crear un enlace al Account padre de la oportunidad. Un formula field no devuelve Rich Text, así que no puede dar formato HTML en negrita, no puede referenciar campos Long Text Area como Description, y concatenar 10 campos de Account y 10 de Opportunity con funciones puede superar el límite de tamaño de compilación de las fórmulas, por lo que no es una opción fiable.
questions.explanationEn: A formula field on Opportunity Product can traverse relationships upward (Opportunity Product, Opportunity, Account) and use HYPERLINK() to build a link to the parent Account of the opportunity. A formula field does not return Rich Text, so it cannot apply HTML bolding, it cannot reference Long Text Area fields such as Description, and concatenating 10 Account fields and 10 Opportunity fields with functions can exceed the formula compile size limit, so it is not a dependable choice.

questions.stem: An app builder at Cloud Kicks created a custom object and related fields in the schema builder. Which next steps should the app builder take to ensure users can access the new object and fields?

options.text: Add the fields to the page layout on the object
Allow reporting for the object and fields.
Create a permission set for access to the object and fields.
Assign data types to the fields on the object.

questions.reviewNote: V23.35 da dos respuestas (permission set y page layout), pero el enunciado no indica cuántas hay que elegir. Los tres votos ciegos solo eligen el permission set, y la otra fuente solo el page layout. Se mantiene la clave de V23.35: el permission set concede el acceso a objeto y campos, y el page layout hace visibles los campos. Conviene verificarlo.
questions.explanationEs: La clave del examen combina dos pasos: crear un permission set que conceda los permisos de objeto y de campo (field-level security) y añadir los campos al page layout del objeto. Schema Builder solo crea los metadatos, así que los usuarios no admin no tienen acceso hasta que se les concede, y sin el campo en el layout no lo verían en la página de registro. Allow Reports solo habilita el objeto para informes y los data types se eligen al crear el campo, por lo que ninguno da acceso. El enunciado no dice cuántas respuestas elegir, de ahí la duda sobre si basta con el permission set.
questions.explanationEn: The exam key combines two steps: create a permission set that grants the object and field permissions (field-level security) and add the fields to the object page layout. Schema Builder only creates the metadata, so non-admin users get no access until it is granted, and without the field on the layout they would not see it on the record page. Allow Reports only makes the object available for reporting and data types are chosen when the field is created, so neither gives access. The stem does not say how many answers to pick, hence the doubt about whether the permission set alone is enough.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks has a custom object with a private sharing setting. The business wants to share individual records with specific people or departments on a case-by-case basis. Which three options does the business user have to manually share individual records? Choose 3 answers
questions.explanationEs: Con el OWD en Private, el manual sharing permite compartir un registro concreto con Users, Public Groups y Roles and Subordinates (también con roles y territorios). Permission Set Groups agrupan permisos pero no son destinatarios de sharing, y los Private Groups no son un destino de manual sharing.
questions.explanationEn: With the OWD set to Private, manual sharing lets you share an individual record with Users, Public Groups and Roles and Subordinates (also roles and territories). Permission Set Groups bundle permissions but are not sharing targets, and Private Groups are not a manual sharing target.

questions.stem: A manager built out a new Account report and wants to add a chart of the data to account records. An app builder tried to use the Report Chart component but was unable to find the manager's report. What are two reasons the app builder is unable to see the report? Choose 2 answers

options.text: The report has no data in it.
The app builder did not create the report.
The report is in the manager's Private reports folder
The report does not have a chart.

questions.explanationEs: Report Chart solo ofrece informes que tienen gráfico y que están en una carpeta a la que el constructor puede acceder, así que un informe guardado en la carpeta Private reports del gestor no aparece, y tampoco uno sin gráfico. Que el constructor no haya creado el informe o que este no tenga datos no impide seleccionarlo.
questions.explanationEn: The Report Chart component lists only reports that contain a chart and that sit in a folder the builder can access, so a report saved in the manager's Private reports folder is hidden, and so is one without a chart. Whether the builder created the report or whether it returns data does not affect whether it can be selected.

questions.stem: The appraisal team at DreamHouse Realty wants to leverage Salesforce Mobile app. What are three things an app builder should do to optimize mobile experience? Choose 3 answers

options.text: Avoid using default field values so that the user is required to fill in all fields on the screen.
Minimize the amount of formula fields and lookup fields to reduce page load time.
Put the most important fields in the compact layout so they are easy to find
Create individual customized layouts for different phone operating systems.
Use Global Actions to make it easy to perform vital functionality on mobile.

questions.explanationEs: Para la app móvil conviene reducir los campos de fórmula y de búsqueda, que retrasan la carga de la página, poner los campos clave en el compact layout para que se vean de inmediato y ofrecer Global Actions para las tareas habituales. Los valores predeterminados ayudan al usuario móvil y no hacen falta layouts distintos por sistema operativo, porque los layouts de Lightning son responsivos.
questions.explanationEn: For the mobile app, the builder should reduce formula and lookup fields, which slow page loads, put the key fields in the compact layout so they show up first, and provide Global Actions for common tasks. Default values help mobile users, and separate layouts per operating system are unnecessary because Lightning layouts are responsive.

questions.stem: At Ursa Major Solar there is a requirement for a new field called Planet Details on the Planet object where users can write detailed descriptions that can include pictures and links. Which field type should the app builder utilize to fulfill this requirement?
questions.explanationEs: Rich Text Area es el tipo de campo que guarda texto con formato y admite imágenes y enlaces dentro del propio campo. Long Text Area solo admite texto plano, URL almacena una única dirección web y Lightning web component es un componente de interfaz, no un tipo de campo, así que ninguna de esas sirve.
questions.explanationEn: Rich Text Area is the field type that stores formatted text and supports images and links inside the field itself. Long Text Area holds plain text only, URL stores a single web address, and a Lightning web component is a UI component rather than a field type, so none of those fit.

questions.stem: After discovering a second sun in the solar system, Ursa Major Solar wants to change the field relationship between Sun__c and Planet__c to a lookup rather than a master-detail. What should an app builder consider about the effect on reporting before making this change?

options.text: Existing reports created under the Sun__c with Planet__c report type made by Salesforce will be unusable, but not deleted.
Existing roll-up summary fields will be deleted from the Sun__c object and from any reports where they were added.
Existing roll-up summary fields will remain on the Sun__c object and available for reporting, but will no longer update.
Existing reports created under the Sun__c with Planet__c report type made by Salesforce will be deleted.

questions.reviewNote: La fuente da la clave A y es la opción que mejor encaja con su explicación, pero no he podido contrastarla con la documentación oficial porque las consultas web fallaron. Dos de los tres votos ciegos eligen B (los roll-up summary fields se eliminan con la conversión), así que la duda es real. Mantengo A y dejo la pregunta como disputed para que una persona decida entre A y B antes de publicar.
questions.explanationEs: Un master-detail no puede convertirse en lookup mientras el objeto padre tenga roll-up summary fields, que solo existen con master-detail, así que la conversión no los borra por sí sola. Al convertir, los informes que usan el tipo de informe que Salesforce genera automáticamente para esa relación dejan de ser utilizables, aunque no se borran. Ese es el efecto en reporting que hay que valorar.
questions.explanationEn: A master-detail relationship cannot be converted to a lookup while the master object has roll-up summary fields, which exist only with master-detail, so the conversion does not delete them by itself. When the conversion happens, reports built on the report type Salesforce generates automatically for that relationship become unusable, though they are not deleted. That is the reporting effect to weigh.

questions.stem: Universal Containers (UC) needs a picklist field called Status on three separate custom objects. UC has a requirement to share the list of values for this field across each object. Which feature should an app builder use?
questions.explanationEs: Un Global Picklist Value Set define una sola lista de valores que pueden usar campos picklist de varios objetos, así que los tres campos Status compartirían los mismos valores. Dependent picklist relaciona dos campos entre sí y no comparte listas entre objetos, y Shared Custom Field y Related Picklist no son funciones de Salesforce para esto.
questions.explanationEn: A Global Picklist Value Set is a single list of values that picklist fields on several objects can use, so the three Status fields would share the same values. A dependent picklist links two fields to each other rather than sharing a list across objects, and Shared Custom Field and Related Picklist are not Salesforce features for this.

questions.stem: Universal Containers has two types of applicants: Hourly and Salary. There are separate record types for each. While all members of the human resources (HR) department need to be able to view all applicant records, only the hiring manager and VP of HR should be able to create Salary applicant records. What should the Platform App Builder recommend to meet this requirement?

options.text: Remove the Create permission for the Salary applicant object for everyone except the hiring manager and VP of HR.
Update the organization-wide default to Private and create a sharing rule for the role of recruiting manager.
Configure the Hourly record type as the default and instruct non-management users to accept the default record type.
Create a permission set containing the Salary record type and assign it to the appropriate users.

questions.explanationEs: Un permiso de creación sobre el objeto no puede distinguirse por record type, así que el acceso al tipo Salary debe concederse aparte: se quita de los perfiles y se asigna mediante un permission set solo al hiring manager y al VP de RRHH, mientras el resto conserva Hourly. Cambiar la OWD afectaría a la visibilidad de todos los registros, y poner Hourly por defecto no impide que quien tenga acceso elija Salary.
questions.explanationEn: Object-level Create permission cannot be split by record type, so access to the Salary record type must be granted separately: remove it from the profiles and assign it through a permission set given only to the hiring manager and the VP of HR, while everyone else keeps Hourly. Changing the OWD would alter record visibility for everyone, and making Hourly the default does not stop users who have access from choosing Salary.

questions.stem: What are the limitations of Schema Builder when creating a custom object?

options.text: Fields and relationships can be created, but they will be unable to add the fields to the page layout from the canvas.
Custom fields can be added to any custom objects, excluding formula field types.
Relationships can be made to any custom objects, but any relationships to standard objects should be built in Lightning Object Manager.
"Save" should be clicked each time a new object, field, or relationship is created

questions.explanationEs: Schema Builder permite crear campos, incluidos los de fórmula, y relaciones, y también muestra las relaciones existentes, pero no puede colocar los campos nuevos en los page layouts desde el lienzo. Esa asignación hay que hacerla después en Object Manager, en el editor de page layouts.
questions.explanationEn: Schema Builder can create fields, including formula fields, and relationships, and it shows existing relationships, but it cannot place new fields on page layouts from the canvas. That placement must be done afterwards in Object Manager, in the page layout editor.

questions.stem: What is one limitation of using schema builder when creating a Field?

options.text: Cannot add fields to page layouts.
Cannot see existing relationships between objects.

questions.explanationEs: Que Schema Builder no pueda crear campos de fórmula o relaciones lookup, o que no muestre relaciones existentes, son afirmaciones falsas: sí puede hacer las tres cosas. La limitación real es que un campo creado allí no se añade al page layout, y eso hay que hacerlo después en el editor de page layouts.
questions.explanationEn: Claims that Schema Builder cannot create formula fields or lookup relationships, or cannot show existing relationships, are false, since it can do all of those. The real limitation is that a field created there is not added to the page layout, which must be done afterwards in the page layout editor.

questions.stem: The Sales Operations team at AW Computing deletes accounts for a variety of reasons. The sales ops director is worried that the Sales team may delete accounts that sales reps are actively selling into. How should the app builder keep accounts with open opportunities from being deleted?

options.text: Remove the Delete permission from the Sales Rep profile.
Remove the delete button on the account layout.
Create a validation rule on the Account object.
Create an Apex Trigger on the Account object.

questions.explanationEs: Una regla de validación solo se evalúa al guardar, no al borrar, así que no puede bloquear la eliminación de una cuenta. Quitar el permiso Delete impediría todas las eliminaciones, no solo las de cuentas con oportunidades abiertas, y quitar el botón del layout solo oculta una vía de borrado sin distinguir casos. Para aplicar una condición sobre datos relacionados al borrar hace falta un Apex trigger before delete en Account que consulte las oportunidades abiertas y añada un error al registro cuando existan.
questions.explanationEn: A validation rule runs only on save, not on delete, so it cannot block deleting an Account. Removing the Delete permission would stop every deletion, not only those of accounts with open opportunities, and removing the button from the layout hides just one way to delete without checking any condition. Enforcing a condition on related data at delete time calls for a before-delete Apex trigger on Account that queries open opportunities and adds an error to the record when any exist.

questions.stem: At DreamHouse Realty (DHR), a Platform App Builder built a new Property_Inspection__c custom object that includes fields, page layouts, an Apex class, a record-triggered flow, and a Lightning record page. The custom object is built in a Developer sandbox. The app builder must move these components to DHR's production org so the field team can begin using them. Which deployment plan should the app builder use?

options.text: Refresh the production org from the Developer sandbox to bring the new components into production.
Have a DHR administrator manually recreate each component in production using Setup.
Upload an outbound change set from the Developer sandbox, then deploy the inbound change set in production.
Create a managed package in the Developer sandbox and install it in production using the generated install URL.

questions.explanationEs: Para pasar metadatos de un sandbox a producción se crea un outbound change set en el sandbox y se despliega el inbound change set correspondiente en producción. Un refresh copia producción al sandbox y no al revés, rehacer los componentes a mano es propenso a errores, y un paquete gestionado está pensado para distribuir software, no para mover cambios entre entornos.
questions.explanationEn: Moving metadata from a sandbox to production uses an outbound change set created in the sandbox and an inbound change set deployed in production. A sandbox refresh copies production into the sandbox, not the reverse, recreating components by hand is error-prone, and a managed package is meant for distributing software rather than moving changes between environments.

questions.stem: Ursa Major Solar wants to automate a welcome email to new clients and include a customized survey about their buying experience. An app Builder is tasked with this project and has very little time to build the solution from scratch, but still needs to be able to fully customize the solution. What should the app builder do to meet the deadline and custom requirements?

options.text: Work with a developer to create custom Apex code and a Lightning web component survey to meet the criteria
Use Salesforce flow to build the survey declaratively to meet the criteria and send it to the customer as an email.
Choose a managed package from AppExchange that closely meets the requirements of the project, restricts programmatic development, but allows declarative development.
Choose an unmanaged package from AppExchange that closely meets the requirements of the project and allows programmatic development.

questions.explanationEs: Hay poco tiempo, pero la solución debe poder personalizarse a fondo. Un paquete unmanaged de AppExchange que se acerque a los requisitos se instala ya construido y su metadata y su código se pueden editar después, tanto de forma declarativa como programática, así que cumple el plazo y la personalización. Un paquete managed queda bloqueado: el suscriptor no puede cambiar su código ni buena parte de sus componentes. Construir la encuesta desde cero con Apex y un Lightning web component, o solo con Flow, no cabe en el plazo.
questions.explanationEn: Time is short, yet the solution must stay fully customizable. An unmanaged package from AppExchange that closely fits the requirements installs ready-made, and its metadata and code can be edited afterwards, both declaratively and programmatically, so it meets the deadline and the customization need. A managed package is locked: the subscriber cannot change its code or many of its components. Building the survey from scratch with Apex and a Lightning web component, or with Flow alone, does not fit the deadline.

questions.stem: Universal Containers has two custom objects, Inspection__c and Building__c, that are not yet related. The maintenance team expects to log approximately three inspections for each building every year. The business has two requirements: When a Building record is deleted, all of its related Inspection records must be deleted automatically. Each Inspection record must follow the same sharing and access settings as its Building. How should the Platform App Builder create the relationship?

options.text: Create a required lookup relationship field on Building__c that relates it to Inspection__c.
Create a master-detail relationship field on Building__c that relates it to Inspection__c.
Create a required lookup relationship field on Inspection__c that relates it to Building__c.
Create a master-detail relationship field on Inspection__c that relates it to Building__c.

questions.explanationEs: Para que al borrar un Building se borren sus Inspection y que cada Inspection herede el acceso de su Building hace falta una relación master-detail. Building__c es el master e Inspection__c el detail, así que el campo master-detail se crea en Inspection__c apuntando a Building__c. Un lookup, aunque sea obligatorio, no borra en cascada ni hace que el hijo herede el sharing del padre. Crear el campo en Building__c invertiría la relación y convertiría a Inspection en el padre.
questions.explanationEn: Deleting a Building must delete its Inspections, and each Inspection must inherit its Building's access, which calls for a master-detail relationship. Building__c is the master and Inspection__c the detail, so the master-detail field is created on Inspection__c and points to Building__c. A lookup, even a required one, neither cascades deletes nor makes the child inherit the parent's sharing. Creating the field on Building__c would reverse the relationship and make Inspection the parent.

questions.stem: Ursa Major Solar has received complaints about inconsistent customer service experiences and wants to provide its agents with a checklist of items that must be accomplished when servicing a case. What should an app builder use to implement this?
questions.reviewNote: La fuente V23.35 da el componente Actions & Recommendations y los tres resolvedores a ciegas llegan a la misma opción, pero todos con confianza baja. Lo habitual para una guía de pasos en un caso sería Path con Guidance for Success, que no figura entre las opciones, y «Business component» parece un texto dañado. Se mantiene la clave de la fuente por descarte, pero conviene contrastarla.
questions.explanationEs: El componente Actions & Recommendations muestra en la página de registro un flow (por ejemplo un screen flow con los pasos obligatorios) y acciones recomendadas al agente, así que es lo más cercano a guiar el servicio de un caso con una lista de pasos. Activity Timeline solo muestra actividades pasadas y futuras, y Highlights Panel muestra campos clave y acciones, pero ninguno guía el proceso. «Business component» no es un componente estándar. Para este tipo de guía lo habitual sería Path, que aquí no se ofrece, por eso la pregunta queda en duda.
questions.explanationEn: The Actions & Recommendations component shows a flow (for example a screen flow holding the required steps) and recommended actions to the agent on the record page, so it is the closest fit for guiding case handling with a list of steps. Activity Timeline only lists past and upcoming activities, and the Highlights Panel shows key fields and actions, but neither guides the process. Business component is not a standard component. A Path with guidance would be the usual tool for this, but it is not offered here, which is why the question stays in doubt.

questions.stem: A Platform App Builder wants to create a report to compare the number of support cases in each status (New, In Progress, or Closed) and by priority (Critical, High, Medium, or Low). Which solution should the app builder use for the report?
questions.explanationEs: Para comparar el número de casos por Status y por Priority se agrupan los casos por esos dos campos, en un summary report con filas agrupadas o en un matrix report con Status en las filas y Priority en las columnas, y los recuentos y totales dan la comparación. Un filtro solo decide qué casos entran en el informe. Las bucket columns crean categorías nuevas que aquí ya existen en los propios campos. Un custom report type define qué objetos y campos están disponibles, no cómo se agrupan.
questions.explanationEn: To compare the number of cases by Status and by Priority, group the cases by those two fields, either in a summary report with grouped rows or in a matrix report with Status in rows and Priority in columns, and the counts and totals give the comparison. A filter only decides which cases are included. Bucket columns create new categories that already exist here in the fields themselves. A custom report type defines which objects and fields are available, not how they are grouped.

questions.stem: A sales rep at AW Computing is unable to find what they are looking for while scrolling through their Chatter feed. How can a filter be utilized to show only posts from their key account and Opportunity records?
questions.reviewNote: La clave de la fuente (Chatter stream) es la respuesta esperada y se mantiene, pero los Chatter streams son una función de Salesforce Classic y no están disponibles en Lightning Experience, así que ya no es la solución actual. Conviene comprobarlo en la documentación de la versión vigente.
questions.explanationEs: Un Chatter stream es una vista del feed que combina los feeds de las personas, grupos y registros que el usuario elija. Así el rep ve solo las publicaciones de sus cuentas y oportunidades clave, y esa es la respuesta que espera el examen. Hoy es una función de Salesforce Classic, no de Lightning Experience. Los bookmarks solo guardan publicaciones concretas para verlas después, una notification avisa de actividad pero no filtra el feed, y un Chatter group es un espacio de colaboración, no un filtro por registros.
questions.explanationEn: A Chatter stream is a feed view that combines the feeds of the people, groups and records the user picks. That way the rep sees only the posts from their key accounts and opportunities, which is the answer the exam expects. Today it is a Salesforce Classic feature, not a Lightning Experience one. Bookmarks only save individual posts to read later, a notification alerts the user to activity but does not filter the feed, and a Chatter group is a collaboration space, not a filter by records.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks wants to set up a new opportunity approval process and execute various action items based on the initial submission. Which three action types should an app builder use in the approval process? Choose 3 answers
questions.explanationEs: Las acciones que puede ejecutar un approval process al enviar, aprobar, rechazar o recuperar un registro son Task, Email Alert, Field Update y Outbound Message. Como Field Update no está entre las opciones, valen Task, Email Alert y Outbound Message. Decision es un elemento de Flow, no una acción de aprobación, e Invocable Flow no es un tipo de acción del approval process clásico.
questions.explanationEn: The actions an approval process can run on submission, approval, rejection or recall are Task, Email Alert, Field Update and Outbound Message.
