Since Field Update is not listed, the valid choices are Task, Email Alert and Outbound Message. Decision is a Flow element, not an approval action, and Invocable Flow is not an action type of the classic approval process.

questions.stem: At Ursa Major Solar there is a requirement for a new field called Planet Details on the Planet object where users can write detailed descriptions that can include pictures and links. Which field type should the app builder use to fulfill this requirement?
questions.explanationEs: Rich Text Area permite texto con formato, imágenes y enlaces dentro del campo, justo lo que pide el requisito de descripciones detalladas. Long Text Area es texto plano sin imágenes ni enlaces, URL solo guarda una dirección web y Multi-Select Picklist almacena valores de una lista predefinida, no descripciones libres.
questions.explanationEn: Rich Text Area supports formatted text, images and links inside the field, which is what detailed descriptions with pictures and links require. Long Text Area is plain text without images or links, URL holds a single web address, and Multi-Select Picklist stores values from a predefined list rather than free-form descriptions.

questions.stem: Ursa Major Solar wants to create a relationship between the standard Contact object and a custom Solar Project object. Contacts can potentially be related to multiple Solar Project objects, and a Solar Project can have multiple Contacts associated with it. How should an app builder configure the data model?

options.text: Two Master-detail relationships on a new custom object
One Master-detail relationship on Contact and one Master-detail relationship on Solar Project
Two Lookup relationships on a new custom object
One Lookup relationship on Contact and one Lookup relationship on Solar Project

questions.explanationEs: Un many-to-many entre Contact y Solar Project se modela con un junction object: un objeto personalizado nuevo con dos relaciones master-detail, una hacia Contact y otra hacia Solar Project. Cada registro del junction une un contacto con un proyecto, y ambos lados pueden tener muchos de esos registros. Poner relaciones master-detail directamente en Contact y Solar Project no sirve: Contact es estándar y no puede ser el detail, y además solo daría relaciones uno a muchos. Dos lookups en el objeto nuevo conectan registros, pero no es el modelo estándar, porque no heredan sharing ni permiten roll-up summary.
questions.explanationEn: A many-to-many between Contact and Solar Project is modeled with a junction object: a new custom object with two master-detail relationships, one to Contact and one to Solar Project. Each junction record links one contact to one project, and both sides can have many such records. Putting master-detail relationships directly on Contact and Solar Project does not work: Contact is a standard object and cannot be the detail side, and it would only give one-to-many links. Two lookups on the new object do connect records, but that is not the standard model because they give no inherited sharing and no roll-up summary fields.

questions.stem: DreamHouse Realty is building a custom Lightning app to track its expanding solar water collection business. The Lightning app currently contains a Custom Lightning record page with standard components. From which two resources should an app builder get custom components to bring into the new Lightning app? Choose 2 answers
questions.explanationEs: Los componentes personalizados que se añaden a una Lightning page vienen de dos fuentes: AppExchange, con componentes ya empaquetados que se instalan en la org, y los Lightning components creados a medida (Lightning web components o Aura), que aparecen en el panel de componentes personalizados del Lightning App Builder. Import Wizard es una herramienta para cargar datos y Apex es código de servidor; ninguno aporta por sí mismo componentes de interfaz.
questions.explanationEn: Custom components added to a Lightning page come from two sources: AppExchange, with ready-made packaged components installed into the org, and custom-built Lightning components (Lightning web components or Aura), which show up in the custom components pane of Lightning App Builder. The Import Wizard is a data loading tool and Apex is server-side code; neither supplies UI components by itself.

questions.stem: Universal Containers uses the Asset object to track products that are installed at customer locations. A new object, Asset Inventory, has Been created to capture details about the asset. Which approach should the app builder take to display Asset Inventory as a Related list on Asset?

options.text: Create a lookup relationship on Asset Inventory to Asset. Add the Asset Inventory Related list to the Asset page layout.
Create a roll-up on Asset. Add the Asset Inventory related list to the Asset page Layout.
Create a master-detail relationship on Asset to Asset Inventory. Add the Asset Inventory related list to the Asset page layout.
Create a junction object to relate Asset Inventory and Asset. Add the Asset Inventory Related list to the Asset page layout.

questions.explanationEs: El campo de relación va en el objeto hijo: un lookup en Asset Inventory que apunta a Asset, y luego se añade la related list de Asset Inventory al page layout de Asset. Un master-detail creado en Asset hacia Asset Inventory invierte la dirección, un roll-up no genera related lists y un junction object solo se necesita para relaciones many-to-many.
questions.explanationEn: The relationship field goes on the child object: a lookup on Asset Inventory pointing to Asset, and then the Asset Inventory related list is added to the Asset page layout. A master-detail created on Asset toward Asset Inventory reverses the direction, a roll-up does not generate related lists, and a junction object is only needed for many-to-many relationships.

questions.stem: Universal Containers uses a custom object called Projects. When managers Assign projects, they set a custom field on the Project record called Estimated Hours. Once set, users should be able to decrease but not increase the value. How can an app builder meet this requirement?

options.text: Create a validation rule that uses the ISCHANGED function.
Create a formula default value for the custom field
Create a validation rule that uses the PRIORVALUE function.
Create a formula field that uses the PREVGROUPVAL function.

questions.explanationEs: Una validation rule puede comparar el valor nuevo con el anterior usando PRIORVALUE, por ejemplo Estimated_Hours__c > PRIORVALUE(Estimated_Hours__c) combinada con que el valor previo no esté vacío, y así bloquea los aumentos y deja bajar el número. ISCHANGED solo detecta que el campo cambió, no si subió o bajó. Un valor por defecto con fórmula solo se aplica al crear el registro, y PREVGROUPVAL es una función de fórmulas de informes, no de validation rules ni de formula fields.
questions.explanationEn: A validation rule can compare the new value with the old one using PRIORVALUE, for example Estimated_Hours__c > PRIORVALUE(Estimated_Hours__c) combined with a check that the prior value is not blank, which blocks increases while still allowing decreases. ISCHANGED only detects that the field changed, not whether it went up or down. A formula default value only applies when the record is created, and PREVGROUPVAL is a report formula function, not available in validation rules or formula fields.

questions.stem: An app builder wants to deploy a new version of an auto-launched flow to production in an active state so that the new functionality is immediately available to users. What should the app builder take into consideration when planning the deployment?

options.text: User access needs to be granted to the flow.
Verify there is an Apex test that provides test coverage for the flow.
Manually activate the flow after deployment.

questions.explanationEs: Para desplegar un flow autolaunched ya activo en producción, la org debe cumplir los requisitos de cobertura de pruebas de flows, así que hay que comprobar que existe un Apex test que cubra el flow (se exige un mínimo del 75 %). No se exige una cobertura del 100 %. Activar el flow a mano después del despliegue no cumple el objetivo de que la funcionalidad esté disponible de inmediato. Dar acceso de usuario al flow no es la consideración clave para desplegarlo activo.
questions.explanationEn: To deploy an active autolaunched flow to production, the org must meet the flow test coverage requirements, so the builder should check that an Apex test covers the flow (a minimum of 75% is required). 100% coverage is not required. Activating the flow by hand after deployment fails the goal of having the functionality available immediately. Granting users access to the flow is not the key consideration for deploying it as active.

questions.stem: The Director of Customer Service wants to receive a notification when a case stays in the new status for more than four business hours. Which two automation processes should be used to accomplish this? Choose 2 answers
questions.explanationEs: Las escalation rules están pensadas para casos que llevan demasiado tiempo sin atenderse: respetan las business hours y pueden enviar un email de notificación al director. Flow Builder cubre el mismo requisito con un flujo disparado por registro y un scheduled path que, pasado el plazo, comprueba si el caso sigue en New y envía el aviso. Una Validation Rule solo impide guardar datos inválidos, no espera ni notifica; y Scheduled Apex funcionaría, pero es código y un App Builder debe preferir las herramientas declarativas.
questions.explanationEn: Escalation rules are built for cases that sit untouched for too long: they honor business hours and can email a notification to the director. Flow Builder meets the same need with a record-triggered flow and a scheduled path that, after the delay, checks whether the case is still in New and sends the alert. A Validation Rule only blocks bad data from being saved, it cannot wait or notify; and Scheduled Apex would work but it is code, while an app builder should prefer declarative tools.

questions.stem: Ursa Major Solar's service department gets requests for several types of services, such as installation, repair, and maintenance. Service Managers need to be able to tell when maintenance was last done on an asset to help determine if they are meeting contract agreements, but the last Maintenance date can be difficult to determine when there are many work orders related to the asset. They think it would be helpful to have a field auto-populated on the Asset record when a maintenance work order gets closed. Which tool should an app builder recommend to help meet this requirement?
questions.explanationEs: Un record-triggered Flow sobre Work Order puede detectar que una orden de mantenimiento pasa a cerrada y actualizar con una acción Update Records el campo de última fecha de mantenimiento del Asset relacionado, sin código. Un Roll-up Summary no sirve porque exige una relación master-detail y Work Order se relaciona con Asset mediante un lookup. Un Apex Trigger lo lograría pero es innecesario cuando Flow lo resuelve de forma declarativa, y Einstein Next Best Action solo recomienda acciones, no actualiza datos.
questions.explanationEn: A record-triggered Flow on Work Order can detect when a maintenance work order is closed and use an Update Records action to set the last maintenance date field on the related Asset, with no code. A Roll-up Summary does not work because it requires a master-detail relationship and Work Order relates to Asset through a lookup. An Apex Trigger could do it but is unnecessary when Flow solves it declaratively, and Einstein Next Best Action only recommends actions, it does not update data.

questions.stem: DreamHouse Realty (DR) asks for some improvements in case management. They want to enforce process compliance so that cases are unable to be reverted to an earlier case status, and to ensure that certain fields are required when specific case criteria are met. Which solution should an app builder implement to meet these requirements?

options.text: Configure validation rules with help text.
Create dependent picklist fields and set them as required
Use an approval process to check field criteria are met.
Make the fields required on the page layout.

questions.explanationEs: Las validation rules se evalúan al guardar y bloquean el registro con un mensaje de error cuando la fórmula se cumple. Con PRIORVALUE o ISCHANGED sobre el Status impiden volver a un estado anterior, y con ISBLANK combinado con las condiciones del caso exigen campos solo cuando corresponde. Un campo obligatorio en el page layout lo es siempre y solo en la interfaz, los dependent picklists únicamente filtran valores disponibles y un approval process sirve para aprobar registros, no para validar en el guardado.
questions.explanationEn: Validation rules run on save and block the record with an error message when their formula is true. PRIORVALUE or ISCHANGED on Status prevents going back to an earlier status, and ISBLANK combined with the case criteria makes fields required only when the conditions apply. A field required on the page layout is always required and only in the UI, dependent picklists merely filter the available values, and an approval process routes records for approval rather than validating on save.

questions.stem: DreamHouse Realty (DHR) recently acquired Cloud Kicks (CK), a company That is still on Salesforce Classic. DHR is keeping the CK Salesforce org; however, it Will migrate this org to Lightning Experience. Where should the app builder find prebuilt resources to help with this project and Overall adoption?
questions.explanationEs: AppExchange (hoy también presentado junto a AgentExchange) es el marketplace de Salesforce donde se encuentran apps, componentes y recursos de adopción ya preparados, incluidos los que ayudan a pasar un org de Classic a Lightning Experience. Flow Builder es una herramienta de automatización, Lightning Object Creator crea objetos a partir de una hoja de cálculo e Import Wizard sirve para importar datos; ninguno es una fuente de recursos prediseñados de migración o adopción.
questions.explanationEn: AppExchange (now also presented alongside AgentExchange) is the Salesforce marketplace where you find ready-made apps, components and adoption resources, including those that help move an org from Classic to Lightning Experience. Flow Builder is an automation tool, Lightning Object Creator builds objects from a spreadsheet and Import Wizard is for importing data; none of them is a source of prebuilt migration or adoption resources.

questions.stem: Universal Containers (UC) has a custom Invoice object and a custom Invoice Line Item Object. The Invoice Line Item object has a lookup relationship to the Invoice. UC would like to Convert the lookup relationship to a master-detail relationship but is unable to do so. Which two reasons could be preventing this relationship conversion? Choose 2 answers

options.text: There are already two master-detail relationships on the Invoice Line Item.
Custom objects are unable to be on the detail side of a master-detail Relationship.
Invoice Line Item records exist without having the Invoice lookup field populated
There is a roll-up summary field on the Invoice object.

questions.explanationEs: Convertir un lookup en master-detail falla si el objeto hijo ya tiene dos relaciones master-detail, que es el máximo permitido, o si existen registros hijos con el lookup vacío, porque en master-detail el padre es obligatorio en todos ellos. Un objeto personalizado sí puede ser el lado detail, así que esa opción es falsa. Tener un roll-up summary en Invoice no impide la conversión; al contrario, es algo que la nueva relación habilitaría.
questions.explanationEn: Converting a lookup to master-detail fails if the child object already has two master-detail relationships, which is the maximum allowed, or if child records exist with an empty lookup, because in a master-detail the parent is required on every record. A custom object can be the detail side, so that statement is false. Having a roll-up summary field on Invoice does not block the conversion; it is actually something the new relationship would enable.

questions.stem: How should an app builder configure access to a contact's Twitter profile for Salesforce mobile app users?

options.text: Add a Twitter Quick Action to the mobile navigation.
Add an AppExchange Lightning Component to the mobile app.
Add the Twitter component to mobile view Lightning pages.
Add a formula field to the Contact page layout.

questions.reviewNote: La clave de la fuente (el componente Twitter en las páginas Lightning de móvil) era la respuesta del examen, pero Salesforce retiró la integración con Twitter, así que hoy esa configuración ya no es posible. No he podido contrastarlo con la documentación actual (sin acceso a la web); lo doy por obsoleto por el consenso de los tres resolutores y por mi conocimiento del producto.
questions.explanationEs: En el examen, la respuesta era añadir el componente estándar Twitter a la página Lightning de móvil del Contact con Lightning App Builder, que mostraba el perfil y los tweets recientes. Una quick action de Twitter no existe como tal, un componente de AppExchange es innecesario si hay uno estándar, y un campo de fórmula en el page layout solo mostraría un enlace, no el perfil integrado. Hoy la integración con Twitter está retirada, por lo que esta pregunta ya no refleja una configuración vigente.
questions.explanationEn: On the exam, the answer was to add the standard Twitter component to the Contact's mobile Lightning page using Lightning App Builder, which displayed the profile and recent tweets. A Twitter quick action does not exist as such, an AppExchange component is unnecessary when a standard one exists, and a formula field on the page layout would only show a link, not the embedded profile. The Twitter integration has since been retired, so this question no longer reflects a current configuration.

questions.stem: The Recruiting team at AW Computing captures the job acceptance and date of hire of A candidate on the Job Application custom object. Once the candidate accepts The recruiter's job offer, the date of hire should be entered and not be changed on Subsequent record edits. Which validation formula should the app builder use?
questions.reviewNote: Las opciones están muy deformadas por el PDF. Reconstruyo la opción de la clave de la fuente como AND (NOT(ISBLANK(Job_Accepted__c)) && ISCHANGED(Hire_Date__c)), que es la fórmula de la explicación de la fuente y la que bloquea cambiar la fecha una vez aceptada la oferta; la opción con "11" es el OR (||). Los tres resolutores ciegos eligieron esa opción del OR leyendo "11" como el operador, pero con OR saltaría en cualquier edición tras aceptar la oferta, así que mantengo la clave de la fuente.
questions.explanationEs: Una validation rule bloquea el guardado cuando su fórmula devuelve TRUE, así que hay que describir la situación de error: la oferta ya está aceptada Y la fecha de contratación ha cambiado, es decir NOT(ISBLANK(Job_Accepted__c)) && ISCHANGED(Hire_Date__c). La variante con OR saltaría en cualquier edición una vez aceptada la oferta, aunque la fecha no cambie. Las fórmulas que parten de ISBLANK sin negar disparan justo cuando la oferta aún no se ha aceptado, lo contrario de lo pedido.
questions.explanationEn: A validation rule blocks the save when its formula returns TRUE, so the formula must describe the error situation: the offer is already accepted AND the hire date has changed, that is NOT(ISBLANK(Job_Accepted__c)) && ISCHANGED(Hire_Date__c). The OR variant would fire on any edit once the offer is accepted, even if the date did not change. The formulas that start from a plain ISBLANK fire exactly when the offer has not been accepted yet, the opposite of what is required.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks asked the app builder to insert a list of 25,000 records using Deduplication for the Delivery custom object. Which tool should be used?
questions.explanationEs: Data Import Wizard admite objetos personalizados, importa hasta 50.000 registros por operación y ofrece opciones para evitar duplicados al cargar, por lo que encaja con 25.000 registros de Delivery con deduplicación. Data Loader maneja volúmenes mayores, pero no tiene una opción de deduplicación integrada. Lightning Object Creator crea objetos a partir de una hoja de cálculo y Schema Builder diseña el modelo de datos; ninguno es una herramienta de importación con deduplicación.
questions.explanationEn: The Data Import Wizard supports custom objects, imports up to 50,000 records per operation and offers options to avoid duplicates during the load, so it fits 25,000 Delivery records with deduplication. Data Loader handles larger volumes but has no built-in deduplication option. Lightning Object Creator builds objects from a spreadsheet and Schema Builder designs the data model; neither is an import tool with deduplication.

questions.stem: An app builder wants to streamline the user experience by reflecting summarized calculations of Specific fields on various objects. Which three field types can be used in roll-up summary fields to accomplish this? Choose 3 answers
questions.explanationEs: Un roll-up summary puede resumir campos Number, Currency y Percent (SUM, MIN, MAX) y también Date y Date/Time (MIN, MAX) del objeto detail en una relación master-detail. Por eso Currency, Date y Percent son válidos. Checkbox no se puede agregar (solo sirve en los filtros del roll-up) y Time no es un tipo de campo compatible.
questions.explanationEn: A roll-up summary can summarize Number, Currency and Percent fields (SUM, MIN, MAX) as well as Date and Date/Time fields (MIN, MAX) from the detail object in a master-detail relationship. That makes Currency, Date and Percent valid. Checkbox cannot be aggregated (it is only usable in the roll-up filter criteria) and Time is not a supported field type.

questions.stem: A Platform App Builder is asked to make a custom, standalone Lightning component accessible to sales reps. The component should be accessed directly from the navigation bar of the custom "Sales Operations" Lightning App. What is the best approach to achieve this?

options.text: Add the Lightning component to the Utility Bar of the Lightning App.
Embed the Lightning component into a dashboard and add the dashboard to the navigation menu.
Create a Web Tab and point the URL to the Lightning component's generated endpoint.
Create a Lightning Component tab and add that tab to the Lightning App's navigation menu.

questions.explanationEs: Un Lightning Component tab expone como pestaña un componente personalizado (Aura con appHostable o LWC con destino de pestaña), y esa pestaña se puede añadir a los elementos de navegación del Lightning app desde App Manager. La utility bar es una barra de acceso rápido en el pie de la app, no la barra de navegación. Meter el componente en un dashboard añade un rodeo innecesario y un Web Tab apunta a una URL externa, no a un componente Lightning.
questions.explanationEn: A Lightning Component tab exposes a custom component as a tab (Aura with appHostable or an LWC with a tab target), and that tab can be added to the Lightning app's navigation items in App Manager. The utility bar is a quick-access bar at the bottom of the app, not the navigation bar. Embedding the component in a dashboard adds needless indirection, and a Web Tab points to an external URL, not to a Lightning component.

questions.stem: The sales team receives a list of approximately 800 leads each morning from The marketing team. The marketing team does not know if any of the leads are Currently in the pipeline and sends the entire list each morning. Which tool should be used to import these leads into Salesforce while preventing the Duplicates from being inserted?
questions.explanationEs: Data Import Wizard puede emparejar los leads del fichero con los ya existentes (por nombre, email o Salesforce ID), así que cada mañana solo se insertan los nuevos y se evitan los duplicados; 800 registros caben de sobra en su límite. Data Loader y Data Loader.io insertan todas las filas sin ese emparejamiento sencillo: para evitar duplicados habría que preparar un upsert con un ID externo. Introducir 800 leads a mano cada día no es viable.
questions.explanationEn: Data Import Wizard can match the file's leads against existing ones (by name, email or Salesforce ID), so each morning only the new leads are inserted and duplicates are avoided; 800 records are well within its limit. Data Loader and Data Loader.io insert every row without that simple matching step: avoiding duplicates would require preparing an upsert on an external ID. Typing 800 leads by hand every day is not practical.

questions.stem: Universal Containers implemented an application process that uses custom objects called Internships and Applications. The organization-wide default (OWD) for Internships has been set to Private and is the master in the master-detail relationship with Applications. The VP of Human Resources wants to allow Edit access to Applications to recruiters. How should a Platform App Builder configure the proper access?

options.text: Add a sharing rule that grants the users Read/Write access to Internship records.
Create a queue for the web applications and assign access to users who will edit the records.
Set the OWD on the Applications object to Read/Write.
Create a sharing rule that grants the users Read/Write access to Application records.

questions.explanationEs: Applications es el objeto detalle de una relación master-detail, así que hereda el acceso de su master, Internship: no tiene OWD propio (queda como Controlled by Parent) y no admite sharing rules. Por eso se da acceso Read/Write a los reclutadores con una sharing rule sobre los registros de Internship, y ese acceso se extiende a sus Applications. Cambiar el OWD de Applications o crear una sharing rule sobre Applications no es posible, y una queue no sirve porque los registros detalle no tienen propietario propio.
questions.explanationEn: Applications is the detail object of a master-detail relationship, so it inherits access from its master, Internship: it has no OWD of its own (it shows Controlled by Parent) and cannot have sharing rules. That is why recruiters get Read/Write through a sharing rule on Internship records, and that access flows down to their Applications. Changing the OWD on Applications or creating a sharing rule on Applications is not possible, and a queue does not help because detail records have no owner of their own.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks (CK) increased its Salesforce development efforts so That it now has multiple custom development efforts happening in parallel. CK's developers and admins perform the customizations and have Complained that working in one sandbox has led to many problems. They Requested a solution in which they can work in at least 20 different Sandboxes at once, that all start with the same base configuration and data. What should an app builder use to solve the problem?
questions.explanationEs: Sandbox cloning crea un sandbox a partir de otro sandbox existente, así que cada copia parte de la misma configuración y datos de origen: es la forma de dar a 20 personas entornos paralelos idénticos. Un sandbox refresh solo actualiza un sandbox que ya existe desde producción, no crea otros nuevos. Partial Copy y Full Copy se crean desde producción, hay pocos disponibles y no sirven para montar 20 entornos con el mismo punto de partida.
questions.explanationEn: Sandbox cloning creates a sandbox from an existing sandbox, so every copy starts with the same configuration and data from the source: it is the way to give 20 people identical parallel environments. A sandbox refresh only updates a sandbox that already exists from production and does not create new ones. Partial Copy and Full Copy sandboxes are created from production, only a few are available, and they do not give you 20 environments with the same starting point.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks conducts an evaluation of sales reps with a custom object that houses a scorecard. The company wants to ensure that only the sales reps, their managers, and their manager's executives can view the rep's scorecard, but also prevent the Reps from being able to view the executive comment fields on their review. How should these requirements be met?

options.text: Use a private sharing model granting record access using custom settings; manage field access with record types and page layouts.
Use a private sharing model granting record access using hierarchy; manage field access with field-level security.
Use a private sharing model granting record access using custom settings; manage field access with page layouts and field-level security.
Use a private sharing model granting record access using hierarchy; manage field access with record types and field-level security.

questions.explanationEs: Con un modelo de compartición Private y la role hierarchy, el rep, su manager y los ejecutivos por encima ven el registro de la evaluación, y nadie más. Para que el rep no vea el campo de comentarios del ejecutivo se usa field-level security, que oculta el campo a nivel de perfil o permission set. Custom settings no conceden acceso a registros, y record types y page layouts solo cambian lo que se muestra, no protegen un campo (se podría ver en reports o por API).
questions.explanationEn: With a Private sharing model and the role hierarchy, the rep, their manager and the executives above them can see the evaluation record, and nobody else. To keep the rep from seeing the executive comments field you use field-level security, which hides the field at the profile or permission set level. Custom settings do not grant record access, and record types and page layouts only change what is displayed, they do not protect a field (it could still show up in reports or through the API).

questions.stem: Universal Containers require different fields to be filled out at each stage of the Opportunity sales process. Which configuration steps can an app builder use to meet this requirement?

options.text: Create a validation rule to prevent the user for field information.
Set page layout required fields based on the current stages.
Define record types and page layouts for each stage.
Add the Path component to the Lightning record page.

questions.explanationEs: El componente Path de la Lightning record page se apoya en el picklist de stage de la Opportunity y permite definir key fields y guidance for success distintos para cada etapa, de modo que el usuario ve qué rellenar en cada una. Los required fields del page layout se aplican siempre, no por etapa; los record types no están ligados a las etapas del proceso de venta; y Process Builder está retirado y no es la herramienta para pedir campos al usuario.
questions.explanationEn: The Path component on the Lightning record page is driven by the Opportunity stage picklist and lets you define different key fields and guidance for success for each stage, so users see what to fill in at every step. Required fields on a page layout apply all the time, not per stage; record types are not tied to the stages of the sales process; and Process Builder is retired and is not the tool for prompting users for fields.

questions.stem: Sales reps want the ability to see who can view their account records and How the people have access. Which button should the app builder add to the Account page layout to enable this?
questions.reviewNote: La V23.35 marca Sharing Hierarchy, pero los tres resolvedores a ciegas votaron Sharing, que abre la página de detalle con quién tiene acceso y por qué. Los dos botones enseñan el acceso al registro y no he podido confirmar cuál espera el examen; mantengo la clave de V23.35.
questions.explanationEs: El botón Sharing Hierarchy muestra qué usuarios tienen acceso al registro y por qué lo tienen (nivel y motivo de acceso), que es justo lo que piden los reps. New Task y Edit no tienen relación con la visibilidad del registro. El botón Sharing también abre una página de detalle de compartición, pero está pensado sobre todo para conceder y gestionar el acceso manual, por eso encaja peor con ver cómo tiene acceso cada persona.
questions.explanationEn: The Sharing Hierarchy button shows which users have access to the record and why they have it (access level and reason), which is exactly what the reps are asking for. New Task and Edit have nothing to do with record visibility. The Sharing button also opens a sharing detail page, but it is mainly meant for granting and managing manual access, so it fits less well for seeing how each person has access.

questions.stem: Ursa Major Solar (UNS) uses a public sharing model for accounts. UNS would like to move to a more restrictive sharing model but wants the Sales team to continue to have access to all account records with the sales record type. Which two actions should an app builder complete to implement this change? Choose 2 answers
questions.explanationEs: Para pasar de un modelo público a uno más restrictivo hay que cambiar el OWD de Account (por ejemplo a Private) y después abrir el acceso del equipo Sales con una criteria-based sharing rule cuyo criterio sea el record type Sales. Una owner-based sharing rule comparte según el propietario del registro, no según su record type, y el perfil Sales no puede dar acceso a registros por encima del OWD, porque los perfiles controlan permisos de objeto y de campo.
questions.explanationEn: To move from a public model to a more restrictive one you change the Account OWD (for example to Private) and then open access for the Sales team with a criteria-based sharing rule whose criterion is the Sales record type. An owner-based sharing rule shares by record owner, not by record type, and the Sales profile cannot grant record access beyond the OWD, because profiles control object and field permissions.

questions.stem: The Service Manager provided the app builder with color code requirements for case age on open cases. - New cases populate a green circle. - Day-old cases populate a yellow circle. - Three day-old cases populate a red circle. How should an app builder implement this requirement?
questions.explanationEs: Un formula field basado en la antigüedad del caso (por ejemplo con CreatedDate y TODAY() dentro de un IF o CASE) puede devolver con la función IMAGE un círculo verde, amarillo o rojo, sin escribir código. Un custom button o un quick action sirven para ejecutar una acción, no para mostrar un indicador de forma permanente, y un Lightning Web Component supone código cuando basta una solución declarativa.
questions.explanationEn: A formula field based on the age of the case (for example using CreatedDate and TODAY() inside an IF or CASE) can use the IMAGE function to return a green, yellow or red circle, with no code. A custom button or a quick action runs an action rather than showing a permanent indicator, and a Lightning Web Component means code when a declarative solution is enough.

questions.stem: An app builder wants to limit the amount of fields users see When creating a new Opportunity. Once they fill out the required fields and Save, the full record page with additional fields relevant to the Opportunity Type becomes available. How could this be accomplished?

options.text: Make the Opportunity type a required field on the initial Opportunity page layout and Use automation to update the record type based on the Opportunity type.
Use different page layouts for Opportunity types based on the user profile.
Once the required fields are populated, use a sharing rule to share the new fields with The user.
Hide additional sections on the page layout and the users how to manually Expand them when they want to fill in the fields in the hidden sections.

questions.explanationEs: Se deja un page layout inicial mínimo con el campo Type como obligatorio y, al guardar, una automatización (por ejemplo un record-triggered flow) asigna el record type según el Type; el page layout de ese record type ya muestra el conjunto completo de campos. Usar layouts distintos por perfil no depende del tipo de oportunidad, una sharing rule comparte registros y no campos, y ocultar secciones obliga a cada usuario a desplegarlas a mano.
questions.explanationEn: You keep a minimal initial page layout with Type as a required field and, on save, an automation (for example a record-triggered flow) sets the record type based on the Type; the page layout assigned to that record type then shows the full set of fields. Different layouts per profile do not depend on the opportunity type, a sharing rule shares records and not fields, and hiding sections makes every user expand them manually.

questions.stem: Universal Containers has a custom object called Project__c and a custom object called Time_Entry__c. A Time Entry must always be associated with a Project. However, the organization-wide default (OWD) sharing setting for Project__c is Public Read/Write, while Time_Entry__c records contain sensitive data and must be strictly Private to the user who created them. Which relationship type should the Platform App Builder use to relate Time_Entry__c to Project__c?
questions.explanationEs: En una relación Master-Detail el registro hijo hereda la propiedad y el acceso del padre (no tiene Owner propio y su acceso es «Controlled by Parent»), así que Time_Entry__c quedaría con el Public Read/Write de Project__c y no podría ser Private. Una relación Lookup (marcada como obligatoria) conserva el Owner y el OWD propios de Time_Entry__c, de modo que puede ser Private aunque el padre sea público. Hierarchical solo existe en el objeto User y External lookup relaciona con objetos externos, por lo que ninguna encaja.
questions.explanationEn: In a Master-Detail relationship the child record inherits ownership and access from its parent (it has no Owner field of its own and its access is Controlled by Parent), so Time_Entry__c would take on the Public Read/Write of Project__c and could not be Private. A Lookup relationship, marked as required, keeps Time_Entry__c's own Owner and OWD, so it can stay Private even though the parent is public. Hierarchical exists only on the User object and External lookup links to external objects, so neither fits.

questions.stem: A Platform App Builder has deployed a change set from a sandbox to production. There is a long delay in the deployment. What is causing the delay?

options.text: Dependent fields are included in the change set.
Profiles are included in the change set.
A field type change is included in the change set.
Roles are included in the change set.

questions.explanationEs: Un cambio de tipo de campo incluido en el change set obliga a Salesforce a convertir los datos existentes en producción durante el despliegue, y en objetos con muchos registros eso puede alargarlo mucho; las buenas prácticas de change sets lo advierten. Los profiles, los roles y los dependent fields añaden complejidad o recálculos, pero no son la causa típica de un retraso largo. Si hay que evitar la espera, se puede hacer el cambio de tipo a mano después del despliegue.
questions.explanationEn: A field type change in a change set forces Salesforce to convert the existing data in production during the deployment, and on objects with many records that can make it very slow; the change set best practices warn about this. Profiles, roles and dependent fields add complexity or recalculation, but they are not the typical cause of a long delay. If the wait must be avoided, the field type can be changed manually after the deployment.

questions.stem: Ursa Major Solar wants to provide sales console users with an incredible experience, with the most-used components easily accessible at all Times. Which solution can enable reps to see and access these components from anywhere within the app without leaving the page where the team is working?
questions.explanationEs: La utility bar es un pie de página persistente de una Lightning app (incluidas las console apps) que da acceso a componentes como Notes, History o un softphone desde cualquier página; se abren en paneles acoplados sin salir de la página en la que se trabaja. Home page es una sola página, Favorites solo guarda atajos a registros o páginas, y las global actions permiten crear registros pero no mantienen componentes disponibles de forma continua.
questions.explanationEn: The utility bar is a persistent footer in a Lightning app (including console apps) that gives access to components such as Notes, History or a softphone from any page; they open in docked panels without leaving the page being worked on. The Home page is a single page, Favorites only stores shortcuts to records or pages, and global actions let users create records but do not keep components continuously available.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks (CK) tracks the support level of its customers on the account Record page. CK wants to show a text notification on a case record page when the Related account is a platinum-level customer. How can an app builder meet this requirement?

options.text: Clone the Case Lightning page. Add a rich text component to the new page, and assign this page to platinum accounts.

Add a rich text component to the Case Lightning page. Set the component visibility of the rich text component to when the account support level is Platinum. Create a text-only custom Lightning Web Component. Drag the custom Lightning Web Component into the Case page layout.
Set its visibility to when the account support level is platinum. Create a text-only custom Lightning Web Component. Clone the case page layout.
Drag the custom Lightning Web Component into the page, and assign the layout to platinum cases.

questions.reviewNote: Las opciones de esta pregunta están mezcladas en la fuente (restos de una versión con Lightning Web Component). Se conserva la clave: la opción correcta es la única que combina Rich Text con component visibility según el support level de la cuenta. La versión limpia está en ab-fc143-117.
questions.explanationEs: La solución declarativa es añadir un componente Rich Text a la Lightning record page de Case y filtrar su component visibility por el support level de la cuenta relacionada (Support Level = Platinum). Clonar la página y asignarla «a cuentas Platinum» no funciona porque las asignaciones de página se hacen por app, record type y perfil, no por el valor de un campo de otro objeto. Crear un componente a medida (LWC o Visualforce) añade desarrollo innecesario, y cambiar el page layout no hace que un componente aparezca según datos de la cuenta. La frase final sobre un componente propio en la opción correcta es ruido de la fuente: lo que cumple el requisito es el Rich Text con su filtro de visibilidad.
questions.explanationEn: The declarative solution is to add a Rich Text component to the Case Lightning record page and filter its component visibility on the related account's support level (Support Level = Platinum). Cloning the page and assigning it to Platinum accounts does not work because page assignments are made by app, record type and profile, not by a field value on another object. Building a custom component (LWC or Visualforce) adds needless development, and changing the page layout does not make a component appear based on account data. The trailing custom-component sentence in the correct choice is source noise: what satisfies the requirement is the Rich Text with its visibility filter.

questions.stem: Universal Containers uses a Private sharing model on Accounts. User A and User B both own Accounts of their own and have been sent a link to a new Account record owned by User C. User A can open and view the record, but User B receives an insufficient privileges error. User A and User B have the same role in the role hierarchy as User C. Why does User A have access, but User B does not?

options.text: User A and User B have different login access policies.
User B has a scoping rule that restricts Account access.
User A has View All Fields permission on the Account object.
User A is in a public group that has access through a sharing rule.

questions.explanationEs: Con el OWD de Account en Private y los tres usuarios en el mismo role, ninguno obtiene acceso a los registros de los demás por la jerarquía. Que un usuario abra el registro y el otro no solo se explica por un mecanismo de compartición, como pertenecer a un public group al que apunta una sharing rule. Las login access policies tienen que ver con el inicio de sesión, no con registros concretos; View All Fields afecta a la visibilidad de campos, no a la de registros; y un scoping rule filtra qué registros se ven por defecto, pero no bloquea el acceso directo a un registro.
questions.explanationEn: With the Account OWD set to Private and all three users in the same role, none of them gets access to the others' records through the hierarchy. One user opening the record while the other cannot is explained only by a sharing mechanism, such as membership in a public group targeted by a sharing rule. Login access policies relate to signing in, not to specific records; View All Fields affects field visibility, not record visibility; and a scoping rule filters which records are shown by default but does not block direct access to a record.

questions.stem: The Dream House Realty (DR) service manager asks for some Improvements in case management. They want to enforce compliance so That cases are unable to be reverted to an earlier case status, and to Ensure that certain fields are required when specific case criteria are met. Which solution should an app builder implement to meet these Requirements?
questions.explanationEs: Las validation rules son la herramienta declarativa para imponer reglas de cumplimiento antes de guardar: con PRIORVALUE o ISCHANGED impiden que el Status del caso retroceda y con ISBLANK exigen campos cuando se cumplen ciertos criterios. Un approval process enruta registros para aprobación y no valida cada guardado, y un dependent picklist solo controla qué valores se ofrecen según otro campo. Un flow sobre Case puede automatizar pasos, pero para bloquear un guardado con estas condiciones la validation rule es más simple y directa.
questions.explanationEn: Validation rules are the declarative tool for enforcing compliance rules before a record is saved: PRIORVALUE or ISCHANGED stops the case Status from moving backward, and ISBLANK makes fields required when certain criteria are met. An approval process routes records for approval and does not validate every save, and a dependent picklist only controls which values are offered based on another field. A flow on Case can automate steps, but to block a save under these conditions a validation rule is simpler and more direct.

questions.stem: Universal Containers allows all employees to submit reviews for leadership using a custom object called Review. These Reviews should only be Visible to the HR department and the employee who submitted the record. Which three steps should an app builder take to properly control access to Reviews? Choose 3 answers

options.text: Add a Master-Detail(User) field on the Review object.
Remove Review Read permission from non-HR Department user Profiles.
Create a criteria-based Sharing Rule for the HR Department.

questions.explanationEs: Para que los Reviews solo los vean RR. HH. y quien los envió, el OWD de Review debe ser Private (el empleado que crea el registro es su propietario y siempre lo ve), hay que desactivar Grant Access Using Hierarchies para que los managers por encima en el role hierarchy no hereden el acceso (posible porque es un objeto personalizado) y se crea una sharing rule que abra los registros al grupo de RR. HH. Quitar el permiso Read a los perfiles no HR impediría que los empleados vieran sus propios Reviews, y un campo Master-Detail a User no se puede crear en un objeto personalizado.
questions.explanationEn: For Reviews to be visible only to HR and the employee who submitted them, the Review OWD must be Private (the employee who creates the record owns it and always sees it), Grant Access Using Hierarchies must be disabled so managers above in the role hierarchy do not inherit access (possible because it is a custom object), and a sharing rule opens the records to the HR group. Removing Read from non-HR profiles would stop employees from seeing their own Reviews, and a Master-Detail field to User cannot be created on a custom object.

questions.stem: Universal Containers generates leads from three different Sources: web, trade shows, and partners. Some of the information Collected is applicable to all sources, there is also information that is unique to each type of lead. What should an app builder configure to meet these requirements?

options.text: Create three lead record types each with its own page layout containing the relevant Fields.
Create three sections on the lead layout and instruct users to collapse the non- Relevant fields.
Create a lead object on the partner community and a record type for web and trade leads.
Create custom objects for each type of lead with each page layout only containing the Relevant fields.

questions.explanationEs: Los record types de Lead permiten asignar un page layout distinto a cada origen (web, trade shows, partners), de modo que cada tipo muestra los campos comunes más los propios de su origen. Tres secciones en un solo layout dejan los campos irrelevantes a la vista y dependen de que el usuario los colapse. Crear un objeto de Lead en la comunidad o un objeto personalizado por tipo fragmentaría la gestión de leads y se perdería la funcionalidad estándar de Lead, como la conversión.
questions.explanationEn: Lead record types let you assign a different page layout to each source (web, trade shows, partners), so each type shows the common fields plus the ones specific to its source. Three sections on a single layout leave irrelevant fields visible and rely on users to collapse them. Creating a Lead object in the community or a custom object per type would fragment lead management and lose standard Lead functionality such as conversion.

questions.stem: At AW Computing, the Candidate object has a checkbox field for Previous Experience and a number field for Years of Previous Experience. The recruiting team wants the number field to display only if the Previous Experience field is checked. Which functionality should the app builder use to meet this requirement?

options.text: Create two different page layouts and a process to change the layout if Previous Experience is checked.
Create a dependency between the Previous Experience and Years of Previous Experience fields.
Use Dynamic Forms to display the Years of Previous Experience field if Previous Experience is checked.
Use a Visualforce component on the candidate page layout to conditionally display the fields.

questions.explanationEs: Es un requisito de visibilidad condicional de un campo, y Dynamic Forms lo cubre con una regla de visibilidad en Lightning App Builder: el campo numérico aparece solo cuando el checkbox es true. Una field dependency solo permite que el campo dependiente sea un picklist, no un número. Dos page layouts no cambian según el valor de un campo (se asignan por perfil y record type), y Visualforce añade código cuando la solución es declarativa.
questions.explanationEn: This is a conditional field visibility requirement, and Dynamic Forms covers it with a visibility rule in Lightning App Builder: the number field shows only when the checkbox is true. A field dependency only allows the dependent field to be a picklist, not a number. Two page layouts do not switch based on a field value (they are assigned by profile and record type), and Visualforce adds code when a declarative solution exists.

questions.stem: Which three standard component types are available in the Lightning App Builder? Choose 3 answers
questions.explanationEs: Recent Items, Filter List y Rich Text son componentes estándar que se arrastran desde la lista de componentes de Lightning App Builder. «Plain text» no existe como componente (el estándar para texto es Rich Text) y «Report details» tampoco: el componente estándar para informes es Report Chart.
questions.explanationEn: Recent Items, Filter List and Rich Text are standard components you drag from the component list in Lightning App Builder. Plain text does not exist as a component (the standard one for text is Rich Text) and neither does Report details: the standard report component is Report Chart.

questions.stem: The finance manager at Universal Containers wants to receive a new Business notification email each time a new client is won. The sales manager wants to Receive a task letting them know to onboard the new client unless it is a top-tier Client. Which automation tool should an app builder use to best address all these requests?
questions.explanationEs: Un record-triggered flow se ejecuta solo cuando el cliente se gana: envía el email al finance manager y, con un elemento Decision que comprueba si es un cliente top-tier, crea la tarea de onboarding para el sales manager únicamente cuando no lo es. Todo cabe en una sola automatización declarativa. Un approval process sirve para aprobar registros, no para notificar; Apex es innecesario porque Flow lo cubre sin código; y un screen flow necesita que un usuario lo ejecute de forma interactiva.
questions.explanationEn: A record-triggered flow runs automatically when the client is won: it sends the email to the finance manager and, with a Decision element that checks whether the client is top-tier, creates the onboarding task for the sales manager only when it is not. Everything fits in one declarative automation. An approval process is for approving records, not for notifying; Apex is unnecessary because Flow covers it without code; and a screen flow needs a user to run it interactively.

questions.stem: A services manager wants to make sure the team enters case priority consistently. Which feature should a Platform App Builder use to accomplish this?
questions.explanationEs: Path divide el proceso de un registro en etapas a partir de un campo de lista de selección y, en cada etapa, permite mostrar campos clave (por ejemplo Priority) junto con Guidance for Success, que indica al equipo qué debe informar y cómo. Así todos los usuarios de servicio rellenan la prioridad del Case con el mismo criterio. In-App Guidance ofrece avisos contextuales generales pero no estructura el proceso de un registro, y Next Best Action sirve para recomendar acciones u ofertas, no para guiar la entrada de datos. Flow podría fijar la prioridad automáticamente, pero el enunciado pide que el equipo la introduzca de forma consistente, no que se automatice.
questions.explanationEn: Path breaks a record's process into stages based on a picklist field and, at each stage, can show key fields (such as Priority) together with Guidance for Success that tells the team what to capture and how. This way every service user fills in Case priority with the same criteria. In-App Guidance gives general contextual prompts but does not structure a record's process, and Next Best Action is meant to recommend actions or offers, not to guide data entry. A Flow could set the priority automatically, but the requirement is for the team to enter it consistently, not to automate it.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks has a formula field Specialty__c on Opportunity that gets its value from the Specialty__c field on the related Account. Cloud Kicks has changed its processes to allow Opportunities to have different values for Specialty__c than their Account. Sales reps need to be able to enter values for the Specialty__c field on Opportunity while preserving the values on existing Opportunities. What should a Platform App Builder do to achieve this?

options.text: Export the data, convert the field to a text field, and import the data.
Create a new text field and import the formula field values into it.
Create a new text field and keep using the existing formula field.
Convert the field to a text field and the values will be in it.

questions.explanationEs: Un formula field es de solo lectura y no se puede convertir a otro tipo de dato, así que los usuarios nunca podrían escribir en él. La solución es crear un campo Text nuevo en Opportunity y cargar en él los valores actuales de la fórmula (exportándolos con Data Loader o un informe e importándolos), y después retirar o renombrar la fórmula antigua. Así se conservan los valores de las oportunidades existentes y los usuarios pueden editarlos. Exportar, convertir el campo e importar, o convertirlo directamente, no funciona porque esa conversión no existe. Crear el campo nuevo y seguir usando la fórmula dejaría sin datos a las oportunidades existentes.
questions.explanationEn: A formula field is read-only and cannot be converted to another data type, so users could never type into it. The solution is to create a new Text field on Opportunity and load the current formula values into it (export them with Data Loader or a report and import them), then retire or rename the old formula. This preserves the values on existing opportunities and lets users edit them from now on. Exporting, converting the field and importing, or converting it directly, does not work because that conversion does not exist. Creating the new field and continuing to use the formula would leave existing opportunities without their data.

questions.stem: An app builder needs a custom solution and is considering using either AppExchange or their local developer community. The app builder wants to minimize the need for manual maintenance. What should the app builder consider?
questions.explanationEs: Un managed package de AppExchange lo mantiene y actualiza el publicador, que distribuye upgrades que se instalan sobre la versión existente sin que el cliente tenga que rehacer nada. Eso minimiza el mantenimiento manual. Un unmanaged package, sea de AppExchange o de código abierto, se instala como una copia editable de los metadatos, sin vínculo con el original ni upgrades, y cada cambio se aplica a mano. El desarrollo a medida de código abierto obliga al equipo a mantener, probar y desplegar el código por su cuenta.
questions.explanationEn: A managed package from AppExchange is maintained and updated by its publisher, who ships upgrades that install over the existing version without the customer having to rebuild anything. That minimizes manual maintenance. An unmanaged package, whether from AppExchange or open source, is installed as an editable copy of the metadata with no link to the original and no upgrades, so every change is applied by hand. Open-source custom development forces the team to maintain, test and deploy the code on its own.

questions.stem: At Ursa Solar Major, only users with the Outer Planets profile need to see the Jupiter field on the Solar System object. How should the app builder satisfy this requirement?
questions.explanationEs: Field-level security controla, por profile (o permission set), si un campo concreto es visible o editable. Si el campo Jupiter solo es visible para el profile Outer Planets, el resto de usuarios no lo ven. Los sharing rules regulan el acceso a registros, no a campos. Classic encryption enmascara valores pero no limita la visibilidad por profile. Un filtered view solo filtra qué registros aparecen en una lista y no oculta el campo del objeto.
questions.explanationEn: Field-level security controls, per profile (or permission set), whether a specific field is visible or editable. If the Jupiter field is visible only to the Outer Planets profile, every other user cannot see it. Sharing rules govern access to records, not fields. Classic encryption masks values but does not limit visibility by profile. A filtered view only filters which records appear in a list and does not hide the field on the object.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks wants to display 12 key fields at once in a separate section at the top of opportunity records on the desktop. Which component should an app builder add to the record page to enable this functionality?
questions.explanationEs: El Highlights Panel es el componente estándar de la record page que muestra, en una sección destacada en la parte superior del registro, los campos clave definidos en el compact layout del objeto. Path solo muestra las etapas de un campo de lista de selección, un Accordion agrupa componentes en secciones plegables dentro de la página, y un Custom Lightning Web Component exigiría código para algo que la plataforma ya ofrece de forma declarativa. El número exacto de campos que cita el enunciado (12 aquí, 10 en otras copias de la pregunta) no cambia la respuesta: el componente que resuelve el requisito es el mismo.
questions.explanationEn: The Highlights Panel is the standard record page component that shows, in a prominent section at the top of the record, the key fields defined in the object's compact layout. Path only shows the stages of a picklist field, an Accordion groups components into collapsible sections within the page, and a Custom Lightning Web Component would require code for something the platform already provides declaratively. The exact number of fields quoted in the stem (12 here, 10 in other copies of the question) does not change the answer: the component that meets the requirement is the same.

questions.stem: A Cloud Kicks employee submitted an opportunity for approval by their manager. What will happen if the employee attempts to edit the description field after submission?

options.text: User will be able to edit the description field only.
User will be presented with a ' Record Lock ' notification.
User will be able to edit the name, but unable to edit the description.
User will see the record is now owned by their manager.

questions.explanationEs: Cuando un registro se envía a aprobación, Salesforce lo bloquea (record lock) para que nadie cambie los datos mientras se decide. Un usuario normal que intente editar la descripción verá un aviso de registro bloqueado y no podrá guardar el cambio; solo un administrador o, según la configuración del proceso, el aprobador asignado pueden editarlo. No puede editar solo la descripción ni solo el nombre, porque el bloqueo afecta a todo el registro, y el envío a aprobación no cambia el propietario: el manager solo revisa la solicitud.
questions.explanationEn: When a record is submitted for approval, Salesforce locks it (record lock) so nobody changes the data while a decision is pending. A regular user who tries to edit the description will see a locked-record message and cannot save the change; only an administrator or, depending on the process settings, the assigned approver can edit it. The user cannot edit just the description or just the name, because the lock applies to the whole record, and submitting for approval does not change the owner: the manager only reviews the request.

questions.stem: A sales manager at Cloud Kicks wants the team to spend more time in the field and less time manually entering the information found on the business cards they collect. What should an app builder do to help achieve this goal without sacrificing data quality?

options.text: Post daily to the Chatter feed any relevant fields that need to be populated.
Use Flow to create a data entry wizard to automate data entry.
Research and evaluate data enrichment products on the AppExchange to automate data entry.
Use a formula field to populate key fields for the sales user.

questions.explanationEs: Las apps de AppExchange de data enrichment o de escaneo de tarjetas de visita leen la tarjeta y crean o completan Leads, Contacts y Accounts, de modo que el equipo escribe menos y los datos siguen siendo fiables. Publicar los campos en Chatter no rellena ningún registro. Un Flow no puede leer una tarjeta por sí solo, y un formula field solo calcula valores a partir de datos que ya están en el registro, no captura datos nuevos.
questions.explanationEn: AppExchange data enrichment or business-card scanning apps read the card and create or complete Leads, Contacts and Accounts, so the team types less and the data stays reliable. Posting the fields to Chatter does not populate any record. A Flow cannot read a business card on its own, and a formula field only calculates values from data that is already on the record, it does not capture new data.

questions.stem: Sales reps at Universal Containers use Salesforce on their mobile devices. They want a way to add new contacts quickly and then follow up later to complete the Additional information necessary. Which mobile solution should an app builder recommend to create the new contact?

options.text: Build a global action to create Contacts.
Use Path and set pre-defined values.
Customize the mobile menu to move Contacts to the top.
Add a compact layout to Contacts.

questions.explanationEs: Un global action de tipo Create a Record para Contact, con un layout que incluya solo los campos imprescindibles, aparece en el menú de acciones de la app móvil y permite crear un contacto en segundos. Después el representante completa el resto de la información. Path guía las etapas de un registro que ya existe, personalizar el menú móvil solo cambia la posición de Contacts sin simplificar la creación, y un compact layout define qué campos de resumen se muestran, no cómo se crea un registro.
questions.explanationEn: A Create a Record global action for Contact, with a layout that includes only the essential fields, appears in the mobile app's action menu and lets reps create a contact in seconds. They complete the remaining information afterwards. Path guides the stages of a record that already exists, customizing the mobile menu only moves Contacts up without simplifying creation, and a compact layout defines which summary fields are shown, not how a record is created.

questions.stem: An app builder needs to change the data type of some custom fields. Which two limitations should the app builder be aware of when changing the data Type of a custom field? Choose 2 answers

options.text: It is not possible to change the data type of a formula field to any data type.
It is not possible to change the data type of field referenced by Apex code.
It is not possible to change the data type of a field used as an External ID from number to Text.
It is not possible to change the data type of a Text Area (Long) field to Text.

questions.reviewNote: V23.35 marca como correctas la limitación del formula field y la de Text Area (Long) a Text. Los tres solvers ciegos coinciden en la del formula field, pero ninguno acepta Text Area (Long) a Text: uno cree que se permite truncando el texto, dos añaden External ID de Number a Text y uno las referencias en Apex. No he podido contrastarlo en la ayuda de Salesforce («Notes on Changing Custom Field Types»), así que se mantiene la clave de la fuente y se marca como dudosa.
questions.explanationEs: La limitación segura es que un formula field no se puede convertir a ningún otro tipo de dato, porque su valor se calcula: hay que crear un campo nuevo y migrar los datos. La fuente cita además el paso de Text Area (Long) a Text, que obliga a reducir la longitud y puede perder datos. Las otras dos opciones (campos referenciados en Apex y External ID de Number a Text) son restricciones que también aparecen en la ayuda sobre cambio de tipos, pero con matices, y conviene revisarlas en «Notes on Changing Custom Field Types» antes de cambiar el tipo. Como la clave de la fuente no está confirmada, la pregunta queda marcada como dudosa.
questions.explanationEn: The safe limitation is that a formula field cannot be converted to any other data type, because its value is calculated: you must create a new field and migrate the data. The source also lists moving from Text Area (Long) to Text, which forces a shorter length and can lose data. The other two options (fields referenced in Apex and External ID from Number to Text) are restrictions that also appear in the Help on changing field types, but with caveats, and should be checked in "Notes on Changing Custom Field Types" before changing the type. Because the source key is not confirmed, the question is flagged as disputed.

questions.stem: Universal Containers has Public Read/Write as the Account Organization-wide default (OWD) setting. Visitors to the customer Community site report that they can see all of the company's account Records. How should an app builder configure Account sharing so that community Users only see their own Account?

options.text: Create an account record type for external accounts.
Set the account external OWD to private.
Define an owner-based sharing rule for external accounts.
Define a permission set for external accounts.

questions.explanationEs: En Experience Cloud el acceso de los usuarios externos se rige por el external OWD, que es independiente del OWD interno. Si Account está en Public Read/Write para externos, cualquier usuario de la comunidad ve todas las cuentas; poner el external OWD de Account en Private hace que solo vea las suyas. Un record type no controla la visibilidad de los registros, un owner-based sharing rule solo amplía el acceso, y un permission set concede permisos de objeto o campo sin restringir el acceso por registro.
questions.explanationEn: In Experience Cloud, external users' access is governed by the external OWD, which is independent of the internal OWD. If Account is Public Read/Write for external users, any community user sees every account; setting the Account external OWD to Private means they only see their own. A record type does not control record visibility, an owner-based sharing rule can only widen access, and a permission set grants object or field permissions without restricting record access.

questions.stem: Universal Container's sales reps can modify fields on an opportunity until it is closed. The sales operations team has access to modify the Post-Close Follow-up Date and Post-Close Follow-up Comments fields after the Opportunity is closed. After the opportunity is closed, the rest of the fields are read only. How should these requirements be met?

options.text: Use field-level security on page layouts to restrict editing fields.
Use field-level security on page layouts with record types to restrict editing fields.
Use record types with field sets and restrict editing fields using field-level security.
Use field-level security to mark fields as read-only on the Sales profile.

questions.explanationEs: Se combinan record types con un page layout distinto para cada uno: las oportunidades abiertas usan el layout editable y las cerradas pasan a un record type cuyo layout deja los campos en solo lectura, salvo los dos de seguimiento posterior al cierre, que Sales Operations puede editar. Un solo layout, o marcar los campos como solo lectura en el perfil Sales, se aplica igual en cualquier etapa y no distingue entre oportunidades abiertas y cerradas. Los field sets agrupan campos para mostrarlos en otros componentes y no controlan si un campo se puede editar. El texto de la opción es impreciso al hablar de «field-level security on page layouts», pero lo que cambia según la etapa es la asignación de layouts por record type.
questions.explanationEn: Record types are combined with a different page layout for each one: open opportunities use the editable layout, and closed ones move to a record type whose layout makes the fields read-only except the two post-close follow-up fields, which Sales Operations can edit. A single layout, or marking the fields read-only on the Sales profile, applies the same way at every stage and cannot tell open opportunities from closed ones. Field sets group fields for display in other components and do not control whether a field is editable. The option wording about field-level security on page layouts is loose, but what changes by stage is the layout assignment per record type.

questions.stem: Managers at Universal Containers want a quick way to create additional accounts to form a hierarchy from a Parent Account record. They want to auto-populate five fields based on the parent to make it easier for users to create the child accounts quickly. What should the app builder recommend?

options.text: Add a custom link on Account
Create a custom action on Account

questions.explanationEs: Una acción personalizada específica del objeto Account (tipo Create a Record) se lanza desde el registro de la cuenta padre y puede definir valores predefinidos para los cinco campos a partir de ese registro, de modo que la cuenta hija nace ya rellenada. Una global action no tiene contexto de un registro padre, así que no puede copiar sus valores. Path solo guía las etapas de un registro y no crea registros, y un custom link requiere construir una URL a mano, algo que no es el enfoque recomendado en Lightning.
questions.explanationEn: An object-specific custom action on Account (Create a Record type) is launched from the parent account record and can set predefined values for the five fields from that record, so the child account starts out pre-filled. A global action has no parent record context, so it cannot copy values from it. Path only guides the stages of a record and does not create records, and a custom link means hand-building a URL, which is not the recommended approach in Lightning.

questions.stem: A Platform App Builder built a flow that retrieves all the Opportunities related to a specific Account. The app builder wants to filter only the top five highest-value Opportunities based on the Amount. Which element should the app builder use to achieve the requirements?
questions.explanationEs: El elemento Collection Sort ordena la colección de Opportunities por Amount en orden descendente y permite limitar el número de elementos de salida, así que con un límite de cinco se queda con las cinco de mayor valor. Collection Filter solo conserva los registros que cumplen unas condiciones y no sabe elegir los N primeros. Decision solo decide por qué rama continúa el flujo, y Transform convierte datos entre estructuras sin ordenar ni limitar la colección.
questions.explanationEn: The Collection Sort element orders the Opportunity collection by Amount in descending order and lets you limit the number of output items, so a limit of five keeps the five highest-value records. Collection Filter only keeps the records that meet conditions and cannot pick the top N. Decision only chooses which path the flow follows, and Transform maps data between structures without sorting or limiting the collection.

questions.stem: Universal Containers has a requirement that an email notification needs to be sent to an Account owner automatically 5 days before a related Contract's end date. Which flow type and element combination should the Platform App Builder use?

options.text: Schedule-triggered flow with a Get Records element and a Send Email action
Record-triggered flow with a Send Email action, using a scheduled path
Screen flow with a Send Email action and a Date element
Autolaunched flow with a Wait element and a Send Email action

questions.reviewNote: La fuente V23.35 marca el schedule-triggered flow (y su explicación lo justifica con un flujo diario con Get Records), pero los tres resolvedores a ciegas eligieron el record-triggered flow con scheduled path. Ambos diseños sirven para el aviso 5 días antes de EndDate; he mantenido la clave de la fuente por ser plausible y porque cubre también contratos existentes que no se editan, pero la pregunta es ambigua.
questions.explanationEs: Un schedule-triggered flow diario puede buscar con Get Records los contratos cuya fecha de fin está a cinco días, obtener la cuenta relacionada y su propietario y llamar a Send Email, y funciona también con contratos ya existentes que nadie edita. Un screen flow necesita que un usuario lo ejecute y un autolaunched flow no se programa por sí solo, aunque se le añada un Wait. El scheduled path de un record-triggered flow también calcula fechas relativas, pero solo se programa cuando el contrato se crea o se modifica, por eso no cubre los contratos que no cambian.
questions.explanationEn: A daily schedule-triggered flow can use Get Records to find the contracts whose end date is five days away, get the related account and its owner, and call Send Email, and it also works for existing contracts that nobody edits. A screen flow needs a user to run it, and an autolaunched flow does not schedule itself even when a Wait element is added. The scheduled path of a record-triggered flow can also compute relative dates, but it is only scheduled when the contract is created or updated, so it does not cover contracts that never change.

questions.stem: Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) has created the custom objects Trail and Park in Salesforce to track trails and parks respectively. NTO wants to Track the total number of trails a park has on the park record without writing any code. Which two actions should an app builder take to accomplish this requirement? Choose 2 answers

options.text: Use a formula field on the Park record to show the total number of trails.
Use a roll-up summary field on the Park record to show the total number of Trails.
Use a master-detail relationship between the Park and Trail objects.
Use a lookup relationship between the Park and Trail objects.

questions.explanationEs: Un roll-up summary field en Park puede contar los registros hijos de Trail sin escribir código, pero solo existe cuando la relación entre ambos objetos es master-detail con Park como master. Una relación lookup no admite roll-up summary de forma nativa, y un formula field no puede contar ni agregar registros hijos, solo lee campos del propio registro o de registros padre.
questions.explanationEn: A roll-up summary field on Park can count the child Trail records with no code, but it only exists when the relationship between the two objects is master-detail with Park as the master. A lookup relationship does not support a native roll-up summary, and a formula field cannot count or aggregate child records, since it only reads fields from its own record or from parent records.

questions.stem: The VP of Sales at Universal Containers has asked the app builder to let sales reps create opportunity records directly from the account, with a number of fields pre-populated. Which feature should the app builder use to allow users to create the opportunity?
questions.explanationEs: Una quick action de tipo Create a Record en el objeto Account permite crear la Opportunity desde la cuenta y rellenar de antemano varios campos con valores predefinidos. Un custom button o un custom link tendrían que construir una URL con los valores y no son la opción declarativa y adaptada a móvil. Default action no es una función de Salesforce que sirva para esto.
questions.explanationEn: A Create a Record quick action on the Account object lets reps create the Opportunity from the account with several fields pre-filled through predefined values. A custom button or custom link would have to build a URL carrying the values and is not the declarative, mobile-friendly choice. Default action is not a Salesforce feature that fits this need.

questions.stem: Which two features can be used to allow users to access Flows? Choose 2 answers
