questions.reviewNote: La fuente V23.35 marca Flow Launcher y Quick Action. «Flow Launcher» no es un nombre oficial de una función de Salesforce (se interpreta como el componente Flow en una página Lightning o similar). Los tres resolvedores coinciden en Quick Action, pero dos de ellos prefieren Apex como segunda opción; he mantenido la clave de la fuente porque Apex ni Approval Process son vías de acceso para el usuario, aunque la pregunta es ambigua.
questions.explanationEs: Un quick action de tipo Flow abre el flujo desde un registro o una página, y lo que el enunciado llama «Flow Launcher» se entiende como la forma de poner el flujo al alcance del usuario en una página, como el componente Flow en Lightning App Builder. Apex puede iniciar un flujo por código, pero no es una función con la que el usuario acceda a él. Un Approval Process solo enruta registros para su aprobación y no sirve para lanzar flujos a los usuarios.
questions.explanationEn: A Flow-type quick action opens the flow from a record or a page, and what the stem calls Flow Launcher is read as the way of putting the flow in front of users on a page, such as the Flow component in Lightning App Builder. Apex can start a flow in code, but it is not a feature through which users access it. An Approval Process only routes records for approval and cannot be used to launch flows for users.

questions.stem: DreamHouse Realty has a mentorship program that pairs Experienced Realtors with new Realtors. Each experienced Realtor can Mentor one or several new Realtors, and each new Realtor is required to Work with a single experienced Realtor they report to for a probationary period. Which type of relationship would an app builder set up to meet this Specification?
questions.explanationEs: Cada Realtor nuevo se relaciona con un único mentor, y un mentor puede tener varios Realtors nuevos, así que es una relación uno a muchos entre registros del mismo objeto, que se resuelve con un lookup (obligatorio) hacia el propio objeto Realtor. Un master-detail no se puede definir de un objeto hacia sí mismo y además impone herencia de propietario y borrado en cascada que no se piden. Many-to-many exigiría un junction object y no encaja, porque cada nuevo Realtor tiene un solo mentor. Indirect lookup sirve para external objects.
questions.explanationEn: Each new Realtor is tied to a single mentor, and a mentor can have several new Realtors, so this is a one-to-many relationship between records of the same object, solved with a (required) lookup from the Realtor object to itself. A master-detail cannot be defined from an object to itself, and it also brings owner inheritance and cascade delete that nobody asked for. Many-to-many would need a junction object and does not fit, because each new Realtor has only one mentor. Indirect lookup is meant for external objects.

questions.stem: Universal Containers needs to stamp the Stage_Last_Changed__c date field on the Opportunity record whenever StageName changes. How should the Platform App Builder implement this request?

options.text: A before-save record-triggered flow on Opportunity that assigns today's date to Stage_Last_Changed__c when StageName changes.
A scheduled path on an after-save record-triggered flow that updates Stage_Last_Changed__c to today's date one hour after the change.
An approval process on Opportunity that uses Update Records to set Stage_Last_Changed__c to today's date when StageName changes.
An autolaunched flow invoked from a custom button that the user clicks after editing the Opportunity StageName to update Stage_Last_Changed__c to today's date.

questions.explanationEs: Un record-triggered flow before-save sobre Opportunity puede comprobar que StageName ha cambiado y asignar la fecha de hoy a Stage_Last_Changed__c en el mismo registro, sin una operación DML adicional y sin retrasos. Un scheduled path en un flujo after-save añade una espera de una hora y una actualización extra. Un Approval Process no está pensado para estampar un campo, y un autolaunched flow lanzado desde un botón depende de que el usuario lo pulse, así que no garantiza capturar todos los cambios.
questions.explanationEn: A before-save record-triggered flow on Opportunity can check that StageName changed and assign today's date to Stage_Last_Changed__c on the same record, with no extra DML operation and no delay. A scheduled path on an after-save flow adds a one-hour wait and an additional update. An Approval Process is not meant for stamping a field, and an autolaunched flow started from a button depends on the user clicking it, so it cannot guarantee that every change is captured.

questions.stem: AW Computing uses a private sharing model for opportunities. Whenever An opportunity with a type of Service Agreement is created, all users in the Service Manager role should be able to view the opportunity. Which tool should AW Computing use to accomplish this?
questions.explanationEs: Una criteria-based sharing rule comparte automáticamente las Opportunities cuyo Type es Service Agreement con el rol Service Manager, aunque el modelo de acceso sea privado. Una owner-based sharing rule decide por el propietario del registro y no puede filtrar por un valor de campo. Compartir mediante Apex requiere código y no es la herramienta declarativa, y el manual sharing exige que alguien lo haga registro a registro, por lo que no es automático.
questions.explanationEn: A criteria-based sharing rule automatically shares the Opportunities whose Type is Service Agreement with the Service Manager role, even though the sharing model is private. An owner-based sharing rule decides by the record owner and cannot filter on a field value. Sharing through Apex requires code and is not the declarative tool, and manual sharing has to be done record by record by someone, so it is not automatic.

questions.stem: Due to the complexity of the Universal Containers sandbox release schedule and requirements, it is advised that change sets are used as often as possible to migrate from one environment to another. Which three common items can an app builder move when using a change set? Choose 3 answers
questions.reviewNote: V23.35 marca Custom object, Apex class y Custom field. Los tres resolvedores ciegos eligieron Standard fields en lugar de Apex class. Ambas opciones se pueden añadir a un change set (las clases Apex sin matices; los campos estándar solo como personalizaciones), y solo Web-to-lead queda fuera, así que la pregunta es ambigua. Se mantiene la clave de V23.35 porque Apex class es un componente típico de change set sin condiciones.
questions.explanationEs: Un change set mueve metadatos entre orgs relacionadas, y los componentes más habituales son los objetos personalizados, los campos personalizados y las clases Apex (estas últimas deben cumplir los requisitos de cobertura de pruebas al desplegar en producción). Web-to-lead no es un componente de metadatos que se pueda añadir al change set, es una configuración que hay que volver a hacer en el destino. Los campos estándar solo viajan como personalizaciones de un campo existente, no como elemento común por sí mismo, por eso no se cuentan entre los tres.
questions.explanationEn: A change set moves metadata between related orgs, and the most common components are custom objects, custom fields and Apex classes (the latter must meet the test coverage requirements when deployed to production). Web-to-lead is not a metadata component that can be added to a change set; it is a setting that has to be set up again in the target org. Standard fields only travel as customizations of an existing field rather than as a common item in their own right, which is why they are not counted among the three.

questions.stem: Universal Containers has a defined need to add the contents of a white paper about its product offerings within a field on the Product object. This content contains tables, lists, and images. Which field format should a Platform App Builder use to ensure the appropriate display?
questions.explanationEs: Text Area (Rich) es el único tipo de campo de texto que guarda y muestra formato, con tablas, listas e imágenes, que es justo lo que necesita el contenido del white paper. Text Area y Text Area (Long) solo guardan texto plano sin formato ni imágenes, y Text Area (Encrypted) está pensado para texto corto que se enmascara por seguridad, no para contenido extenso con formato.
questions.explanationEn: Text Area (Rich) is the only text field type that stores and displays formatting, including tables, lists and images, which is exactly what the white paper content needs. Text Area and Text Area (Long) hold plain text with no formatting or images, and Text Area (Encrypted) is meant for short text that is masked for security, not for long formatted content.

questions.stem: After a deal is closed, Cloud Kicks (CK) wants to assign a user as a customer service manager (CSM) in addition to the account owner and would like a new field to easily track and report which CSM is assigned to the Account. Which solution should an app builder use for this request?
questions.explanationEs: Un Lookup field hacia el objeto User permite elegir un usuario real como CSM en la cuenta, junto al propietario, y como es una relación se puede filtrar y agrupar en informes por ese usuario. Un Text field guarda texto escrito y un Picklist field guarda un valor de una lista fija, y ninguno de los dos está ligado a un registro de usuario, y un Multi-select picklist tampoco identifica usuarios y además permitiría varios valores.
questions.explanationEn: A Lookup field to the User object lets the team pick a real user as the CSM on the account, next to the owner, and because it is a relationship it can be filtered and grouped by that user in reports. A Text field stores typed text and a Picklist field stores a value from a fixed list, and neither is tied to a user record, and a Multi-select picklist does not identify users either and would allow several values.

questions.stem: Ursa Major Solar has a lookup relationship between a custom delay_ object and a custom Size_ object. An app builder wants to create a roll-up summary field that counts the total number of Size_ records related to each delay_ record. How would the current configuration impact the ability to achieve the desired result?

options.text: The roll-up summary can be achieved by creating a formula field on the delay_ object.
This lookup relationship will need to be converted to a master-detail relationship before a roll-up summary field can be created.
A roll-up summary field will need to be created on the delay_ object with a field filter that selects all related Size_ records.
The roll-up summary can be achieved by creating a formula field on the Size_ object.

questions.explanationEs: Un roll-up summary field solo se puede crear en el objeto maestro de una relación master-detail, así que con una relación lookup hay que convertirla primero a master-detail. Un campo de fórmula no puede agregar ni contar registros hijos, y no existe un roll-up summary con filtro que funcione sobre una lookup, de modo que las demás soluciones propuestas no logran el recuento.
questions.explanationEn: A roll-up summary field can only be created on the master object of a master-detail relationship, so with a lookup relationship it has to be converted to master-detail first. A formula field cannot aggregate or count child records, and a roll-up summary with a filter does not work on a lookup, so the other proposed solutions cannot produce the count.

questions.stem: A Platform App Builder notices several Accounts converted from Leads are missing information they expected to be caught through Account validation rules. What is the source of this issue?

options.text: Account validation rules fail to validate on records converted from a Lead.
The Lead settings are allowing users to intentionally bypass validation rules.
The Lead settings are unchecked to require validation for converted Leads.
Lead validation rules fail to validate on records when they are being converted.

questions.explanationEs: En Lead Settings existe la opción Require Validation for Converted Leads, y si no está marcada la conversión no aplica las validation rules ni los campos obligatorios a los registros que crea. Por eso faltan datos en las cuentas convertidas. Las validation rules de Account y de Lead sí se aplican en la conversión cuando esa opción está activada, así que no fallan por sí mismas. Tampoco son los usuarios quienes se saltan las reglas a propósito: es un ajuste global que afecta por igual a todas las conversiones.
questions.explanationEn: Lead Settings has the Require Validation for Converted Leads option, and when it is not checked, conversion does not apply validation rules or required fields to the records it creates. That is why information is missing on the converted accounts. Account and Lead validation rules are applied during conversion when that option is enabled, so they do not fail on their own. Nor are users bypassing the rules on purpose: it is an org-wide setting that affects every conversion in the same way.

questions.stem: Universal Containers deployed an app in a large change set from a Developer Sandbox to a Developer Pro Sandbox used for testing. After Testing, changes had to be made to several of the components in the Change set. How should an app builder move the new changes to the Developer Pro Sandbox?

options.text: Rename the change set, add the changes and re-deploy.
Clone the change set and re-deploy.
Refresh the test sandbox and re-deploy the change set.
Update the change set and re-deploy.

questions.explanationEs: Un change set ya subido queda bloqueado y no se puede editar, así que hay que clonarlo: el clon toma las versiones actuales de los componentes, permite añadir cambios y se sube y despliega de nuevo. Renombrar o actualizar el original no es posible una vez subido, y refrescar el sandbox de pruebas borraría todo su contenido sin resolver cómo llevar los cambios nuevos.
questions.explanationEn: An uploaded change set is locked and cannot be edited, so it has to be cloned: the clone picks up the current versions of the components, lets you add changes, and is uploaded and deployed again. Renaming or updating the original is not possible once it is uploaded, and refreshing the test sandbox would wipe its contents without solving how to move the new changes.

questions.stem: Universal Containers asked the app builder to ensure when an Account type changes to ' Past-Customer ' the contacts directly related to that account get an updated status of ' Re-Market '. Which automation should the app builder use to accomplish this task?
questions.explanationEs: Un record-triggered flow sobre Account se ejecuta solo cuando el Type cambia a Past-Customer y puede actualizar los Contacts relacionados con un elemento Update Records, sin intervención del usuario. Una validation rule solo bloquea guardados y no actualiza registros, un screen flow necesita que un usuario lo ejecute, y un Lightning component es un elemento de interfaz que no automatiza cambios en segundo plano.
questions.explanationEn: A record-triggered flow on Account runs on its own when the Type changes to Past-Customer and can update the related Contacts with an Update Records element, with no user involvement. A validation rule only blocks saves and does not update records, a screen flow needs a user to run it, and a Lightning component is a UI element that does not automate background changes.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks (CK) wants to quickly insert a list of over 1 million net new Accounts. The template based on CK's data model was used to populate the list. Which tool should be used?
questions.explanationEs: Data Loader es la herramienta para cargas masivas de registros: admite inserciones de millones de registros desde un archivo CSV. Import Wizard tiene un límite de 50.000 registros por importación, Schema Builder sirve para diseñar el modelo de datos, y Lightning Object Creator crea un objeto personalizado nuevo a partir de una hoja de cálculo; ninguno de los dos carga cuentas nuevas en el objeto Account existente.
questions.explanationEn: Data Loader is the tool for bulk record loads: it can insert millions of records from a CSV file. Import Wizard is limited to 50,000 records per import, Schema Builder is used to design the data model, and Lightning Object Creator builds a new custom object from a spreadsheet; neither loads new accounts into the existing Account object.

questions.stem: Universal Containers needs automation that runs every Sunday at 2:00 a.m. The automation sets a custom checkbox field, Inactive__c, to True on every Account whose standard Last Activity Date is more than 90 days in the past. The automation must evaluate all Account records and repeat on this schedule every week. Which flow design should the Platform App Builder use?

options.text: A record-triggered flow on Account with a scheduled path set to run 90 days after each Account's Last Activity Date
An autolaunched flow that an app builder schedules to run every Sunday at 2:00 a.m.
A schedule-triggered flow on Account, set to a Weekly frequency with a Sunday 2:00 a.m. start time, with entry conditions selecting Accounts whose Last Activity Date is more than 90 days old
A schedule-triggered flow on Account, set to a Once frequency for the upcoming Sunday at 2:00 a.m., with entry conditions selecting Accounts whose Last Activity Date is more than 90 days old

questions.explanationEs: Un schedule-triggered flow sobre Account con frecuencia Weekly, inicio el domingo a las 2:00 y una condición de entrada sobre Last Activity Date evalúa todas las cuentas cada semana y marca Inactive__c en las que cumplen. Un scheduled path de un record-triggered flow actúa por registro y solo cuando ese registro cambia, la frecuencia Once se ejecuta una sola vez, y un autolaunched flow no tiene programación propia.
questions.explanationEn: A schedule-triggered flow on Account with a Weekly frequency, a Sunday 2:00 a.m. start and an entry condition on Last Activity Date evaluates every account each week and sets Inactive__c on the ones that match. A scheduled path in a record-triggered flow works per record and only after that record changes, the Once frequency runs a single time, and an autolaunched flow has no schedule of its own.

questions.stem: A new field is being created on a custom object. However, the app builder does not want the field to show up on pre-existing custom report Types. What should the app builder do on the custom field setup to fulfill this requirement?

options.text: Remove the new field from all page layouts.
Remove visibility to all report profiles.
Grant read-only access to all report profiles.
Deselect auto add to custom report type.

questions.explanationEs: Al crear un campo personalizado hay una casilla para añadirlo a los custom report types existentes, marcada por defecto, y hay que desmarcarla para que el campo no aparezca en ellos. Quitar el campo de los page layouts o cambiar el acceso de los perfiles solo afecta a lo que ven los usuarios en los registros y en los permisos, no a qué campos ofrecen los report types.
questions.explanationEn: When creating a custom field there is a checkbox to add it to existing custom report types, selected by default, and it has to be cleared so the field does not appear in them. Removing the field from page layouts or changing profile access only affects what users see on records and their permissions, not which fields the report types offer.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks recently implemented the application lifecycle Management process to its release management strategy. Which category handles bug fixes and simple changes?
questions.explanationEs: Patch es la categoría de release de ALM para corregir errores y hacer cambios sencillos y de bajo impacto. Minor se reserva para mejoras pequeñas y Major para funcionalidad nueva o cambios grandes. «Roll» es una versión truncada de Rollback, que no es una categoría de release sino la acción de revertir un despliegue ya hecho.
questions.explanationEn: Patch is the ALM release category for fixing bugs and making simple, low-impact changes. Minor is reserved for small enhancements and Major for new functionality or large changes. "Roll" is a truncated Rollback, which is not a release category but the action of reversing a deployment that has already been made.

questions.stem: Universal Containers has purchased a lightning component on the AppExchange. In which two areas can these components be used? Choose 2 answers
questions.explanationEs: Un componente Lightning comprado en AppExchange se puede colocar en páginas editadas con Lightning App Builder (home, record y app pages) y, si está preparado para ello, se puede usar como Lightning component quick action. Una validation rule es una fórmula de lógica de negocio que bloquea un guardado, no un lugar donde se muestren componentes, y «Time Failure» no es un área de Salesforce donde se usen componentes.
questions.explanationEn: A Lightning component bought on AppExchange can be placed on pages edited in Lightning App Builder (home, record and app pages) and, if it is built for it, used as a Lightning component quick action. A validation rule is a business-logic formula that blocks a save, not a place where components are displayed, and "Time Failure" is not a Salesforce area where components are used.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks (CK) needs to capture the tier for each Loyalty_Member__c record. CK has three fixed tier values: Standard, Plus, and Elite. The team wants to prevent users from entering inconsistent values and wants to filter and group Loyalty Member reports by Tier. Which field type should the Platform App Builder use?

options.text: A picklist field with the three values defined
A multi-select picklist field with the three values defined
A text field with no formatting constraints
A formula field that only allows three values

questions.explanationEs: Un campo picklist de selección simple con los tres valores (Standard, Plus y Elite) obliga a elegir un único valor de una lista controlada, evita entradas inconsistentes y se puede usar para filtrar y agrupar en informes. Un multi-select picklist permitiría que un miembro tuviera varios niveles a la vez, un campo de texto libre admite variaciones de ortografía que ensucian los informes, y un campo de fórmula calcula su valor a partir de otros datos en lugar de dejar elegir al usuario.
questions.explanationEn: A single-select picklist field with the three values (Standard, Plus and Elite) forces users to pick exactly one value from a controlled list, prevents inconsistent entries and can be used to filter and group in reports. A multi-select picklist would let a member hold several tiers at once, a free text field allows spelling variations that pollute reports, and a formula field derives its value from other data instead of letting the user choose.

questions.stem: An app builder has created a change set and deployed a report from their development sandbox to a partial sandbox for User Acceptance Testing. When the app builder runs the report, no data is returned. What can be a reason for this?

options.text: Data is deployed when added to a change sets.
Data is unable to be deployed with change sets.
Reports have to be manually re-created in each environment.
Reports have to be deployed with Salesforce OK.

questions.explanationEs: Los change sets despliegan solo metadatos (configuración, como la definición del informe) y nunca registros, así que los datos no viajan con ellos. El informe se desplegó bien, pero el partial copy sandbox solo contiene una muestra de los datos de producción y nada en el change set trae los registros que el informe necesita, por lo que el resultado sale vacío. Los informes sí se pueden desplegar con change sets sin recrearlos a mano, y «Salesforce OK» no es ningún requisito de despliegue.
questions.explanationEn: Change sets deploy metadata only (configuration, such as the report definition) and never records, so data does not travel with them. The report deployed fine, but the partial copy sandbox holds only a sample of production data and nothing in the change set brings the records the report needs, so the result is empty. Reports can be deployed with change sets without recreating them by hand, and "Salesforce OK" is not a deployment requirement.

questions.stem: Universal Containers wants sales reps to get permission from their managers before deleting Opportunities. What can be used to meet these requirements?

options.text: Approval process and flow with a scheduled path
Schedule-triggered flow with Submit for Approval action
Approval process with a record triggered flow

questions.explanationEs: Salesforce no tiene un paso de aprobación nativo que se dispare al borrar un registro. El patrón declarativo es que el rep solicite el borrado (por ejemplo con un campo o estado de solicitud), un approval process envíe la solicitud al manager y, al aprobarse, un record-triggered flow ejecute el borrado de la Opportunity. Un approval process de dos pasos solo enruta la aprobación y nunca borra nada, y un scheduled path o un schedule-triggered flow dependen del tiempo y no reaccionan a la petición del usuario.
questions.explanationEn: Salesforce has no native approval step that fires when a record is deleted. The declarative pattern is for the rep to request the deletion (for example with a request field or status), an approval process to send the request to the manager, and, once approved, a record-triggered flow to delete the Opportunity. A two-step approval process only routes the approval and never deletes anything, and a scheduled path or schedule-triggered flow is time-based and does not react to the user's request.

questions.stem: Universal Containers manages leads in a Lead qualification queue where Sales reps can accept ownership of the Lead. Campaign members are required to have a sales owner. Which validation rule should an app builder configure?
questions.reviewNote: El texto de las cuatro opciones está muy dañado por el OCR (por ejemplo «Lea Owner:ter.Id»). V23.35 marca la regla con ISNEW() e ISBLANK sobre el propietario de tipo User, que reconstruyo como AND(ISNEW(), ISBLANK(Lead.Owner:User.Id)): da error al crear un Campaign Member cuyo Lead no tiene un usuario como propietario, por ejemplo porque sigue en la cola. Esa clave es coherente con el enunciado, y la explicación de la fuente la lee igual. Las tres votaciones ciegas, en cambio, eligen la regla NOT(ISBLANK(Lead.Owner:Queue.Id)), que también serviría y era más legible que la reconstruida. Como las opciones están dañadas y no puedo confirmar el texto original, mantengo la clave de V23.35 y la marco como dudosa. La reconstrucción de las opciones es una lectura razonable, no una certeza.
questions.explanationEs: Un Lead que está en la cola de cualificación tiene como propietario una Queue y no un usuario, así que para exigir un sales owner la regla debe dar error cuando el propietario del Lead no es un User. La regla de la clave lo hace con ISBLANK sobre el Id del propietario de tipo User, que queda vacío cuando el dueño es una cola, y ISNEW() limita la comprobación al momento de crear el Campaign Member. La regla basada en Lead.Owner.Id nunca se cumple, porque ese Id está informado tanto si el dueño es un usuario como una cola. La regla que solo comprueba que el dueño sea una Queue detectaría el mismo caso, pero se dispararía también en cada edición posterior. La variante cuyo texto quedó ilegible tras el OCR no se puede evaluar.
questions.explanationEn: A Lead sitting in the qualification queue is owned by a Queue rather than a user, so to require a sales owner the rule must raise an error when the Lead's owner is not a User. The keyed rule does it with ISBLANK on the User-type owner Id, which is empty when the owner is a queue, and ISNEW() limits the check to the moment the Campaign Member is created. The rule based on Lead.Owner.Id never fires, because that Id is populated whether the owner is a user or a queue. The rule that only tests that the owner is a Queue would catch the same case, but it would also fire on every later edit. The variant whose text was left unreadable by the OCR cannot be evaluated.

questions.stem: The Director of Marketing at Northern Trail Outfitters wants the app builder to create a Formula field that tracks how many days have elapsed since a contact was sent a Marketing communication. The director is only interested in whole units. Which function should be used to return a date for calculating the difference?
questions.explanationEs: TODAY() devuelve la fecha actual como valor Date, y restarle el campo de fecha del envío da el número de días completos transcurridos. NOW() devuelve fecha y hora, así que la resta arrastra fracciones de día, y DATETIMEVALUE() también produce un valor de fecha y hora. DATEVALUE() solo convierte un valor de fecha y hora o de texto en una fecha, pero no devuelve la fecha actual.
questions.explanationEn: TODAY() returns the current date as a Date value, and subtracting the send-date field from it gives the number of whole days elapsed. NOW() returns a date/time, so the subtraction carries fractions of a day, and DATETIMEVALUE() also produces a date/time value. DATEVALUE() only converts a date/time or text value into a date and does not return the current date.

questions.stem: The Cloud Kicks (CK) sales team is currently using a sales app in Lightning Experience. CK is planning a Salesforce mobile app rollout next month to increase productivity for reps while out in the field. After reviewing the mobile app, the sales operations manager asks about ways to create an enhanced user experience. Which two solutions could an app builder suggest? Choose 2 answers

options.text: Allow mobile users to support Account Upstream Agent Closets.
Include Today as a guide from in line size.
Set up different mobile menu configurations of different types of users.
Create a custom app page and Assign to the mobile menu.

questions.reviewNote: Dos de las cuatro opciones (la de «Account Upstream Agent Closets» y la de «Today as a guide from in line size») están ilegibles por el OCR. Las claves de V23.35 y FreeCram v3.5 marcan la opción de Today y la de la custom app page, y la explicación de la fuente reinterpreta el texto roto como «incluir Today como elemento de navegación». Las tres votaciones ciegas, en cambio, eligen la custom app page y las configuraciones de menú móvil distintas por tipo de usuario, porque la opción de Today no se puede leer. Esta última también es una función real de Salesforce, y no puedo comprobar qué decía la opción de Today en el original. Se mantiene la clave de la fuente y se marca como dudosa.
questions.explanationEs: Crear una custom app page con Lightning App Builder y asignarla al menú de navegación móvil es una forma real de dar a los reps una experiencia pensada para el móvil. La clave de la fuente marca además la opción que incluye Today, una función estándar de la app móvil, aunque su texto está ilegible y no se puede verificar. Configurar menús móviles distintos según el tipo de usuario también es posible en Salesforce, así que la pregunta es dudosa. La opción sobre «Account Upstream Agent Closets» es texto roto sin sentido y no se puede aceptar.
questions.explanationEn: Creating a custom app page with Lightning App Builder and assigning it to the mobile navigation menu is a real way to give reps an experience designed for mobile. The source key also marks the option that includes Today, a standard feature of the mobile app, but its text is unreadable and cannot be verified. Setting up different mobile menus per type of user is also possible in Salesforce, which is why this question is disputed. The option about "Account Upstream Agent Closets" is garbled text with no meaning and cannot be accepted.

questions.stem: A Platform App Builder created a scheduled flow that runs at midnight to perform data cleanup. The flow is designed to query all open Opportunities that haven't been worked for more than 60 days and update the Status field to Closed Lost. However, the app builder notices that the flow is running into governor limits during execution. What is the reason for this?

options.text: The app builder did not specify an object and filter criteria in the Start element of the schedule-triggered flow.
The app builder did not create a Fault Path on the Update Records element.
The flow contains a Loop element that contains an Update Records element inside it.
Schedule-triggered flows do not support updates to standard objects like Opportunities.

questions.explanationEs: Un elemento Update Records dentro de un Loop ejecuta una operación DML en cada iteración, y con muchas Opportunities se agotan los governor limits de la transacción. La solución es modificar los registros con Assignment, guardarlos en una record collection y hacer una sola actualización después del Loop. Un Fault Path gestiona errores pero no reduce el consumo de límites, y los schedule-triggered flows sí pueden actualizar objetos estándar como Opportunity. Indicar el objeto y los filtros en la Start es correcto y no causa el problema.
questions.explanationEn: An Update Records element inside a Loop runs a DML operation on every iteration, and with many Opportunities the transaction governor limits are exhausted. The fix is to change the records with Assignment elements, store them in a record collection and run a single update after the Loop. A Fault Path handles errors but does not reduce limit consumption, and schedule-triggered flows can update standard objects such as Opportunity. Specifying the object and filters in the Start element is correct and does not cause the problem.

questions.stem: The VP of sales at AW Computing would like a Roll-Up Summary field on the Account object to aggregate the amount of opportunities related to an Account. The app builder is unable to implement this change. Why is the app builder unable to fulfill the request?

options.text: The default currency is not an active currency in the organization.
The organization has Advanced Currency Management enabled
Roll-Up Summary fields are unavailable on the Account object.
Currency fields are unable to be referenced in Roll-Up Summary fields.

questions.reviewNote: La relación estándar entre Opportunity y Account es un lookup, así que en rigor un roll-up summary nativo sobre Account no existe de todas formas. Entre las opciones, Advanced Currency Management es la limitación documentada que pretende la pregunta, y las demás son claramente falsas.
questions.explanationEs: Con Advanced Currency Management activado, Salesforce documenta que los campos roll-up summary en Account que resumen importes de Opportunity no están disponibles, y por eso el app builder no puede crear el que pide el VP. Que la divisa por defecto no esté activa no es la restricción que bloquea el roll-up, los roll-up summary sí existen en Account cuando la relación con el objeto hijo es master-detail, y los campos de tipo Currency se pueden resumir en general. En rigor, la relación entre Opportunity y Account es un lookup y por eso tampoco habría un roll-up nativo, pero de las opciones dadas esta es la causa que busca la pregunta.
questions.explanationEn: With Advanced Currency Management enabled, Salesforce documents that roll-up summary fields on Account that summarize Opportunity amounts are not available, which is why the app builder cannot create the one the VP asks for. An inactive default currency is not the restriction that blocks the roll-up, roll-up summary fields do exist on Account when the relationship with the child object is master-detail, and Currency fields can be summarized in general. Strictly, the Opportunity-to-Account relationship is a lookup, so there would be no native roll-up either, but of the choices given this is the cause the question is after.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks has a sales rep who is stating that their Contact is unavailable for other users to see within Salesforce. In which three ways can an app builder troubleshoot this issue? Choose 3 answers

options.text: Review the Contact record and ensure it is linked to an Account.
Create a new Contact and have the users try again.
Verify the users with the issue have access to the Contact object.
Create an Account Sharing Rule to give the users access to all records.
Confirm whether Default Organization-Wide Sharing Settings provide access to the Account.

questions.explanationEs: Un Contact sin Account es privado: solo lo ven su propietario y quienes están por encima en la jerarquía de roles, así que hay que comprobar que esté vinculado a un Account. Además los usuarios necesitan permiso de lectura sobre el objeto Contact y, si el Contact está «Controlled by Parent», el acceso depende del OWD del Account. Crear un Contact nuevo no diagnostica nada y una sharing rule del Account para todos los registros abre datos de más en lugar de encontrar la causa.
questions.explanationEn: A Contact with no Account is private: only its owner and users above them in the role hierarchy can see it, so you must check that it is linked to an Account. Users also need Read permission on the Contact object and, when Contact is Controlled by Parent, access follows the Account organization-wide default. Creating a new Contact diagnoses nothing, and an Account sharing rule for all records overexposes data instead of finding the cause.

questions.stem: Sales Managers want to be automatically notified any time there is a change to an Opportunity Close Date and want these changes to be tracked on the Opportunity. Which two configurations should an app builder recommend? Choose 2 answers

options.text: Use a record-triggered flow on Opportunity and a Chatter post action.

questions.explanationEs: Feed Tracking sobre Opportunity con el campo Close Date registra cada cambio en el feed del registro, y un record-triggered flow que se dispara al cambiar Close Date con una acción de Chatter post avisa automáticamente a los managers (por ejemplo con una @mención). Un outbound message envía datos a un endpoint externo y es una acción de Workflow Rules, ya retirado, y Historical Trending solo guarda instantáneas de valores para informes: ni notifica ni publica en el feed.
questions.explanationEn: Feed Tracking on Opportunity with the Close Date field records every change in the record's feed, and a record-triggered flow that fires when Close Date changes, with a Chatter post action, automatically alerts the managers (for example with an @mention). An outbound message sends data to an external endpoint and is a Workflow Rules action, which is retired, and Historical Trending only keeps value snapshots for reports: it neither notifies nor posts to the feed.

questions.stem: An app builder needs to deploy a new account detail page layout from Sandbox to production. Which three components should an app builder include in the Change Set to ensure it Deploys successfully and visually as expected? Choose 3 answers
questions.explanationEs: Un page layout se despliega con change set junto con los componentes que referencia: los custom fields que muestra y las custom actions (quick actions) que incluye en el publisher; si faltan en producción, el despliegue falla o el layout se ve incompleto. El System Administrator profile no hace falta para mover el layout, solo si se quisieran desplegar permisos o asignaciones de layout. Lightning App Builder es una herramienta para crear páginas Lightning, no un componente de un page layout clásico.
questions.explanationEn: A page layout is deployed in a change set together with the components it references: the custom fields it displays and the custom actions (quick actions) it includes; if those are missing in production, the deployment fails or the layout looks incomplete. The System Administrator profile is not needed to move the layout, only if you also want to deploy permissions or layout assignments. Lightning App Builder is a tool for building Lightning pages, not a component of a classic page layout.

questions.stem: An app builder at DreamHouse Realty created a custom object which has Fields containing data from two different objects via related lookups. What is needed to create "with" or "without" reports on the new custom Object?
questions.explanationEs: Los informes «with / without» se crean con un Custom Report Type, donde se define la relación entre objetos como «A records with or without B records». Los Report Filters solo restringen filas de un informe ya existente y no definen relaciones entre objetos, el Row-Level Formula calcula un valor por fila y el Bucket Field agrupa valores de un campo; ninguno crea la estructura de informe con o sin registros relacionados.
questions.explanationEn: "With / without" reports are built with a Custom Report Type, where you define the object relationship as "A records with or without B records". Report filters only restrict rows of an existing report and do not define relationships between objects, a row-level formula calculates a value per row, and a bucket field groups values of a field; none of them creates the report structure for records with or without related records.

questions.stem: Universal Containers wants to track installation information once a Container has been purchased on a custom object. Sales reps should have visibility of All the installations associated with their opportunities. Which kind of relationship should this new object have to Opportunity?
questions.explanationEs: Con una relación Master-Detail el objeto de instalación hereda el sharing del Opportunity padre: quien ve una Opportunity ve también todas sus instalaciones, sin configurar nada más. Un Lookup tiene su propio OWD y su propia propiedad, así que no garantiza esa visibilidad. Hierarchical solo existe en el objeto User y Many to Many exige un junction object con dos masters, algo que el requisito no pide.
questions.explanationEn: With a Master-Detail relationship the installation object inherits sharing from its parent Opportunity: anyone who can see an Opportunity also sees all of its installations, with no extra setup. A Lookup has its own organization-wide default and its own ownership, so it does not guarantee that visibility. Hierarchical exists only on the User object, and Many to Many requires a junction object with two masters, which the requirement does not call for.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks works on an annual subscription model. When a sales rep marks An opportunity as closed won, a new opportunity should automatically be created for The renewal. The contracts team works outside of Salesforce but also needs to be Notified about closed deals in order to initiate the contract process with the customer. Which automation solution would meet these requirements?
questions.explanationEs: Un record-triggered flow se dispara cuando la Opportunity pasa a Closed Won, crea la Opportunity de renovación con Create Records y avisa al equipo de contratos externo con un email o una llamada saliente. Un Approval Process solo enruta aprobaciones, una Validation Rule solo bloquea guardados y un Outbound Message (acción de Workflow Rules, ya retirado) puede avisar a un sistema externo pero no crea registros.
questions.explanationEn: A record-triggered flow fires when the Opportunity becomes Closed Won, creates the renewal Opportunity with Create Records, and notifies the external contracts team with an email or an outbound call. An Approval Process only routes approvals, a Validation Rule only blocks saves, and an Outbound Message (a Workflow Rules action, which is retired) can alert an external system but cannot create records.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks has three types of customer support processes: Platinum, Diamond, and Bronze. The Platform App Builder created separate record types for each process on the Case object. The customer support team should be unable to create new Cases with the Bronze record type. How should the app builder meet this requirement?

options.text: Create a permission set group for Case that includes the Platinum and Diamond record types.
Update the organization-wide defaults to Private for Case.
Update the support team's profile to remove the Bronze record type.
Make the record type hidden to support users and update sharing rules to Private.

questions.explanationEs: Los record types que puede elegir un usuario al crear un registro se asignan en su profile (o en permission sets), así que se quita Bronze del profile del equipo de soporte; si otro permission set también lo concede, hay que retirarlo ahí. El OWD y las sharing rules controlan qué registros se ven, no qué record types se pueden usar, y las sharing rules no pueden ponerse en «Private». Un permission set group con Platinum y Diamond solo añade acceso y no revoca el de Bronze que ya da el profile.
questions.explanationEn: The record types a user can pick when creating a record are assigned in their profile (or permission sets), so you remove Bronze from the support team's profile; if another permission set also grants it, it must be removed there too. Organization-wide defaults and sharing rules control which records users see, not which record types they can use, and sharing rules cannot be set to Private. A permission set group with Platinum and Diamond only adds access and does not revoke the Bronze access the profile already gives.

questions.stem: A company wants to prevent sales users from saving Opportunity Products with discounts over 15% for Opportunity records. How should the company configure this requirement?

options.text: Validation rule on the Opportunity Product record
Approval process triggered by Opportunity Product updates
Validation rule on the Opportunity record
Big Deal alert for the Opportunity record

questions.explanationEs: El descuento vive en cada línea (Opportunity Product, OpportunityLineItem), así que la Validation Rule debe crearse en ese objeto con una fórmula que sea TRUE cuando Discount supere el 15 %, y así bloquea el guardado. Una regla en Opportunity no evalúa de forma fiable los campos de las líneas ni se ejecuta cuando solo cambian las líneas. Un Approval Process enruta una excepción en lugar de impedir el guardado y Big Deal alert era una alerta de Workflow ya retirada que solo avisa.
questions.explanationEn: The discount lives on each line item (Opportunity Product, OpportunityLineItem), so the Validation Rule must be created on that object with a formula that is TRUE when Discount exceeds 15%, which blocks the save. A rule on Opportunity does not reliably evaluate line item fields and does not run when only line items change. An Approval Process routes an exception instead of preventing the save, and a Big Deal alert was a retired Workflow-era notification that only informs.

questions.stem: An app builder wants to configure a sandbox environment for users to perform user acceptance testing of the latest features from developers. The sandbox should include about 500MB worth of data configured via a template. Also, the sandbox should be refreshed weekly. Which sandbox meets the requirements?
questions.explanationEs: Un Partial Copy sandbox copia metadata más una muestra de datos definida con un sandbox template (hasta 5 GB), lo que cubre los 500 MB pedidos, y se puede refrescar cada 5 días, de modo que una frecuencia semanal es viable. Un Full sandbox copia todos los datos y solo se refresca cada 29 días, y los Developer y Developer File sandbox no admiten templates de datos ni tienen esa capacidad de datos de muestra.
questions.explanationEn: A Partial Copy sandbox copies metadata plus a data sample defined with a sandbox template (up to 5 GB), which covers the 500 MB needed, and it can be refreshed every 5 days, so a weekly refresh is feasible. A Full sandbox copies all data and can only be refreshed every 29 days, and Developer and Developer File sandboxes do not support data templates or this sample data capacity.

questions.stem: At Universal Containers, a Platform App Builder is building a record-triggered flow on Opportunity. When a new Opportunity is created, the flow must set the Stage field to a default value based on the related Account's Industry. The app builder wants the most efficient configuration. Which flow configuration should the app builder use?

options.text: An after-save record-triggered flow with an Assignment element that sets the Opportunity Stage based on Record.Account.Industry.
A before-save record-triggered flow with an Assignment element that sets the Opportunity Stage based on Record.Account.Industry.
An after-save record-triggered flow with an Update Records element that sets the Opportunity's Stage based on the Account's Industry.
A before-save record-triggered flow with an Update Records element that sets the Opportunity's Stage based on the Account's Industry.

questions.explanationEs: Un before-save record-triggered flow es la opción más eficiente para cambiar campos del propio registro que dispara el flow: los valores se asignan antes de guardar y no hace falta una segunda operación DML. Un Assignment sobre $Record asigna Stage leyendo Record.Account.Industry a través de la relación. Un after-save flow o un Update Records añaden una operación de guardado extra y son menos eficientes.
questions.explanationEn: A before-save record-triggered flow is the most efficient way to change fields on the record that triggered the flow: values are set before the save, so no second DML operation is needed. An Assignment on $Record sets Stage while reading Record.Account.Industry through the relationship. An after-save flow or an Update Records element adds an extra save operation and is less efficient.

questions.stem: Universal Containers wants to control the visibility of a specific section of a Lightning page based on the device type used by the user. What should a Platform App Builder recommend?
questions.explanationEs: Dynamic Forms permite definir reglas de visibilidad sobre las secciones de campos de una página de registro, y esas reglas pueden depender del dispositivo (Device), sin escribir código. Un Lightning Web Component serviría, pero exige programación y no es la herramienta declarativa que se pide. Los Record Types determinan procesos de negocio y valores de picklist, y el Page Layout no ofrece visibilidad según el dispositivo.
questions.explanationEn: Dynamic Forms lets you set visibility rules on the field sections of a record page, and those rules can depend on the device (Device), with no code. A Lightning Web Component could do it, but it requires programming and is not the declarative tool asked for. Record Types control business processes and picklist values, and a Page Layout has no device-based visibility.

questions.stem: Sales reps at Cloud Kicks (CK) forget to submit for approval when CK needs orders reviewed before close won. CK wants to automatically submit Opportunities into the Secure Commitment Stage to eliminate manual submission. Which feature meets the business requirements?

options.text: Record-Triggered flow optimized for Actions and Related Records
Record-Triggered flow optimized for Fast Field Updates

questions.explanationEs: Un record-triggered flow optimizado para Actions and Related Records se ejecuta después de guardar el registro, así que puede usar la acción Submit for Approval sobre la Opportunity cuando llega a la etapa indicada. El optimizado para Fast Field Updates corre antes de guardar y está pensado para actualizar campos del propio registro, por lo que no puede enviarlo a aprobación. Un Platform Event-Triggered flow necesita un evento de plataforma y un botón con screen flow depende de que el usuario haga clic, así que ninguno elimina el envío manual.
questions.explanationEn: A record-triggered flow optimized for Actions and Related Records runs after the record is saved, so it can use the Submit for Approval action on the Opportunity when it reaches the stage. The one optimized for Fast Field Updates runs before save and is meant for updating fields on the triggering record, so it cannot submit for approval. A Platform Event-Triggered flow needs a platform event, and a custom button with a screen flow depends on a user clicking, so neither removes the manual submission.

questions.stem: Universal Containers wants to embed a chart of all related Opportunities, by stage, on the Account detail page. Which type of report should an app builder create to add to the Account page layout?

options.text: A tabular report on the Opportunity object
A tabular report on the Account object
A summary report on the Opportunity object
A summary report on the Account object

questions.explanationEs: Para mostrar un gráfico por etapa en la página de Account hace falta un summary report sobre Opportunity agrupado por Stage, que después se añade como Report Chart filtrado al registro. Un informe tabular no permite agrupar, así que no puede generar los totales que necesita el gráfico. Un summary report sobre Account no agrupa las Opportunities por etapa, así que no sirve para esa vista.
questions.explanationEn: To show a chart of related Opportunities by stage on the Account page, you need a summary report on the Opportunity object grouped by Stage, which is then added as a Report Chart filtered to the Account record. A tabular report cannot group rows, so it cannot produce the totals the chart needs. A summary report on the Account object does not group the Opportunities by stage, so it does not serve this view.

questions.stem: Universal Containers ' 24/7 support requires a guided wizard to step customer service reps through a standardized troubleshooting script. The process must capture user input at various stages and create a follow- up Case record upon completion. Which type of flow should the Platform App Builder build to provide this interactive user interface?
questions.explanationEs: Screen Flow es el tipo de flow interactivo: muestra pantallas con instrucciones y preguntas, guarda las respuestas del agente en cada paso y puede crear al final el Case de seguimiento con un elemento Create Records. Los schedule-triggered flow, los record-triggered flow y los platform event-triggered flow se ejecutan en segundo plano sin interfaz para el usuario, así que no pueden guiar al agente por el guion.
questions.explanationEn: A Screen Flow is the interactive flow type: it shows screens with instructions and questions, stores the agent's answers at each step, and can create the follow-up Case at the end with a Create Records element. Schedule-triggered, record-triggered and platform event-triggered flows run in the background with no user interface, so they cannot walk a rep through a script.

questions.stem: At Universal Containers, two record-triggered flows run after an Opportunity is updated. One calculates a custom discount amount, and the other sends an email notification that references the calculated discount. The Platform App Builder must guarantee that the discount-calculation flow runs before the notification flow, while keeping the two flows separate for ownership reasons. How should the app builder meet this requirement?

options.text: Configure the notification flow to run asynchronously after the save so it executes after other record- triggered flows on Opportunity.
Add a scheduled path with a zero-minute interval at the start of the notification flow to delay its execution.
Move both flows ' logic into a single before-save record-triggered flow on Opportunity to control execution order natively.
Set the trigger order in Flow Trigger Explorer for each flow so the discount-calculation flow has a lower trigger order value than the notification flow.

questions.explanationEs: Flow Trigger Explorer permite fijar el Trigger Order de cada record-triggered flow sobre el mismo objeto y evento, así que el flow de cálculo puede ejecutarse antes que el de notificación manteniendo cada flow separado. Juntar la lógica en un único flow rompe la separación de responsabilidades que se exige. Un scheduled path con cero minutos o ejecutar el flow de notificación de forma asíncrona no garantiza el orden frente a los demás record-triggered flows.
questions.explanationEn: Flow Trigger Explorer lets you set the Trigger Order of each record-triggered flow on the same object and event, so the discount calculation can run before the notification while each flow stays separate. Merging the logic into a single flow breaks the required ownership separation. A zero-minute scheduled path or running the notification asynchronously does not guarantee the order against the other record-triggered flows.

questions.stem: Which two places can an app builder go to see a list of available Custom Lightning Components in their org? Choose 2 answers
questions.explanationEs: Los componentes Lightning personalizados aparecen en el panel de componentes de Lightning App Builder, dentro de su sección personalizada, y en Setup, en Lightning Components, donde se listan los componentes LWC y Aura de la org. Los componentes de Visualforce también están en Setup, pero son otra tecnología y no componentes Lightning. Salesforce Optimizer analiza la configuración de la org y no es un listado de componentes.
questions.explanationEn: Custom Lightning components appear in the components panel of Lightning App Builder, in its custom section, and in Setup under Lightning Components, which lists the org's Lightning Web Components and Aura components. Visualforce components are also in Setup, but they are a different technology and not Lightning components. Salesforce Optimizer reviews the org's configuration and is not a component listing.

questions.stem: At Ursa Major Solar, there is a single Lightning record page for the Celestial Bodies custom object; however, there is a Lightning component the App builder wants to restrict to mobile app users. Which feature in the Lightning app builder should be utilized?
questions.explanationEs: El component visibility filter de Lightning App Builder muestra u oculta un componente según condiciones como el tipo de dispositivo (Device Type), así que puede limitarse a los usuarios de la app móvil dentro de la única página de registro, sin crear otra página. El highlights panel y los related list quick links son elementos de contenido de la página y no restringen un componente por dispositivo. Los form factor checkboxes no son la forma de ocultar un componente concreto dentro de una misma página.
questions.explanationEn: The component visibility filter in Lightning App Builder shows or hides a component based on conditions such as the device type (Device Type), so the component can be limited to Salesforce mobile app users on the single record page without creating another page. The highlights panel and related list quick links are page content elements and do not restrict a component by device. Form factor checkboxes are not the way to hide one specific component within a single page.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks is redefining its entire business process to convert the Manager Notes field from a long text area field. The goal is to encourage Managers to be more concise in their comments and stay at 255 characters or less. There is preexisting information in the Manager Notes field that often is well beyond the character limit. What would happen to any existing information if the app builder tries to convert a preexisting long text area field to text area?

options.text: Preexisting information will truncate to the first 255 characters.
Preexisting information will cause an error message to pop up.
Preexisting information will remain even if it was over 255 characters.
Preexisting information in the field will be completely lost.

questions.explanationEs: Al convertir un Long Text Area a Text Area, Salesforce trunca los valores existentes a sus primeros 255 caracteres: no conserva el texto completo, no borra el campo ni muestra un error. El administrador debe avisar a los managers antes de la conversión, porque el contenido que pase de 255 caracteres se pierde.
questions.explanationEn: When a Long Text Area field is converted to Text Area, Salesforce truncates existing values to their first 255 characters: the full text is not kept, the field is not cleared, and no error is shown. The administrator should warn managers before the conversion, because any content beyond 255 characters is lost.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks (CK) wants to set up a custom child object to track gift cards issued to a customer. A key requirement is to track the total number of gift cards opened and gift cards issued on an Account. CK wants to permanently ensure the gift cards are unable to be moved across any other Account once it is created. On the gift card object, which field type should be created to support this requirement?
questions.explanationEs: Una master-detail relationship hace que Gift Card sea hijo de Account: el Account puede llevar roll-up summary fields que cuenten las gift cards abiertas y emitidas, y cada tarjeta queda ligada a su padre desde su creación, sin poder moverse a otra cuenta mientras no se permita el reparenting. Una lookup no admite roll-up summary sobre el padre, y un roll-up summary o una fórmula no pueden guardar el vínculo entre los dos registros, así que cada alternativa incumple algún requisito.
questions.explanationEn: A master-detail relationship makes Gift Card a child of Account: the Account can carry roll-up summary fields that count its gift cards opened and issued, and each card stays tied to its parent from creation and cannot be moved to another account unless reparenting is allowed. A lookup relationship does not support roll-up summary fields on the parent, and a roll-up summary or formula field cannot store the link between the two records. Each of the other choices therefore fails one of the requirements.

questions.stem: A sales manager has noticed that reps continue to input contacts Directly in their phone instead of adding them to Salesforce. What should an app builder recommend to ensure the data makes it into Salesforce?

options.text: Allow Salesforce to import Contacts from mobile device Contact lists.
Enable in-app notifications every time a contact is created
Enable offline create, edit, and delete in Salesforce for Android and iOS.
Allow users to relate a contact to multiple accounts.

questions.explanationEs: Permitir que Salesforce importe contactos desde la lista de contactos del dispositivo trae a la org los contactos que los reps ya guardan en el teléfono, así que el dato termina en Salesforce. Activar offline create, edit and delete solo permite crear o editar registros dentro de la app sin conexión y no recoge los contactos ya guardados en el móvil. Las notificaciones en la app y poder relacionar un contacto con varias cuentas no hacen que esos contactos lleguen a Salesforce.
questions.explanationEn: Allowing Salesforce to import contacts from the device's contact list brings the contacts reps already saved on their phones into the org, so the data reaches Salesforce. Enabling offline create, edit and delete only lets reps create or change records in the app without a connection, and it does not pull in the contacts already on the phone. In-app notifications and relating a contact to multiple accounts do not get those contacts into Salesforce.

questions.stem: Northern Trail Outfitters wants the field sales team to only see the accounts that they Own. Separate North American and European marketing teams should only see Accounts in their respective regions. The inside sales team needs to see all accounts In Salesforce. How can this be accomplished?

options.text: Set the Organization-Wide Default to Public for accounts. Create profiles for each marketing team, and create an Inside Sales Team role that is at the top of the Role Hierarchy.

Set the Organization Wide Default to Public for accounts. Create criteria-based sharing rules for Each marketing team, and create an Inside Sales Team permission set with the "View All" setting for Accounts.
Set the Organization-Wide Default to Private for accounts. Create permission sets for each marketing Team, and create an Inside Sales Team profile with the "View All" setting for accounts.

Set the Organization Wide Default to Private for accounts. Create criteria-based sharing rules for Each marketing team, and create an Inside Sales Team profile with the "View All" setting for Accounts.

questions.explanationEs: El Organization-Wide Default de Account debe ser Private para que el equipo de field sales solo vea las cuentas que posee; desde ahí se abre acceso solo donde hace falta. Los criteria-based sharing rules comparten las cuentas de cada región con el equipo de marketing correspondiente, y un profile de Inside Sales con el permiso de objeto "View All" en Accounts le da visibilidad de todas las cuentas sin tocar el OWD. Con OWD Public todos verían todas las cuentas, y los permission sets o un rol en lo alto de la jerarquía por sí solos no comparten cuentas por región.
questions.explanationEn: The Account Organization-Wide Default must be Private so that field sales only sees the accounts it owns, and access is then opened only where needed. Criteria-based sharing rules share each region's accounts with the matching marketing team, and an Inside Sales profile with the "View All" object permission on Accounts gives that team visibility of every account without touching the OWD. With a Public OWD everyone would see every account, and permission sets or a role at the top of the hierarchy do not share accounts by region on their own.

questions.stem: Universal Containers wants to ensure that they are accepting clean data from their users and verify that important fields are entered. What should an app builder recommend to meet this requirement?

options.text: Update the important fields to be required on the page layout.
Create a Flow to clean any data that is formatted wrong.
Configure a validation to require a field for a specific record type.
Make a formula field to check the format of the important fields.

questions.explanationEs: Una validation rule que exige el campo para un record type concreto se ejecuta al guardar desde cualquier vía (interfaz, API, importaciones, Data Loader) y bloquea los datos incompletos, que es lo que significa aceptar datos limpios. Marcar el campo como obligatorio en el page layout solo actúa en la interfaz y no cubre integraciones ni cargas masivas. Un Flow que limpia los datos después no impide que entren mal, y un campo de fórmula solo muestra un valor calculado: no puede rechazar un guardado.
questions.explanationEn: A validation rule that requires the field for a specific record type runs on save from any entry point (UI, API, imports, Data Loader) and blocks incomplete data, which is what accepting clean data means. Making the field required on the page layout only works in the UI and does not cover integrations or bulk loads. A Flow that cleans data afterwards does not stop bad data from coming in, and a formula field only displays a calculated value: it cannot reject a save.

questions.stem: Universal Containers has a single Contact Lightning record page. A component takes up a lot of room on the page and is NOT needed by users With a Marketing profile. What should the app builder use to solve this issue?
questions.explanationEs: Los filtros de visibilidad de componente de Lightning App Builder muestran u ocultan un componente según condiciones, como el profile del usuario. La única página de registro de Contact sigue siendo la misma y solo los usuarios de Marketing dejan de ver ese componente. El detail page layout define campos y secciones de la ficha, no la visibilidad de componentes de la página; el field-level security controla el acceso a campos, no a componentes; y AppExchange no aporta nada a este problema.
questions.explanationEn: Component visibility filters in Lightning App Builder show or hide a component based on conditions such as the user's profile. The single Contact record page stays the same and only Marketing users stop seeing that component. The detail page layout defines the fields and sections of the record, not the visibility of page components; field-level security controls access to fields, not components; and AppExchange adds nothing to this problem.

questions.stem: An app builder wants to update a field on the parent record When a child record connected via lookup is deleted. Which automation should the app builder use?
questions.explanationEs: Un record-triggered flow sobre el objeto hijo, configurado para ejecutarse cuando se elimina un registro, puede localizar el registro padre y actualizar su campo sin intervención del usuario. Una validation rule solo bloquea guardados y no actualiza otros registros. Un autolaunched flow no tiene disparador propio y necesita que otra automatización o un usuario lo invoque, y una quick action exige que alguien la ejecute a mano, así que ninguno reacciona por sí solo al borrado.
questions.explanationEn: A record-triggered flow on the child object, configured to run when a record is deleted, can find the parent record and update its field with no user involvement. A validation rule only blocks saves and does not update other records. An autolaunched flow has no trigger of its own and needs another automation or a user to call it, and a quick action requires someone to run it manually, so neither reacts to the deletion by itself.

questions.stem: Universal Containers wants to create a report to show job applications with or without resumes. Which consideration should the Platform App Builder be aware of when creating the custom report type?

options.text: When a custom or external object is deleted, the report type and reports remain but cause an error when the report is run.
A primary object selection is locked once the custom report type has been saved.
Once the report type has been deployed, it is unable to be deleted.
An app builder is unable to create custom report types for objects they do not have permissions for.

questions.explanationEs: Al crear un custom report type hay que elegir el primary object, y esa elección queda bloqueada en cuanto se guarda el tipo: no se puede cambiar después, así que conviene decidirla bien desde el principio. Para mostrar job applications con o sin resumes, el primary object es el de las job applications y el de los resumes se añade como objeto relacionado. Las otras afirmaciones describen efectos posteriores, como qué pasa al eliminar un objeto, o consideraciones distintas, y no la limitación que se fija al guardar el tipo.
questions.explanationEn: When you create a custom report type you choose the primary object, and that choice is locked as soon as the report type is saved: it cannot be changed afterwards, so it is worth deciding it correctly from the start. To show job applications with or without resumes, the primary object is the job applications object and the resumes object is added as a related object. The other statements describe later effects, such as what happens when an object is deleted, or unrelated considerations, rather than the limitation that is fixed when the report type is saved.

questions.stem: Universal Containers is excited to launch a new app. The company wants to increase the adoption rate and guide users through different walkthroughs and targeted prompts. What should the Platform App Builder recommend?
questions.explanationEs: In-App Guidance permite crear prompts dirigidos a una audiencia concreta y walkthroughs que enlazan varios prompts paso a paso dentro de Lightning Experience, justo lo que se pide para aumentar la adopción de una app nueva. Un screen flow guía la captura de datos de un proceso, no la adopción de la interfaz. Dynamic Actions muestran u ocultan acciones según condiciones y Dynamic Forms muestran campos de forma condicional: ninguno ofrece prompts ni recorridos guiados.
questions.explanationEn: In-App Guidance lets you build prompts aimed at a specific audience and walkthroughs that chain several prompts step by step inside Lightning Experience, which is exactly what is needed to raise adoption of a new app. A screen flow guides data entry for a process, not adoption of the interface. Dynamic Actions show or hide actions based on conditions and Dynamic Forms show fields conditionally: neither offers prompts or guided tours.

questions.stem: An app builder has downloaded a component from the AppExchange successfully; however, they are unable to add it to the Lightning home page. Which two reasons can be preventing the app builder from being able to add the Custom component? Choose 2 answers

options.text: A custom tab must be created to add custom components to the page with the App Builder.
The component requires a developer permission to add it to the page with the App Builder.
My Domain must be deployed to add custom components to the page with the App Builder.
The component is tagged for record pages instead of home pages and is not showing up in The App Builder.

questions.explanationEs: Hay dos causas posibles. El componente puede estar expuesto solo para páginas de registro y no para la Home page (el destino lightning__HomePage), por lo que no aparece en la paleta de Lightning App Builder al editar la página de inicio. Además, My Domain debe estar desplegado para poder usar componentes Lightning personalizados en Lightning App Builder. No hace falta crear una custom tab, que sirve para la navegación y no para colocar componentes en una página, ni un permiso de desarrollador especial para añadir el componente.
questions.explanationEn: There are two possible causes. The component may be exposed only for record pages and not for the Home page (the lightning__HomePage target), so it does not show up in the Lightning App Builder palette when editing the home page. In addition, My Domain must be deployed to use custom Lightning components in Lightning App Builder. A custom tab is not needed, since tabs are for navigation and not for placing components on a page, and no special developer permission is required to add the component.

questions.stem: Universal Containers uses a custom picklist field Account Region on the Account record. They want this region to be reflected on all related contact records And stay in sync if the value of this field changes on the Account. How should an app builder meet this requirement?

options.text: Create a picklist field called ' Account Region ' on Contact object > Create a Lookup Relationship to Update this field if the Account Region field on the Account is changed
Create a formula field on the Contact object > Set the value of the formula to ISPICKVAL (Account.Account_Region__c).
Create a text field called ' Account Region ' on Contact object > Create a Lookup Relationship to Update this field if the Account Region field on the Account is changed
Create a formula field on the Contact object > Set the value of the formula to TEXT (Account.Account_Region__c).

questions.explanationEs: Un campo de fórmula en Contact que usa TEXT(Account.Account_Region__c) lee el valor del Account padre en tiempo real, así que siempre está sincronizado sin ninguna automatización. TEXT() es necesario porque el campo origen es un picklist y una fórmula no puede devolver un picklist. ISPICKVAL() solo comprueba si el picklist es igual a un valor y devuelve verdadero o falso, no la región. Copiar el valor en un campo de Contact mediante una relación lookup no actualiza ese campo por sí sola, así que la copia quedaría desfasada cuando cambie el Account.
questions.explanationEn: A formula field on Contact that uses TEXT(Account.Account_Region__c) reads the parent Account's value in real time, so it stays in sync with no automation at all. TEXT() is needed because the source field is a picklist and a formula cannot return a picklist. ISPICKVAL() only tests whether the picklist equals a value and returns true or false, not the region itself. Copying the value into a field on Contact through a lookup relationship does not update that field on its own, so the copy would drift once the Account changes.

questions.stem: Properly installing managed packages helps prevent conflicts With customizations made by customers and partners. Which functionality should be used to set up packages?
questions.explanationEs: El namespace prefix es un identificador único que se asocia a un managed package y se antepone a los nombres de API de todos sus componentes. Así los componentes del paquete no chocan con las personalizaciones de clientes ni de otros partners. Description y Help setting son solo texto informativo que no afecta a los nombres de los componentes, y Allow sharing es un ajuste de acceso a registros sin relación con la instalación de paquetes.
questions.explanationEn: The namespace prefix is a unique identifier tied to a managed package and prepended to the API names of all its components. This keeps the package's components from clashing with customizations made by customers and other partners. Description and Help setting are informational text that does not affect component names, and Allow sharing is a record access setting unrelated to installing packages.

questions.stem: A new app builder on the Cloud Kicks team is getting familiar with the data Model. They want to see how standard objects and custom objects relate. Which functionality should the app builder use to view these relationships?
questions.explanationEs: Schema Builder muestra de forma gráfica los objetos estándar y personalizados y las relaciones entre ellos, lo que ayuda a entender el modelo de datos de un vistazo. Object Manager y Fields & Relationships se centran en configurar un solo objeto cada vez y no dibujan el mapa de relaciones. Lightning App Builder sirve para construir páginas, no para ver el modelo de datos.
questions.explanationEn: Schema Builder graphically shows standard and custom objects and the relationships between them, which helps you understand the data model at a glance. Object Manager and Fields & Relationships focus on configuring one object at a time and do not draw a relationship map. Lightning App Builder is for building pages, not for viewing the data model.

questions.stem: Universal Containers has a Lightning record page that supports both the mobile app and desktop. An app builder has downloaded a custom Lightning component from AppExchange, but users are unable to view the component on mobile devices.

options.text: The component needs to be activated
The record page template is unable to support mobile devices.
The component has been developed for Desktop Pages.
The record page needs to be activated

questions.explanationEs: La página de registro ya admite móvil y escritorio, así que el fallo no está en la plantilla de la página ni en su activación. Un componente de AppExchange solo se muestra en la app móvil de Salesforce si su desarrollador lo marcó como compatible con el factor de forma Small (teléfono); si se creó solo para páginas de escritorio (Large), desaparece en móvil. Además, los componentes Lightning no se «activan»: lo que se activa son las páginas.
questions.explanationEn: The record page already supports both mobile and desktop, so the problem is neither the page template nor page activation. An AppExchange component only appears in the Salesforce mobile app if its developer made it compatible with the Small (phone) form factor; if it was built only for desktop (Large) pages, it disappears on mobile. Also, Lightning components are not 'activated': pages are.
