questions.stem: Cloud Kicks (CK) wants to begin socializing and collaborating within Salesforce around Customer accounts to discuss various topics. CK would like all company employees to see these Conversations. Which two features of Chatter would meet CK's business needs? Choose 2 answers

options.text: Set up new public Chatter groups.
Set up new private Chatter groups.
Use Chatter actions to create tasks to complete.
Use post action on the Account object.

questions.explanationEs: Las public groups de Chatter están abiertas a todos los empleados, por lo que permiten una conversación visible para toda la compañía. La acción de publicar (post) en el feed del Account deja la conversación junto al registro del cliente, visible para quien tenga acceso a esa cuenta. Las private groups limitan la visibilidad a sus miembros y las acciones de Chatter para crear tareas sirven para asignar trabajo, no para abrir un debate sobre las cuentas.
questions.explanationEn: Public Chatter groups are open to all employees, so they give company-wide visibility to the conversation. The post action on the Account feed keeps the discussion next to the customer record, visible to anyone who has access to that account. Private groups limit visibility to their members, and Chatter actions that create tasks assign work rather than start an open discussion about accounts.

questions.stem: An app builder has created a new report type but users are unable to select It from the Report Type list when making a new report for records they own. What could be causing this issue?

options.text: The report type is in a status of In Development.
Access to the necessary object is unavailable.
The report type is in a status of Deployed
Access to Create and Customize Reports is disabled

questions.explanationEs: Un report type con estado In Development solo es visible para los usuarios con permiso para gestionar report types personalizados; el resto no lo ve en la lista al crear un informe. Hasta que se pasa a Deployed, los usuarios normales no pueden elegirlo. El estado Deployed es justo el que lo haría disponible, así que no explica el problema, y como los usuarios ya pueden crear informes sobre sus propios registros, tampoco lo explican ni el acceso al objeto ni el permiso Create and Customize Reports.
questions.explanationEn: A report type with the In Development status is only visible to users who can manage custom report types; everyone else does not see it in the list when creating a report. Until it is moved to Deployed, regular users cannot select it. The Deployed status is exactly what would make it available, so it cannot be the cause, and since users can already create reports on their own records, neither object access nor the Create and Customize Reports permission explains it.

questions.stem: At Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO), a Platform App Builder built a new commission calculation flow and supporting components in a Developer sandbox. Before the change reaches production, the project lead requires sales operations users to validate the calculation against real Opportunity data. NTO has a Full sandbox available. Which deployment plan should the app builder use?

options.text: Deploy the components from the Developer sandbox to production using a change set with the Validate Only option, then conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT) in production.
Refresh the Developer sandbox from production to bring in real Opportunity data, conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT) in the Developer sandbox, then deploy to production.
Deploy the components from the Developer sandbox directly to production, then have sales operations users validate in production.
Deploy the components from the Developer sandbox to the Full sandbox, conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT) in the Full sandbox, then deploy to production.

questions.explanationEs: Una Full sandbox es una réplica de producción con metadatos y datos, por lo que es el entorno adecuado para que sales operations haga el UAT con Opportunities reales antes de desplegar a producción. El flujo y los componentes se despliegan desde la Developer sandbox a la Full sandbox, se validan allí y solo después se pasan a producción. Hacer el UAT en producción, aunque sea tras un change set Validate Only, expone a los usuarios reales a cambios sin probar. Una Developer sandbox no contiene datos de producción y refrescarla pisaría lo construido.
questions.explanationEn: A Full sandbox is a replica of production with both metadata and data, so it is the right place for sales operations to run UAT against real Opportunity data before going to production. The flow and components are deployed from the Developer sandbox to the Full sandbox, validated there, and only then moved to production. Doing UAT in production, even after a Validate Only change set, exposes real users to untested changes. A Developer sandbox holds no production data, and refreshing it would overwrite the build.

questions.stem: The Human Resources department at Cloud Kicks uses a custom object, JobApplication__c, to record all job applicant information, including fields for the applicant's current and desired salaries. Any Cloud Kicks user who performs hiring manager functions needs to be able to see all applicants ' salary information. Which tool should the Platform App Builder use to accomplish this?
questions.explanationEs: Ver los campos de salario es una cuestión de field-level security, y los Permission Sets permiten dar ese acceso solo a quienes hacen de hiring manager sin tocar su profile. Se crea un permission set con acceso al objeto JobApplication__c y lectura de los campos de salario. Los Sharing Rules y los Organization-Wide Defaults controlan el acceso a registros, no a campos, y los Page Layouts solo cambian lo que se muestra pero no pueden saltarse la field-level security.
questions.explanationEn: Seeing the salary fields is a field-level security matter, and Permission Sets let you grant that access only to users who act as hiring managers without changing their profiles. You create a permission set with access to the JobApplication__c object and Read on the salary fields. Sharing Rules and Organization-Wide Defaults control record access, not field access, and Page Layouts only change what is displayed and cannot override field-level security.

questions.stem: Universal Containers (UC) has several large customers that sell their products through dealers. UC identifies and works with a single individual at each customer and at each dealer. Separate bills are sent to each customer and each dealer. These details need to be stored in a format that clearly displays the business entities and their appropriate representatives. How should an app builder implement these requirements?

options.text: Create both customer and dealer as accounts, create account teams on each account and associate the dealer records with the parent account.
Create a single account record, add each rep as a contact and create a custom dealer object.
Create a single parent record, add each rep as a contact to the parent account and add each dealer as a child record.
Create both customer and dealer as accounts, add each rep as a contact on the corresponding account and create an account hierarchy.

questions.explanationEs: Como se factura por separado a cada cliente y a cada dealer, ambos deben ser Accounts distintas. El representante de cada uno se guarda como Contact en su propia cuenta, y la account hierarchy (campo Parent Account) refleja la relación entre las entidades. Un único Account con un objeto personalizado de dealers no permite facturar por separado, y las Account Teams son usuarios internos de Salesforce que trabajan una cuenta, no representantes externos del cliente o del dealer.
questions.explanationEn: Because each customer and each dealer is billed separately, both must be separate Accounts. Each one's representative is stored as a Contact on its own account, and the account hierarchy (Parent Account field) shows how the entities relate. A single Account plus a custom dealer object cannot support separate billing, and Account Teams are internal Salesforce users working an account, not external customer or dealer representatives.

questions.stem: An app builder needs to modify an existing Process Builder that automates some of the work being done by the sales team. What are three capabilities of Process Builder that improve productivity? Choose 3 answers
questions.reviewNote: Process Builder está retirado: ya no se pueden crear procesos nuevos y hoy esta automatización se haría con un record-triggered flow en Flow Builder. La clave de la fuente (crear registro hijo, actualizar registro relacionado y enviar alerta de email) coincide con las acciones reales de Process Builder y con los tres resolvedores. La pregunta solo sirve para entender procesos heredados.
questions.explanationEs: Process Builder (hoy retirado en favor de Flow) podía crear un registro hijo, actualizar un registro relacionado y enviar una email alert, que son las capacidades que mejoraban la productividad del equipo de ventas. No existe ninguna acción llamada «Start an additional message» y Process Builder no tenía acción para borrar registros relacionados. Para automatizaciones nuevas hay que usar un record-triggered flow.
questions.explanationEn: Process Builder (now retired in favor of Flow) could create a child record, update a related record and send an email alert, which are the capabilities that boosted the sales team's productivity. There is no action called 'Start an additional message', and Process Builder had no action to delete related records. New automation should be built with a record-triggered flow.

questions.stem: Northern Trail Outfitters wants to initiate an automatic daily backup of its Salesforce org. Which tool should an app builder recommend for this task?
questions.explanationEs: Para una copia de seguridad automática y diaria hace falta una solución de backup de AppExchange (o el add-on Backup and Restore), porque Data Export Service es nativo pero solo se programa de forma semanal o mensual. Refrescar una Full Copy sandbox no es una copia de seguridad automatizada y exportar un informe solo saca los datos de ese informe, no el org completo.
questions.explanationEn: An automatic daily backup requires a backup solution from AppExchange (or the Backup and Restore add-on), because Data Export Service is native but can only be scheduled weekly or monthly. Refreshing a Full Copy sandbox is not an automated backup, and a report export only extracts the data in that report, not the whole org.

questions.stem: Universal Containers created a ' New Task ' custom action on the Opportunity object. The action was added to all page layouts in the Mobile & Lightning Actions section. Which Lightning component should the app builder add to the layout to Display the action?
questions.explanationEs: Los botones de acción de un registro Lightning, incluidas las acciones personalizadas de la sección Mobile & Lightning Actions del page layout, se muestran en el componente Highlights panel de la página de registro. Por eso hay que añadir ese componente para que aparezca New Task. El componente Activities solo ofrece las acciones estándar de actividad dentro de su propio publicador, y Related lists y Related record muestran registros relacionados, no la barra de acciones.
questions.explanationEn: The action buttons of a Lightning record, including custom actions from the Mobile & Lightning Actions section of the page layout, are shown in the Highlights panel component of the record page. That is why this component must be added for New Task to appear. The Activities component only offers the standard activity actions in its own composer, and Related lists and Related record show related records, not the actions bar.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks is building a Field Generation prompt template in Prompt Builder that populates a custom field on the Contact record page with a paragraph summarizing the Contact's most recent Orders. To ground the prompt in the Contact's related Order data, the Platform App Builder needs to build a flow. Which type of flow should the app builder use?
questions.explanationEs: Un template-triggered prompt flow es el tipo de flow que Prompt Builder invoca para recuperar datos relacionados, como los Orders del Contact, y devolver ese contexto a la plantilla de prompt. Es el tipo que permite usar el elemento Add Prompt Instructions. Un record-triggered flow se dispara por cambios en los registros, un schedule-triggered flow se ejecuta a intervalos y un autolaunched flow genérico no tiene la integración con Prompt Builder.
questions.explanationEn: A template-triggered prompt flow is the flow type that Prompt Builder invokes to retrieve related data, such as the Contact's Orders, and return that context to the prompt template. It is the type that supports the Add Prompt Instructions element. A record-triggered flow fires on record changes, a schedule-triggered flow runs at set intervals, and a generic autolaunched flow lacks the Prompt Builder integration.

questions.stem: An app builder at Cloud Kicks has been working on changes to a Custom Shoe Sales app in a sandbox and is ready to deploy their changes to production with a change set. Part of the work included updates to a Permission set. What should the app builder take into consideration when deploying the Change set to production?

options.text: The existing permission set will be completely overwritten.
The deployed permission set will only contain changes related to the change set.
Changes to field-level security in the permission set will not be applied
The deployed permission set will merge with the existing permission set.

questions.reviewNote: V23.35 marca que el permission set desplegado solo contiene los cambios relacionados con el change set, mientras que las tres votaciones ciegas eligieron que se sobrescribe por completo. Mantengo la clave de V23.35 porque, por lo que sé de la plataforma, el permission set que viaja en un change set solo lleva los permisos de los componentes incluidos, y no tengo una fuente que confirme que el de producción se reemplace entero. Aun así, la opción de que se fusione con el existente también es defendible y no he podido contrastarlo con la documentación en línea, por eso queda como dudosa.
questions.explanationEs: Al desplegar un permission set con un change set, solo viajan los permisos que se refieren a los componentes incluidos en ese change set (por ejemplo los objetos, campos o clases que van dentro), así que el permission set desplegado no es una copia completa del de sandbox. El field-level security sí se despliega cuando el campo forma parte del change set, por lo que no es cierto que no se aplique. Las opciones de sobrescritura total y de fusión describen otro comportamiento, y en la práctica conviene revisar el permission set de producción tras el despliegue. Para que un cambio llegue a producción, el componente al que afecta tiene que ir en el change set.
questions.explanationEn: When a permission set is deployed through a change set, only the permissions that refer to components included in that change set travel with it (for example the objects, fields or classes that are part of it), so the deployed permission set is not a full copy of the sandbox one. Field-level security is deployed when the field is part of the change set, so it is not true that it is not applied. The total-overwrite and merge options describe different behavior, and in practice it is wise to review the production permission set after deploying. For a change to reach production, the component it affects has to be in the change set.

questions.stem: Universal Containers wants to dynamically display a component on a Lightning record page for an account based on criteria about the related contact. Which solution should an app builder use to fulfill this requirement?

options.text: Add a related record component to the page layout.
Hide the component behind a tab on the page layout.
Set the filter type on the component visibility to display based on user permissions, using custom Permission to define the dynamic criteria
Set the component visibility to display based on an advanced filter type, using the contact field(s) to Define the dynamic criteria

questions.explanationEs: La visibilidad dinámica de un componente en una Lightning page se configura en Lightning App Builder con filtros de visibilidad. El tipo de filtro avanzado permite evaluar valores de campos (incluidos los de registros relacionados, como el Contact) y combinarlos con lógica AND/OR, que es lo que pide el escenario. El filtro por permisos con un custom permission solo depende de quién es el usuario, no de los datos del registro. Añadir el componente Related Record solo muestra información y esconder el componente detrás de una pestaña solo lo agrupa: en ambos casos no se decide dinámicamente si aparece.
questions.explanationEn: Dynamic visibility of a component on a Lightning page is set up in Lightning App Builder with visibility filters. The advanced filter type can evaluate field values (including those of related records, such as the Contact) and combine them with AND/OR logic, which is what the scenario asks for. A user-permission filter with a custom permission depends only on who the user is, not on record data. Adding a Related Record component only displays information, and hiding the component behind a tab only groups it: in neither case is it decided dynamically whether the component appears.

questions.stem: Universal Containers (UC) is launching a new HR Recruitment app and needs to perform User Acceptance Testing (UAT) before deploying to production. This app deals with sensitive data, testing requires realistic data volume, and needs to be tested by actual UC users. Which sandbox should a Platform App Builder recommend for this phase?
questions.explanationEs: Para un UAT con usuarios reales de UC hace falta un sandbox con una muestra de datos de producción y volumen realista. El Partial Copy copia los metadatos más un subconjunto de datos definido en una sandbox template, donde además se pueden excluir los objetos o datos sensibles. Developer y Developer Pro solo copian metadatos y tienen poco almacenamiento, así que no ofrecen datos realistas. Un scratch org no es un sandbox: se crea vacío a partir de código fuente, sin datos ni usuarios de producción, y se usa para desarrollo.
questions.explanationEn: A UAT with real UC users needs a sandbox that holds a sample of production data at a realistic volume. A Partial Copy sandbox copies the metadata plus a subset of data defined in a sandbox template, where sensitive objects or data can also be left out. Developer and Developer Pro sandboxes copy only metadata and have little storage, so they do not provide realistic data. A scratch org is not a sandbox: it is created empty from source code, with no production data or users, and is used for development.

questions.stem: A Platform App Builder at Cloud Kicks is creating a flow approval process for travel requests. The requirement is to assign the approval to a specific user who will be determined at runtime based on other data in the flow. How must the app builder configure the approver for the approval step?

options.text: Use a Formula resource to define the approver directly in the Approver Type field.
Set the Approver Type to "User" and select a specific user from the list.
Set the Approver Type to "Resource" and select the text variable containing the username.
Set the Approver Type to "Queue" and assign the queue that contains the dynamic user.

questions.explanationEs: Cuando el aprobador se decide en tiempo de ejecución a partir de datos del flow, el approval step debe usar el tipo de aprobador Resource y apuntar a la variable de texto que identifica al usuario. El tipo User obliga a elegir un usuario fijo al diseñar el flow, y Queue asigna la aprobación a una cola configurada, no a un usuario concreto calculado en ese momento. Un formula resource no se puede poner directamente como Approver Type: este campo solo admite los tipos de aprobador disponibles.
questions.explanationEn: When the approver is decided at runtime from data in the flow, the approval step must use the Resource approver type and point to the text variable that identifies the user. The User type forces you to pick a fixed user when designing the flow, and Queue assigns the approval to a configured queue, not to a specific user worked out at that moment. A formula resource cannot be placed directly in the Approver Type field: that field only accepts the available approver types.

questions.stem: Universal Containers requires a standardized project management tracking system to be visible within its existing Salesforce environment. The Platform App Builder decides to browse AgentExchange to find a complete, preconfigured solution that includes custom objects, fields, and automation rules. What should the app builder install from AgentExchange to ensure automatic upgrades to the package?
questions.explanationEs: Un managed package es el tipo de paquete que el publicador mantiene y actualiza: las nuevas versiones llegan a los clientes que lo instalaron (incluso con push upgrades) sin tener que reinstalar los componentes a mano. Un unmanaged package se instala como una copia editable de los componentes, sin vínculo con el publicador, así que no recibe actualizaciones. Un change set sirve para mover metadatos entre orgs relacionadas y no es algo que se instale desde AgentExchange, y un data kit no es el tipo de paquete que entrega una aplicación actualizable con objetos, campos y automatizaciones.
questions.explanationEn: A managed package is the package type that its publisher maintains and upgrades: new versions reach the customers who installed it (even through push upgrades) without reinstalling the components by hand. An unmanaged package is installed as an editable copy of the components, with no link to the publisher, so it does not receive upgrades. A change set moves metadata between related orgs and is not something you install from AgentExchange, and a data kit is not the package type that delivers an upgradeable application with objects, fields and automation.

questions.stem: Universal Containers manages internal projects by department using a custom object called Projects. Only employees in the project's respective department should have view access to all of the department's project records. If an employee changes job roles and moves to another department, the employee should no longer have access to projects within the former department. Which option meets these requirements, assuming the organization-wide default for Projects is set to Private?

options.text: Create a criteria-based sharing rule using the Project's department that grants access to users through Public Groups.
Create a criteria-based sharing rule using the Project's department that grants access to users through Permission Sets.
Create a criteria-based sharing rule using the Project's department that grants access to users through Profiles.
Create a criteria-based sharing rule using the Project's department that grants access to users through Account Teams.

questions.explanationEs: Con el OWD de Projects en Private, un criteria-based sharing rule sobre el campo de departamento comparte los proyectos de cada departamento con un public group de ese departamento. Cuando un empleado cambia de departamento, se le saca del grupo anterior y se le añade al nuevo, y tras el recálculo pierde el acceso a los proyectos del antiguo. Los profiles y los permission sets conceden permisos de objeto y de campo, pero no son destinatarios de una sharing rule, y las account teams solo existen para Account, no para un objeto personalizado.
questions.explanationEn: With the Projects OWD set to Private, a criteria-based sharing rule on the department field shares each department's projects with a public group for that department. When an employee changes department, they are removed from the old group and added to the new one, and after recalculation they lose access to the former department's projects. Profiles and permission sets grant object and field permissions but are not targets of a sharing rule, and account teams exist only for Account, not for a custom object.

questions.stem: Universal Containers (UC) wants to test code against a subset of production data that is under 5 GB. Additionally, UC wants to refresh this sandbox every weekend. Which type of sandbox should be used to accomplish this?
questions.explanationEs: Partial Copy es el tipo que combina un subconjunto de datos de producción (definido con una sandbox template y con un límite de 5 GB) y un intervalo de refresco de 5 días, así que se puede refrescar cada fin de semana. Full Copy copia todos los datos de producción, sin el límite de 5 GB, y solo se puede refrescar cada 29 días. Developer y Developer Pro solo copian metadatos, sin datos de producción, por lo que no sirven para probar código con un subconjunto de datos reales.
questions.explanationEn: Partial Copy is the type that combines a subset of production data (defined with a sandbox template and capped at 5 GB) with a 5-day refresh interval, so it can be refreshed every weekend. Full Copy copies all production data, with no 5 GB cap, and can only be refreshed every 29 days. Developer and Developer Pro sandboxes copy only metadata, with no production data, so they cannot be used to test code against a subset of real data.

questions.stem: Service agents at Ursa Major Solar want a more condensed case view. Service agents also want to be able to modify the associated contact and account Records from the case page layout on the Lightning record page. Which two components should an app builder use to meet these requirements? Choose 2 answers
questions.explanationEs: Tabs agrupa los componentes en pestañas y condensa una página de Case que de otro modo sería muy larga. El componente Related Record muestra los campos de un registro relacionado, como el Contact o el Account del caso, y permite al agente editarlos sin salir de la página. Path solo muestra y permite avanzar las etapas de un campo picklist, y Rich text es contenido estático: ninguno de los dos permite modificar los registros relacionados.
questions.explanationEn: Tabs group components into tabbed sections and condense a Case page that would otherwise be very long. The Related Record component shows the fields of a related record, such as the case's Contact or Account, and lets the agent edit them without leaving the page. Path only shows and advances the stages of a picklist field, and Rich text is static content: neither lets agents modify the related records.

questions.stem: An app builder is creating a custom object called Testimonial__c and wants to connect Testimonial__c records with both the submitter's Contact record and Account record. If the Account is deleted, the Testimonial__c records should also be deleted. If the Contact is deleted, but the Account remains, the Testimonial__c records should remain. How should this be accomplished?

options.text: Create a lookup relationship from Testimonial__c to Account and a master-detail relationship from Testimonial__c to Contact.
Make Testimonial a junction object between Account and Contact using master-detail relationships.
Create a master-detail relationship from Testimonial to Account and a lookup relationship from Testimonial to Contact.
Make both the Contact and Account fields required on the Testimonial object and create lookup relationships from Testimonial to Contact and to Account.

questions.explanationEs: Un master-detail hacia Account hace que, al borrar la cuenta, se borren en cascada sus Testimonial__c. Un lookup hacia Contact no crea esa dependencia: si se borra el contacto, el testimonio se conserva y el campo se limpia. Si se invierten los dos tipos de relación, el borrado del Contact eliminaría los testimonios y el del Account no. Un junction object con dos master-detail borra el registro cuando se borra cualquiera de los dos padres, y dos lookups, aunque sean obligatorios, nunca borran en cascada.
questions.explanationEn: A master-detail relationship to Account makes the Testimonial__c records cascade-delete when the account is deleted. A lookup to Contact creates no such dependency: if the contact is deleted, the testimonial is kept and the field is cleared. If the two relationship types are swapped, deleting the Contact would remove the testimonials and deleting the Account would not. A junction object with two master-detail relationships deletes the record when either parent is deleted, and two lookups, even required ones, never cascade-delete.

questions.stem: An app builder needs to create new automation on an object. Which best practice should the app builder follow when building out automation?

options.text: One record change process per object

questions.reviewNote: La fuente V23.35 marca «One record change process per object», que es la buena práctica de Process Builder (record-change process), una herramienta retirada que no se debe usar para automatización nueva. La pregunta habla de crear automatización nueva y otra de las opciones es «One Flow per object», que es la recomendación vigente (un record-triggered flow por objeto, o uno por evento). Las tres votaciones ciegas coinciden en esa opción y la propia explicación de V23.35 reconoce que su clave es la práctica clásica de Process Builder. FreeCram v10.8 oculta la clave y su explicación genérica también apunta a Flow.
questions.explanationEs: La buena práctica actual es agrupar la automatización de cada objeto en un único record-triggered flow (o uno por evento, before-save y after-save). Así se controla el orden de ejecución, se evitan solapamientos entre varios flows y el comportamiento es predecible y fácil de depurar. «Un record change process por objeto» era la recomendación de Process Builder, que está retirado para automatización nueva. Un validation rule por objeto no es una práctica recomendada, porque las validaciones se separan por requisito, y un invocable process es un proceso reutilizable que se llama desde otro, no el contenedor principal de la automatización de un objeto.
questions.explanationEn: The current best practice is to group each object's automation into a single record-triggered flow (or one per event, before-save and after-save). That keeps the order of execution under control, avoids overlap between several flows and makes behavior predictable and easy to debug. One record-change process per object was the Process Builder recommendation, and Process Builder is retired for new automation. One validation rule per object is not a recommended practice, because validations are split by requirement, and an invocable process is a reusable process called from another one, not the main container for an object's automation.

questions.stem: DreamHouse Realty has a policy that requires the phone number on Contact to be deleted when the Do Not Call checkbox is checked. Which automation tool should the app builder recommend?
questions.explanationEs: Para borrar el teléfono automáticamente cuando se marca Do Not Call hace falta una automatización que modifique datos: un Flow disparado por registro (record-triggered) sobre Contact puede comprobar el checkbox y dejar el campo Phone en blanco. Una validation rule solo puede bloquear el guardado, no cambiar valores. Una quick action es manual, así que no cumple una política que debe aplicarse siempre. «If-then rule» no es una herramienta de automatización de Salesforce.
questions.explanationEn: Clearing the phone number automatically when Do Not Call is checked needs automation that changes data: a record-triggered Flow on Contact can check the checkbox and set the Phone field to blank. A validation rule can only block a save, not change values. A quick action is manual, so it cannot enforce a policy that must always apply. An "if-then rule" is not a Salesforce automation tool.

questions.stem: Northern Trail Outfitters wants to change a master-detail Relationship on Account to a lookup relationship with a custom object Park. The app builder tries to reconfigure this but is unable to do so. What could be causing this?

options.text: The Account is included in a flow process on the Park object.
The park records have existing formulas on the Account.
The Park object needs at least one Master-Detail field for reporting.
The Account record includes Parks roll-up summary fields.

questions.explanationEs: Salesforce no permite convertir una relación master-detail en lookup mientras el objeto padre tenga roll-up summary fields que resumen los registros hijos, porque esos campos dependen de la relación master-detail. Hay que eliminar primero los roll-up summary fields de Account sobre Park y después se puede convertir. Que el objeto aparezca en un flow, que haya fórmulas o que Park necesite otro master-detail «para informes» no son restricciones de la conversión.
questions.explanationEn: Salesforce does not allow converting a master-detail relationship to a lookup while the parent object has roll-up summary fields that summarize the child records, because those fields depend on the master-detail relationship. The roll-up summary fields on Account over Park must be deleted first, and then the conversion is possible. Being referenced in a flow, having formulas, or Park needing another master-detail field "for reporting" are not restrictions on the conversion.

questions.stem: The app builder at Cloud Kicks has created a custom object named Delivery__c to track the Details of products shipped to customers. Which two actions should the app builder take to prevent users in the shipping department from Deleting delivery records? Choose 2 answers

options.text: Remove the delete button from the Delivery page layout.
Use a permission set to remove the Delete permission.
Remove the Delete permission from the Shipper profile.
Change the organization-wide default of deliveries to Private.

questions.reviewNote: La fuente V23.35 marca como correctas la opción de quitar el botón Delete del page layout y la de quitar el permiso Delete al perfil Shipper. Los tres resolvedores a ciegas eligieron en cambio la opción del permission set y la del perfil. Se mantiene la clave de la fuente porque quitar el permiso del perfil es el control real, pero hay dudas. Un permission set normal solo concede permisos y no puede restar uno que ya da el perfil (solo un muting permission set dentro de un permission set group lo hace), así que la opción del permission set no es válida tal como está redactada. Quitar el botón de borrado solo oculta la acción en la página y no impide borrar por otras vías. Revisar contra el PDF original.
questions.explanationEs: El control real sobre el borrado es el permiso de objeto Delete: quitárselo al perfil Shipper impide que esos usuarios borren registros de Delivery__c. Quitar el botón Delete del page layout hace desaparecer la acción en la página del registro, es un paso de apoyo de interfaz y no sustituye al permiso. Cambiar el organization-wide default a Private afecta a la visibilidad de los registros, no al permiso de borrado. Un permission set normal solo concede permisos y no puede quitar uno que ya da el perfil; solo un muting permission set dentro de un permission set group puede restarlo.
questions.explanationEn: The real control over deletion is the Delete object permission: removing it from the Shipper profile stops those users from deleting Delivery__c records. Removing the Delete button from the page layout takes the action off the record page; it is a supporting user-interface step and does not replace the permission. Changing the organization-wide default to Private affects record visibility, not the delete permission. A regular permission set only grants permissions and cannot remove one that the profile already gives; only a muting permission set inside a permission set group can subtract it.

questions.stem: The app builder at AW Computing has been asked to track the number of times a case has been reopened. Which solution should the app builder utilize to help with this request?
questions.explanationEs: Un record-triggered flow sobre Case puede ejecutarse cuando se actualiza el caso, detectar que el Status pasa de cerrado a abierto e incrementar un campo numérico contador. Es la solución declarativa que se espera de un app builder. Un screen flow depende de que un usuario lo lance a mano, y un scheduled flow se ejecuta por lotes según un horario, así que ninguno detecta cada reapertura. Un Apex trigger funcionaría, pero es código y solo se justifica cuando lo declarativo no basta.
questions.explanationEn: A record-triggered flow on Case can run when the case is updated, detect that Status moves from closed to open, and increment a numeric counter field. This is the declarative solution expected from an app builder. A screen flow depends on a user launching it manually, and a scheduled flow runs in batches on a schedule, so neither catches each reopen event. An Apex trigger would work, but it is code and is only justified when declarative tools are not enough.

questions.stem: An app builder wants to create a formula field on an Account to include data from related Contacts but is unable to find the relationship in the formula editor. What is a limitation of formulas that could be causing the issue?

options.text: More than 5,000 characters in the formula.
Contact and Account objects DO NOT have a Master-Detail Relationship,
Unable to reference the child records.
Formula field limit reached on the Account object,

questions.explanationEs: Una fórmula en Account solo puede recorrer relaciones hacia arriba (hacia registros padre, mediante lookup o master-detail), no hacia abajo. Los Contacts son registros hijos de Account, así que su relación no aparece en el editor de fórmulas; para resumirlos haría falta un roll-up summary (solo con master-detail) o un flow. Los límites de 5.000 caracteres o de campos de fórmula darían otros errores, y la relación entre Contact y Account no necesita ser master-detail para que una fórmula de Contact lea datos de Account.
questions.explanationEn: A formula on Account can only traverse relationships upward (to parent records through lookup or master-detail), not downward. Contacts are child records of Account, so their relationship does not appear in the formula editor; summarizing them would need a roll-up summary (master-detail only) or a flow. The 5,000-character limit or a field limit would produce different errors, and the Contact-Account relationship does not need to be master-detail for a Contact formula to read Account data.

questions.stem: An app builder at Ursa Major Solar has been working on a new custom app In a sandbox that has been upgraded to the next major Salesforce version, and their Production instance is still on the current Salesforce version. The development is Complete and they are ready to deploy a change set. What should the app builder consider when planning the deployment?

options.text: The change set will be automatically deployed when production is upgraded
The deployment is not possible due to different versions.
The change set components will be upgraded to the next version in production.
It will fail if there is a feature only available in the next version.

questions.explanationEs: Cuando el sandbox ya está en la versión siguiente y producción sigue en la actual, el change set se puede desplegar, pero fallará si incluye componentes que usan una función disponible solo en la versión nueva. Producción no se actualiza por el despliegue, los componentes no suben de versión al llegar a producción y el change set no se despliega solo cuando producción se actualiza. Tampoco es cierto que el despliegue sea imposible por la diferencia de versiones: solo falla lo que depende de funciones nuevas.
questions.explanationEn: When the sandbox is already on the next release and production is still on the current one, the change set can be deployed, but it fails if it contains components that use a feature available only in the newer release. Deploying does not upgrade production, components are not upgraded when they reach production, and the change set is not deployed automatically when production is upgraded. It is also not true that deployment is impossible because of the version difference: only components that depend on new features fail.

questions.stem: A follow-up Task is created. An Event is created on the support manager's calendar. A Custom Notification is sent to the Case team. Which Flow design should the Platform App Builder use?

options.text: A before-save record-triggered flow on Case that uses Create Records elements for the Task and Event and a Send Custom Notification action
An after-save record-triggered flow on Case that uses Create Records elements for the Task and Event and a Send Custom Notification action
A Screen Flow that the support agent launches manually from the Case page when a Case is escalated
A platform event-triggered flow that listens on the Case object for the escalation

questions.explanationEs: Crear una Task y un Event y enviar una Custom Notification al equipo del caso exige un record-triggered flow after-save, porque el registro ya está guardado, se pueden crear otros registros con Create Records y existe la acción Send Custom Notification. Un flow before-save solo sirve para actualizar campos del propio registro y no puede crear otros registros ni enviar notificaciones. Un screen flow lanzado a mano no garantiza que ocurra siempre, y un flow disparado por platform event escucha un platform event, no el objeto Case.
questions.explanationEn: Creating a Task and an Event and sending a Custom Notification to the case team requires an after-save record-triggered flow, because the record is already saved, other records can be created with Create Records, and the Send Custom Notification action is available. A before-save flow is only for updating fields on the triggering record and cannot create other records or send notifications. A screen flow launched manually does not guarantee that it always happens, and a platform event-triggered flow listens to a platform event, not to the Case object.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks created a Locked__c custom field to identify Account records that should restrict modifications for all users except the System Administrator. Which validation rule enforces this requirement on locked Account records?
questions.explanationEs: Una validation rule bloquea el guardado cuando su fórmula devuelve TRUE. Para restringir las modificaciones a todos salvo al System Administrator, la fórmula debe ser verdadera cuando el registro está bloqueado y el perfil del usuario no es System Administrator, usando $Profile.Name. La versión basada en $UserRole comprueba el rol, no el perfil. La que añade Stage usa un campo que no existe en Account, y la que compara con igualdad bloquearía justo a los administradores.
questions.explanationEn: A validation rule blocks the save when its formula returns TRUE. To restrict modifications for everyone except the System Administrator, the formula must be true when the record is locked and the user's profile is not System Administrator, using $Profile.Name. The version based on $UserRole checks the role, not the profile. The one that adds Stage uses a field that does not exist on Account, and the one that compares with equality would block exactly the administrators.

questions.stem: Universal Containers wants to understand return on investment for the latest advertising buy. They currently use a private security model for all objects. What should an app builder recommend?

options.text: Configure Campaign Hierarchies and Campaign statistics
Utilize Account Hierarchies and Roll-Up Summary Fields
Change to a public security model

questions.reviewNote: La opción de Campaign de la fuente dice «Campaign Interactions» y la de Account «Account Interactions» y «Rule Up Summary Fields». Son errores de transcripción: la otra fuente de la misma pregunta y los tres resolvedores indican Campaign Hierarchies, Account Hierarchies y Roll-Up Summary Fields, así que se corrige el texto. Revisar contra el PDF.
questions.explanationEs: Para medir el retorno de una inversión publicitaria se usan Campaigns: las Campaign Hierarchies agrupan campañas hijas bajo una padre y las Campaign statistics (coste real, oportunidades ganadas, ROI) se acumulan en la jerarquía. No hace falta cambiar el modelo de seguridad a público, que expondría datos sin necesidad. Las Account Hierarchies con roll-up summary fields no registran el coste de una campaña, y un informe de pipeline de oportunidades no relaciona el gasto publicitario con los ingresos.
questions.explanationEn: Measuring the return on an advertising investment is done with Campaigns: Campaign Hierarchies group child campaigns under a parent, and Campaign statistics (actual cost, won opportunities, ROI) roll up through the hierarchy. There is no need to switch the security model to public, which would expose data unnecessarily. Account Hierarchies with roll-up summary fields do not capture campaign cost, and an opportunity pipeline report does not tie advertising spend to revenue.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks wants to simultaneously delete a Supplier__c record and all Supplier_Item__c records if a partnership ends with a supplier. Which solution should a Platform App Builder use to meet the requirement?
questions.explanationEs: Solo una relación Master-Detail borra en cascada: al eliminar el Supplier__c (master) se eliminan también todos sus Supplier_Item__c (detail), sin Flow ni Apex. Indirect Lookup es para relacionar objetos externos con registros de Salesforce, Hierarchical solo existe para el objeto User, y Many-to-Many es un patrón de objeto de unión que no define por sí mismo el borrado en cascada.
questions.explanationEn: Only a Master-Detail relationship deletes in cascade: when the Supplier__c (master) is deleted, all of its Supplier_Item__c (detail) records are deleted with it, with no Flow or Apex. Indirect Lookup relates external objects to Salesforce records, Hierarchical exists only for the User object, and Many-to-Many is a junction-object pattern that does not by itself define cascade delete.

questions.stem: What is the process to upgrade an unmanaged package that is currently Installed in production?

options.text: Uninstall the current version and install the new version.
Use the Install Wizard to install the upgrade to production.
Install the new version to a Developer org then deploy to production.
Click the update link on the Installed Packages page.

questions.explanationEs: Un paquete unmanaged no tiene ruta de actualización: sus componentes se copian en la org y pasan a ser editables, así que el publicador no puede empujar versiones nuevas. Para pasar a la nueva versión hay que quitar la instalada e instalar la nueva. El enlace de actualización y el flujo de upgrade solo existen para paquetes managed, y desplegar desde una Developer org no es necesario ni sustituye a la instalación.
questions.explanationEn: An unmanaged package has no upgrade path: its components are copied into the org and become editable, so the publisher cannot push new versions. To move to the new version you remove the installed one and install the new one. The update link and the upgrade flow exist only for managed packages, and going through a Developer org and deploying is neither required nor a replacement for installing.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks (CK) switched to Lightning Experience and started using Chatter across its global workforce to support its fast-paced sales cycle. CK Loves Chatter but struggle with gathering feedback from core team members, including understanding who is available to respond. Which two ways could CK use Chatter to solve this problem? Choose 2 answers
questions.reviewNote: V23.35 marca Streams y Out of Office, pero el enunciado trata de recoger comentarios del equipo (el PDF dice «feed» por una errata de «feedback») y de saber quién puede responder. Eso lo cubren Polls y Out of Office; Streams solo reúne publicaciones en una vista y no recoge opiniones. Dos de los tres votos ciegos eligen Polls y Out of Office, y la versión de FreeCram v14.3 conserva el enunciado completo con «feedback» (su explicación también apunta a Polls y Out of Office, aunque es evidencia débil). Cambio la clave a Polls y Out of Office.
questions.explanationEs: Los Polls permiten lanzar una encuesta rápida en Chatter al equipo clave y recoger sus opiniones, y Out of Office indica quién no está disponible para responder. Streams solo combina varios feeds en una vista, pero no recoge comentarios ni muestra disponibilidad, y Topics solo etiqueta y agrupa publicaciones.
questions.explanationEn: Polls let CK run a quick Chatter survey of the core team and collect their opinions, and Out of Office shows who is unavailable to respond. Streams only combines several feeds into one view without collecting feedback or showing availability, and Topics only tag and group posts.

questions.stem: To increase adoption, Universal Containers is proposing changes to its Salesforce data model to allow easier visibility for sales reps into key metrics. The Proposal has three custom objects related to the Account object, one with a master- Detail, and two that are not. Each of these objects has 15 fields they would like to Summarize on the Account object. What are two considerations for this proposal? Choose 2 answers

options.text: Roll-up summaries are limited to master-detail relationships.
Roll-up summaries allow MAX, MIN, SUM, COUNT, and AVG.
An object can have 25 roll-up summaries.
An object can have 20 object references.

questions.explanationEs: Los roll-up summary fields solo se pueden crear en el objeto master de una relación master-detail, así que solo el objeto custom en master-detail puede resumirse en Account sin código, y cada objeto admite 25 roll-ups por defecto (hay que tenerlo en cuenta con 15 campos por objeto). AVG no existe: solo hay COUNT, SUM, MIN y MAX. El límite de 20 referencias a objetos no corresponde a ningún límite real de roll-ups.
questions.explanationEn: Roll-up summary fields can only be created on the master object of a master-detail relationship, so only the custom object in master-detail can be summarized on Account without code, and each object allows 25 roll-up summaries by default (relevant with 15 fields per object). AVG does not exist: the only functions are COUNT, SUM, MIN and MAX. The 20 object references limit is not a real roll-up limit.

questions.stem: The app builder at Northern Trail Outfitters created a report type for opportunities with or without shipments. The operations team wants to See the account rating information on the report. What should the app builder do to fulfill this request?

options.text: Use add fields related via lookup with the view set to opportunities.
Change the account/opportunity relationship to a master/detail relationship.
Change the primary object of the custom report type to the Account object.
Add the Account Rating field to the opportunity record page.

questions.explanationEs: En el custom report type basado en Opportunities se puede ampliar el diseño con Add fields related via lookup, que expone campos de objetos alcanzables por lookup, como Account Rating, manteniendo Opportunity como objeto primario. La relación Account-Opportunity es estándar (lookup) y no se puede convertir en master-detail, cambiar el objeto primario rompería el tipo de informe, y la página de registro de Opportunity no afecta a los informes.
questions.explanationEn: In the custom report type based on Opportunities you can extend the layout with Add fields related via lookup, which exposes fields from objects reachable through a lookup, such as Account Rating, while Opportunity stays the primary object. The Account-Opportunity relationship is a standard lookup that cannot be converted to master-detail, changing the primary object would break the report type, and the Opportunity record page has no effect on reports.

questions.stem: Universal Containers wants to automatically send an email notification to the Account owner immediately after a related Opportunity is Closed Won. The Platform App Builder chooses to implement this automation using Flow Builder. Which flow type and configuration must the app builder use to update a related record and trigger an email alert?

options.text: A record-triggered flow configured for Fast Field Updates
An autolaunched flow invoked by a validation rule
A Screen Flow deployed through an AgentExchange package
A record-triggered flow configured for Actions and Related Records

questions.explanationEs: Un record-triggered flow optimizado para Actions and Related Records es after-save, y por eso puede actualizar registros relacionados y enviar un email alert o una notificación. Fast Field Updates es before-save y solo modifica el registro que dispara el flow. Una validation rule no puede invocar un autolaunched flow, y un Screen Flow necesita interacción del usuario, así que no sirve para automatizar tras el cierre de la Opportunity.
questions.explanationEn: A record-triggered flow optimized for Actions and Related Records runs after save, so it can update related records and send an email alert or notification. Fast Field Updates runs before save and can only change the record that triggers the flow. A validation rule cannot invoke an autolaunched flow, and a Screen Flow needs user interaction, so it cannot automate the step when the Opportunity closes.

questions.stem: What should an app builder consider when choosing a template for a new Lightning record page?

options.text: Page structure will automatically adapt to the device being used to view the record page.
To view the record page, users need "View All Data" permissions for the object.
The template is unable to be changed after the initial save.
Select a new template for each type of device users use to view the record page.

questions.explanationEs: Las plantillas de página Lightning son responsivas: la estructura se adapta sola al dispositivo (escritorio, tableta o móvil), así que no hace falta elegir una plantilla por tipo de dispositivo. Para ver la página no se necesita View All Data (basta el acceso normal al objeto y al registro), y la plantilla no queda bloqueada tras el primer guardado.
questions.explanationEn: Lightning page templates are responsive: the page structure adapts by itself to the device (desktop, tablet or phone), so you do not choose a template per device type. Viewing the page does not require View All Data (normal object and record access is enough), and the template is not locked after the first save.

questions.stem: Universal Containers has created two custom objects called Seminars and Attendees. Organization-wide defaults for these objects have been set to Private. Universal Containers wants to set up a new junction object between these custom objects. A select group of users should be able to edit records in the junction object. Which two steps should an app builder take to configure the proper security? Choose 2 answers

options.text: Create owner-based sharing rules that give Read access to the master objects.
Set lookup filters on both junction object relationship fields.
Set Sharing Settings to Read Only on both Master-Detail relationship fields.
Create an owner-based sharing rule that gives Read access to the junction object.

questions.explanationEs: En un objeto de unión con dos master-detail, el acceso lo controlan los padres. Con sharing rules owner-based que dan Read sobre los dos objetos master al grupo, y con el Sharing Setting de ambos campos master-detail en Read Only (basta Read en el master para crear, editar y borrar detalles), ese grupo puede editar el objeto de unión. Un objeto detail no admite sharing rules propias, y los lookup filters no son un mecanismo de seguridad.
questions.explanationEn: On a junction object with two master-detail relationships, access is controlled by the parents. With owner-based sharing rules that give the group Read on both master objects, and the Sharing Setting on both master-detail fields set to Read Only (Read on the master is enough to create, edit and delete detail records), that group can edit the junction object. A detail object cannot have its own sharing rules, and lookup filters are not a security mechanism.

questions.stem: When a sales rep submits an account for approval, Universal Containers Wants the user to answer additional questions via a popup window to populate Additional record fields. What should an app builder use to achieve the desired result?
questions.explanationEs: Un custom button (o acción) que lanza un Screen Flow abre una ventana emergente con pantallas que hacen las preguntas al usuario y guardan las respuestas en campos del registro, todo de forma declarativa. Una Visualforce page o un Lightning component custom exigen código para algo que Flow resuelve con clics, y un custom object solo almacena datos: no muestra ninguna ventana ni formulario.
questions.explanationEn: A custom button (or action) that launches a Screen Flow opens a popup with screens that ask the user the questions and save the answers to record fields, all declaratively. A Visualforce page or a custom Lightning component needs code for something Flow handles with clicks, and a custom object only stores data: it shows no popup or form.

questions.stem: On the Account Lightning record page, users need to see ten fields and the ability to sort and wrap text on their Related Lists. Which Related List type should the app builder select for the Related List Lightning component?
questions.explanationEs: En el componente Related List de Lightning App Builder, el tipo Enhanced List muestra hasta 10 campos y permite ordenar columnas, ajustar el texto y redimensionarlas. Basic List muestra pocas columnas y no ofrece ordenar ni ajustar texto, y List View y List Class no son tipos de lista relacionada de este componente.
questions.explanationEn: In the Related List component in Lightning App Builder, the Enhanced List type shows up to 10 fields and lets users sort columns, wrap text and resize columns. Basic List shows only a few columns and offers no sorting or text wrapping, and List View and List Class are not related list types of this component.

questions.stem: An app builder is tasked with adding key performance indicators on client Pages. They want to see a summary of the number of open Opportunities and the Number of won Opportunities for each Account. Where should the app builder go to build these new rollups?
questions.explanationEs: Un roll-up summary field resume registros hijos y se crea en el objeto padre, así que los recuentos de Opportunities abiertas y ganadas por cliente se construyen desde Object Manager, en el objeto Account. Opportunity es el objeto hijo que se cuenta, no el que muestra el resumen; Lightning App Builder solo coloca componentes en las páginas y no crea campos calculados, y Lightning Object Creator sirve para crear objetos nuevos a partir de una hoja de cálculo. Ojo: la relación Opportunity-Account es un lookup estándar, así que un roll-up nativo no está disponible; en la práctica se resolvería con un flow o una herramienta de agregación, pero el campo igualmente vive en Account.
questions.explanationEn: A roll-up summary field summarizes child records and is created on the parent object, so the counts of open and won Opportunities per client are built from Object Manager on the Account object. Opportunity is the child object being counted, not the one that shows the summary; Lightning App Builder only places components on pages and does not create calculated fields, and Lightning Object Creator is for creating new objects from a spreadsheet. Note that the Opportunity-Account relationship is a standard lookup, so a native roll-up is not available there; in practice a flow or an aggregation tool would be used, but the field still lives on Account.

questions.stem: At Cloud Kicks, a record-triggered flow on the Opportunity object that updates related Contract records has begun failing intermittently in production. The Platform App Builder needs to identify which element is failing and review the input and output values for each affected run without asking users to reproduce the error. How should the app builder do this?

options.text: Review the Flow Interview records in Setup to inspect paused interview variable values.
Review the failed flow interviews in the Monitor tab in the Automation App.
Use the Apex Replay Debugger against the flow.
Open the flow in Flow Builder and run Debug with the "Run flow as another user" option enabled.

questions.explanationEs: La pestaña Monitor de la Automation app lista las ejecuciones (interviews) fallidas de los flows, con el elemento que falló y los valores de entrada y salida, y se consulta sin pedir a nadie que reproduzca el error. La vista de Setup con interviews en pausa muestra flows pausados, no los fallidos ni el elemento donde fallaron; el Apex Replay Debugger depura Apex, no flows; y ejecutar Debug como otro usuario vuelve a lanzar el flow en lugar de revisar las ejecuciones reales que ya fallaron en producción.
questions.explanationEn: The Monitor tab of the Automation app lists failed flow interviews, with the element that failed and the input and output values, and it can be reviewed without asking anyone to reproduce the error. The Setup view of paused interviews shows paused flows, not failed ones or the element where they failed; the Apex Replay Debugger debugs Apex, not flows; and running Debug as another user re-launches the flow instead of reviewing the real runs that already failed in production.

questions.stem: Ursa Major Solar (UMS) uses Cases to track customer Complaints, an Issue__c object to represent known problems with its solar Panels, and a Case_Issue__c junction object to relate known problems to Customer complaints. Periodically, UMS conducts audits which require the Auditing users to view Case_Issue__c records. Which access levels must be configured to allow UMS users to access Case_Issue__c records?

options.text: Read-Only access on Case and Issue__c
Read-Only access on Case and Case_Issue__c
Read-Only access on Issue__c and Case_Issue__c

questions.explanationEs: Case_Issue__c es un objeto de unión con dos relaciones master-detail, hacia Case y hacia Issue__c, y sus registros no tienen un acceso propio: lo heredan de ambos padres. Para que los auditores vean un registro de unión necesitan acceso de lectura a los dos registros padre, así que hay que dar Read en Case y en Issue__c (se da por supuesto el permiso de objeto sobre el propio objeto de unión). Dar acceso solo al objeto de unión no abre los padres, y las combinaciones que dejan fuera Case o Issue__c tampoco bastan.
questions.explanationEn: Case_Issue__c is a junction object with two master-detail relationships, to Case and to Issue__c, and its records have no access of their own: they inherit it from both parents. For the auditors to see a junction record they need read access to both parent records, so Read must be granted on Case and on Issue__c (object permission on the junction object itself is assumed). Access to the junction object alone does not open the parents, and combinations that leave out Case or Issue__c are not enough.

questions.stem: Northern Trail Outfitters wants to initiate a daily backup of its Salesforce org. Which tool should an app builder recommend for this task?
questions.reviewNote: Ojo con la premisa: Data Export Service solo se programa de forma semanal o mensual, no diaria. Es la única herramienta nativa de backup entre las opciones, así que se mantiene la clave de la fuente; en la variante con «AppExchange package» la respuesta es el paquete de AppExchange.
questions.explanationEs: Data Export Service es la herramienta nativa de Salesforce para exportar y programar copias de los datos del org, y es la única opción que cumple esa función. Hay que tener en cuenta que solo se programa de forma semanal o mensual, no diaria, así que para algo estrictamente diario haría falta un backup de AppExchange. Refrescar una Full Copy sandbox no es una copia de seguridad, el Add/Change package no es una herramienta de Salesforce y un Support expert no hace backups.
questions.explanationEn: Data Export Service is Salesforce's native tool for exporting and scheduling copies of the org's data, and it is the only option that does that job. Note that it can only be scheduled weekly or monthly, not daily, so a strictly daily backup would need an AppExchange solution. Refreshing a Full Copy sandbox is not a backup, Add/Change package is not a Salesforce tool, and a support expert does not perform backups.

questions.stem: The training team at Northern Trail Outfitters uses a custom Training object to track customer training sessions. An app builder needs to create a relationship between the Training object and the related Students' record. Which two behaviors should an app builder take into consideration? Choose 2 answers

options.text: On Student record, users can set up Roll-up summary field on Training records.
Cross-object field updates between Training and Student records are not supported.
On Training record, the Student Lookup field can be made optional.
On Training record, users can only delete Students, if they have access to it.

questions.reviewNote: La fuente V23.35 da la clave sobre las actualizaciones de campo entre objetos y el campo opcional, y los tres resolvedores a ciegas dan en cambio el roll-up summary y el campo opcional. Mantengo la clave de V23.35: la opción del campo opcional habla de un «Student Lookup field», y con un lookup un roll-up summary no es posible (exige master-detail), así que la opción del roll-up no puede ser correcta a la vez que la del lookup opcional. Aun así, la opción sobre las actualizaciones de campo entre objetos es discutible hoy, porque un flow sí puede actualizar registros relacionados a través de un lookup. Conviene contrastarla.
questions.explanationEs: La opción habla de un «Student Lookup field», es decir, de un lookup. Dos consecuencias de elegir lookup son que el campo en Training puede ser opcional (con master-detail sería obligatorio) y que las actualizaciones de campo entre objetos del antiguo workflow no están soportadas (solo funcionaban con master-detail); hoy esas actualizaciones se resuelven con un record-triggered flow. El roll-up summary sobre Training exige que Student sea master en una relación master-detail, algo incompatible con un lookup opcional, y la frase sobre borrar Students describe un permiso genérico, no un comportamiento propio de la relación.
questions.explanationEn: The option refers to a "Student Lookup field", that is, a lookup. Two consequences of choosing a lookup are that the field on Training can be optional (with master-detail it would be required) and that the cross-object field updates of the old workflow are not supported (they only worked with master-detail); today those updates are handled with a record-triggered flow. A roll-up summary on Training requires Student to be the master in a master-detail relationship, which is incompatible with an optional lookup, and the statement about deleting Students describes a generic permission, not a behavior specific to the relationship.

questions.stem: At Universal Containers, the VP of Service has requested a visual indicator flag on each case, based on the case priority. High-priority cases should be flagged red, medium-priority should be flagged Yellow, and low- priority cases should be flagged green. Which two formulas will accomplish this requirement? Choose 2 answers
questions.explanationEs: Para mostrar una bandera hay que devolver una imagen, no una ruta: IMAGE() recibe la URL de la imagen y su texto alternativo. Tanto los IF anidados con ISPICKVAL como un CASE sobre el picklist Priority eligen la bandera verde, amarilla o roja y se la pasan a IMAGE(). Las dos fórmulas sin IMAGE() solo devuelven el texto de la ruta, de modo que el campo mostraría una URL en lugar de la bandera. En sintaxis estricta el CASE sobre un picklist necesitaría TEXT(Priority), pero la intención de la opción es clara.
questions.explanationEn: To show a flag you have to return an image, not a path: IMAGE() takes the image URL and its alternative text. Both the nested IF with ISPICKVAL and a CASE on the Priority picklist pick the green, yellow or red flag and pass it to IMAGE(). The two formulas without IMAGE() only return the path as text, so the field would display a URL instead of the flag. In strict syntax the CASE on a picklist would need TEXT(Priority), but the intent of that formula is clear.

questions.stem: An app builder is loading data into Salesforce. To link the new records back to the legacy system, a field will be used to track the legacy ID on the Account object. For future data loads this ID will be used when upserting records. Which two field attributes should be selected? Choose 2 answers
questions.explanationEs: Para enlazar con el sistema antiguo y hacer upsert hay que marcar el campo como External ID, que permite a Data Loader, la API y las importaciones localizar el registro por ese valor. Unique evita que dos cuentas compartan el mismo ID legado, lo que haría ambiguo el emparejamiento. Text (encrypted) es un tipo de campo, no un atributo para localizar registros, y un campo encriptado no puede ser External ID; Required solo obliga a rellenar el campo y no ayuda a emparejar.
questions.explanationEn: To link back to the legacy system and upsert, the field must be marked as External ID, which lets Data Loader, the API and imports find the record by that value. Unique prevents two accounts from sharing the same legacy ID, which would make the match ambiguous. Text (encrypted) is a field type, not an attribute for locating records, and an encrypted field cannot be an External ID; Required only forces the field to be filled in and does not help matching.

questions.stem: DreamHouse Realty is rethinking its sandbox utilization strategy after acquiring Cloud Kicks. The Salesforce COE already utilizes a partial and a Full sandbox, which it refreshes on their own regular schedules. Teams are expanding and have to begin each of their small projects in a sandbox before Committing to the larger pool for collaborative testing while still keeping costs down. Which sandbox type should be considered first?
questions.explanationEs: Developer sandbox es el tipo más pequeño y barato (copia solo metadatos, con poco almacenamiento y refresco diario), ideal para que cada equipo arranque un proyecto pequeño antes de pasar al entorno compartido más grande. Developer Pro cuesta más y ofrece más almacenamiento del necesario; Partial y Full ya los usa el COE, son los más caros y se refrescan mucho más despacio (cada 5 y cada 29 días).
questions.explanationEn: A Developer sandbox is the smallest and cheapest type (it copies metadata only, with little storage and a daily refresh), ideal for each team to start a small project before moving to the larger shared environment. Developer Pro costs more and offers more storage than needed; Partial and Full are already used by the COE, are the most expensive and refresh far more slowly (every 5 and every 29 days).

questions.stem: Universal Containers (UC) requires that all users specify a Contract is sent on each Opportunity prior to marking it as "Closed Won". UC wants to be able to report on how many Opportunities have sent Contracts compared to how many have a missing contract when the Opportunities close. Which field type should an app builder configure to fulfill this requirement?
questions.explanationEs: Un Checkbox guarda verdadero o falso, justo lo que hace falta para contar las Opportunities con contrato enviado frente a las que no lo tienen: se filtra y se agrupa en informes sin esfuerzo, y una validation rule puede exigir que esté marcado al pasar a Closed Won. Text y Text Area dejan escribir valores distintos y hacen inviable un recuento fiable. Un picklist también serviría, pero añade valores y mantenimiento para un simple sí o no.
questions.explanationEn: A Checkbox stores true or false, exactly what is needed to count Opportunities with a sent contract against those without one: it is easy to filter and group in reports, and a validation rule can require it to be checked when moving to Closed Won. Text and Text Area let users type different values and make a reliable count impossible. A picklist could also work, but it adds values and maintenance for a simple yes or no.

questions.stem: A Platform App Builder created a change set for new fields and updated page layouts in a sandbox. After deploying the change set to production, the page layout appears to be missing three fields that were previously showing on the production layout. What is causing this to happen?

options.text: The validation failed and the deployment was rolled back.
The newly deployed page layout overwrote the existing one in production when deployed.
The permissions to the fields were not included in the change set and therefore removed.
The page layout assignment needs to be updated after deployment.

questions.explanationEs: Un change set despliega el page layout completo, no solo los campos añadidos: el layout de la sandbox sustituye al de producción. Los tres campos que solo estaban en el layout de producción desaparecen porque no existían en la versión desplegada. Si la validación hubiera fallado no se habría desplegado nada; los permisos de campo (field-level security) no quitan campos del layout, solo los ocultan al usuario; y la asignación del layout no cambia su contenido.
questions.explanationEn: A change set deploys the whole page layout, not just the added fields: the sandbox layout replaces the production one. The three fields that existed only on the production layout disappear because they were not in the deployed version. If validation had failed nothing would have been deployed; field-level security does not remove fields from the layout, it only hides them from the user; and the layout assignment does not change the layout's content.

questions.stem: At DreamHouse Realty, a Screen Flow in production that creates a Property Visit record works correctly when the Platform App Builder runs it, but a sales rep on the "Realty Sales" profile reports that the flow errors and does not create the expected record. The app builder wants to reproduce the failure in the sales rep's permission context without involving the rep or creating production data. How should the app builder reproduce the failure?

options.text: Enable the debug log for the sales rep, ask the rep to run the flow again, and inspect the log for the failed step.
Review the flow's failed interviews in Setup and inspect the variable values at the failed element.
Open the flow in Flow Builder, click Debug, and select the option to run the flow as the sales rep.
Request Login Access from the sales rep through Setup and run the flow while logged in as that user.

questions.explanationEs: Flow Builder permite ejecutar Debug como otro usuario, de modo que el flow se prueba con el perfil, los permission sets y el field-level security de la comercial y se reproduce el fallo sin que ella intervenga. Activar el debug log y pedirle que repita el flow, o pedir Login Access y ejecutarlo como ella, implican a la comercial y crearían datos reales en producción, y revisar los interviews fallidos analiza un error ya ocurrido en lugar de reproducirlo en su contexto de permisos.
questions.explanationEn: Flow Builder lets you run Debug as another user, so the flow is tested with the sales rep's profile, permission sets and field-level security and the failure is reproduced without involving her. Turning on the debug log and asking her to run the flow again, or requesting Login Access and running it as her, involve the rep and would create real data in production, and reviewing failed interviews analyzes an error that already happened instead of reproducing it in her permission context.

questions.stem: Universal Containers wants to give sales managers the ability to quickly provide sign off on an Opportunity via the Opportunity record page when a sales rep has discounted a deal by 20% To 30%. Which two features should be used for this requirement? Choose 2 answers
questions.explanationEs: Un Approval Process define los criterios (por ejemplo, un descuento del 20 % al 30 %), los pasos y los aprobadores, así que aporta el visto bueno formal del sales manager. Dynamic Actions permite mostrar en la página de registro de la Opportunity las acciones de aprobar o rechazar solo cuando se cumple la condición, para que el manager firme rápido desde ahí. Schema Builder sirve para diseñar el modelo de datos y una Validation Rule solo impide guardar datos inválidos; ninguna de las dos ofrece un sign-off.
questions.explanationEn: An Approval Process defines the entry criteria (for example a 20% to 30% discount), the steps and the approvers, so it provides the sales manager's formal sign-off. Dynamic Actions lets you show approve or reject actions on the Opportunity record page only when the condition is met, so the manager can sign off quickly from there. Schema Builder is for designing the data model and a Validation Rule only blocks invalid data from being saved; neither gives a sign-off.

questions.stem: A user is unable to use inline editing on a list view. A quick check verifies the user should be able to perform inline editing as they have been Assigned the appropriate permissions. Which condition should the app builder review?

options.text: If the list view selected is locked by another user
If the list view restricts sharing for the user
If the list view contains a chart created by the user
If the list view contains more than one record type

questions.explanationEs: La inline editing no está disponible en una list view que contiene más de un record type, porque cada record type puede tener campos y valores de picklist distintos. Hay que filtrar la list view a un solo record type para poder editar en línea. Que la list view esté bloqueada por otro usuario no es una restricción real, y los sharing settings solo limitan qué filas ve el usuario. Un gráfico en la list view tampoco impide editar en línea.
questions.explanationEn: Inline editing is not available in a list view that contains more than one record type, because each record type can have different fields and picklist values. The list view has to be filtered to a single record type before you can edit inline. A list view being locked by another user is not a real restriction, and sharing settings only limit which rows the user can see. A chart on the list view does not prevent inline editing either.

questions.stem: DreamHouse Realty wants to track how many lifts are being installed into Customer garages. The To Be Installed custom checkbox field on the custom Lift Object should be checked and an external system should be notified via an outbound Message the next day when a lift is sold. Which automation tool should be used to complete this task?
questions.explanationEs: Flow es la herramienta actual para automatizar esto: un record-triggered flow puede marcar el checkbox To Be Installed y, con un scheduled path, ejecutar al día siguiente la acción de Outbound Message hacia el sistema externo.
