Approval process solo gestiona aprobaciones, Validation rule solo impide guardar datos inválidos y Assignment rule asigna propietarios de leads o cases; ninguna programa acciones diferidas ni notifica a sistemas externos.
questions.explanationEn: Flow is the current tool for this: a record-triggered flow can check the To Be Installed checkbox and, using a scheduled path, run the Outbound Message action the next day to notify the external system. An approval process only handles approvals, a validation rule only blocks invalid data, and an assignment rule assigns owners of leads or cases; none of them schedules delayed actions or notifies external systems.

questions.stem: Sales managers at Cloud Kicks would like to standardize what information sales reps are gathering. Sales reps want recommendations, sales strategies and to know what key fields need to be completed at each step of the sales process on the opportunity record. Which feature should an app builder use to provide this functionality?
questions.explanationEs: Path muestra los stages de la Opportunity y, en cada uno, los key fields que hay que completar y un panel de Guidance for Success con recomendaciones y estrategia de venta, lo que estandariza la información que recogen los reps. Un Approval Process solo enruta aprobaciones de registros y una Global Action crea o actualiza registros desde cualquier página, sin guiar por las etapas de venta.
questions.explanationEn: Path shows the Opportunity stages and, for each one, the key fields to complete plus a Guidance for Success panel with recommendations and sales strategy, which standardizes the information reps gather. An Approval Process only routes records for approval, and a Global Action creates or updates records from any page without guiding users through the sales stages.

questions.stem: Universal Containers wants to build a screen that gives the user the ability to edit all Order Line Items related to a specific Order. The user should also be able to add new Order Line Items. Which screen component should the Platform App Builder use to achieve the requirements?
questions.explanationEs: Repeater es el screen component de un screen flow que muestra un conjunto de campos por cada elemento de una colección: permite precargar los Order Line Items existentes, editarlos y añadir o quitar elementos. Data Table sirve para mostrar y seleccionar registros, pero no permite añadir filas nuevas. Section solo organiza el diseño de la pantalla y Slider captura un valor numérico.
questions.explanationEn: Repeater is the screen flow component that shows a set of fields for each item in a collection: it can be prepopulated with the existing Order Line Items, lets users edit them, and lets them add or remove items. Data Table is for displaying and selecting records and does not let users add new rows. Section only organizes the screen layout and Slider captures a numeric value.

questions.stem: A recently refreshed partial sandbox at Cloud Kicks has no data in The custom object Shipping. Checking in production, there are two million Rows of data in the object. What could be the reason the data is missing?

options.text: The sandbox was refreshed too early.
The sandbox is still populating data
The selected objects in the sandbox template.
The partial sandbox is at capacity.

questions.explanationEs: Un partial sandbox solo copia los datos de los objetos que se seleccionan en su sandbox template, y como mucho 10.000 registros por objeto. Si el objeto custom Shipping no se incluyó en el template, llega vacío aunque producción tenga dos millones de filas. Un refresh demasiado temprano o un sandbox que sigue poblándose no explicarían que falte justo un objeto, y el límite de capacidad no deja un objeto seleccionado en cero.
questions.explanationEn: A partial sandbox only copies data for the objects selected in its sandbox template, and at most 10,000 records per object. If the custom Shipping object was not included in the template, it arrives empty even though production holds two million rows. A refresh done too early or a sandbox that is still populating would not explain why one specific object is missing, and a capacity limit would not leave a selected object at zero.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks wants customer care agents to follow a guided, multi-step form directly on the Case record page to capture a product return. The form takes the agent through verifying the order, choosing a return reason, and confirming a refund method, collecting input at each step. Which type of flow should the Platform App Builder use?
questions.explanationEs: Un screen flow es el único tipo de flow que muestra pantallas e interactúa con el usuario: se puede añadir a la página del Case y guiar al agente por varios pasos recogiendo datos en cada uno. Un record-triggered flow se ejecuta solo cuando cambia un registro, un schedule-triggered flow corre a horas fijas sobre lotes de registros y un autolaunched flow no tiene pantallas por sí mismo.
questions.explanationEn: A screen flow is the only flow type that shows screens and interacts with the user: it can be placed on the Case record page and walk the agent through several steps, collecting input at each one. A record-triggered flow runs only when a record changes, a schedule-triggered flow runs at set times over batches of records, and an autolaunched flow has no screens of its own.

questions.stem: An app builder has a custom component they want to make available on the utility bar, but the component is unavailable. How should the component be tagged?

options.text: For use in Lightning App Builder.
For use on the utility bar.

questions.explanationEs: Para que un componente custom aparezca como utility item en la utility bar hay que exponerlo con el target específico (lightning__UtilityBar en un Lightning web component; en Aura, la interfaz lightning:utilityItem). Eso es la etiqueta «For use on the utility bar». Exponerlo para record pages o para Lightning App Builder en general no lo hace disponible en la utility bar, y App Manager es donde se configura la utility bar de la app, no donde se etiqueta un componente.
questions.explanationEn: For a custom component to show up as a utility item in the utility bar, it has to be exposed with the specific target (lightning__UtilityBar in a Lightning web component; in Aura, the lightning:utilityItem interface). That is the "For use on the utility bar" tag. Exposing it for record pages or for Lightning App Builder in general does not make it available in the utility bar, and App Manager is where the app's utility bar is configured, not where a component gets tagged.

questions.stem: Universal Containers uses a custom object called Reviews to capture Information generated by interviewers during the candidate process. The Review records are visible to any user that has access to the related custom Candidate record. The VP of Human Resources wants the comment field on the Review to be private to anyone outside of the HR department. How should the app builder meet this requirement?

options.text: Create a page layout with the field and use field-level security to hide the field from all other users.
Create a sharing rule to share the field with the VP of HR with Role and Subordinates.
Create a page layout with the field for HR users and another page layout without the field for all other users.
Create an Apex sharing rule to share the field with users that have "HR" in their role.

questions.explanationEs: Field-level security es lo que restringe de verdad el acceso a un campo: se oculta el campo Comment a todos los perfiles y permission sets salvo los de HR, y se deja en el page layout para quienes deben verlo. Un page layout por sí solo solo oculta el campo en la interfaz, que sigue accesible por reports o API. Los sharing rules y el Apex sharing controlan el acceso a registros, no a campos individuales.
questions.explanationEn: Field-level security is what truly restricts access to a field: the Comment field is hidden from every profile and permission set except those for HR, and kept on the page layout for the people who should see it. A page layout on its own only hides the field in the user interface, and it stays reachable through reports or the API. Sharing rules and Apex sharing control access to records, not to individual fields.

questions.stem: An app builder installed a custom Lightning component from AppExchange. What should be done next in order to configure the component for use in a record page?

options.text: Edit a record page using the Page Layout editor > Drag the Visualforce component onto the page.
Edit a record page using Lightning App Builder > Drag the component onto the page.
Edit a record page using App Manager > Drag the component onto the page.
Edit a record page using the Page Layout editor > Drag the component onto the page.

questions.explanationEs: Un componente Lightning instalado desde AppExchange se coloca en una record page editando esa página en Lightning App Builder y arrastrando el componente al lienzo, para después guardar y activar la página. El Page Layout editor configura campos, botones y related lists, no el lienzo de la Lightning page, y no es donde se arrastran componentes Lightning. App Manager gestiona las apps y su utility bar, no el contenido de las record pages.
questions.explanationEn: A Lightning component installed from AppExchange is placed on a record page by editing that page in Lightning App Builder and dragging the component onto the canvas, then saving and activating the page. The Page Layout editor configures fields, buttons and related lists, not the Lightning page canvas, and it is not where Lightning components are dragged. App Manager manages apps and their utility bar, not the content of record pages.

questions.stem: The CFO of Cloud Kicks needs a way for new vendors to accept terms on Agreements for any new major retail store lease before the opportunity can be closed. Which feature should be used to handle this requirement?
questions.explanationEs: Un Approval Process permite que una parte designada (aquí, quien represente a los vendors) acepte formalmente los términos y que el registro quede bloqueado o en estado pendiente hasta que se apruebe, de modo que la oportunidad no pueda cerrarse antes. Email Alert solo notifica y no impone ningún paso de aceptación. Dynamic Action solo cambia qué botones se ven en la página, y una Validation Rule bloquea un guardado según los datos, pero no recoge ni enruta una aceptación explícita de nadie.
questions.explanationEn: An Approval Process lets a designated party (here, whoever represents the vendors) formally accept the terms, and it keeps the record locked or pending until approval is given, so the opportunity cannot be closed before that. Email Alert only notifies and enforces no acceptance step. Dynamic Action only changes which buttons appear on the page, and a Validation Rule blocks a save based on data but does not capture or route an explicit acceptance from anyone.

questions.stem: Universal Containers expects impacts to operations due to increased demand. The executive team will reach out to current customers and wants to see the number of open cases for the account and parent account. What should an app builder use to display the number of open cases on the account page?
questions.explanationEs: Un Flow (por ejemplo un record-triggered flow sobre Case, o un screen flow en la página) puede contar los casos abiertos de la cuenta y también los de su cuenta padre, y mostrar o guardar el resultado en la cuenta. Un Roll-up summary field solo funciona sobre una relación master-detail, y la relación entre Case y Account es un lookup estándar, además de que no sube datos a la cuenta padre. Approval Process y Custom object no cuentan registros relacionados.
questions.explanationEn: A Flow (for example a record-triggered flow on Case, or a screen flow on the page) can count the open cases of the account and of its parent account, then show or store the result on the account. A Roll-up summary field only works over a master-detail relationship, and the relationship between Case and Account is a standard lookup, and it also would not aggregate to the parent account. An Approval Process and a Custom object do not count related records.

questions.stem: Universal Containers ' global support team routes complex milestone approvals based on the region of the submitting user. They need the flow to dynamically assign the approval task to a specific regional queue instead of a statically hard-coded user ID. How should the Platform App Builder store and reference the queue assignments inside the Flow Builder logic?

options.text: Hard-code individual user profile IDs into a Screen element, then use a Get Records element.
Use a formula variable that evaluates the queue's DeveloperName, then use a Get Records element.
Launch an asynchronous path that ignores the record owner field.
Map the approval request to a custom text field on the Task object.

questions.explanationEs: Las queues se guardan como registros Group de tipo Queue, y su DeveloperName es un identificador estable. El flow puede calcular en una variable de fórmula el nombre de la queue según la región del usuario y luego usar un Get Records sobre Group filtrando por ese DeveloperName y por Type = Queue, para asignar la tarea sin ningún ID fijo. Meter IDs de usuario o de perfil en una pantalla vuelve a ser una asignación estática. Una ruta asíncrona que ignora el propietario no decide quién recibe la tarea, y un campo de texto en Task no asigna nada por sí solo.
questions.explanationEn: Queues are stored as Group records of type Queue, and their DeveloperName is a stable identifier. The flow can calculate the queue name from the user's region in a formula variable and then use Get Records on Group, filtering by that DeveloperName and Type = Queue, to assign the task without any hard-coded ID. Putting user or profile IDs into a screen is still a static assignment. An asynchronous path that ignores the owner does not decide who receives the task, and a text field on Task does not assign anything by itself.

questions.stem: Ursa Major Solar (UMS) is looking to hire some new employees. UMS wants to allow the same applicant to apply for multiple open positions Using a single application. What should an app builder recommend to meet these requirements?

options.text: Create a master-detail relationship field on Open Position to Application.
Create a master-detail relationship field on Applicant to Application.
Create a master-detail relationship field on Applicant to Open Position.
Create a master-detail relationship field on Application to Open Position.

questions.reviewNote: V23.35 marca la creación del campo master-detail en Open Position hacia Application. Los resolutores ciegos se dividen (dos por esa opción y uno por el campo en Application hacia Open Position, con confianza baja) y la explicación de FreeCram v10.8 apunta a esta última. Con la convención «campo en X hacia Y» (X es el hijo, Y el padre), solo la opción de V23.35 deja que una misma Application cubra varias Open Positions, así que se mantiene su clave. El modelo es poco natural y la redacción es ambigua, por lo que conviene revisarla.
questions.explanationEs: Un campo master-detail se crea en el objeto hijo y apunta al padre. Para que una única Application sirva a varias Open Positions, Application tiene que ser el padre y Open Position el hijo, es decir, el campo se crea en Open Position hacia Application. Crear el campo en Application hacia Open Position haría que cada application dependiera de una sola position. Los campos entre Applicant y Application o entre Applicant y Open Position relacionan al candidato, pero no hacen que una misma application cubra varias positions.
questions.explanationEn: A master-detail field is created on the child object and points to the parent. For a single Application to serve several Open Positions, Application has to be the parent and Open Position the child, that is, the field is created on Open Position pointing to Application. Creating the field on Application pointing to Open Position would make each application depend on a single position. The fields between Applicant and Application or between Applicant and Open Position relate the candidate, but they do not let one application cover several positions.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks (CK) captures all shipping information in a custom object called Shipments__c. CK's app builder is tasked with creating an approval process to ensure department members can approve all overnight shipments. Where should the app builder route the approval request?
questions.reviewNote: V23.35 marca Queue; FreeCram v14.3 marca Public group y los tres resolutores ciegos votaron Public group. En un approval process una queue es un tipo de aprobador válido (cualquier miembro puede aprobar), mientras que usar un public group directamente como aprobador no está claro: las aprobaciones clásicas ofrecen user, queue y related user, y los grupos solo aparecen en los Flow Approvals más recientes. Se mantiene la clave de V23.35 por prudencia; conviene revisarla.
questions.explanationEs: En un approval process la solicitud puede asignarse a una queue: les llega a todos los miembros del departamento y cualquiera de ellos puede aprobarla, que es lo que pide el enunciado. Role y Hierarchy field no representan a un departamento, sino que resuelven un aprobador según la estructura de roles o un campo de usuario como el manager. Public group es la alternativa que otras fuentes proponen; el tipo de aprobador habitual en un paso de aprobación es user, queue o related user, por eso aquí se mantiene la queue, aunque el punto es discutible.
questions.explanationEn: In an approval process the request can be assigned to a queue: it reaches all the members of the department and any one of them can approve it, which is what the stem asks for. Role and Hierarchy field do not represent a department; they resolve an approver from the role structure or from a user field such as the manager. Public group is the alternative that other sources propose; the usual approver type in an approval step is user, queue or related user, so the queue is kept here, although the point is debatable.

questions.stem: Universal Containers (UC) utilizes two custom picklist fields Called sales_Organization__c and Pricing_Tier__c. Which validation rule should an app builder use to ensure Pricing Tier__c is required for customers with a Sales Organization__c value of Canada?
questions.explanationEs: Una validation rule bloquea el guardado cuando su fórmula devuelve TRUE, así que debe dispararse solo cuando la organización es Canada y el Pricing Tier está vacío. AND combina las dos condiciones, ISPICKVAL compara el picklist y ISBLANK(TEXT(...)) comprueba si el otro picklist está vacío. OR se activaría con cualquier registro de Canada o con cualquier tier vacío. ISNULL no sirve con un picklist, y la fórmula con IF y la comparación directa del picklist con un texto no son válidas.
questions.explanationEn: A validation rule blocks the save when its formula returns TRUE, so it must fire only when the organization is Canada and the Pricing Tier is empty. AND combines the two conditions, ISPICKVAL compares the picklist and ISBLANK(TEXT(...)) checks whether the other picklist is empty. OR would fire for any Canada record or for any empty tier. ISNULL does not work with a picklist, and the IF formula with a direct picklist comparison against text is not valid.

questions.stem: An app builder wants to create a custom Sync button on Account that will Call a Lightning Web Component that connects with an external system. This action Should only be available if the custom Status field is set to Ready to Sync. What should an app builder use to add this functionality to an Account record page?
questions.explanationEs: Las Dynamic Actions de la Lightning record page permiten añadir una acción (por ejemplo una quick action que lance un Lightning Web Component) y mostrarla solo cuando el campo Status vale Ready to Sync, mediante un filtro de visibilidad. Un Custom link no puede lanzar un LWC con esa visibilidad condicional. Un Formula field no es un botón, y un producto de AppExchange es innecesario para algo que se resuelve de forma declarativa.
questions.explanationEn: Dynamic Actions on the Lightning record page let you add an action (for example a quick action that launches a Lightning Web Component) and show it only when the Status field equals Ready to Sync, using a visibility filter. A Custom link cannot launch an LWC with that conditional visibility. A Formula field is not a button, and an AppExchange product is unnecessary for something that can be solved declaratively.

questions.stem: Universal Containers wants to send a reminder email 7 days after a Project__c record's Status field changes to On Hold. For example, a project placed on hold on March 1 should trigger its reminder on March 8, independent of any other project. Which flow design should the Platform App Builder use?

options.text: A platform event-triggered flow that sends the reminder email 7 days after a platform event message is received.
A schedule-triggered flow on Project__c that runs once each day and sends a reminder email to each record that has been in On Hold status for 7 days.
An after-save record-triggered flow on Project__c, triggered when Status is changed to On Hold, with a scheduled path set to run 7 days after the record is updated.
An after-save record-triggered flow on Project__c, triggered when Status is changed to On Hold, with a scheduled path set to run 7 days after the record's CreatedDate.

questions.explanationEs: Un record-triggered flow after-save con entrada cuando Status cambia a On Hold y un scheduled path a 7 días de la actualización del registro calcula el momento de forma individual para cada proyecto: el 1 de marzo se programa el 8 de marzo, sin depender de los demás. El schedule-triggered flow diario tendría que averiguar por su cuenta qué proyectos llevan 7 días en On Hold. La referencia a CreatedDate contaría desde la creación del registro, no desde el cambio de estado. El platform event-triggered flow depende de un evento que aquí no existe.
questions.explanationEn: An after-save record-triggered flow that runs when Status changes to On Hold, with a scheduled path set 7 days after the record is updated, calculates the time individually for each project: a project placed on hold on March 1 is scheduled for March 8, independent of the others. A daily schedule-triggered flow would have to work out on its own which projects have been On Hold for 7 days. Using CreatedDate would count from record creation, not from the status change. A platform event-triggered flow depends on an event that does not exist in this scenario.

questions.stem: Northern Trail Outfitters uses a custom object to track travel requests. Rangers want to have automatic posts on a record whenever a travel request has been approved. Which feature should be used to accomplish this?
questions.explanationEs: Feed tracking genera automáticamente una publicación en el feed del registro cuando cambia un campo seguido, por ejemplo el campo de estado de aprobación de la travel request, y se puede activar en objetos personalizados. Un Approval process gestiona el flujo de aprobación pero no publica por sí mismo en el feed del registro cada cambio. Auto-response rule responde a leads o casos por email, y una Feed quick action solo publica cuando un usuario la ejecuta a mano.
questions.explanationEn: Feed tracking automatically creates a post in the record feed when a tracked field changes, for example the approval status field of the travel request, and it can be enabled on custom objects. An Approval process manages the approval flow but does not by itself post every change to the record feed. An Auto-response rule replies to leads or cases by email, and a Feed quick action only posts when a user runs it manually.

questions.stem: Ursa Major Solar is ramping up the sales team to meet increased demand. As part of the short ramp up for these new reps, the manager wants to provide a help guide to enable reps to easily get help where needed during the different sales processes. Which solution should an app builder recommend?
questions.explanationEs: Path muestra las etapas del proceso de ventas en la parte superior del registro y permite configurar para cada etapa los campos clave y un texto de Guidance for Success, que sirve como guía de ayuda para los nuevos reps. Chatter Publisher es para publicar y colaborar, no para guiar un proceso. Journey Builder pertenece a Marketing Cloud y gestiona recorridos de clientes. Un Flow automatiza pasos, pero no ofrece ayuda contextual por etapa dentro del registro.
questions.explanationEn: Path shows the stages of the sales process at the top of the record and lets you configure key fields and Guidance for Success text for each stage, which works as a help guide for new reps. Chatter Publisher is for posting and collaborating, not for guiding a process. Journey Builder belongs to Marketing Cloud and manages customer journeys. A Flow automates steps, but it does not provide per-stage contextual help inside the record.

questions.stem: Universal Containers assigns system access through permission sets and permission set groups to ensure each user has proper access. One department with varying levels of support staff has five consistent permission sets they require to complete their duties. Some higher-level staff have additional permission sets that are required only for them. How should a Platform App Builder recommend assigning permission sets to users?

options.text: Utilize the Manage Assignments button to assign each user the same set of permission set groups and permission sets.
Utilize Data Loader to mass update the desired users with their full list of permission sets and permission set groups.
Utilize the Manage Assignments button to assign a permission set group and additional individual permission sets to each user.
Utilize Data Import Wizard to mass update the desired users with their full list of permission sets and permission set groups.

questions.explanationEs: Las cinco permission sets que necesita todo el departamento se agrupan en un permission set group, y con Manage Assignments se asigna ese grupo a cada usuario; al personal sénior se le añaden además las permission sets individuales que solo ellos necesitan. Así el acceso común se mantiene en un solo sitio y nadie recibe permisos de más. Asignar a todos el mismo conjunto completo rompería el mínimo privilegio, y Data Loader o Data Import Wizard no son la vía adecuada: el segundo ni siquiera admite asignaciones de permission sets y el primero añade una carga masiva innecesaria.
questions.explanationEn: The five permission sets the whole department needs are bundled into one permission set group, and Manage Assignments assigns that group to each user; senior staff then get the extra individual permission sets that only they need. The common access is maintained in one place and nobody receives more than they should. Giving everyone the same full set would break least privilege, and Data Loader or Data Import Wizard are not the right tools here: the wizard does not even support permission set assignments, and Data Loader adds an unnecessary bulk load.

questions.stem: DreamHouse Realty wants to display a weather map component on a Lightning record page when a house is scheduled for a showing. How should the app builder meet the requirement?
questions.explanationEs: Component visibility en Lightning App Builder permite poner filtros a un componente para que solo aparezca cuando un campo del registro cumple una condición, por ejemplo cuando la casa tiene una visita programada. Field-level security controla el acceso a los campos, no si un componente se muestra; un formula field solo calcula un valor, y las sharing rules deciden quién ve el registro, no qué componentes tiene la página.
questions.explanationEn: Component visibility in Lightning App Builder lets you attach filters to a component so it only appears when a field on the record meets a condition, for example when the house has a showing scheduled. Field-level security controls access to fields, not whether a component is displayed; a formula field only calculates a value, and sharing rules decide who can see the record, not which components the page shows.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks wants to know the total value of all won Opportunities for Accounts and display it on the record. Which type of summary should the app builder use in the roll-up summary field?
questions.reviewNote: Premisa dudosa en la práctica: un roll-up summary nativo exige una relación master-detail y Account-Opportunity es un lookup. La respuesta que pretende el examen (Sum) no cambia.
questions.explanationEs: Un roll-up summary de tipo Sum suma el campo Amount de las oportunidades hijas, y con un criterio de filtro (por ejemplo, solo las ganadas) se obtiene el valor total de las oportunidades ganadas de cada cuenta. Count solo devuelve cuántas oportunidades hay, y Total y Aggregate no son tipos de roll-up (los tipos son Count, Sum, Min y Max). Matiz: un roll-up nativo necesita master-detail y Account-Opportunity es un lookup, así que en la práctica haría falta un flow u otra herramienta, pero el tipo que pide el examen es Sum.
questions.explanationEn: A roll-up summary of type Sum adds up the Amount field of the child opportunities, and a filter criterion (for example, only won ones) gives the total value of the won opportunities for each account. Count only returns how many opportunities there are, and Total and Aggregate are not roll-up types (the types are Count, Sum, Min and Max). Caveat: a native roll-up needs a master-detail relationship and Account-Opportunity is a lookup, so in practice a flow or another tool would be needed, but the type the exam expects is Sum.

questions.stem: Universal Containers has deployed custom tabs to production via change sets, without including the profile settings or permission sets. What is the setting for the visibility of custom tabs?

options.text: Custom tabs are hidden for all users.
Custom tabs are default off for all users.
Custom tabs are default on for all users.

questions.explanationEs: Un custom tab desplegado con un change set sin profiles ni permission sets no lleva ningún ajuste de visibilidad, así que ningún usuario lo ve: queda oculto (Tab Hidden) hasta que se configure en un profile o permission set. Default On y Default Off son valores de visibilidad que viven en esos profiles o permission sets, por lo que no se aplican solos. La opción de que los tabs no se despliegan es falsa: el tab sí llega a Production, lo que falta es el acceso.
questions.explanationEn: A custom tab deployed through a change set without profiles or permission sets carries no visibility setting, so no user sees it: it stays hidden (Tab Hidden) until visibility is configured in a profile or permission set. Default On and Default Off are visibility values that live in those profiles or permission sets, so they are not applied on their own. The claim that the tabs are not deployed is false: the tab does reach Production, what is missing is the access.

questions.stem: Universal Containers wants to match Opportunity data from Salesforce to records in a financial database. What is required to configure an indirect lookup relationship in Salesforce between the Salesforce Opportunity records and those in a financial database?
questions.explanationEs: Un indirect lookup relaciona un external object hijo con un objeto de Salesforce (aquí Opportunity) comparando un valor de la base externa con un campo External ID único de ese objeto, porque los datos financieros no contienen Ids de Salesforce. Por eso hay que marcar un campo personalizado como External ID (y Unique) en Opportunity. El Salesforce Record ID sirve para un lookup normal, y TEXT(Id) o CASESAFEID(Id) solo transforman el Id: no crean la clave de coincidencia que necesita la base externa.
questions.explanationEn: An indirect lookup relates a child external object to a Salesforce object (here Opportunity) by matching a value from the external database against a unique External ID field on that object, because the financial data does not contain Salesforce Ids. That is why a custom field must be marked as External ID (and Unique) on Opportunity. The Salesforce Record ID is for a regular lookup, and TEXT(Id) or CASESAFEID(Id) merely transform the Id: they do not create the matching key the external database needs.

questions.stem: Universal Containers has a record-triggered flow with a Scheduled Path to send an email 7 days after a Case closes. The Platform App Builder needs to confirm that a recently closed Case has an email waiting in the queue. Where in Setup should the app builder look to see this pending action?
questions.reviewNote: Los tres resolvedores ciegos eligieron Paused and Failed Flow Interviews, pero la clave de V23.35 es Time-Based Automations y la explicación de la fuente cita esa página de Setup para ver los scheduled paths pendientes. No he podido contrastarlo con la documentación oficial. Mantengo la clave de V23.35 porque los scheduled paths pendientes no son interviews pausadas ni fallidas hasta que se ejecutan. Conviene comprobarlo en una org.
questions.explanationEs: Las acciones pendientes de un scheduled path de un record-triggered flow se consultan en la página de Setup Time-Based Automations, que lista las acciones programadas que esperan su momento. Flow Trigger Explorer muestra el orden de ejecución de los flows de un objeto, no las ejecuciones futuras; Apex Flex Queue solo gestiona jobs batch de Apex; y Paused and Failed Flow Interviews lista interviews pausadas o con error, no los paths programados que todavía no se han ejecutado.
questions.explanationEn: Pending actions of a scheduled path in a record-triggered flow are checked on the Time-Based Automations page in Setup, which lists the scheduled actions waiting for their time. Flow Trigger Explorer shows the order in which an object's flows run, not future executions; Apex Flex Queue only manages queued Apex batch jobs; and Paused and Failed Flow Interviews lists interviews that are paused or have errored, not scheduled paths that have not run yet.

questions.stem: Universal Containers would like Account owners to be able to quickly access a report of all of the current Assets associated with their Account. Account owners should access this report through the Account record page. How should the Platform App Builder accomplish this?
questions.explanationEs: Un custom link con una URL dinámica, colocado en el layout de Account, abre el informe de Assets pasando el Id de la cuenta como filtro, de modo que el owner ve solo los activos de esa cuenta desde su página de registro. Un dashboard con filtro no recibe el registro actual como contexto, los scheduled reports solo se envían por email según un horario, y un custom report type solo define qué objetos y campos se pueden informar, sin dar acceso desde la página.
questions.explanationEn: A custom link with a dynamic URL, placed on the Account layout, opens the Assets report passing the account Id as a filter, so the owner sees only that account's assets from the record page. A dashboard with a filter does not receive the current record as context, scheduled reports are only emailed on a schedule, and a custom report type merely defines which objects and fields can be reported on, without giving access from the page.

questions.stem: A business user wants a quick way to edit a record's status and enter a Custom due date field from the record's feed in Salesforce Mobile App. What should be used to accomplish this?
questions.explanationEs: Una custom action (una quick action específica del objeto, de tipo Update a Record) que muestre los campos Status y la fecha de vencimiento personalizada, añadida al publisher del registro, permite editarlos rápido desde el feed en la app móvil de Salesforce. Un custom button no es una acción del feed móvil y un campo de fórmula con URL solo muestra un valor calculado, sin actualizar nada. Un custom quick access link no es la función de Salesforce adecuada para este caso.
questions.explanationEn: A custom action (an object-specific quick action of type Update a Record) that exposes the Status field and the custom due date field, added to the record's publisher, lets the user edit them quickly from the feed in the Salesforce mobile app. A custom button is not an action available in the mobile feed, and a URL formula field only shows a calculated value without updating anything. A custom quick access link is not the right Salesforce feature for this case.

questions.stem: Universal Containers have changes that need to be deployed from Sandbox to Production. Where should an app builder look to verify that a Change Set can be deployed?
questions.reviewNote: El PDF de V23.35 repite el texto Inbound Change Sets en dos opciones, un fallo de transcripción. He sustituido la segunda copia por Outbound Change Sets, que es un distractor verosímil, pero es una suposición mía. Se mantiene la clave de V23.35 (Inbound Change Sets), porque es donde se valida un change set en la org de destino. Los resolvedores ciegos discreparon: uno aceptó las dos copias como correctas, otro eligió Deployment Status, que también muestra resultados de validación.
questions.explanationEs: Para comprobar si un change set se puede desplegar, en la org de destino (Production) se abre Inbound Change Sets, se selecciona el change set subido y se usa Validate, que simula el despliegue y avisa de errores antes de confirmarlo. Deployment Settings solo sirve para autorizar conexiones de despliegue entre orgs, y Deployment Status muestra el progreso y el historial de despliegues, no es donde se valida. Outbound Change Sets es donde se crea y se sube el change set en la org de origen.
questions.explanationEn: To check whether a change set can be deployed, you open Inbound Change Sets in the target org (Production), select the uploaded change set and use Validate, which simulates the deployment and reports errors before you commit it. Deployment Settings is only for authorizing deployment connections between orgs, and Deployment Status shows deployment progress and history, not where you validate. Outbound Change Sets is where the change set is built and uploaded in the source org.

questions.stem: Duplicate management for Leads has been implemented at Universal Containers but it seems duplicate leads are still being created. The Org Wide Default (OWD) is set to "Private" for Leads. Which two actions help prevent duplicate Leads from being created? Choose 2 answers

options.text: Change the Lead Duplicate Rule details to Bypass Sharing Rules.
Change the Lead Assignment Rule to check for duplicates.
Change OWD for Leads to Public Read Only
Change the Lead Duplicate actions to Block on Create.

questions.explanationEs: Con el OWD de Lead en Private, la duplicate rule solo compara con los leads que el usuario puede ver, y por eso se cuelan duplicados; activar Bypass Sharing Rules en la regla hace que busque entre todos los leads. Además, la acción tiene que ser Block on Create, porque con Alert el usuario puede guardar el duplicado igualmente. Las lead assignment rules solo asignan propietarios y no detectan duplicados, y pasar el OWD a Public Read Only ampliaría el acceso a todos los leads para resolver un problema que la propia duplicate rule ya resuelve.
questions.explanationEn: With the Lead OWD set to Private, the duplicate rule only compares against leads the user can see, which is why duplicates slip through; enabling Bypass Sharing Rules on the rule makes it search all leads. The action must also be Block on Create, because with Alert the user can still save the duplicate. Lead assignment rules only assign owners and do not detect duplicates, and changing the OWD to Public Read Only would widen access to every lead to solve a problem the duplicate rule already solves.

questions.stem: Ursa Major Solar (UMS) is planning to hire some new employees. UMS Wants to allow a job candidate (Job Candidate__c) to apply for multiple open Positions (Open_Position__c) and then be able to view the applications (Application__c) on the job candidate's record. UMS also wants to view all the Applications for a specific open position. What should an app builder recommend to meet these requirements? Choose 2 answers

options.text: Create a master-detail relationship field on Application to open_Position
Create a master-detail relationship field on Application to Job Candidate
Create a master-detail relationship field on Open Position to Application
Create a master-detail relationship field on Job Candidate to Application

questions.explanationEs: Es una relación many-to-many entre Job Candidate y Open Position, que se modela con Application como junction object: dos campos master-detail creados en Application, uno hacia Job Candidate y otro hacia Open Position. Así cada candidato ve sus applications en una related list y cada position ve las suyas. Los campos creados en Open Position o en Job Candidate apuntando a Application invierten la dirección y harían que esos objetos fueran hijos de Application, con lo que no se obtiene el modelo pedido.
questions.explanationEn: This is a many-to-many relationship between Job Candidate and Open Position, modeled with Application as a junction object: two master-detail fields created on Application, one to Job Candidate and one to Open Position. That way each candidate sees their applications in a related list and each position sees its own. Fields created on Open Position or on Job Candidate pointing to Application reverse the direction and would make those objects children of Application, which does not give the requested model.

questions.stem: Universal Containers has a custom object that holds over 100 fields. The App builder wants to break up the fields into separate tabs on the lightning page. Which Lightning component is most appropriate to fulfil this requirement?
questions.reviewNote: V23.35 marca Accordion y se mantiene, pero los tres solvers ciegos votaron Field Section (confianza baja o media). La pregunta habla de pestañas y ninguna opción es el componente Tabs: tanto Field Section como Accordion son contenedores o agrupadores de Dynamic Forms. No se puede zanjar con seguridad cuál espera el examen.
questions.explanationEs: Con Dynamic Forms, un objeto con más de 100 campos deja de mostrarse como un único bloque y sus campos se reparten en grupos dentro de contenedores como Accordion o Tabs, de modo que el contenido que no se ve al abrir la página no se carga de golpe. Accordion es el contenedor que organiza esos grupos en áreas separadas y plegables. Highlights Panel solo muestra unos pocos campos clave y Record Detail muestra todos los campos en un único bloque, así que ninguno divide la página. Field Section agrupa campos, pero es la pieza que va dentro de un contenedor y no el componente que reparte la página.
questions.explanationEn: With Dynamic Forms, an object with more than 100 fields no longer has to be shown as a single block: its fields are split into groups inside containers such as Accordion or Tabs, so content that is not visible when the page opens is not loaded all at once. Accordion is the container that organizes those groups into separate, collapsible areas. Highlights Panel only shows a few key fields and Record Detail shows every field in one block, so neither divides the page. Field Section groups fields, but it is the piece that goes inside a container and not the component that divides the page.

questions.stem: A Platform App Builder needs to display different icons and control the colors based on a formula field. How should the app builder achieve this task?

options.text: Modify the formula to use IMAGE() and CASE().
Add the formula field to the page layout and set field help with icon and color cues.
Create a screen flow and add it as a component on the page.

questions.explanationEs: Dynamic Forms permite aplicar conditional formatting a los campos de la página de registro según reglas, de forma declarativa y sin tocar la fórmula. Así se controlan los colores y los iconos que ve el usuario. Modificar la fórmula con IMAGE() y CASE() solo cambia la imagen que devuelve el campo y no da control de los colores en la página. El texto de ayuda del campo es solo texto, y un screen flow en la página es un formulario interactivo que no da formato a los campos.
questions.explanationEn: Dynamic Forms lets you apply conditional formatting to fields on the record page based on rules, declaratively and without touching the formula. That is how you control the colors and icons the user sees. Changing the formula with IMAGE() and CASE() only changes the image the field returns and does not give you control of colors on the page. Field help text is just text, and a screen flow on the page is an interactive form that does not format fields.

questions.stem: After utilizing the Lightning Object Creator to create a new object, its fields, and to insert all of the data, an app builder now needs to set up the Lightning Record Page. Which component should the app builder have on their Lightning Record Page to see all of the fields from the page layout?
questions.explanationEs: El componente Record Detail muestra todos los campos y secciones del page layout asignado al usuario en la Lightning Record Page. Highlights Panel solo muestra los campos del compact layout y las acciones principales. Path muestra las etapas de un campo de picklist, y Recommendations muestra sugerencias de Next Best Action; ninguno de los dos lista los campos del layout.
questions.explanationEn: The Record Detail component shows all the fields and sections of the page layout assigned to the user on the Lightning Record Page. Highlights Panel only shows the compact layout fields and the main actions. Path shows the stages of a picklist field, and Recommendations shows Next Best Action suggestions; neither lists the layout fields.

questions.stem: Universal Containers wants to collect information from a user and use that input to update a related Account record. Which combination of flow elements should the Platform App Builder use to meet this requirement?

options.text: Autolaunched flow with a Screen element and an Update Records element
Record-triggered flow with a Screen element and a Create Records element
Schedule-triggered flow with an Assignment element and a Create Records element
Screen flow with Screen elements and an Update Records element

questions.explanationEs: Para recoger datos de un usuario hace falta un screen flow, que es el único tipo que muestra Screen elements. Un Update Records modifica el Account relacionado con lo que el usuario escribió. Un autolaunched flow, un record-triggered flow y un schedule-triggered flow se ejecutan en segundo plano y no pueden mostrar pantallas. Además, Create Records crearía registros nuevos en vez de actualizar el Account existente.
questions.explanationEn: Collecting input from a user requires a screen flow, the only flow type that displays Screen elements. An Update Records element then changes the related Account with what the user entered. Autolaunched, record-triggered and schedule-triggered flows run in the background and cannot show screens. Create Records would also create new records instead of updating the existing Account.

questions.stem: DreamHouse Realty (DR) employees started using company-owned airplanes for work travel after Ursa Major Solar was acquired. DR executives want to automate the submission of travel request forms to enforce the internal policy. How should an app builder automate travel requests based on these criteria?
questions.explanationEs: Un approval process permite enviar automáticamente a aprobación los registros que cumplen unos criterios de entrada, como un viaje en avión de la empresa, y enrutarlos a los aprobadores para hacer cumplir la política interna. Una validation rule solo bloquea el guardado y no inicia ningún flujo de aprobación. Una assignment rule solo asigna Leads o Cases a un propietario o una queue, y Apex sería innecesario para un requisito que se resuelve de forma declarativa.
questions.explanationEn: An approval process can automatically submit records that meet entry criteria, such as company airplane travel, and route them to approvers to enforce the internal policy. A validation rule only blocks the save and does not start any approval flow. An assignment rule only assigns Leads or Cases to an owner or queue, and Apex would be unnecessary for a requirement that can be solved declaratively.

questions.stem: A Platform App Builder needs to implement a solution where a virtual assistant can independently handle end- to-end customer service interactions-understanding intent, querying Salesforce data, and taking action- without requiring a human to intervene at each step. Which feature supports this requirement?
questions.explanationEs: Agentforce proporciona agentes de IA autónomos que entienden la intención del cliente, consultan datos de Salesforce y ejecutan acciones sin que una persona intervenga en cada paso. Einstein Bots sigue diálogos guiados y con script, y deriva a un humano cuando se sale de ellos. Case Assignment Rules solo enrutan casos a un propietario o una queue, y Live Chat conecta al cliente con agentes humanos.
questions.explanationEn: Agentforce provides autonomous AI agents that understand customer intent, query Salesforce data and take action without a person stepping in at each stage. Einstein Bots follow scripted, guided dialogs and hand off to a human when the conversation leaves the script. Case Assignment Rules only route cases to an owner or queue, and Live Chat connects customers with human agents.

questions.stem: At Ursa Major Solar (UMS), a Platform App Builder built an HR Onboarding application that includes custom objects, page layouts, Lightning record pages, and an Apex class. The application is built in a Developer sandbox tied to UMS's production org. UMS's wholly-owned subsidiary, UMS Logistics, runs a separate Salesforce production org that has no deployment connection to UMS's production org. The app builder must move the HR Onboarding application from UMS's Developer sandbox to UMS Logistics ' production org for evaluation. Which deployment plan should the app builder use?

options.text: Create an unmanaged package in UMS's Developer sandbox and install it in UMS Logistics ' production org using the install URL.
Create a managed package in UMS's Developer sandbox and install it in UMS Logistics ' production org using the install URL.
Upload an outbound change set from UMS's Developer sandbox to UMS Logistics ' production org.
Refresh a UMS Logistics sandbox from UMS's Developer sandbox, then deploy from there using change sets.

questions.explanationEs: Sin deployment connection entre las dos orgs de producción, un unmanaged package subido desde el Developer sandbox se puede instalar en la otra org con su install URL, y es una buena opción para una evaluación puntual. Un managed package no se crea en un sandbox, sino en un packaging org (Developer Edition). Un outbound change set solo se puede enviar a orgs conectadas por una deployment connection, y un sandbox de otra org no se puede refrescar desde este Developer sandbox.
questions.explanationEn: With no deployment connection between the two production orgs, an unmanaged package uploaded from the Developer sandbox can be installed in the other org through its install URL, which fits a one-off evaluation. A managed package is not created in a sandbox but in a packaging org (Developer Edition). An outbound change set can only be sent to orgs linked by a deployment connection, and a sandbox of another org cannot be refreshed from this Developer sandbox.

questions.stem: An app builder wants to create a custom object and 10 fields. What should they use to create the object, fields, and relationships quickly from one place?
questions.explanationEs: Schema Builder es la interfaz de arrastrar y soltar donde se crean objetos, campos y relaciones desde un único lugar, sin saltar de una página de Setup a otra. Manage Field Permissions solo configura el acceso a campos que ya existen y Developer Console es un entorno para escribir y depurar código. Lightning Object Creator crea un objeto a partir de una hoja de cálculo, pero no es la herramienta para definir campos y relaciones en un único lienzo.
questions.explanationEn: Schema Builder is the drag-and-drop interface where you create objects, fields and relationships from one place, without jumping between Setup pages. Manage Field Permissions only configures access to fields that already exist, and Developer Console is an environment for writing and debugging code. Lightning Object Creator builds an object from a spreadsheet, but it is not the tool for defining fields and relationships on a single canvas.

questions.stem: An app builder wants to add the option to ' Send New Email ' from Leads, Contacts, and Accounts for users on mobile. What is the benefit of using global actions to accomplish this?

options.text: The global action's layout automatically clones the default page layout.
Salesforce Lightning Component Library houses existing global actions prebuilt for use.
Global actions are record-specific and are available when searching that particular Object.
Global actions can be accessed anywhere actions are available in mobile including Record detail pages, feed, and Chatter groups.

questions.explanationEs: Una global action no está ligada a un objeto, así que se puede usar en cualquier lugar donde haya acciones disponibles en móvil, como las páginas de detalle de registro, el feed y los grupos de Chatter. Por eso sirve para Send New Email desde Leads, Contacts y Accounts. Su layout se diseña por separado y no clona el page layout por defecto, no se aloja en la Lightning Component Library y no es específica de un registro: eso describe las object-specific actions.
questions.explanationEn: A global action is not tied to an object, so it can be used anywhere actions are available on mobile, such as record detail pages, the feed and Chatter groups. That is why it works for Send New Email from Leads, Contacts and Accounts. Its layout is designed separately and does not clone the default page layout, it is not housed in the Lightning Component Library, and it is not record-specific: that describes object-specific actions.

questions.stem: The sales reps at Cloud Kicks have not been properly filling out their sales pipeline and are regularly creating new Opportunities and moving them directly to a "Contract Signed" status. How should a Platform App Builder prevent this from happening so the sales reps have better insight into the true sales pipeline?

options.text: Set up Path on the Opportunity object to guide sales users through key Opportunity stages using the standard Sales Path.
Set up Guidance for Success as part of Sales Path to provide sales users with best practices to follow during each Opportunity stage.
Set up a validation rule to prevent users from skipping critical steps as they progress through Opportunity stages.
Set up an approval flow for managers to approve stage progression when sales users update the Opportunity stage to "Contract Signed".

questions.explanationEs: Una validation rule es lo único que impide de verdad guardar la Opportunity cuando el cambio de Stage se salta pasos: su fórmula puede comparar el valor nuevo con el anterior (por ejemplo con PRIORVALUE o ISCHANGED) y bloquear el guardado si el salto no está permitido. Sales Path y Guidance for Success solo guían al usuario y muestran consejos, pero no le impiden elegir directamente «Contract Signed». Un approval flow añadiría una aprobación manual en cada cambio, sin asegurar que se hayan completado las etapas intermedias.
questions.explanationEn: A validation rule is the only choice that actually prevents the save when the Stage change skips steps: its formula can compare the new value with the previous one (for example with PRIORVALUE or ISCHANGED) and block the record if the jump is not allowed. Sales Path and Guidance for Success only guide users and show tips, so a rep can still pick "Contract Signed" directly. An approval flow would add a manual approval to every change without guaranteeing that the intermediate stages were completed.

questions.stem: Service Agents are required to confirm a user's identity before providing support information over the phone. Which feature can an app builder use to help agents meet this requirement?

options.text: Add Path to the top of the Case layout
Include Surveys as a Case related list
Guided Action Flows on the record page

questions.reviewNote: La fuente V23.35 marca Guided Action Flows en la página de registro y la explicación de FreeCram v14.3 coincide; los tres resolvedores ciegos eligieron Path (con confianza baja y citando Guided Action Flows como alternativa). Mantengo Guided Action Flows porque un screen flow puede pedir y registrar las preguntas de verificación, mientras que Path solo muestra etapas y texto de ayuda, pero no es una clave del todo segura.
questions.explanationEs: Guided Action Flows son screen flows que se muestran en la página de registro (con el componente Actions & Recommendations) y llevan al agente paso a paso, por ejemplo con las preguntas de verificación de identidad, antes de dar información. Path solo muestra las etapas del Case y texto de orientación, pero no recoge ni confirma datos del cliente. Las validation rules solo bloquean guardados inválidos y no guían una conversación telefónica, y Surveys sirven para recoger la opinión del cliente, no para verificar su identidad.
questions.explanationEn: Guided action flows are screen flows displayed on the record page (through the Actions & Recommendations component) that walk the agent step by step, for example through identity verification questions, before giving out information. Path only shows the Case stages and guidance text; it neither collects nor confirms customer data. Validation rules only block invalid saves and cannot guide a phone conversation, and Surveys collect customer feedback rather than verify identity.

questions.stem: DreamHouse Realty wants to import its property records from an external system into Salesforce. The app builder will use an external ID field to house the property ID from the external system. Which two details should the app builder know when using external ID fields?

options.text: Each org can have up to 25 custom external ID fields.
Each object can have up to 25 custom external ID fields.
An external ID field can be a URL field.
An external ID field can be an auto-number field.

questions.explanationEs: Salesforce permite hasta 25 campos External ID personalizados por objeto, no por organización, y entre los tipos admitidos está Auto Number (además de Text, Number y Email). Por eso es falso que el límite sea de 25 por org, y también es falso que un campo URL pueda marcarse como External ID, porque ese tipo no está soportado.
questions.explanationEn: Salesforce allows up to 25 custom external ID fields per object, not per org, and the supported field types include Auto Number (along with Text, Number and Email). So a limit of 25 per org is wrong, and a URL field cannot be marked as an external ID because that type is not supported.

questions.stem: A Platform App Builder wants to see the total sales for each Account. Sales are tracked as Closed Won Opportunities. How should the app builder meet this need?

options.text: Create a roll-up summary field for the Opportunity object with COUNT rollup type summarizing Accounts.
Create a roll-up summary field for the Account object with SUM rollup type summarizing Opportunities aggregated by Amount with filter criteria on Stage.
Create a roll-up summary field for the Account object with SUM rollup type summarizing Opportunities aggregated by Amount including all records in the calculation.
Create a roll-up summary field for the Account object with COUNT rollup type summarizing Opportunities.

questions.explanationEs: Para ver las ventas totales de cada Account hace falta un roll-up summary en Account que haga SUM del Amount de las Opportunities, con un filtro por Stage para contar solo las Closed Won. Sin el filtro se sumarían también las Opportunities abiertas y perdidas, y un COUNT da el número de registros, no el importe vendido. El roll-up debe estar en Account, que es donde se quiere el resultado, no en Opportunity, porque un roll-up solo resume registros hijos en el objeto padre. Nota: Account y Opportunity se relacionan por un lookup, así que en una org real este roll-up nativo no existe y se resolvería con un record-triggered flow; el examen da por buena esta configuración.
questions.explanationEn: To show total sales per Account you need a roll-up summary on Account that does a SUM of the Opportunity Amount, with a filter on Stage so only Closed Won records count. Without the filter, open and lost Opportunities would be added too, and a COUNT returns the number of records rather than the amount sold. The roll-up must live on Account, where the result is needed, not on Opportunity, because a roll-up only summarizes child records on the parent object. Note: Account and Opportunity are related by a lookup, so in a real org this native roll-up does not exist and a record-triggered flow would be used instead; the exam treats this setup as valid.

questions.stem: Universal Containers (UC) tracks Account locations in Zip Code, a custom text field with a validation rule to enforce proper formatting of the US ZIP+4 code for UC's orders. Which formula should the app builder create on Order to display only the first five digits of Zip Code from the parent Account?
questions.explanationEs: LEFT(texto, n) devuelve los primeros n caracteres de un texto, así que LEFT(Account.Zip_Code__c, 5) muestra los cinco primeros dígitos del ZIP+4 del Account padre, usando un cross-object formula en Order. BEGINS solo devuelve TRUE o FALSE al comprobar cómo empieza un texto, LPAD rellena un texto hasta una longitud dada, y TEXT convierte un valor a texto con un solo argumento, por lo que no extrae caracteres.
questions.explanationEn: LEFT(text, n) returns the first n characters of a text value, so LEFT(Account.Zip_Code__c, 5) shows the first five digits of the parent Account's ZIP+4 through a cross-object formula on Order. BEGINS only returns TRUE or FALSE when checking how a text starts, LPAD pads a text to a given length, and TEXT converts a value to text with a single argument, so it does not extract characters.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks models the relationship between Stores and Loyalty Members with a custom Store_Membership__c junction object that has two master-detail relationships, one to Store__c and one to Loyalty_Member__c. A regional manager has Read access to Store__c but no access to Loyalty_Member__c. The manager reports that Store_Membership__c records do not appear on the Store record page. What should the Platform App Builder do to resolve this?

options.text: Grant Read access to the Store_Membership__c object on the profile.
Grant Read access to the Loyalty_Member__c object on the profile.
Create a sharing rule on the Store_Membership__c object, granting the manager's role access.
Create a sharing rule on the Loyalty_Member__c object, granting the manager's role access.

questions.explanationEs: Un registro de un junction object con dos master-detail no tiene acceso propio: lo hereda de ambos masters, así que el usuario necesita acceso a los dos. El manager ya puede leer Store__c, pero no tiene permiso sobre el objeto Loyalty_Member__c, y darle Read en su profile cubre la parte que falta. Dar Read solo sobre Store_Membership__c no basta, porque sigue sin poder ver el segundo master. Un sharing rule en Loyalty_Member__c no sustituye el permiso de objeto, y no puede crearse un sharing rule en Store_Membership__c porque es un objeto detail cuyo acceso lo controlan sus masters.
questions.explanationEn: A junction object record has no access of its own: it inherits access from both masters, so the user needs access to both. The manager can already read Store__c but has no permission on the Loyalty_Member__c object, and granting Read on the profile supplies the missing piece. Read on Store_Membership__c alone is not enough, because the user still cannot see the second master. A sharing rule on Loyalty_Member__c does not replace the object permission, and no sharing rule can be created on Store_Membership__c because it is a detail object whose access is controlled by its masters.

questions.stem: Universal Containers has a custom picklist called Support Level on the Account object. They would like to show the real-time value of Support Level on all case records. How should an app builder implement this requirement?

options.text: Create a formula field on the Account object using the ISPICKVAL function.
Create a Lookup Relationship on the Case object.
Create a roll-up summary field using Support Level on the Account object.
Create a formula field on the Case object using the TEXT function.

questions.explanationEs: Un formula field en Case con TEXT(Account.Support_Level__c) lee el valor del Account padre en tiempo real; TEXT es necesario porque el campo es un picklist. Un formula field en Account no aparece en los Cases, y ISPICKVAL solo devuelve TRUE o FALSE al comparar el picklist con un valor, no muestra el valor. Un roll-up summary solo funciona de hijos a padre y no admite picklists. Un field update con Process Builder copiaría el valor una vez, sin ser en tiempo real, y Process Builder está retirado para automatizaciones nuevas.
questions.explanationEn: A formula field on Case with TEXT(Account.Support_Level__c) reads the value from the parent Account in real time; TEXT is required because the field is a picklist. A formula field on Account does not appear on Cases, and ISPICKVAL only returns TRUE or FALSE when comparing the picklist to a value, it does not display it. A roll-up summary only works from children up to the master and does not support picklists. A Process Builder field update would copy the value once rather than stay real time, and Process Builder is retired for new automation.

questions.stem: Northern Trail Outfitters has two custom objects that are part of a master- Detail relationship. What determines the ownership and sharing access of the detail record?

options.text: The owner is set independently on the detail object's settings.
The default owner is set in the parent object's settings.
The Owner field on the Detail record
The Owner field on the Master record

questions.explanationEs: En una relación master-detail, el registro detail no tiene propietario propio: su Owner y su acceso de compartición los hereda del registro Master, y el objeto detail queda con el org-wide default «Controlled by Parent». Por eso lo que decide es el campo Owner del registro Master. El detail no tiene ajuste de propietario independiente, no existe un campo Owner editable en él, y tampoco hay un propietario por defecto definido en los ajustes del objeto padre.
questions.explanationEn: In a master-detail relationship the detail record has no owner of its own: its ownership and sharing access are inherited from the master record, and the detail object's org-wide default is "Controlled by Parent". So what decides it is the Owner field on the master record. The detail has no independent owner setting, there is no editable Owner field on it, and no default owner is defined in the parent object's settings.

questions.stem: Universal Containers is adding drone delivery to service offerings. The Developer wrote and tested the code and the change set is ready to go. However, the Deployment window will occur when the developer is on vacation. What can the app builder do to help ensure the code will successfully deploy to Production?

options.text: Remove Apex classes from inbound change set.

questions.explanationEs: En la org de destino se puede validar el inbound change set antes de la ventana de despliegue: la validación ejecuta las mismas comprobaciones y tests que el despliegue real, sin cambiar nada, y si pasa se puede hacer un quick deploy sin necesitar al desarrollador. Los outbound change sets no se pueden validar. Quitar las clases Apex del change set rompería lo que el desarrollador probó, y un «metadata package set» no es un método estándar de despliegue con change sets.
questions.explanationEn: In the target org you can validate the inbound change set ahead of the deployment window: validation runs the same checks and tests as the real deployment without changing anything, and once it passes a quick deploy can be done without the developer. Outbound change sets cannot be validated. Removing the Apex classes from the change set would break what the developer tested, and a "metadata package set" is not a standard change set deployment method.

questions.stem: DreamHouse Realty wants to make sure an Opportunity has a field, Expected_Close_Date__c, populated before it is allowed to enter the qualified stage. How should an app builder solution this request?
questions.explanationEs: Una validation rule sobre Opportunity puede impedir guardar el registro cuando el Stage es Qualified y Expected_Close_Date__c está vacío, y se aplica en cualquier punto de entrada (interfaz, API, importaciones). El page layout solo puede marcar un campo como obligatorio en la interfaz y no depende de la etapa. Los record types sirven para variar layouts o valores de picklist, y Activity History es una lista relacionada de tareas y eventos: ninguno obliga a rellenar un campo.
questions.explanationEn: A validation rule on Opportunity can block the save when the Stage is Qualified and Expected_Close_Date__c is empty, and it applies at every entry point (UI, API, imports). A page layout can only mark a field as required in the UI and does not depend on the stage. Record types are used to vary layouts or picklist values, and Activity History is a related list of tasks and events: none of them forces a field to be filled in.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks wants to efficiently increase the company's adoption of Salesforce while simultaneously moving away from its reliance on spreadsheets. A Platform App Builder is given a spreadsheet everyone is sharing that needs to be added to Salesforce. The object with fields needs to be created and the data inserted simultaneously. Which tool should the app builder use?
questions.explanationEs: Lightning Object Creator (Create Object from Spreadsheet) toma una hoja de cálculo y, en un solo asistente, crea el objeto, genera los campos a partir de las columnas e inserta los datos. Schema Builder crea objetos y campos, pero no importa registros. Data Loader y Data Import Wizard importan datos solo en objetos que ya existen, por lo que no resuelven la creación del objeto y de sus campos al mismo tiempo.
questions.explanationEn: Lightning Object Creator (Create Object from Spreadsheet) takes a spreadsheet and, in a single wizard, creates the object, builds the fields from the columns and inserts the data. Schema Builder creates objects and fields but does not import records. Data Loader and Data Import Wizard only load data into objects that already exist, so they do not cover creating the object and its fields at the same time.

questions.stem: Universal Containers needs the 18-digit record ID from Opportunity records when exporting data to Excel in order to ensure each record is treated Uniquely. Which formula should an app builder use to create this new field?
questions.explanationEs: CASESAFEID(Id) convierte el ID de 15 caracteres, que distingue mayúsculas de minúsculas, en el ID de 18 caracteres, que es seguro para herramientas que no las distinguen como Excel; así dos registros distintos no se confunden al exportar. VALUE convierte texto en número y no tiene relación con el ID, TEXT(Id) solo devuelve el mismo ID de 15 caracteres como texto e ISNUMBER únicamente devuelve verdadero o falso.
questions.explanationEn: CASESAFEID(Id) converts the case-sensitive 15-character ID into the 18-character ID, which is safe for tools that ignore letter case such as Excel, so two different records are not treated as the same one after an export. VALUE turns text into a number and has nothing to do with IDs, TEXT(Id) just returns the same 15-character ID as text, and ISNUMBER only returns true or false.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks (CK) is finding sales reps are inconsistent in data Entry when deals are won. CK requires that custom shoes are shipped Within two weeks after the close date. A custom field called Scheduled Ship Date on the opportunity records the ship date. How should the app builder ensure this field is properly filled out before setting the opportunity to closed won?
questions.explanationEs: Es una validation rule: bloquea el guardado cuando su fórmula devuelve TRUE. La fórmula correcta usa OR para detectar dos errores, que el stage sea Closed Won con una Scheduled Ship Date posterior a 14 días desde la Close Date, o que la Scheduled Ship Date esté en blanco. El picklist se compara con ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won") y las condiciones se unen con &&. Las otras fórmulas no son válidas: comparan StageName con = dentro de ISPICKVAL, usan un solo & o no tienen operador entre las condiciones.
questions.explanationEn: This is a validation rule: it blocks the save when its formula returns TRUE. The right formula uses OR to catch two errors, a Closed Won stage whose Scheduled Ship Date is more than 14 days after the Close Date, or a blank Scheduled Ship Date. The picklist is compared with ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won") and the conditions are joined with &&. The other formulas are not valid: they compare StageName with = inside ISPICKVAL, use a single & or have no operator between the conditions.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks (CK) wants to track orders against inventory, ensuring its ability to fulfill order requests. CK created a junction object called Request Inventory to enable many-to-many relationships with the Inventory and Order objects. What does the app builder need to provide to ensure users can view Request Inventory records?

options.text: Apex-based sharing on the first master object.
Read access to both master objects.
Sharing rules on Request Inventory object.
Read access to the first master object.

questions.explanationEs: Request Inventory es un junction object con dos master-detail, hacia Inventory y hacia Order. Un registro de la junction hereda su acceso de ambos masters, así que el usuario necesita al menos acceso de lectura a los dos para verlo. Dar acceso a un solo master no basta, las sharing rules no se pueden crear sobre un objeto detail que está controlado por sus padres y el Apex-based sharing sobre un master no es necesario ni resuelve el segundo padre.
questions.explanationEn: Request Inventory is a junction object with two master-detail relationships, to Inventory and to Order. A junction record inherits its access from both masters, so the user needs at least Read access to both of them to see it. Access to only one master is not enough, sharing rules cannot be created on a detail object whose sharing is controlled by its parents, and Apex-based sharing on one master is unnecessary and does not cover the second parent.

questions.stem: Which three options are available when activating a Lightning page from The Lightning App Builder? Choose 3 answers

options.text: Assign the page to a combination of apps and permission sets.
Assign the page to a combination of apps and profiles.
Make the page the default homepage for specific apps.
Make the page the default homepage for specific roles.
Make the page the org default.

questions.explanationEs: Al activar una Lightning page en Lightning App Builder se puede dejar como org default, asignarla como página de inicio por defecto de apps concretas o asignarla a una combinación de apps y profiles. Los permission sets y los roles no son destinos de activación: la asignación de páginas se basa en apps, record types y profiles, no en permission sets ni en la jerarquía de roles.
questions.explanationEn: When activating a Lightning page in Lightning App Builder you can make it the org default, make it the default home page for specific apps, or assign it to a combination of apps and profiles. Permission sets and roles are not activation targets: page assignment is based on apps, record types and profiles, not on permission sets or the role hierarchy.

questions.stem: At Cloud Kicks when an opportunity close date is delayed by more than 60 days, the Manager and the VP of Sales want to review the change. Which two solutions will meet the requirement? Choose 2 answers

options.text: Build an approval process that requires unanimous approval from the manager and VP of Sales.
Build a validation rule that does not allow a user to save the opportunity record
Create a formula field that calculates if the close date is less than 60 days and then send An email alert.
Create a flow that submits the record for an approval process.

questions.explanationEs: Se pide que el manager y el VP de Sales revisen el cambio, y eso es un flujo de aprobación. Un approval process con aprobación unánime obliga a que ambos aprueben, y un flow que ejecuta Submit for Approval envía el registro a ese proceso cuando la fecha se retrasa. Una validation rule solo bloquea el guardado y no pide revisión a nadie, y una formula field con un email alert no puede enviar correos ni obtiene ninguna aprobación.
questions.explanationEn: The requirement is for the manager and the VP of Sales to review the change, which is an approval flow. An approval process with unanimous approval forces both of them to approve, and a flow with a Submit for Approval action sends the record into that process when the close date is pushed back. A validation rule only blocks the save and asks nobody to review, and a formula field with an email alert cannot send email and gets no approval.

questions.stem: A Platform App Builder is asked to create a sandbox for a developer. The developer will be testing robust sample data sets and will need to store up to 250 MB of data. The sandbox will be refreshed each day. Which type of sandbox should the app builder create?
questions.explanationEs: Un Developer Pro sandbox ofrece 1 GB de almacenamiento de datos y se puede refrescar una vez al día, por lo que cubre los 250 MB y el refresco diario. Un Developer sandbox también se refresca cada día, pero solo tiene 200 MB. Partial Copy solo se puede refrescar cada 5 días, y un Full sandbox cada 29 días.
questions.explanationEn: A Developer Pro sandbox gives 1 GB of data storage and can be refreshed once a day, so it covers both the 250 MB and the daily refresh. A Developer sandbox is also refreshable daily but has only 200 MB. A Partial Copy sandbox can only be refreshed every 5 days, and a Full sandbox every 29 days.

questions.stem: The marketing director is concerned that too many car parts were given Away for free last year. Which functionality should be used to ensure all free parts receive the marketing Directors ' sign-off?
