questions.explanationEs: Un approval process es la función declarativa que exige que un aprobador designado, aquí el marketing director, dé su visto bueno antes de que el registro avance, y puede bloquear el registro mientras tanto. Un Slack post y un email automático solo notifican y no obligan a nadie a aprobar. Chatter approval no es una función estándar para firmar formalmente un registro.
questions.explanationEn: An approval process is the declarative feature that requires a designated approver, here the marketing director, to sign off before the record moves forward, and it can lock the record meanwhile. A Slack post and an automated email only notify people and do not force anyone to approve. Chatter approval is not a standard feature for formally signing off a record.

questions.stem: An app builder at Northern Trail Outfitters created a sandbox template for Accounts, Projects, and Project Milestones to reconfigure some flows for the project management app. Which type of testing environment should the app builder create?
questions.explanationEs: Las sandbox templates definen qué objetos y datos se copian y solo se pueden usar con Partial Copy y Full sandboxes. De las opciones, solo Partial Copy lo permite. Developer y Developer Pro copian únicamente la metadata, sin datos de producción, y un scratch org no es un sandbox, se crea con Salesforce CLI a partir de una definición.
questions.explanationEn: Sandbox templates define which objects and data are copied and can only be used with Partial Copy and Full sandboxes. Of the choices, only Partial Copy supports them. Developer and Developer Pro sandboxes copy only metadata, without production data, and a scratch org is not a sandbox: it is created with the Salesforce CLI from a definition file.

questions.stem: Where can an app builder edit an existing app to add Components to the utility bar?
questions.explanationEs: Los utility items de una app existente se añaden en Setup, App Manager, editando la app y abriendo Utility Items. Lightning App Builder se usa para editar páginas, y una Lightning record page solo cubre los componentes de esa página de registro. El App Menu solo sirve para abrir las apps, no para configurarlas.
questions.explanationEn: The utility items of an existing app are added in Setup, App Manager, by editing the app and opening Utility Items. Lightning App Builder is used to edit pages, and a Lightning record page only covers the components of that record page. The App Menu only launches apps and does not configure them.

questions.stem: Sales representatives want to capture custom Feedback record details related to each Account. The sales reps want to accomplish this with minimal clicks on mobile. Which two solutions should be recommended in order to meet this requirement? Choose 2 answers

options.text: Create a object-specific action on Account
Create a feedback object as a parent of Account
Create a global action on Account
Create predefined values for most of the fields

questions.explanationEs: Una acción específica del objeto Account (object-specific quick action) se ejecuta en el contexto de la cuenta, crea el Feedback como registro hijo ya relacionado con ella y aparece en la barra de acciones del móvil. Dar valores predefinidos a la mayoría de los campos reduce lo que el usuario tiene que teclear. Hacer que Feedback sea padre de Account invierte la relación, y una global action no tiene contexto de la cuenta, así que el Feedback no quedaría relacionado con ella.
questions.explanationEn: An object-specific quick action on Account runs in the context of the account, creates the Feedback as a child record already related to it, and shows up in the mobile action bar. Predefined values for most fields cut down what the user has to type. Making Feedback a parent of Account reverses the relationship, and a global action has no account context, so the Feedback would not be related to the account.

questions.stem: Which two report formats can be used as a source report to configure a reporting snapshot? Choose 2 answers
questions.explanationEs: Un reporting snapshot guarda en un objeto personalizado los resultados de un informe origen, y ese informe debe tener formato Tabular o Summary. Los formatos Matrix y Joined no se admiten como origen de un snapshot, así que esos dos distractores quedan descartados.
questions.explanationEn: A reporting snapshot stores the results of a source report in a custom object, and that source report must be in Tabular or Summary format. The Matrix and Joined formats are not supported as a snapshot source, so those two distractors are ruled out.

questions.stem: Universal Containers is setting up Salesforce for the first time. Management wants the sales and marketing teams to have different navigation menus in The Salesforce Mobile App. Which option is available to an app builder to satisfy this requirement?

options.text: Create public groups for sales and marketing and create mobile navigation menus for each group.
Create sales and marketing apps and assign the respective profiles to each app.
Create roles for sales and marketing and assign a custom homepage layout for each role.
Create mobile navigation menus for both the sales and marketing profiles.

questions.reviewNote: V23.35 marca crear apps de Ventas y Marketing y asignarlas a cada perfil, y la plantilla de FreeCram v10.8 también apunta a esa respuesta. Los tres votos ciegos preferían en cambio menús de navegación móvil por perfil (dos votos) o por grupo público (uno), y la versión de FreeCram v14.3 usa menús por perfil. Se mantiene la clave de V23.35 porque hoy el menú de la app móvil sale de las apps Lightning disponibles para el usuario, pero no he podido confirmarlo con la documentación actual.
questions.explanationEs: En la app móvil de Salesforce, el menú de navegación que ve cada usuario depende de las apps Lightning a las que tiene acceso. Por eso se crean una app de Sales y otra de Marketing, cada una con sus propios elementos de navegación, y se asigna cada app a su perfil. Los grupos públicos no sirven para asignar menús, y una página de inicio personalizada por rol cambia el contenido de la Home, no la navegación.
questions.explanationEn: In the Salesforce mobile app, the navigation menu each user sees depends on the Lightning apps they can access. So you build one Sales app and one Marketing app, each with its own navigation items, and assign each app to its profile. Public groups cannot be used to assign menus, and a custom home page per role changes the Home content, not the navigation.

questions.stem: A custom field on an account is used to track finance information about a customer. Only members of the finance team have access to this field. However, the business wants to allow one customer service agent, who is assigned the Customer Service profile, read-only access to this field for special Circumstances. What is the recommended solution to grant the customer service agent access to the field?

options.text: Create a new profile to allow for read-only access to the field via field level security and assign it to the agent.
Create a permission set that allows read-only access to the field via field level security and assign it to the agent.
Update the custom field's field level security in setup to allow the agent read-only access to the field
Update the Customer Service Profile already assigned to the agent to allow for read-only access to the field via field level security.

questions.explanationEs: Es una excepción para un solo usuario, y lo recomendado es un permission set que concede lectura sobre el campo mediante field-level security y se asigna solo a ese agente. Modificar el perfil Customer Service abriría el campo a todos los agentes que lo comparten, y crear un perfil nuevo para una sola persona es difícil de mantener. El FLS tampoco se asigna a un usuario concreto desde la definición del campo: se concede por perfil o por permission set, así que cambiarlo en Setup afectaría igualmente a todos los usuarios de ese perfil.
questions.explanationEn: This is a one-user exception, and the recommended approach is a permission set that grants read access to the field through field-level security and is assigned only to that agent. Editing the Customer Service profile would open the field to every agent who shares it, and creating a new profile for one person is hard to maintain. FLS is also not assigned to a single user from the field definition: it is granted per profile or per permission set, so changing it in Setup would still affect everyone on that profile.

questions.stem: An app builder just added a lookup field to Account from the Existing custom object, Box. Which report type is automatically created?
questions.reviewNote: Los tres votos ciegos eligieron un report type "with or without" (confianza baja o media, de memoria), mientras que V23.35 marca Accounts with Boxes. Se mantiene la clave de V23.35 porque el nombre automático de un report type estándar sigue el patrón "Objeto padre with Objeto hijo", pero no lo he podido contrastar con la documentación actual. Además el enunciado es ambiguo sobre en qué objeto vive el lookup: se interpreta que el campo está en Box y apunta a Account.
questions.explanationEs: Se interpreta que Box tiene un lookup hacia Account, de modo que Account es el padre y Box el hijo. Salesforce crea entonces de forma automática un report type estándar con el padre primero, Accounts with Boxes, que devuelve las cuentas que tienen al menos un Box. Boxes with Accounts parte del hijo, y los report types "with or without" no son los que se generan solos con ese patrón: se configuran al crear un custom report type, para incluir también cuentas sin Box.
questions.explanationEn: The lookup is read as living on Box and pointing to Account, so Account is the parent and Box the child. Salesforce then automatically creates a standard report type with the parent first, Accounts with Boxes, which returns the accounts that have at least one Box. Boxes with Accounts starts from the child, and the "with or without" report types are not the ones generated automatically with that pattern: they are set up when you build a custom report type, to include accounts that have no Box.

questions.stem: An app builder is preparing to deploy a new app from the sandbox to Production using change sets. Which two considerations should an app builder keep in mind during this process? Choose 2 answers

options.text: Transactions will revert if the deployment errors.
Users should be logged out of production when receiving inbound change sets.
Salesforce Connect automatically establishes a link between environments.
Change sets do not include all components and may have to perform some changes Manually.

questions.explanationEs: Un change set se despliega como una sola transacción: si hay errores se revierte todo, y no incluye todos los componentes, por lo que algunos cambios hay que repetirlos a mano en el destino. No hace falta desconectar a los usuarios de producción para recibir un inbound change set. Salesforce Connect sirve para acceder a datos externos, no para enlazar entornos: la conexión entre orgs la define la deployment connection.
questions.explanationEn: A change set deploys as a single transaction: if there are errors everything is rolled back, and it does not carry every component, so some changes must be repeated manually in the target org. Users do not need to be logged out of production to receive an inbound change set. Salesforce Connect is for accessing external data, not for linking environments: the link between orgs is defined by the deployment connection.

questions.stem: AW Computing has a custom object for service plans. A service plan needs to be associated to one and only one contact. The support manager noticed if the wrong contact is associated, the reps are unable to Change the contact. The app builder already confirmed the user has correct access to the field and there are no validations associated with the service Plans. What could be causing the issue?

options.text: The Read Only radio button, Allows users with at least Read access to the Master record to create, edit, or delete related Detail records, is selected
The Allow reparenting checkbox, Child records can be reparented to other parent records after they are created, is unchecked
The Read/Write radio button, Allows users with at least Read/Write access to the Master record to create, edit, or delete related Detail records, is selected
The Allow reparenting checkbox, Child records can be reparented to other parent records after they are created, is checked

questions.explanationEs: Un service plan que debe tener siempre un contacto y que los usuarios no pueden cambiar después apunta a una relación master-detail en la que la casilla Allow reparenting está desmarcada. Con ella desmarcada, el detalle queda fijo al padre con el que se creó. Los ajustes de compartición de lectura o de lectura/escritura del padre controlan quién crea o edita detalles, no si se puede cambiar el padre, y tener Allow reparenting marcada sería justo lo contrario del problema.
questions.explanationEn: A service plan that must always have a contact and that users cannot change afterwards points to a master-detail relationship where the Allow reparenting checkbox is unchecked. With it unchecked, the detail record stays tied to the parent it was created with. The read-only and read/write sharing settings on the parent control who can create or edit detail records, not whether the parent can be changed, and having Allow reparenting checked would be the opposite of the problem.

questions.stem: Universal Containers has a requirement that an opportunity should have a field showing the value of its associated account's billing state. This value should be static after the opportunity has been created. What is the recommended solution to configure this automation behavior?
questions.explanationEs: El valor debe copiarse una sola vez, al crear la oportunidad, y quedarse fijo después. Un record-triggered flow que se ejecuta solo al crear puede leer el Billing State de la cuenta y guardarlo en un campo de la oportunidad, sin código. Un formula field se recalcula siempre y reflejaría los cambios posteriores de la cuenta, un roll-up summary field solo agrega registros hijos hacia el padre, y Apex haría lo mismo pero no es lo recomendado cuando una herramienta declarativa lo resuelve.
questions.explanationEn: The value must be copied once, when the opportunity is created, and then stay fixed. A record-triggered flow that runs only on create can read the account's Billing State and store it in an opportunity field, with no code. A formula field always recalculates and would reflect later changes to the account, a roll-up summary field only aggregates child records up to the parent, and Apex would do the same job but is not recommended when a declarative tool solves it.

questions.stem: Universal Containers wants to create a custom checkbox formula field on The Opportunity object. This formula should evaluate to true if the following conditions are met: Stage is set to Negotiation/Review and Close Date is less than 1 week away. Which formula meets these requirements?
questions.explanationEs: Un campo de fórmula checkbox necesita un AND que combine las dos condiciones. Como StageName es un picklist, la comparación debe hacerse con ISPICKVAL y no con un signo igual, y la fecha se compara con TODAY(): CloseDate menos 7 menor que TODAY() equivale a que falte menos de una semana. Las demás fórmulas no usan ISPICKVAL sobre el picklist o tienen una sintaxis de fecha inválida (DAY(7), TODAY(1)). Las opciones de la fuente vienen muy dañadas, por eso se ha reparado la correcta.
questions.explanationEn: A checkbox formula field needs an AND that combines both conditions. Because StageName is a picklist, the comparison must use ISPICKVAL rather than an equals sign, and the date is compared against TODAY(): CloseDate minus 7 less than TODAY() means the close date is less than a week away. The other formulas either do not use ISPICKVAL on the picklist or have invalid date syntax (DAY(7), TODAY(1)). The source options are heavily damaged, so the correct one has been repaired.

questions.stem: Universal Containers utilizes opportunities and a custom object called Detailed_Sales__c. The company would like to roll sales metrics up to an opportunity for only Detailed_Sales__c records that have their picklist status set to Active. What is the recommended method for the app builder to achieve this request?

options.text: Utilize the AppExchange to download a third-party application that can roll up the sales dollars with The appropriate filter.
Utilize Apex code to roll up the desired amounts.
Create a master detail relationship between the parent and child object with a roll up summary field That filters on the status field
Create a lookup relationship between the parent and child object with a roll-up summary field that Filters on the status field

questions.explanationEs: Un roll-up summary field es la solución declarativa recomendada para resumir registros hijos en el padre, y solo existe en el lado master de una relación master-detail. Aquí Opportunity es el padre y Detailed_Sales__c el hijo, y el campo se define con un filtro Status igual a Active para sumar solo esos registros. Una relación lookup no admite roll-up summary fields estándar, y recurrir a Apex o a una app de AppExchange es innecesario cuando la función nativa cubre el requisito.
questions.explanationEn: A roll-up summary field is the recommended declarative way to summarize child records on a parent, and it only exists on the master side of a master-detail relationship. Here Opportunity is the parent and Detailed_Sales__c is the child, and the field is defined with a filter of Status equals Active so only those records are included. A lookup relationship does not support standard roll-up summary fields, and using Apex or an AppExchange app is unnecessary when the native feature meets the requirement.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks wants to start tracking how many shoe subscriptions have been Sold for each shoe catalog. A master-detail relationship exists between the Subscription And the shoe__c objects. Which type of field should an app builder create?
questions.explanationEs: Un Roll-up summary field en el objeto maestro Shoe__c, con la función COUNT, cuenta los registros Subscription detalle relacionados con cada zapato. Es posible porque ya existe una relación master-detail, que es el requisito para los roll-up summary. Crear otro Lookup field o Master-detail field solo definiría una relación que ya existe y no cuenta nada, y «Sum field» no es un tipo de campo de Salesforce.
questions.explanationEn: A Roll-up summary field on the master object Shoe__c, using the COUNT function, counts the related Subscription detail records for each shoe. This works because a master-detail relationship already exists, which is the prerequisite for roll-up summaries. Creating another Lookup field or Master-detail field would only define a relationship that already exists and counts nothing, and "Sum field" is not a Salesforce field type.

questions.stem: Universal Containers (UC) delivers purchased containers to remote Construction sites. Customers supply UC with crossroads or location markers. Which field type should the app builder use to capture this information?
questions.explanationEs: Un Geolocation field guarda latitud y longitud en un único campo, así que sirve para registrar cruces de calles o marcadores de ubicación y permite calcular distancias o mostrarlos en mapas. Un Number field solo guarda un valor numérico suelto y no entiende de coordenadas. Reference y External Lookup sirven para relacionar registros (internos o de un sistema externo), no para capturar una posición geográfica.
questions.explanationEn: A Geolocation field stores latitude and longitude in a single field, so it fits crossroads or location markers and supports distance calculations and map display. A Number field holds only a single loose numeric value and has no notion of coordinates. Reference and External Lookup relate records (internal or from an external system) and do not capture a geographic position.

questions.stem: A business user at Universal Containers wants to update an Account directly from an Opportunity record What should the app builder create to allow the business user to make these edits?

options.text: Opportunity fields updated by a process.
Formula fields displaying the Account fields.
An update record action with a related record component.
An update record action with a detail's component.

questions.explanationEs: El componente Related Record en la página de la Opportunity muestra la Account relacionada, y con una Update Record quick action definida sobre Account el usuario puede editarla sin salir de la Opportunity. Los campos de Opportunity actualizados por un proceso son automatización, no una edición directa del usuario. Los formula fields son de solo lectura y no escriben en la Account, y el componente de detalle del registro solo muestra la Opportunity actual.
questions.explanationEn: The Related Record component on the Opportunity page shows the related Account, and with an Update Record quick action defined on Account the user can edit it without leaving the Opportunity. Opportunity fields updated by a process are automation, not a direct edit by the user. Formula fields are read-only and cannot write to the Account, and a record detail component shows only the current Opportunity.

questions.stem: Universal Containers wants users to have access to the pricing guidelines document when viewing a Contract related to an Account. Which feature should an app builder use to create easy access to the document?

options.text: A custom detail page link on the Contract object
Quick Action on the Account object
A custom detail page link on the Account object
Quick Action on the Contracts object

questions.explanationEs: Los usuarios necesitan el documento mientras ven un Contract, así que el custom detail page link debe crearse en el objeto Contract y añadirse a su page layout, y un clic abre la guía de precios. Un link en el objeto Account aparecería en las páginas de Account, no en las de Contract. Las quick actions sirven para crear o actualizar registros o lanzar un flow o componente, no para abrir un documento mediante un enlace.
questions.explanationEn: Users need the document while viewing a Contract, so the custom detail page link must be created on the Contract object and added to its page layout, and one click opens the pricing guidelines. A link on the Account object would appear on Account pages, not on Contract pages. Quick actions are used to create or update records or to launch a flow or component, not to open a document through a link.

questions.stem: DreamHouse Realty wants to import its property records from an external system into Salesforce. The app builder will use an external ID field to house the property ID from the external System. Which two field types are allowed as an external ID? Choose 2 answers
questions.explanationEs: Solo los campos personalizados de tipo Text, Number, Email y Auto Number pueden marcarse como External ID. De las opciones ofrecidas, Text y Number son válidos, mientras que Phone y URL no son tipos admitidos para un External ID.
questions.explanationEn: Only custom fields of type Text, Number, Email and Auto Number can be marked as External ID. Of the choices offered, Text and Number are valid, while Phone and URL are not supported types for an external ID.

questions.stem: A customer service representative at a call center wants to be able to Collect information from customers using a series of question prompts. What should an app builder use to accomplish this?
questions.explanationEs: Un screen flow permite mostrar una secuencia de pantallas con preguntas al cliente y guardar o usar las respuestas durante la llamada. Un Approval Process enruta registros para aprobación, un Path guía las etapas de un registro y una Validation Rule solo impide guardar datos inválidos; ninguno presenta preguntas guiadas.
questions.explanationEn: A screen flow can present a sequence of screens with questions to the customer and store or use the answers during the call. An Approval Process routes records for approval, a Path guides the stages of a record, and a Validation Rule only blocks invalid data from being saved; none of them presents guided questions.

questions.stem: A production org includes custom objects containing confidential Information. A sandbox is needed that includes data records, excludes all of the Confidential objects, and can be refreshed weekly. Which steps should an app builder take to meet these requirements?

options.text: Create a Developer Pro Sandbox and schedule Data Loader to download selected object data weekly.
Create a Full Copy Sandbox and use a sandbox template.
Create a Partial Copy Sandbox and use a sandbox template.
Create a Developer Sandbox and schedule Data Loader to download selected object data weekly.

questions.explanationEs: Un Partial Copy sandbox incluye una muestra de datos y admite sandbox templates, que permiten elegir qué objetos se copian y dejar fuera los confidenciales; además se puede refrescar cada 5 días, compatible con una cadencia semanal. Un Full Copy sandbox también admite templates, pero solo se puede refrescar cada 29 días. Los Developer y Developer Pro sandbox copian solo metadatos y no incluyen registros, así que los datos habría que cargarlos aparte con Data Loader, lo que no cumple el requisito por sí solo.
questions.explanationEn: A Partial Copy sandbox includes a sample of data and supports sandbox templates, which let you choose which objects are copied and leave out the confidential ones; it can also be refreshed every 5 days, which fits a weekly cadence. A Full Copy sandbox also supports templates but can only be refreshed every 29 days. Developer and Developer Pro sandboxes copy only metadata and no records, so the data would have to be loaded separately with Data Loader, which does not meet the requirement on its own.

questions.stem: Which Lightning component for related lists should a Platform App Builder use to enable record sort order and hiding actions?
questions.explanationEs: Dynamic Related List - Single se configura en Lightning App Builder y permite definir el orden de los registros, las columnas, los filtros y si se muestran o no las acciones de la lista. Related List - Single y el componente Related Lists dependen más de la definición de la lista en el page layout y no ofrecen ese control. Related List Quick Links solo muestra enlaces de navegación a las listas relacionadas, no una lista configurable.
questions.explanationEn: Dynamic Related List - Single is configured in Lightning App Builder and lets you define the record sort order, columns, filters, and whether list actions are shown or hidden. Related List - Single and the Related Lists component depend more on the related list definition in the page layout and do not give that control. Related List Quick Links only shows navigation links to the related lists, not a configurable list.

questions.stem: Shipments at Cloud Kicks (CK) are created and updated by the warehouse staff in a Shipping application. The information needs to be pushed into Salesforce on a regular Basis. CK's app builder creates a custom object called Delivery__c to track the Information. How can the app builder prevent creating duplicate delivery records and update the Correct existing records when migrating data from the shipping application?

options.text: Use the Import Wizard and match on the tracking number.
Create a unique External ID field and use Data Loader.
Use the Import Wizard and match on the Salesforce ID.
Create a duplicate/match rule and use Data Loader.

questions.explanationEs: Un campo External ID único (por ejemplo el número de seguimiento) junto con la operación upsert de Data Loader hace coincidir cada fila con el registro existente: lo actualiza si existe y lo crea si no, sin generar duplicados. El Import Wizard solo puede hacer coincidir por Name, Salesforce ID o un campo External ID, no por un campo cualquiera como el tracking number, y hacerlo por Salesforce ID exige que el sistema externo conozca esos Ids. Las duplicate y matching rules detectan o bloquean duplicados, pero no actualizan el registro correcto.
questions.explanationEn: A unique External ID field (for example the tracking number) combined with the Data Loader upsert operation matches each row to the existing record: it updates it if found and creates it if not, without producing duplicates. The Import Wizard can only match on Name, Salesforce ID, or an External ID field, not on an ordinary field such as the tracking number, and matching on Salesforce ID would require the external system to know those Ids. Duplicate and matching rules detect or block duplicates but do not update the correct record.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks has created a custom object called Interests which is joined to Accounts by way of a junction object called Account Interest. What is the impact to users attempting to view an Account and the associated Account Interest records if they are without read access to the Interest object?

options.text: Users will be able to view the Account Interest records and will have read-only access to the Interest Records.
Users will be unable to view Account records that have a related Account Interest record.
Users will be unable to view the Account Interest records or the Interest records.
Users will be able to view the Account Interest record, but unable to view the field or any Information relating to the Interest record.

questions.reviewNote: V23.35 marca C (no se ven ni los Account Interest ni los Interest), pero los tres resolvedores ciegos coinciden en D: el registro de unión sigue visible y solo se pierde la información que viene de Interest. Los permisos de objeto son independientes: sin Read en Interest no se ve nada de Interest, pero el objeto de unión se rige por su propio permiso y por el acceso a la Account. Las explicaciones de las otras fuentes defienden C, pero son débiles. Confianza media; se cambia la clave a D.
questions.explanationEs: Los permisos de objeto se evalúan por objeto: sin Read en Interest, el usuario no puede ver los registros Interest ni ninguna información que venga de ellos. El registro de unión Account Interest se sigue mostrando en la Account porque se rige por su propio permiso y por el acceso a la Account, aunque sin el campo ni los datos de Interest. La Account no se bloquea, y no existe un acceso de solo lectura automático a Interest.
questions.explanationEn: Object permissions are evaluated per object: without Read on Interest, the user cannot see Interest records or any information that comes from them. The Account Interest junction record still shows on the Account because it follows its own permission and the access to the Account, although without the Interest field or data. The Account is not blocked, and there is no automatic read-only access to Interest.

questions.stem: The app builder at AW Computing needs to capture information about sales rep help requests for sales engineering. Some Opportunities are more complex and require many different requests for help. Additionally, the date of the most recent request should be displayed on the Opportunity page. What should the app builder use to accomplish this?

options.text: Opportunity with Master-detail field to custom object
Custom object with Lookup field to Opportunity
Custom object with Master-detail field to Opportunity
Opportunity with Lookup field to custom object

questions.explanationEs: Hay que crear un objeto personalizado para las solicitudes de ayuda con un Master-detail field hacia Opportunity, así una Opportunity puede tener muchas solicitudes y se puede añadir en ella un roll-up summary MAX sobre la fecha de la solicitud para mostrar la más reciente. Un objeto estándar como Opportunity no puede ser el detalle de una relación master-detail con un objeto personalizado. Con un Lookup field no hay roll-up summary estándar, por lo que no se puede mostrar la fecha más reciente.
questions.explanationEn: Create a custom object for the help requests with a Master-detail field to Opportunity, so one Opportunity can have many requests and you can add a MAX roll-up summary on the request date to show the most recent one. A standard object such as Opportunity cannot be the detail side of a master-detail relationship with a custom object. With a Lookup field there is no standard roll-up summary, so the most recent date could not be displayed.

questions.stem: An app builder has created a custom Lightning App and wants to make it available to the internal users at Universal Containers. Which two steps are necessary to accomplish this task? Choose 2 answers:

options.text: Build a Custom Tab for the app.
Add the app to a Vendor or page.
Make it the app to Static Position.

questions.reviewNote: El PDF tiene corruptas tres de las cuatro opciones. La primera dice «Asking new options.» y, según la explicación de la fuente, es «Assign the app to profiles»; no la he reescrito con textFixes porque el duplicado de FreeCram v10.8 conserva el texto corrupto y el build no podría emparejarlas. Se mantiene la clave de V23.35 (la opción corrupta de asignar la app a perfiles y la pestaña personalizada para la app). Dos de los tres resolvedores ciegos votaron por la pestaña y «Add the app to a Vendor or page», pero no pudieron leer la primera opción. Queda la duda porque las otras dos opciones corruptas («Vendor or page» y «Static Position») siguen siendo ilegibles.
questions.explanationEs: Para que los usuarios internos puedan usar una Lightning app personalizada hay que asignarla a los perfiles que deben verla (Assigned Apps / User Profiles), porque sin esa asignación no aparece en el App Launcher ni en el selector de apps; esa es la opción cuyo texto está corrupto («Asking new options»). La app también necesita una pestaña personalizada (custom tab) para su contenido, que se muestra en la barra de navegación. Añadir la app a una página no es un paso del proceso de publicación, y colocarla en una posición estática tampoco existe como mecanismo para dar acceso a los usuarios.
questions.explanationEn: To let internal users work with a custom Lightning app, it must be assigned to the profiles that should see it (Assigned Apps / User Profiles); without that assignment it does not show up in the App Launcher or the app menu. That is the choice whose text is corrupted ("Asking new options"). The app also needs a custom tab for its content, which appears in the navigation bar. Adding the app to a page is not a step in publishing an app, and placing it in a static position is not a mechanism for granting users access.

questions.stem: The app builder at Ursa Major Solar created a master-detail relationship between a parent object Galaxy__c and child object Star__c. What is the effect of creating this type of relationship if users want to report on Galaxy__c with star__c?

options.text: A Star__c report type with Galaxy__c as a field will be automatically created.
A new custom report type will need to be created for Galaxy__c with Star__c.
A Galaxy__c with Star__c report type will be automatically created.
A new custom report type will need to be created for Star__c with lookup fields from Galaxy__c.

questions.explanationEs: Al crear una relación master-detail entre Galaxy__c y Star__c, Salesforce genera automáticamente el report type estándar Galaxy__c with Star__c, que permite informar sobre el padre junto con sus hijos sin configurar nada. Por eso no hace falta crear un custom report type para esa combinación, ni uno basado en Star__c con campos de Galaxy__c. Tampoco se crea un report type de Star__c que solo incluya Galaxy__c como un campo más: el tipo automático parte del padre y le añade el hijo.
questions.explanationEn: Creating a master-detail relationship between Galaxy__c and Star__c makes Salesforce automatically generate the standard Galaxy__c with Star__c report type, so users can report on the parent together with its children with no extra setup. That is why no custom report type is needed for this combination, nor one built on Star__c with lookup fields from Galaxy__c. Salesforce also does not create a Star__c report type that merely carries Galaxy__c as a field: the automatic type starts from the parent and adds the child.

questions.stem: A Platform App Builder created multiple custom fields, page layouts, and reports in the sandbox and added them to a change set. After the change set was deployed to production, the custom fields were not displayed on the page layouts. What should the app builder do?
questions.reviewNote: La fuente V23.35 y FreeCram v3.5 marcan «Update page layout assignments» y se mantiene esa clave. Dos de los tres resolvedores ciegos votaron «Update field-level security in production». Ambas son lagunas reales de los change sets: las asignaciones de page layout a perfiles y el field-level security de los campos nuevos viajan con los perfiles, que aquí no se incluyeron. La pregunta no permite distinguirlas con total seguridad, y el enunciado habla de que los campos no aparecen en los page layouts, lo que encaja mejor con las asignaciones.
questions.explanationEs: Las asignaciones de page layout a perfiles y a record types forman parte de los metadatos del perfil, y un change set con solo campos, layouts e informes no las lleva. Tras el despliegue, los usuarios de producción siguen viendo el layout anterior y los campos nuevos no aparecen, así que hay que actualizar las page layout assignments en producción. Volver a desplegar el change set no cambia el resultado porque los componentes ya llegaron, y recrear los campos es innecesario. El field-level security es el otro punto que no se despliega solo, pero aquí el síntoma descrito es la ausencia de los campos en el layout.
questions.explanationEn: Page layout assignments to profiles and record types are part of the profile metadata, and a change set that only contains fields, layouts and reports does not carry them. After the deployment, production users still see the old layout and the new fields do not appear, so the page layout assignments must be updated in production. Redeploying the change set does not change anything because the components already arrived, and recreating the fields is unnecessary. Field-level security is the other setting that does not deploy by itself, but the symptom described here is the fields missing from the layout.

questions.stem: A new field has been added to the Applicant object that is part of an unmanaged package. A recruiter ran the Position with or without Applicants Report and noticed that the new field was missing as an option to add as a column. How should an app builder troubleshoot this issue?

options.text: Add the field to the custom report type field layout.
Adjust the field level security to include in the report type.
Check Allow Reports for the position and applicant objects.
Update the profile with the Manage Public Reports permission.

questions.explanationEs: En un custom report type, los campos que se ofrecen como columnas dependen de su field layout, así que un campo nuevo del objeto Applicant solo aparece si se añade a ese layout. La solución es editar el layout del report type y añadir el campo. El field-level security decide quién puede ver el campo, no si el report type lo ofrece. Allow Reports no aplica porque el informe ya existe y funciona con esos objetos, y Manage Public Reports solo permite gestionar informes públicos, sin tocar las columnas disponibles.
questions.explanationEn: In a custom report type, the fields offered as columns depend on its field layout, so a new field on the Applicant object only shows up if it is added to that layout. The fix is to edit the report type's layout and add the field. Field-level security decides who can see the field, not whether the report type offers it. Allow Reports does not apply because the report already exists and works with those objects, and Manage Public Reports only lets users manage public reports without affecting the available columns.

questions.stem: Which two solutions prevent a formula field from being referenced by a Roll-Up Summary field? Choose 2 answers

options.text: The NOW() function in the formula field
A cross-object workflow updating a field referenced by the formula field
The CASE() function in the formula field
A cross-object field referenced in the formula field

questions.explanationEs: Un roll-up summary solo puede resumir un formula field cuya fórmula no contenga referencias a campos de otros objetos (cross-object) ni funciones dependientes del momento actual como NOW() o TODAY(). Por eso la referencia a un campo de un objeto relacionado y la función NOW() impiden usar la fórmula en el roll-up. CASE() es una función de lógica ordinaria y no restringe nada, y una actualización entre objetos de un campo que la fórmula referencia tampoco lo impide.
questions.explanationEn: A roll-up summary field can only summarize a formula field whose formula contains no references to fields on other objects (cross-object) and no functions that depend on the current moment, such as NOW() or TODAY(). That is why a cross-object field reference and the NOW() function both stop the formula from being used in a roll-up. CASE() is an ordinary logic function and restricts nothing, and a cross-object update of a field the formula references does not prevent it either.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks wants to display 10 key fields at once in a separate section at the top of opportunity records on the desktop. Which component should an app builder add to the record page to enable this functionality?
questions.explanationEs: El Highlights Panel muestra en la parte superior de la record page los campos clave del compact layout del objeto, y un compact layout admite hasta 10 campos, justo la cifra del enunciado. Path solo presenta las etapas de un campo de lista de selección, un Accordion agrupa componentes en secciones plegables y no es un panel superior de campos clave, y un Custom Lightning Web Component supone programar algo que ya existe de forma declarativa.
questions.explanationEn: The Highlights Panel shows the key fields from the object's compact layout at the top of the record page, and a compact layout supports up to 10 fields, exactly the figure in the stem. Path only presents the stages of a picklist field, an Accordion groups components into collapsible sections and is not a top panel of key fields, and a Custom Lightning Web Component means coding something that already exists declaratively.

questions.stem: Universal Containers uses a custom picklist field Account Region on the account record. They want this region to be reflected on all related contact records and stay in sync if the value of this field changes on the Account. How should an app builder meet this requirement?

options.text: Create a picklist field called 'Account Region' on Contact object > Create a workflow rule to update this picklist field if the Account Region field on the Account is changed.
Create a formula field on the Contact object > Set the value of the formula to ISPICKVAL(Account.Account_Region__c).
Create a formula field on the Contact object > Set the value of the formula to TEXT(Account.Account_Region__c).
Create a text field called 'Account Region' on Contact object > Create a workflow ruleto update this picklist field if the Account Region field on the Account is changed.

questions.explanationEs: Un campo de fórmula en Contact con TEXT(Account.Account_Region__c) lee la región del Account padre en cada momento, así que siempre coincide con el valor actual sin automatizaciones adicionales. TEXT() es necesario porque el campo es un picklist y una fórmula no puede devolverlo tal cual. ISPICKVAL() solo devuelve verdadero o falso y no muestra la región. Un campo de texto o picklist en Contact que se actualiza con un workflow rule (herramienta retirada para automatización nueva) duplica el dato y necesita un mantenimiento aparte que la fórmula no requiere.
questions.explanationEn: A formula field on Contact with TEXT(Account.Account_Region__c) reads the parent Account's region at any moment, so it always matches the current value with no extra automation. TEXT() is needed because the field is a picklist and a formula cannot return it as is. ISPICKVAL() only returns true or false and does not show the region. A text or picklist field on Contact updated by a workflow rule (a retired tool for new automation) duplicates the data and needs separate upkeep that the formula does not.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks wants to set up a new opportunity approval process and execute various action items based on the initial submission. Which three action types should an app builder use in the approval process? Choose 3 answers
questions.explanationEs: Un approval process puede ejecutar al enviar el registro acciones de tipo Email Alert, Outbound Message, Task y Field Update. De las opciones, valen Email Alert, Outbound Message y Task. Invocable Flow no es un tipo de acción del approval process, e Invocable Process Builder tampoco: los procesos invocables pertenecen a Process Builder, una herramienta retirada, y se llaman desde otras automatizaciones, no desde un approval process.
questions.explanationEn: An approval process can run Email Alert, Outbound Message, Task and Field Update actions when the record is submitted. Of the choices given, Email Alert, Outbound Message and Task are valid. Invocable Flow is not an approval action type, and neither is Invocable Process Builder: invocable processes belong to Process Builder, a retired tool, and are called from other automations, not from an approval process.

questions.stem: The CFO of Cloud Kicks needs to sign off on any major shoe retail deal that has a discount of more than 30% before the deal can be closed. What feature would be used to handle this requirement?
questions.explanationEs: Un Approval Process (o un Flow Approval Process) envía el registro al CFO para que lo apruebe o lo rechace y puede bloquearlo mientras tanto, así que la operación con más de un 30 % de descuento no se cierra sin su visto bueno. Email Alert y Field Update son acciones que solo avisan o cambian un valor, y Workflow Rule está retirado para automatización nueva y además nunca pudo recoger una aprobación.
questions.explanationEn: An Approval Process (or a Flow Approval Process) routes the record to the CFO to approve or reject and can lock it in the meantime, so a deal with a discount above 30% can't close without sign-off. Email Alert and Field Update are actions that only notify or change a value, and Workflow Rule is retired for new automation and could never collect an approval anyway.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks received a new requirement to calculate summaries from child objects of a standard object. The team would prefer to solve this declaratively. What are two considerations an app builder should evaluate? Choose 2 answers

options.text: An app builder is unable to change a look up to a master-detail relationship.
An object can have up to two master-detail relationships.
A trigger on save or update can kick off calculations.
A value is required in all records of the lookup field prior to converting to a master-detail relationship.

questions.explanationEs: Para resumir registros hijos de forma declarativa hace falta un roll-up summary field, que exige una relación master-detail. Hay que tener en cuenta que un objeto admite hasta dos relaciones master-detail y que, antes de convertir un lookup en master-detail, todos los registros deben tener valor en ese campo lookup. Es falso que no se pueda convertir un lookup en master-detail (se puede si se cumple esa condición), y un trigger es una solución programática, no declarativa.
questions.explanationEn: Summarizing child records declaratively requires a roll-up summary field, which needs a master-detail relationship. Two points to evaluate are that an object can have up to two master-detail relationships and that, before converting a lookup to master-detail, every record must have a value in that lookup field. It is false that a lookup cannot be converted to master-detail (it can, once that condition is met), and a trigger is a programmatic solution, not a declarative one.

questions.stem: Universal Containers is setting up salesforce for the first time. Management wants the sales and marketing teams to have different navigation menus in the Salesforce1 mobile app. Which option is available to an app builder to satisfy the requirement?

options.text: Create sales and marketing profiles to ensure read access to different objects
Create roles for sales and marketing and assign a custom homepage layout for each role.
Create mobile navigation menus for both the sales and marketing profiles.
Create public groups for sales and marketing and create mobile navigation menus for each group.

questions.reviewNote: Esta versión de FreeCram v14.3 tiene otras opciones (no incluye crear apps por perfil), así que cuenta como pregunta distinta de la de V23.35. Con sus opciones, la única que da menús distintos a ventas y marketing es crear menús de navegación móvil por perfil, y dos de los tres votos ciegos coinciden. Pero la versión de V23.35 de la misma pregunta responde con apps Lightning por perfil, por lo que esta redacción parece heredada de Salesforce1 y puede no reflejar el producto actual.
questions.explanationEs: Con las opciones de esta versión, la única que permite que ventas y marketing vean menús distintos en la app móvil es crear menús de navegación móvil y asignarlos a cada perfil. Los grupos públicos no sirven para asignar menús de navegación, una página de inicio por rol no cambia el menú de la app móvil, y crear perfiles con lectura sobre distintos objetos controla permisos, no la navegación. Hoy el menú móvil se define sobre todo con las apps Lightning asignadas a perfiles, de ahí la discrepancia con otras versiones de la pregunta.
questions.explanationEn: With the choices in this version, the only one that gives sales and marketing different menus in the mobile app is creating mobile navigation menus and assigning them to each profile. Public groups cannot be used to assign navigation menus, a home page per role does not change the mobile menu, and profiles with read access to different objects control permissions, not navigation. Today the mobile menu is mostly driven by Lightning apps assigned to profiles, which explains the mismatch with other versions of this question.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks has a shipment date on each shipment that is sent out. Dispatchers need more details on the day and time the shipment was sent out. The app builder needs to change the current field type that is used from Date to Date/Time. What should the app builder be aware of when it comes to data already in the system?

options.text: Historical data will be updated to 12:00 timestamp.

questions.explanationEs: Al cambiar un campo de Date a Date/Time, Salesforce conserva la fecha de cada registro y le asigna una hora fija de 12:00 AM. Los datos históricos quedan entonces con una hora que no refleja el momento real del envío, y solo los registros nuevos tendrán la hora correcta. No se pierden datos y el nombre del campo no cambia. Tampoco es un simple cambio de etiqueta, porque los valores existentes se convierten.
questions.explanationEn: When a field is changed from Date to Date/Time, Salesforce keeps each record's date and gives it a fixed time of 12:00 AM. Historical data therefore ends up with a time that does not reflect when the shipment was actually sent, and only new records will carry the real time. No data is lost and the field name does not change. It is also not a mere label change, because the existing values are converted.

questions.stem: Sales reps at Universal Containers create multiple quotes per opportunity. What automation tool should an app builder recommend to delete rejected quotes?
questions.explanationEs: Flow es la herramienta declarativa que puede borrar registros: un record-triggered flow sobre Quote que se ejecute cuando el estado pase a Rejected (o un schedule-triggered flow) usa el elemento Delete Records. Un Approval process solo gestiona aprobaciones y una Validation rule solo impide guardar datos incorrectos; Workflow rule está retirado y, además, sus acciones nunca incluyeron borrar registros.
questions.explanationEn: Flow is the declarative tool that can delete records: a record-triggered flow on Quote that runs when the status changes to Rejected (or a schedule-triggered flow) uses the Delete Records element. An Approval process only handles approvals and a Validation rule only blocks bad data from being saved; Workflow rule is retired and its actions never included deleting records.

questions.stem: Which two places can an app builder go to see a list of available Custom Lightning components in their org? Choose 2 answers
questions.explanationEs: Lightning App Builder y Setup, en Lightning Components, son los dos sitios donde se listan los componentes Lightning personalizados de la org. Los componentes de Visualforce están en Setup, pero son otra tecnología, y el Lightning component Generator es una herramienta de desarrollo para crear código, no un listado de los componentes de la org.
questions.explanationEn: Lightning App Builder and Setup, under Lightning Components, are the two places where the org's custom Lightning components are listed. Visualforce components are in Setup but use a different technology, and the Lightning component Generator is a developer tool for creating code, not a listing of the org's components.

questions.stem: The case handling process at Universal Containers includes multiple steps Including approvals, notifications, and fields updates. To manage and evaluate all of these changes in a single save operation, an app builder wants to use Process Builder and the Advanced option to let the process evaluate a record multiple times has been selected. Which two options should the app builder avoid to prevent recursion? Choose 2 answers

options.text: Setting a criteria node to No criteria-just execute the procedure

questions.reviewNote: La pregunta trata de Process Builder, que está retirado: ya no se pueden crear procesos nuevos y hoy esta automatización se haría con un record-triggered flow. La clave (nodo sin criterios e invocable processes) es coherente con las buenas prácticas de Process Builder y con los tres resolvedores, pero solo sirve para entender procesos heredados.
questions.explanationEs: Con la opción avanzada que permite evaluar el registro varias veces, un process puede volver a dispararse a sí mismo. Hay que evitar el nodo de criterios con «No criteria—just execute the actions», que ejecuta las acciones en cada pasada, y los invocable processes, que pueden relanzar el proceso sobre el mismo registro. ISCHANGED y las sentencias IF sirven justo para limitar cuándo se cumplen los criterios, así que son la protección y no el riesgo. Process Builder está retirado y hoy esto se resolvería con un record-triggered flow.
questions.explanationEn: With the advanced option that lets a process evaluate the record multiple times, a process can trigger itself again. The app builder should avoid a criteria node set to "No criteria—just execute the actions", which runs its actions on every pass, and invocable processes, which can relaunch the process on the same record. ISCHANGED and IF statements exist precisely to limit when the criteria are met, so they are the safeguard rather than the risk. Process Builder is retired, and today this would be built with a record-triggered flow.

questions.stem: Universal Containers has the Account object's Organization-Wide Default set to Private. The marketing team owns Accounts; however, they also need to be able to see the sales team's Accounts. Both the sales and marketing teams are in completely different branches of the role hierarchy. What feature should be used to enable marketing to see sales-owned accounts.
questions.explanationEs: Con el OWD de Account en Private y los equipos en ramas distintas de la jerarquía de roles, una sharing rule es la función declarativa diseñada para extender el acceso a las cuentas de Sales hacia Marketing sin cambiar el OWD. Un public group solo agrupa usuarios y hace falta como destino dentro de la regla, pero no concede acceso por sí mismo. Flow no es la herramienta estándar para compartir registros por propietario o criterios, y Workflow Rules está retirado y no comparte registros.
questions.explanationEn: With the Account OWD set to Private and the teams in different branches of the role hierarchy, a sharing rule is the declarative feature designed to extend access to Sales-owned accounts to Marketing without changing the OWD. A public group only groups users and is needed as a target inside the rule, but it grants no access by itself. Flow is not the standard tool for sharing records by owner or criteria, and Workflow Rules is retired and does not share records.

questions.stem: An App Builder has been asked to integrate Salesforce with an external web service. The web service must be notified every time an Opportunity is Won. Which two can satisfy this requirement?

options.text: Use a workflow rule and an outbound message
Use a flow and an outbound message
Use a process and Apex Code
Use a process and an outbound message

questions.reviewNote: Las dos respuestas correctas dependen de funciones retiradas (Workflow Rules y Process Builder), por lo que ya no son la elección actual: hoy se usaría un record-triggered flow con una acción de Apex o External Services. Los tres resolvedores ciegos votaron «process + outbound message», pero Process Builder no ofrece la acción de outbound message (es exclusiva de las Workflow Rules), así que la clave decidida es «workflow rule + outbound message» y «process + Apex code». Coincide con lo que dice la propia explicación de la fuente, aunque su clave está oculta en el PDF.
questions.explanationEs: Una workflow rule puede enviar un outbound message al endpoint del servicio externo cuando la Opportunity pasa a Won, y un process puede invocar Apex para hacer la llamada al servicio web. Process Builder no tiene acción de outbound message (solo las Workflow Rules la tienen), por lo que «process + outbound message» no es posible, y la combinación con flow tampoco era válida cuando se redactó la pregunta. Workflow Rules y Process Builder están retirados: hoy se resolvería con un record-triggered flow que llame a Apex o use External Services.
questions.explanationEn: A workflow rule can send an outbound message to the external service's endpoint when the Opportunity becomes Won, and a process can invoke Apex to make the call to the web service. Process Builder has no outbound message action (only workflow rules do), so a process with an outbound message is not possible, and the flow combination was not valid when the question was written. Workflow Rules and Process Builder are retired: today this would be built with a record-triggered flow that calls Apex or uses External Services.

questions.stem: Universal Containers has a customer base where many customers have the same or similar company names. Which functionality should be configured to improve an end user's search experience? Choose 2 answers

options.text: Update the account search layout's view filter settings.
Update the account search layouts search results columns displayed.
Update the account search filter fields.
Update the account search layouts accounts tab columns displayed.

questions.explanationEs: Cuando muchos clientes tienen nombres iguales o parecidos, el usuario necesita ver datos que los distingan. Añadir campos como ciudad o propietario a las columnas de los search results lo permite directamente en los resultados, y los search filter fields dejan acotar la búsqueda por esos mismos campos. Los ajustes de view filter y las columnas de la pestaña Accounts no influyen en cómo se busca ni en qué se muestra al buscar.
questions.explanationEn: When many customers have the same or similar names, users need to see data that tells them apart. Adding fields such as city or owner to the search results columns shows that data right in the results, and the search filter fields let users narrow the search by those same fields. The view filter settings and the columns of the Accounts tab do not affect how users search or what they see when they search.

questions.stem: UVC's CFO has asked that all deals with more than a 40%discount get automatically sent to the VP of Finance. He will review these deals without the sales rep needing to take action. Which two ways can this be accomplished without building code? Choose two answers

options.text: Launch a new approval process that has automatic submission enabled as an initial submission action
Create a new process with a submit for approval action to automatically submit deals for approval
Create a new approval process that has automatic submission enabled in the entry criteria
Launch a flow that uses the submit for approval action to submit deals for approval

questions.reviewNote: La fuente no muestra la clave. Se decide enviar con un flow y con un process de Process Builder, porque un approval process no tiene ningún ajuste de envío automático: sus entry criteria solo definen qué registros pueden entrar cuando alguien los envía, y las initial submission actions se ejecutan después del envío. Dos de los tres solvers eligieron la variante de entry criteria y no coincido con ellos. Como la clave incluye Process Builder, que está retirado, hoy solo el flow sigue siendo una vía válida para esta automatización.
questions.explanationEs: Un approval process no se envía solo: sus entry criteria únicamente deciden qué registros son elegibles cuando alguien los envía, y las initial submission actions se ejecutan después de que el registro ya fue enviado, así que ninguno de esos dos ajustes activa un envío automático. Para enviar sin intervención los deals con más de un 40 % de descuento hace falta una automatización declarativa que ejecute la acción Submit for Approval: un flow que use esa acción o un process de Process Builder. Process Builder está retirado, así que hoy la vía recomendada es el flow.
questions.explanationEn: An approval process does not submit records on its own: its entry criteria only decide which records are eligible when someone submits them, and the initial submission actions run after the record has already been submitted, so neither setting triggers an automatic submission. To send deals with more than a 40% discount without any user action, you need declarative automation that runs the Submit for Approval action: a flow that uses that action or a Process Builder process. Process Builder is retired, so today the recommended route is the flow.

questions.stem: An app builder created multiple custom fields, page layouts, and reports in the sandbox and added them to a change set. After the change set was deployed to production, the reports were NOT deployed. What should the app builder do?

options.text: Move the reports to the Unfiled Public Reports folder and add them to a new change set.
Move the reports from the Unfiled Public Reports folder and add them to a new change set
Recreate the reports in production. Reports are not supported in change sets
Add the reports to an unmanaged package and install the unmanaged package into production.

questions.explanationEs: Los informes guardados en la carpeta Unfiled Public Reports no se pueden incluir en un change set. La solución es sacarlos de esa carpeta, a una carpeta de informes normal, y añadirlos (o añadir la carpeta) a un nuevo change set. Moverlos hacia Unfiled Public Reports empeora el problema, porque esa es justo la carpeta que bloquea el despliegue. Los informes sí se pueden desplegar con change sets, así que recrearlos a mano en producción es innecesario, y un unmanaged package no es la vía prevista para este caso.
questions.explanationEn: Reports stored in the Unfiled Public Reports folder cannot be included in a change set. The fix is to move them out of that folder into a regular report folder and add them (or the folder) to a new change set. Moving them into Unfiled Public Reports makes things worse, because that is exactly the folder that blocks deployment. Reports can be deployed with change sets, so recreating them by hand in production is unnecessary, and an unmanaged package is not the intended route here.

questions.stem: Which three Salesforce functionalities are ignored when processing field updates in workflow rules and approval processes?
questions.reviewNote: La fuente no muestra la clave. Los tres solvers coinciden en field-level security, validation rules y asignación de valores de picklist por record type. La pregunta describe el comportamiento de las field updates de workflow rules, que están retirados para automatización nueva; el comportamiento sigue siendo cierto para las field updates de los approval processes, pero hoy la pregunta ya no refleja la práctica recomendada.
questions.explanationEs: Las field updates de workflow rules y approval processes se aplican como una actualización del sistema: no respetan el field-level security (el campo se actualiza aunque el usuario no pueda editarlo), no vuelven a ejecutar las validation rules y pueden dejar en un picklist un valor que el record type no tiene asignado. Multiple currencies y los límites de decimales y de longitud sí se tienen en cuenta: el importe se convierte según la divisa del registro y el valor se redondea o se trunca al formato del campo. Los workflow rules están retirados y hoy esta lógica se construye con flows.
questions.explanationEn: Field updates from workflow rules and approval processes run as a system update: they do not respect field-level security (the field is updated even if the user cannot edit it), they do not re-run validation rules, and they can leave a picklist with a value the record type has not been assigned. Multiple currencies and the decimal and length limits are still taken into account: amounts are converted according to the record's currency and the value is rounded or truncated to the field format. Workflow rules are retired, and today this logic is built with flows.

questions.stem: An app builder wants to show Groups as the last navigation menu item in the mobile app. However, the app builder is unable to select Groups as one of the items on the drop-down menu. What could cause this?

options.text: Groups is available in the recent section of the navigation menu.
Groups is included in the Smart Search items but unavailable on the navigation menu.
Groups is unavailable in the selected list for the navigation menu.
Groups is available in the Chatter section of the navigation menu.

questions.reviewNote: La fuente no muestra la clave y las opciones están mal redactadas. Se elige que Groups ya aparece dentro de la sección de Chatter del menú de navegación, por lo que no se ofrece como elemento independiente; es la lectura que explica el síntoma y la que apunta la explicación de la fuente. Dos de los tres solvers prefieren la opción de la «lista seleccionada», pero su redacción no explica por qué Groups no sale en el desplegable, así que la clave queda en duda.
questions.explanationEs: En el menú de navegación de la app móvil, Groups ya forma parte de la sección de Chatter, así que no se ofrece de nuevo como elemento independiente en la lista desplegable y no se puede colocar como último elemento. La sección Recent solo muestra objetos usados recientemente y Smart Search Items agrupa los objetos de búsqueda: ninguno de los dos impide elegir Groups. Que Groups no esté en la lista de elementos seleccionados es lo normal antes de añadirlo y tampoco explica el bloqueo.
questions.explanationEn: In the mobile app navigation menu, Groups is already part of the Chatter section, so it is not offered again as a standalone item in the dropdown and cannot be placed as the last menu item. The Recent section only shows recently used objects and Smart Search Items groups the searchable objects: neither of them prevents choosing Groups. Groups being absent from the selected list is normal before adding it and does not explain the block either.

questions.stem: Universal Containers wants to streamline its data capture process by linking fields together. They wish to do this so that the available value on dependents fields are driven by value selected on controlling fields. Which consideration supports the stated requirements? Choose 3 answers

options.text: The import wizard only allows value to be imported into a dependent picklist if they match the appropriate controlling field
Custom picklist field can be either controlling or dependent field
Multi select picklist can be dependent picklist but not controlling fields
Standard and custom picklist fields can be dependent fields.
Checkbox fields can be controlling fields but not dependent fields

questions.explanationEs: Un custom picklist puede ser controlling o dependent, un multi-select picklist solo puede ser dependent (nunca controlling) y un checkbox solo puede ser controlling. Los standard picklists pueden ser controlling pero no dependent, así que no es cierto que cualquier picklist estándar admita ese papel. La Data Import Wizard tampoco valida la combinación entre controlling y dependent al importar, por lo que no impone que los valores coincidan con el campo controlador.
questions.explanationEn: A custom picklist can be either controlling or dependent, a multi-select picklist can only be dependent (never controlling), and a checkbox can only be controlling. Standard picklists can be controlling but not dependent, so it is not true that any standard picklist can take that role. The Data Import Wizard does not validate the controlling and dependent combination on import either, so it does not force values to match the controlling field.

questions.stem: Universal Containers wants sales reps to get permission from their managers before deleting Opportunities, What can be used to meet these requirements?

options.text: Process Builder with Submit for Approval action.
Approval Process with a triggered Flow process.
Approval Process with Time-Dependent Workflow action.

questions.reviewNote: La fuente marca «Two-step Approval Process», pero un approval process, por muchos pasos que tenga, solo enruta la aprobación y no puede borrar el registro ni interceptar el borrado. Las tres votaciones ciegas coinciden en Approval Process con un Flow, que es el patrón declarativo real: la aprobación se pide y un flow borra la Opportunity una vez aprobada. La explicación de la fuente justifica la clave diciendo que el approval process «requiere dos niveles antes de borrar», algo que la plataforma no hace. Es una variante de la pregunta de V23.35 con otros distractores (Process Builder, Time-Dependent Workflow), por eso no se trata como duplicado.
questions.explanationEs: Salesforce no permite poner una aprobación directamente sobre el borrado, así que se combina un approval process, con el que el manager aprueba la solicitud de borrado, con un Flow que elimina la Opportunity una vez aprobada. Un approval process de dos pasos solo enruta la aprobación y no borra nada por sí mismo. Process Builder y las acciones de workflow dependientes del tiempo están retirados para automatización nueva y, además, no pueden retener un borrado a la espera de aprobación.
questions.explanationEn: Salesforce cannot put an approval directly on a delete, so you combine an approval process, where the manager approves the deletion request, with a Flow that removes the Opportunity once it is approved. A two-step approval process only routes the approval and deletes nothing by itself. Process Builder and time-dependent workflow actions are retired for new automation and also cannot hold a delete pending approval.

questions.stem:
Ursa Major Solar (UMS) has a custom object where they track Galactic Vendors. The object has four custom fields for the Galactic Vendor's location: Street (Street__c)
City (City__c)
Planet (Planet__c)
Galaxy (Galaxy__c) The UMS's leadership wants these fields to be concatenated into a single formula field on two lines. Which formula fulfills this requirement?
questions.explanationEs: En una fórmula de texto, el operador & concatena valores y BR() inserta un salto de línea, así que Street__c & BR() & City__c & ", " & Planet__c & " " & Galaxy__c muestra la calle en una línea y "City, Planet Galaxy" en la siguiente. Las fórmulas deben usar los API names de los campos personalizados con el sufijo __c; sin él, la fórmula no se puede guardar. Las dos opciones que solo listan los nombres en líneas separadas no son fórmulas.
questions.explanationEn: In a text formula, the & operator concatenates values and BR() inserts a line break, so Street__c & BR() & City__c & ", " & Planet__c & " " & Galaxy__c shows the street on one line and "City, Planet Galaxy" on the next. Formulas must use the API names of custom fields with the __c suffix; without it the formula cannot be saved. The two options that just list the names on separate lines are not formulas.

questions.stem: The developer at Universal Containers wants to test code in a sandbox environment. In order to ensure the code works properly, the sandbox needs to have at least half a gigabyte of dat a. The sandbox will need to be refreshed after each three-day sprint. What type of sandbox should the App Builder provision to the developer?
questions.explanationEs: Un Developer Pro sandbox ofrece 1 GB de almacenamiento de datos y se puede refrescar una vez al día, así que cubre el medio gigabyte necesario y permite refrescar tras cada sprint de tres días. Un Developer sandbox solo tiene 200 MB. Un Partial Data sandbox solo puede refrescarse cada 5 días, por lo que no sirve para un sprint de tres días, y un Full Copy sandbox solo cada 29 días y es innecesariamente grande para este caso.
questions.explanationEn: A Developer Pro sandbox provides 1 GB of data storage and can be refreshed once a day, so it covers the half gigabyte needed and allows a refresh after every three-day sprint. A Developer sandbox only has 200 MB. A Partial Data sandbox can only be refreshed every 5 days, which does not fit a three-day sprint, and a Full Copy sandbox can only be refreshed every 29 days and is needlessly large for this case.

questions.stem: DreamHouse Realty (DR) has many properties for sale and wants to identify the highest value of all Offer__c records on each Property__c record. What solution should the app builder use to meet DreamHouse Realty's needs?
questions.explanationEs: Para obtener el valor máximo de los registros Offer en Property hace falta un roll-up summary field con MAX en Property, y eso solo existe cuando Offer es hijo en una relación master-detail. Por eso la opción válida es el objeto hijo en master-detail. Un lookup no admite roll-up summary fields, y Text Area (Long) y Multi-select Picklist son campos de entrada que no calculan nada.
questions.explanationEn: To get the highest value of the Offer records on Property you need a roll-up summary field using MAX on Property, and that only exists when Offer is the child in a master-detail relationship. That is why the master-detail child object is the workable choice. A lookup cannot hold roll-up summary fields, and Text Area (Long) and Multi-select Picklist are input fields that calculate nothing.

questions.stem: DreamHouse Realty is building a custom Lightning app to track its expanding solar water collection business. The Lightning app currently contains a custom Lightning record page with standard components. From which two resources should an app builder get custom components to bring into the new Lightning app? Choose 2 answers
questions.explanationEs: Entre estas opciones solo dos pueden aportar componentes a una Lightning page: AppExchange, con componentes empaquetados listos para instalar, y Visualforce, cuyas páginas se pueden mostrar dentro de una Lightning page con el componente estándar de Visualforce. Import Wizard solo importa datos y Apex Code es lógica de servidor, no un componente de interfaz.
questions.explanationEn: Of these choices only two can bring components into a Lightning page: AppExchange, with packaged components ready to install, and Visualforce, whose pages can be shown inside a Lightning page through the standard Visualforce component. The Import Wizard only imports data, and Apex Code is server-side logic rather than a UI component.

questions.stem: Universal Containers uses a private sharing model on Accounts. User A and user B both own Accounts of their own and have both been sent a new account record in an email owned by user C to take a look at. User A is able to open and view the record but user B receives an insufficient privileges error. User A and user B have the same role in the role hierarchy as user C. What are the three reasons user A has access but user B is unable to access the record? Choose 3 answers

options.text: User A is on the same account team as user C.
User A and user B have different profiles.
User C has manually shared the record with user A.
User A was granted an additional permission set.
User A is in a public group that has access via a sharing rule.

questions.explanationEs: Con Account en Private y los tres usuarios en el mismo role, el acceso del usuario que sí entra tiene que venir de una compartición explícita de ese registro: pertenecer al account team, que el propietario haya hecho un manual share o estar en un public group incluido en una sharing rule. Una diferencia de profile o un permission set adicional no explican por sí solos el acceso a un registro concreto, salvo que concedan View All o Modify All sobre Account, algo que el enunciado no indica.
questions.explanationEn: With Account set to Private and all three users in the same role, the access of the user who gets in must come from explicit sharing of that record: membership in the account team, a manual share by the owner, or membership in a public group targeted by a sharing rule. A difference in profile or an extra permission set does not by itself explain access to one specific record unless it grants View All or Modify All on Account, which the question does not state.

questions.stem: Universal containers wants to ensure that they are accepting clean data from their users and verify that important fields are entered. What should an app builder recommend to meet this requirement?

options.text: Update the important fields to be required on the page layout
Make a formula field to check the format of the important fields
Create a workflow rule to check the fields are formatted correctly
Configure a validation to require a field for a specific record type

questions.explanationEs: Una validation rule que exige el campo para un record type concreto se ejecuta al guardar desde cualquier vía (interfaz, API, importaciones, Data Loader) y rechaza el registro si falta el dato. Marcar el campo como obligatorio en el page layout solo funciona en la interfaz y no cubre cargas masivas ni integraciones. Un campo de fórmula solo muestra un valor, y un workflow rule (herramienta retirada para automatización nueva) actúa después de guardar, por lo que ninguno de los dos puede impedir que se guarden datos incorrectos.
