questions.explanationEn: A validation rule that requires the field for a specific record type runs on save from any entry point (UI, API, imports, Data Loader) and rejects the record when the value is missing. Making the field required on the page layout only works in the UI and does not cover bulk loads or integrations. A formula field only displays a value, and a workflow rule (a retired tool for new automation) acts after the record is saved, so neither can stop bad data from being saved.

questions.stem: When a sales rep submits an account for approval, Universal Containers wants the user to answer additional questions via a popup window to populate additional record fields. What should an app builder use to achieve the desired result?

options.text: Custom picklist field and Process Builder

questions.explanationEs: Un custom button que lanza un Flow (de tipo Screen Flow) abre la ventana emergente donde el usuario responde las preguntas y se rellenan los campos del registro. Process Builder está retirado y además se ejecuta en segundo plano sin interactuar con el usuario, así que no puede mostrar un popup, y combinarlo con un Lightning component o con un picklist custom tampoco crea esa ventana de preguntas.
questions.explanationEn: A custom button that launches a Flow (a Screen Flow) opens the popup where the user answers the questions and the record fields get filled in. Process Builder is retired and runs in the background without user interaction, so it cannot show a popup, and pairing it with a Lightning component or a custom picklist does not create that question window either.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks wants to know the total value of all won Opportunities for Accounts and display it on the record. What type of summary should the app builder use in the roll-up summary field?
questions.reviewNote: Premisa dudosa en la práctica: un roll-up summary nativo exige una relación master-detail y Account-Opportunity es un lookup. La respuesta que pretende el examen (Sum) no cambia. Es una pregunta distinta de ab-v2335-251 porque las opciones no son las mismas.
questions.explanationEs: Para obtener el valor total de las oportunidades ganadas hay que usar un roll-up summary de tipo Sum sobre el campo Amount, con un filtro que deje solo las ganadas. Count únicamente cuenta registros, y Min y Max devuelven un solo valor (el menor o el mayor), no la suma. Matiz: un roll-up nativo necesita master-detail y Account-Opportunity es un lookup, así que en la práctica haría falta un flow u otra herramienta, pero el tipo que pide el examen es Sum.
questions.explanationEn: To get the total value of the won opportunities you use a roll-up summary of type Sum on the Amount field, with a filter that keeps only the won ones. Count only counts records, and Min and Max return a single value (the smallest or the largest), not the sum. Caveat: a native roll-up needs a master-detail relationship and Account-Opportunity is a lookup, so in practice a flow or another tool would be needed, but the type the exam expects is Sum.

questions.stem: Accounts at Universal Containers are currently readable by all users but editable only by their owners. Management wants to designate some Accounts as VIP Accounts. Only Account owners should have read access to these VIP accounts. Which two actions should an app builder take to meet the requirements? Choose 2 answers
questions.explanationEs: Con el OWD de Account en Public Read Only no se puede ocultar ningún registro, porque las sharing rules solo amplían el acceso. Hay que cambiar el OWD de Account a Private, de modo que solo el propietario (y la jerarquía de roles) vea cada cuenta, y después crear una criteria-based sharing rule que comparta en solo lectura con todos los usuarios las cuentas que no son VIP. Un permission set no controla el acceso a nivel de registro y un Account Team da acceso adicional, no lo restringe.
questions.explanationEn: With the Account OWD set to Public Read Only no record can be hidden, because sharing rules can only widen access. You have to change the Account OWD to Private, so only the owner (and the role hierarchy) sees each account, and then create a criteria-based sharing rule that shares the non-VIP accounts with all users as read-only. A permission set does not control record-level access, and an Account Team grants extra access instead of restricting it.

questions.stem: When an opportunity close date is delayed by more than 60 days, the manager and the VP sales must approve the change. How can this requirement be met? Choose 2 answers

options.text: Build an approval process that requires unanimous approval from the manager and VP of sales.
Create a workflow rule that checks for close date less than 60 days and add an email alert.
Create a lightning process builder flow that submits the record for an approval process
Build a validation rule that does not allow a user to save the opportunity record.

questions.reviewNote: Es una versión distinta de la pregunta de V23.35 (las opciones cambian: workflow rule y Process Builder en lugar de formula field y flow). El PDF oculta la clave. Las tres votaciones ciegas coinciden en un approval process con aprobación unánime más un Process Builder que envía el registro a aprobación. Esa segunda respuesta depende de Process Builder, que está retirado para automatización nueva; hoy se haría con un record-triggered flow, que esta versión no ofrece.
questions.explanationEs: Hacen falta dos soluciones: un approval process con aprobación unánime, para que el manager y el VP aprueben el cambio, y una automatización que envíe el registro a ese proceso cuando la fecha se retrase más de 60 días; en el examen era un Process Builder. Process Builder y las workflow rules están retirados para automatización nueva, y hoy esa parte se haría con un record-triggered flow que ejecute Submit for Approval. Una workflow rule con un email alert solo avisa sin pedir aprobación, y una validation rule solo bloquea el guardado.
questions.explanationEn: Two solutions are needed: an approval process with unanimous approval so that the manager and the VP of Sales both approve the change, and an automation that submits the record to that process when the date slips by more than 60 days; on the exam this was a Process Builder. Process Builder and workflow rules are retired for new automation, so today that part would be a record-triggered flow with a Submit for Approval action. A workflow rule with an email alert only notifies and asks for no approval, and a validation rule only blocks the save.

questions.stem: Universal Containers is piloting new features in an existing sandbox and wants to prevent outbound email sends during testing. What should the app builder do to meet the requirement?

options.text: Email deliverability set to system email only.
Email relay to the configured host enabled.
Email deliverability set to no access.

questions.explanationEs: Poner el Email deliverability del sandbox en No access bloquea todos los correos salientes generados por Salesforce, que es exactamente lo que se quiere durante las pruebas. System email only sigue enviando correos del sistema, como los de restablecer contraseña o los de nuevos usuarios. La autenticación SMTP y el email relay sirven para enviar a través de un servidor externo y no impiden los envíos.
questions.explanationEn: Setting the sandbox Email deliverability to No access blocks all outbound email generated by Salesforce, which is exactly what is wanted during testing. System email only still sends system emails, such as password resets or new-user emails. SMTP authentication and email relay are for sending through an external server and do not stop emails from going out.

questions.stem: An app builder is creating a Lightning record page and has added Mobile & Lightning Actions to the page layout. What two components could be included on the layout to display the actions? Choose 2 answers
questions.explanationEs: Las acciones de la sección Salesforce Mobile and Lightning Experience Actions del page layout se muestran en el Highlights panel de la Lightning record page y en el publisher del componente Chatter. El componente Path muestra las etapas de un proceso, no acciones, y el componente Activities tiene sus propias acciones de actividad (registrar llamada, crear tarea, enviar correo) que no se configuran como las acciones de esa sección.
questions.explanationEn: The actions from the Salesforce Mobile and Lightning Experience Actions section of the page layout are displayed in the Highlights panel of the Lightning record page and in the publisher of the Chatter component. The Path component shows the stages of a process, not actions, and the Activities component has its own activity actions (log a call, new task, send email) that are not configured like the actions in that section.

questions.stem: Universal Containers wants to deliver purchased containers to remote construction address. In these cases, the customers will supply UC with the coordinates to the location. What type of field should the app builder use to capture this information?
questions.explanationEs: Cuando el cliente aporta coordenadas, el tipo de campo adecuado es Geolocation, que almacena latitud y longitud juntas y permite usar funciones de distancia y mapas. Un Text field guardaría las coordenadas como texto sin validar ni poder calcular distancias, y un Number field solo contiene un valor, no un par de coordenadas. External Lookup relaciona con registros de un objeto externo y no es un tipo para datos de posición.
questions.explanationEn: When the customer supplies coordinates, the right field type is Geolocation, which stores latitude and longitude together and supports distance functions and maps. A Text field would keep the coordinates as unvalidated text with no distance calculation, and a Number field holds a single value rather than a coordinate pair. External Lookup relates to records of an external object and is not a type for position data.

questions.stem: universal containers has 20 different workflows on the opportunity object. To ensure that updates are processing properly for all field updates uc has the re-evaluete workflow rules after field change checkbox checked. Recently after adding a new workflow, users have reported receiving errors about workflow limits. What should a app builder look at so address this?

options.text: Talk to a developer about apex code issues
Number of workflows per object limits
Workflows that cause each other to fire back and forth recursively
Workflows on other objects that are being re triggered

questions.reviewNote: La fuente no muestra la clave. Los tres solvers coinciden en la recursividad entre workflows. La pregunta solo tiene sentido con workflow rules, que están retirados para automatización nueva; hoy el equivalente se resuelve con flows.
questions.explanationEs: Con Re-evaluate Workflow Rules After Field Change marcado, una field update vuelve a evaluar los workflow rules del objeto, así que dos workflows pueden dispararse mutuamente una y otra vez hasta superar los límites y provocar errores. Tener 20 workflows está muy por debajo del límite de workflow rules por objeto, por lo que el número de workflows no es la causa. Un problema de Apex no encaja, porque los errores vienen de los propios workflows. Los workflow rules están retirados y hoy esta lógica se construye con flows.
questions.explanationEn: With Re-evaluate Workflow Rules After Field Change checked, a field update evaluates the object's workflow rules again, so two workflows can trigger each other back and forth until they exceed the limits and raise errors. Having 20 workflows is far below the limit of workflow rules per object, so the number of workflows is not the cause. An Apex problem does not fit, because the errors come from the workflows themselves. Workflow rules are retired, and today this logic is built with flows.

questions.stem: Universal Containers would like to automatically assign a specific permission set to new users. How can this requirement bemet? Choose 2 Answers

options.text: Create an approval process on the User object to assign a permission set
Create a flow on the user object to assign a permission set.
Create a lightning process on the user object to launch a flow.
Create a workflow rule on the User object to assign a permission set.

questions.reviewNote: La fuente no muestra la clave. Los tres solvers coinciden en el flow sobre User y en el process (Process Builder) que lanza un flow. Como la clave incluye Process Builder, que está retirado, hoy solo el flow sigue siendo una vía válida.
questions.explanationEs: Un record-triggered flow sobre el objeto User puede crear el registro de asignación del permission set cuando se crea un usuario, y un process de Process Builder sobre User puede lanzar un flow que haga lo mismo. Un approval process no tiene ninguna acción que asigne permission sets, y las acciones de un workflow rule (field update, email alert, task, outbound message) tampoco lo permiten. Process Builder y los workflow rules están retirados, así que hoy la vía correcta es el flow.
questions.explanationEn: A record-triggered flow on the User object can create the permission set assignment record when a user is created, and a Process Builder process on User can launch a flow that does the same. An approval process has no action that assigns permission sets, and the actions of a workflow rule (field update, email alert, task, outbound message) cannot do it either. Process Builder and workflow rules are retired, so today the right route is the flow.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks (CK) keeps track of its shoe inventory in Salesforce. When an order's status is changed to Activated, the inventory for the ordered shoe is reduced. At that point, a SOAP web service on the CK website must be called so that the website is updated to display the correct inventory amount for the shoe. What should an app builder use to communicate to the CK web service when a shoe's inventory has changed?
questions.reviewNote: La fuente no muestra la clave. Se decide Workflow rule (outbound message, que envía un mensaje SOAP), que es la respuesta de la época del examen y la que dan dos de los tres solvers; la explicación de la fuente apunta al after-save flow. Como la clave depende de Workflow rules, que están retirados, hoy la vía recomendada sería un after-save record-triggered flow con un callout (HTTP callout o acción de Apex).
questions.explanationEs: Un outbound message es una acción de Workflow rule que envía un mensaje SOAP a un endpoint externo cuando se cumplen los criterios, y eso encaja con un web service SOAP del sitio de CK que debe enterarse del cambio de inventario. Process Builder no tiene una acción de outbound message nativa, y un before-save record-triggered flow no puede hacer llamadas externas porque solo modifica el propio registro antes de guardarlo. Los Workflow rules están retirados: hoy se resolvería con un after-save record-triggered flow que lance un callout.
questions.explanationEn: An outbound message is a Workflow rule action that sends a SOAP message to an external endpoint when the criteria are met, which fits a SOAP web service on the CK website that must learn about the inventory change. Process Builder has no native outbound message action, and a before-save record-triggered flow cannot make external calls because it only changes the triggering record before it is saved. Workflow rules are retired: today this would be built with an after-save record-triggered flow that makes a callout.

questions.stem: DreamHouse Realty requires that field value changes for certain fields such as Asking_Price__c and Real_Estate_Agent__c on their House__c custom object show up prominently on Chatter. What Chatter feature should the app builder utilize?
questions.explanationEs: Feed Tracking se configura por objeto en Setup y publica automáticamente en el feed de Chatter del registro los cambios de los campos seleccionados, como Asking_Price__c y Real_Estate_Agent__c. Thanks sirve para reconocer públicamente el trabajo de un compañero, Topics etiqueta y agrupa publicaciones y Publisher Actions son acciones que el usuario ejecuta a mano; ninguna registra cambios de valores de campos.
questions.explanationEn: Feed Tracking is configured per object in Setup and automatically posts changes to the selected fields, such as Asking_Price__c and Real_Estate_Agent__c, to the record's Chatter feed. Thanks is for publicly recognizing a coworker, Topics tag and group posts, and Publisher Actions are actions a user runs manually; none of them records field value changes.

questions.stem: What are two capabilities of Schema Builder? Choose 2 answers

options.text: Showing selected objects on a page
Viewing page layouts in a new window

questions.reviewNote: La fuente no muestra la clave. Dos de tres solvers eligen crear un record type y mostrar objetos en el lienzo; no coincido, porque Schema Builder crea objetos, campos y relaciones pero no record types (eso se hace en Object Manager). Mostrar solo los objetos seleccionados en el lienzo es seguro. Para la segunda respuesta la más defendible es la edición de custom settings (la explicación de la fuente también la incluye), pero el enunciado es débil y no puedo confirmarlo con certeza.
questions.explanationEs: Schema Builder permite elegir qué objetos se muestran en el lienzo, así que puedes ver solo los que te interesan, y la clave aceptada para esta pregunta incluye además la edición de custom settings. Crear un record type y abrir page layouts son tareas de Object Manager, no de Schema Builder, que se centra en crear y relacionar objetos y campos y en visualizar el esquema.
questions.explanationEn: Schema Builder lets you choose which objects appear on the canvas, so you can view only the ones you care about, and the accepted key for this question also includes editing custom settings. Creating a record type and opening page layouts are Object Manager tasks, not Schema Builder ones, since Schema Builder focuses on creating and relating objects and fields and on visualizing the schema.

questions.stem: Universal Containers has a new custom object for Invoices that includes an Invoice Number field. Before the Invoice object can be used, invoices will be migrated from an external system maintaining their current Invoice Number. After the migration, salesforce will be the system of record and each new Invoice created in Salesforce must have a unique Invoice Number. How should the app builder configure the Invoice Number field?

options.text: Create a Text filed for the original Invoice Number and an AutoNumber field for the Salesforce Invoice Number.
Create a Text field and mark it as a unique external ID field.
Create a Text field, then change it to AutoNumber after the migration.
Create an AutoNumber field and migrate the Invoices

questions.explanationEs: Un Text field marcado como Unique External ID permite cargar los números de factura actuales tal cual en la migración y, después, garantiza que cada nueva factura tenga un valor único. Un AutoNumber field genera sus valores solo y no admite importar los antiguos, y un Text field no se puede convertir en AutoNumber después. Tener dos campos, uno de texto y otro AutoNumber, complica el modelo sin necesidad y no cumple que haya un único Invoice Number.
questions.explanationEn: A Text field marked as a Unique External ID lets you load the existing invoice numbers as they are during the migration and then guarantees that each new invoice has a unique value. An AutoNumber field generates its own values and cannot accept the old ones, and a Text field cannot be converted to AutoNumber afterwards. Keeping two fields, one Text and one AutoNumber, needlessly complicates the model and does not give a single Invoice Number.

questions.stem: A new app builder on the Cloud Kicks team is getting familiar with relationships in the data model. What functionality would present the app builder a comprehensive view of all relationships in one picture?
questions.explanationEs: Schema Builder muestra en un solo lienzo los objetos y las relaciones entre ellos, y permite arrastrarlos y filtrarlos, por lo que da la vista de conjunto que necesita quien se familiariza con el modelo de datos. Lightning Object Creator sirve para crear una app a partir de una hoja de cálculo, Object Manager lista objetos y sus campos de uno en uno, y una Lightning Record Page solo personaliza cómo se ve un registro.
questions.explanationEn: Schema Builder shows objects and the relationships between them on a single canvas that you can drag and filter, giving the overview someone learning the data model needs. Lightning Object Creator builds an app from a spreadsheet, Object Manager lists objects and their fields one at a time, and a Lightning Record Page only customizes how a record looks.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks works on an annual subscription model. When a sales rep marks an opportunity as closed won, a new opportunity should automatically be created for the renewal. The contracts team works outside of Salesforce but also needs to be notified about closed deals in order to initiate the contract process with the customer. Which automation solution would meet these requirements?
questions.reviewNote: La fuente espera Process Builder (crear la Opportunity de renovación y enviar un email alert). Process Builder y Workflow Rules están retirados para automatización nueva; hoy la respuesta sería un record-triggered flow, que esta versión de la pregunta no ofrece. Es una pregunta distinta de la de V23.35 porque las opciones cambian.
questions.explanationEs: En su época la respuesta era Process Builder: podía crear la Opportunity de renovación al pasar a Closed Won y enviar un email alert al equipo de contratos. Hoy Process Builder está retirado y lo correcto sería un record-triggered flow. Workflow Rule nunca pudo crear registros, un Approval Process solo gestiona aprobaciones y una Validation Rule únicamente bloquea guardados.
questions.explanationEn: In its day the answer was Process Builder: it could create the renewal Opportunity when the record became Closed Won and send an email alert to the contracts team. Process Builder is now retired and the right choice today would be a record-triggered flow. A Workflow Rule could never create records, an Approval Process only handles approvals, and a Validation Rule only blocks saves.

questions.stem: The convert button on leads should NOT appear until the lead status picklist is set to a qualified. What should an app builder suggest to meet these requirements?

options.text: Picklist dependency, page layouts, record types
Custom button, validation rule, record types
Process builder field update, quick action, record type
Page layout, record types, process builder field update

questions.reviewNote: La fuente no muestra la clave. Los tres solvers coinciden en la combinación page layout, record types y field update de Process Builder, y es la que tiene sentido: la explicación de la fuente (custom button y validation rule) no resuelve el requisito. Como la clave depende de Process Builder, que está retirado, hoy el cambio de record type al llegar a Qualified se haría con un record-triggered flow.
questions.explanationEs: El botón Convert es un botón estándar que se añade o se quita en el page layout. Se crea un record type para los leads cualificados con un page layout que incluye Convert, y el resto de leads usa un layout sin él. Una field update de Process Builder cambia el record type cuando el Status pasa a Qualified. Una picklist dependency, un custom button o una quick action no controlan cuándo aparece el botón estándar, y Process Builder está retirado: hoy lo haría un record-triggered flow.
questions.explanationEn: The Convert button is a standard button that is added to or removed from the page layout. A record type is created for qualified leads with a page layout that includes Convert, while other leads use a layout without it. A Process Builder field update switches the record type when Status becomes Qualified. A picklist dependency, a custom button or a quick action do not control when the standard button appears, and Process Builder is retired: today a record-triggered flow would do it.

questions.stem: Universal Containers uses Contracts for agreements with customers. A sales manager is required to provide approval for contracts and director approval for any contract over $10,000. Which two options should an app builder use to ensure all contracts route for the correct approval and also prevent the sales rep from making changes to the record while it is being approved? Choose 2 answers

options.text: Create an approval process on the Contract object with criteria set on a second approval step set as 'Amount__c > 10,000' and set the approver as director.
Create an approval process on the Contract object and set the field for 'Next Automated Approver Determined By' as Manager'.
Create a validation rule on the Contract object that prevents updates to the contract record while it is being reviewed.
Create an approval process on the Contract object with one step for each sales manager that sets the approver as the director.

questions.reviewNote: La fuente no muestra la clave. Dos de tres solvers eligen el paso del director por importe y el aprobador determinado por el Manager; el tercero cambia este último por la validation rule. Decido el paso por importe y el aprobador por Manager porque Salesforce bloquea automáticamente el registro mientras está en aprobación, así que la validation rule es redundante y es la única respuesta que sobra. Queda como dudosa porque la fuente podría esperar la validation rule.
questions.explanationEs: Un approval process en Contract con un primer paso cuyo aprobador sale del Manager del usuario envía cada contrato al sales manager, y un segundo paso con el criterio Amount__c > 10,000 añade al director solo cuando corresponde. Mientras un registro espera aprobación, Salesforce lo bloquea automáticamente para los demás usuarios, así que no hace falta una validation rule para impedir los cambios. Un paso por cada sales manager con el director como aprobador mandaría todo al director sin filtrar por importe y obligaría a mantener un paso por manager.
questions.explanationEn: An approval process on Contract whose first step takes the approver from the user's Manager sends every contract to the sales manager, and a second step with the criteria Amount__c > 10,000 adds the director only when needed. While a record is waiting for approval, Salesforce locks it automatically for other users, so no validation rule is needed to block changes. One step per sales manager with the director as approver would send everything to the director regardless of amount and would require maintaining one step per manager.

questions.stem: A user is unable to use inline editing on a list view. A quick check verifies the user should be able to perform inline editing as they have been assigned the appropriate permissions. Which two conditions should the app builder review? Choose 2 answers

options.text: If the list view restricts sharing for the user
If the list view selected is the recently viewed list view
If the list view contains a chart created by the user
If the list view contains more than one record type

questions.explanationEs: Dos condiciones bloquean la inline editing en una list view: que sea la list view Recently Viewed, que no admite edición en línea, y que contenga más de un record type, porque cada tipo puede tener campos y valores distintos. Las restricciones de sharing solo limitan qué filas ve el usuario, no la función de editar en línea, y un gráfico en la list view tampoco la impide.
questions.explanationEn: Two conditions block inline editing in a list view: the list view being Recently Viewed, which does not support inline editing, and the list view containing more than one record type, because each type can have different fields and values. Sharing restrictions only limit which rows the user can see, not the inline editing feature itself, and a chart on the list view does not block it either.

questions.stem: After universal containers converted qualified leads. Sales reps need to be able to report on converted leads. How should an app builder support for this requirement?

options.text: Enable preserve lead status in the lead conversion settings
Assign the representative view and edit converted leads permission
Ensure the representative has read access to the original lead records
Create a custom report type with converted leads as the primary object

questions.reviewNote: La fuente no muestra la clave. Dos de tres solvers eligen el permiso View and Edit Converted Leads; el tercero duda y la explicación de la fuente propone un custom report type, lo que no tiene sentido porque ya existe el report type estándar Leads with Converted Lead Information. Decido el permiso, pero queda como dudosa porque el enunciado es ambiguo y no puedo confirmar con certeza qué espera el examen.
questions.explanationEs: Los leads convertidos quedan fuera del alcance normal de los usuarios, y el permiso View and Edit Converted Leads es el que les da acceso a ellos, de modo que los sales reps puedan verlos e informar sobre ellos. Preserve lead status solo conserva el valor del campo Status al convertir, no cambia quién ve los leads convertidos. Tener acceso de lectura a los leads originales no basta, y no hace falta un custom report type porque ya existe un report type estándar para leads convertidos.
questions.explanationEn: Converted leads fall outside users' normal reach, and the View and Edit Converted Leads permission is what gives them access, so sales reps can see them and report on them. Preserve lead status only keeps the Status field value at conversion and does not change who can see converted leads. Read access to the original lead records is not enough, and no custom report type is needed because a standard report type for converted leads already exists.

questions.stem: Universal Containers uses a private sharing model for opportunities. This model CANNOT be changed due to a regional structure. A new sales operations team has been created. This team needs to perform analysis on Opportunity data, all should have read and write access to all Opportunities. What are two recommended solutions for the app builder to give the users appropriate access? Choose 2 answers

options.text: Create a criteria-based sharing rule to all opportunities with the sales operations public group.
Add a manual share for all opportunities with each user on the sales operations team.
Add a permission set with 'View All" and 'Modify All'' opportunity permissions enabled.
Create a criteria-based sharing rule to share all opportunities with the sales operations private group

questions.explanationEs: Como el organization-wide default de Opportunity no se puede cambiar, el acceso extra se concede por otras vías: un criteria-based sharing rule que comparta todas las Opportunities con el public group de sales operations en read/write, o un permission set con View All y Modify All en Opportunity, que da ese acceso sin tocar el modelo de compartición. Los manual shares uno a uno no escalan ni se mantienen solos, y los sharing rules no usan un grupo privado: se comparten con public groups, roles o queues.
questions.explanationEn: Because the Opportunity organization-wide default cannot be changed, the extra access has to come from other places: a criteria-based sharing rule that shares all Opportunities with the sales operations public group at read/write, or a permission set with View All and Modify All on Opportunity, which grants that access without touching the sharing model. One-by-one manual shares do not scale and are not maintained automatically, and sharing rules do not target a private group: they share with public groups, roles or queues.

questions.stem: Universal Containers' app builder has been tasked with replacing workflow rules and Apex triggers with Process Builders where possible. What are two important considerations an app builder should know before the project is started? Choose 2 answers

options.text: Apex has a different SOQL query limit than Flow.
Create a process for each workflow rule.

questions.reviewNote: La fuente no muestra la clave. Los tres solvers coinciden en evitar bucles infinitos y combinar acciones. La pregunta trata de migrar a Process Builder, que está retirado, y sus respuestas correctas son buenas prácticas de ese producto; hoy el mismo consejo se aplica a los record-triggered flows.
questions.explanationEs: Al sustituir workflow rules y Apex triggers por Process Builder hay que evitar bucles infinitos, porque un proceso que actualiza un registro puede volver a dispararse a sí mismo o disparar a otro proceso, y conviene combinar acciones en el mismo proceso en lugar de repetir criterios. Crear un proceso por cada workflow rule es justo lo que se desaconseja, y Apex y Flow no tienen un límite de SOQL distinto porque comparten los límites de la transacción. Process Builder está retirado: hoy el mismo consejo vale para los record-triggered flows.
questions.explanationEn: When replacing workflow rules and Apex triggers with Process Builder you must avoid infinite loops, because a process that updates a record can retrigger itself or fire another process, and you should combine actions in the same process instead of repeating criteria. Creating one process per workflow rule is exactly what is discouraged, and Apex and Flow do not have a different SOQL limit because they share the transaction limits. Process Builder is retired: today the same advice applies to record-triggered flows.

questions.stem: The app builder needs to change the data types of new custom fields. The app builder is not able to delete and recreate any of the fields, nor modify any apex code. Which data type change will require the app builder to perform the additional steps in order to retain existing functionalities?

options.text: Changing the data type of a field used in an apex class from number to text.
Changing the data type of a field used in a report from a text to an encrypted field
Changing the data type of a field used as an external id from number to text.
Changing the data type of a field used in lead conversion from number to text

questions.explanationEs: Cuando un campo está mapeado en lead conversion, cambiar su tipo de number a text obliga a revisar y volver a crear el mapeo de campos de la conversión para que el dato siga llegando a Account, Contact y Opportunity. Un cambio en una clase Apex queda fuera por el enunciado, que prohíbe tocar el código. Un external ID puede ser de tipo text o number, y un campo usado en un report no obliga a rehacer ninguna configuración manual al cambiar su tipo.
questions.explanationEn: When a field is mapped in lead conversion, changing its type from number to text means you must review and re-create the lead conversion field mapping so the data keeps flowing to Account, Contact and Opportunity. A change in an Apex class is ruled out by the stem, which forbids touching the code. An external ID can be of type text or number, and a field used in a report does not force you to redo any manual configuration when its type changes.

questions.stem: What option is available to an App Builder when defining an object-specific Create Record custom action? Choose 2 answers

options.text: Pre-Defining field values on the target object.
Redirecting the end user to the detail page of the target object
Specifying the fields and layout of the action.
Allowing the end user to choose the record type

questions.explanationEs: En una acción Create a Record específica de objeto, el app builder puede predefinir valores de campo en el objeto destino (por ejemplo, valores por defecto) y decidir qué campos y qué disposición tiene el formulario de la acción mediante su action layout. La redirección al registro recién creado la hace Salesforce automáticamente tras guardar y no es una opción configurable. Tampoco se deja elegir el record type al usuario final: el record type de la acción lo fija quien configura la acción.
questions.explanationEn: When defining an object-specific Create a Record action, the app builder can predefine field values on the target object (for example, default values) and decide which fields and layout the action form shows through its action layout. Redirecting to the newly created record is automatic behaviour after saving and is not a configurable option. Letting the end user choose the record type is not available either: the action's record type is set by whoever configures the action.

questions.stem: When a deal is closed- won, it has to be approved by the owner's manager prior to being added to the leaderboard for a quarterly sales competition. An opportunity is won on the last day of the quarter and the manager is on vacation. What is recommended to ensure all of the appropriate deals are reviewed and the leaderboard is up to date?

options.text: Forward the approval request to the manager's assistant.
Set up a delegated approver for the manager
Have the manager log on and reassign the approval request
Use Process Builder to assign a delegated approver.

questions.explanationEs: Configurar un delegated approver para el manager permite que otra persona apruebe o rechace en su nombre mientras está ausente, con lo que todas las solicitudes se revisan antes del cierre del trimestre. Reenviar la solicitud a la asistente no es una acción estándar del proceso de aprobación, y pedir al manager que entre y reasigne no resuelve nada si está de vacaciones. Process Builder está retirado y además no sirve para asignar delegados de aprobación.
questions.explanationEn: Setting up a delegated approver for the manager lets someone else approve or reject on the manager's behalf while the manager is away, so every request is reviewed before the quarter closes. Forwarding the request to the assistant is not a standard approval process action, and asking the manager to log in and reassign solves nothing when the manager is on vacation. Process Builder is retired and cannot assign delegated approvers anyway.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks wants to display the number of opportunities that are Closed Won with a Close Date within the last year on the Account detail page. Which tool should an app builder use to implement this?
questions.reviewNote: Premisa dudosa: la única opción viable es el roll-up summary field, pero Opportunity-Account es un lookup y un roll-up nativo no es posible en Account; en la práctica se usaría un Flow o DLRS. Process Builder y Workflow Rule están retirados y tampoco serían la solución. Se mantiene la respuesta que espera el examen.
questions.explanationEs: La respuesta que espera el examen es el roll-up summary field en Account con criterios de filtro (Closed Won y Close Date del último año) para contar las oportunidades. Process Builder y Workflow Rule están retirados y no sirven para mostrar un conteo agregado, y el Activity Timeline solo muestra actividades. Ojo: un roll-up summary exige master-detail y Opportunity se relaciona con Account por lookup, por lo que en una org real se usaría un record-triggered Flow o DLRS.
questions.explanationEn: The answer the exam expects is the roll-up summary field on Account with filter criteria (Closed Won and a Close Date in the last year) to count the opportunities. Process Builder and Workflow Rule are retired and do not provide an aggregated count, and the Activity Timeline only shows activities. Be aware that a roll-up summary requires master-detail while Opportunity relates to Account through a lookup, so in a real org you would use a record-triggered Flow or DLRS.

questions.stem: A Platform App Builder would like to simplify the user experience with customized, intuitive record pages that change based on field input. What should the app builder consider?

options.text: Create multiple Page Layouts dependent on the user.
Save a Filtered Related List for users to update records.
Leverage Screen Flows for user input.
Migrate to Dynamic Forms and create visibility rules.

questions.explanationEs: Dynamic Forms permite colocar campos y secciones directamente en la Lightning record page y aplicarles visibility rules basadas en valores de otros campos, de modo que la página cambia a medida que el usuario introduce datos. Los page layouts distintos se asignan por perfil o record type, no reaccionan a lo que se escribe en un campo. Un filtered related list solo afecta a registros relacionados, y un Screen Flow añade un paso guiado que no hace falta para adaptar los campos de la propia página.
questions.explanationEn: Dynamic Forms lets you place fields and sections directly on the Lightning record page and apply visibility rules based on the values of other fields, so the page changes as the user enters data. Different page layouts are assigned by profile or record type and do not react to what is typed in a field. A filtered related list only affects related records, and a Screen Flow adds a guided step that is unnecessary to adapt the fields of the page itself.

questions.stem: A Platform App Builder has created a custom object that should be included in Global Search results. Which step should the app builder take to ensure the results are generated in Global Search?

options.text: Create a custom tab set to Default Off.
Create a custom tab set to Hidden.

questions.reviewNote: La fuente (FreeCram v3.5) marca la pestaña personalizada en Default Off; los tres resolvedores ciegos votaron por crear un search layout. Mantengo la clave de la fuente: el search layout solo decide qué columnas se muestran en los resultados, mientras que la pestaña no oculta (con Allow Search activo en el objeto) es lo que clásicamente hace que sus registros entren en la búsqueda, y es la respuesta esperada en el examen. Duda residual: en versiones recientes lo decisivo es Allow Search, que no aparece entre las opciones.
questions.explanationEs: Para que los registros de un objeto personalizado salgan en la búsqueda global, el objeto debe permitir búsqueda y tener una pestaña que no esté oculta para el perfil del usuario; por eso sirve una pestaña personalizada con visibilidad Default Off (o Default On), pero no Hidden. El search layout solo define qué campos aparecen en los resultados, no si el objeto es buscable, y un search filter solo acota los resultados ya existentes.
questions.explanationEn: For records of a custom object to appear in Global Search, the object must allow search and have a tab that is not hidden for the user's profile; that is why a custom tab with Default Off (or Default On) visibility works, while Hidden does not. A search layout only defines which fields show in the results and does not make the object searchable, and a search filter only narrows results that already exist.
